Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Hope you like it here at McCarran.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Make yourself at home here. It's cozy... for an airport.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Checking in with the base, huh?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I can't believe it's over. I figured the Dam would fall and this place would be our last stand.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Fight's gonna break out at the Dam any time now. Feels strange not being there for it.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: The cavalry's finally here. God bless the boys in black.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Word is, our Ranger vets are finally coming up from Baja. The Legion should be pissing their togas.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: With both Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope gone, you have to wonder when McCarran's gonna get attacked.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I've always known Camp Forlorn Hope was a death sentence. I just wish I'd been wrong.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: They're saying we retook Nelson. Finally some good news.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Brotherhood's been quiet lately. Guess they finally realized Rangers beat power armor every time.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Heard the Kings have turned over a new leaf. Doesn't mean you'll see me in Freeside any time soon.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I've been seeing a lot of dead Fiends lately. Damn psychos had it coming.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Are you the one that killed Motor-Runner? Thank God. That guy was a living nightmare.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Bad time to lose Chief Hanlon. He'd have had Caesar running scared.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: The most important POW we've ever taken and he gets away. He must've had help.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: How could we fail to protect our own monorail?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Caesar's dead. So when do we go home?

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Damn that was some light show out there.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: That was blinding out there. Feels like I've been staring at the sun.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Is the plant actually working again?

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: I'm surprised they didn't send you somewhere more vital.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Wow, what are you doing at HELIOS? I feel like I should salute.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Hope you can stay. We could use your expertise here.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: What'd you do wrong to get sent here? Thought you were an up-and-comer.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Are you supporting us here? We'll take what we can get.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Welcome to HELIOS One.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: The attacks have stopped. Winning the dam saved our asses.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: We lost Forlorn Hope. The eastern front is collapsing. They'll be here next.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Thank God we took back Nelson. Now they'll have a harder time hitting us here.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Heard the Brotherhood got smoked. Guess somebody finished what we started.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: With Caesar dead, maybe they'll stop attacking us.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: This chainlink fence perimeter is worthless. We might as well be defending a cage from the inside.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: This place is off-limits to civilians. You don't like it, take it up with Lieutenant Haggerty.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: The Legion's coming for us. Just a matter of time, believe you me.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Pretty sure H.Q. has forgotten all about us.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: That scientist we hired has got to be the dumbest asshole I've ever come across.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: Who knows which side the Legion's gonna hit us from next?

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: If the Legion breaks through our defenses, I got one bullet I'm saving just for me.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: We should be up on the front lines, not out here in bumblefuck. This place is a junkyard.

Speaker: [Faction: VNCRHeliosFaction]
EN: We're supposed to be relieved any day. That's what they keep telling us. I don't think anyone's coming.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Forlorn Hope has fallen, another victory for {KAI-zar}Caesar.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: {respectful}I have heard how you cleansed Forlorn Hope of the Profligates.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Nelson, Forlorn Hope... soon {KAI-zar's}Caesar's banners shall rise on Hoover Dam.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Our march to the Dam is assured.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: With Forlorn Hope's fall, our blades are at the NCR's throat.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Our machetes ran thick with blood here.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: I hope to {KAI-zar}Caesar that the Profligates will send more victims to us.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: {contempt}The Profligates here were weak, no fight in them.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: This is only the first settlement to fall.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: {contempt}The bodies of beggars and cowards fill Nelson's streets now.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Dead Sea has erected a tribute to {KAI-zar}Caesar - made of Profligate corpses.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: When we're fortified here and reinforced, Forlorn Hope will be next.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: We kill only those who resist the will of {KAI-zar}Caesar. The rest are kept as tribute.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Some of Nelson lives on... as slaves. They are being kept nearby.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: If the rest of the Profligate settlements are as weak as this, {KAI-zar's}Caesar's victory is assured.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: This is only part of our detachment. We have others stationed nearby.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Speak to our {deh-CAN-us}Decanus, Dead Sea.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: We do not move unless Dead Sea commands it.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: {contempt}We can see the Profligate cowards stationed on the hill, afraid of us.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: You may walk here - but do not head west along the road.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: That we hold Neslon, that is {KAI-zar's}Caesar's will.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: You meet any of those Rangers dressed up in black yet? My friends say they're mutant cyborgs and they're going to kill us all!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: That new Ranger armor is downright impressive. I'd hate to be on the business end of one of their revolvers.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: We've already got people disappearing at night. I hear the NCR have veterans from out west coming to push us out of Freeside.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I've been hearing rumors of the Rangers getting some heavy reinforcements soon. Hope they don't try to start anything around here.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: The NCR must have paid off the Kings big to get them to sign up. Maybe there was an NCR mole who tricked them into it!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Good news for Freeside. The Kings have decided to work with NCR for a change.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I hear the Kings were wiped out by some kind of Super mutant ninja assassin paid by the NCR! Who else could have taken them down?!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I don't get why the Kings are dead. They weren't a bad bunch of guys.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: Some people are saying the Great Khans got drugged up out of their minds and attacked the dam.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I heard the Khans went wild at Hoover Dam. I suppose they were looking for one last blaze of glory.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I hear the Great Khans staged their own deaths to trick the NCR.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: People say the Khans got wiped out at Red Rock. That's one less bunch of crazies to worry about.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: The Great Khans aren't gone. They're just hiding, biding their time...

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: The Great Khans moved out? One less mob of degenerates to worry about, if you ask me.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: The Khans signed a treaty with NCR? I've heard some crazy rumors before, but that one's rich!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: So, the Great Khans signed up with NCR. Who would have thought those two would settle their differences?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Those sick Legion bastards had the brass balls to attack Bitter Springs? I bet that was one messy fight.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Maybe it'll be a little safer to travel, now that the Fiends' bosses are dead. We owe their killer a debt of gratitude.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I heard Motor Runner got taken down. Maybe the Fiends will finally destroy themselves now that he's gone.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I hear Hanlon was abducted by aliens and that's why he was acting so strangely. Better check yourself for strange scars.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Hanlon was apparently sabotaging NCR's efforts in the area. Now, I kind of wish he hadn't died.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I hear Hanlon was working for the aliens and NCR found out.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Chief Hanlon is dead? I hear that guy couldn't order himself out of a cardboard box, let alone command troops

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: My friends say Kimball's assassination was all an Illuminati plot to reclaim power. I say they're crazy. How do you kill someone with a flashlight?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Kimball getting killed is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: My friends say you're working for the Illuminati, and that's why you killed Kimball. Watch your back. {paranoid whisper}They have listening devices everywhere!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Killing Kimball is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: Thanks for not killing Kimball. I hear he's been working against the secret alien invasion forces above the planet. {paranoid whisper}They want to eat our brains!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: So, I hear that assassination attempt on Kimball didn't quite turn out the way you planned. Now, the NCR are going to be even pissier than usual.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: Good job saving Kimball's life. I hear he's been working against the secret alien invasion forces above the planet. {paranoid whisper}They want to eat our brains!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I suppose you did the right thing saving Kimball, even though it means we're still screwed here in Freeside.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You freed that Silus guy from McCarran? Guess you've got your reasons for helping the Legion.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I hear the monorail bombing was an alien plot. Just a few more gates to destroy and we're all trapped in here.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I guess the monorail getting bombed wasn't all bad. Freeside is getting a lot more business now.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: With the monorail down, we're going to have a lot more NCR goons wandering through here. Yay...

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: Rumor has it Mr. House joined the NCR on account of some secret love child he never even knew he had.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Never thought I'd see House settle for being an NCR lapdog. What the hell happened?

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I think Caesar was killed by alien clone agents! The Legion are just a bunch of alien slaves doing their bidding!

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: I hear Caesar had an alien brain chip in his head, but he died on the operating table when they tried to remove it.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: People say Caesar is dead. I hope someone worse doesn't replace him.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: You killed Caesar? Rumor around here has it he was struck down by a bad case of explosive diarrhea.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: All hail the slayer of Caesar! It's about time that slavemaster got his!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I don't need to read no obituary to know House was an asshole.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: With no House to boss Vegas around, the NCR's gonna want that job.

Speaker: [Faction: vFreesideLocalGossipDialogueFaction]
EN: According to the rumor mill, House is faking his death to catch the NCR off-guard.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: House dead? Good riddance.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Better give the Securitrons a wide berth if you know what's good for you. Those new upgrades look nasty.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: House must have special plans for you to get into the Lucky 38 and come out alive.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I hear you made a real mess of the Omerta's plans. Hopefully, the new management does a better job running Gomorrah.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Impressive work fighting off Benny's thugs! I know I wouldn't have survived that.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I heard you made a run on The Tops. You've got guts, kid.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Figures that Benny would run. Sorry coward's nobody without his thugs to back him.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Private Watson sure seemed excited about meeting Kimball.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: I actually got to see the President.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: I hear President Kimball had a pretty close call with some assassins.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: The death of the President is going to be a permanent blight on this place.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: If the President of our republic isn't safe here, how can we be?

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Kimball died, security seemed so tight, how could such a thing happen?

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: President Kimball is going to arrive pretty soon to give his speech and meet that wounded soldier.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: How do we know if Mr. House is really gone? No one's ever seen him in the first place!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Colonel Moore survived four tours against the Brotherhood back west. If anyone can help take on the Legion, it's her.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: You hear that rumor that Colonel Moore was kicked out of Gomorrah a while back? I heard she's had it in for the Omertas ever since.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: I'm really surprised Colonel Moore accepted the Brotherhood's help. I heard she lost a lot of men in war with them back west.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Is it true? Was there really a Brotherhood base nearby that blew sky high?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: I heard a rumor that Moore hired some mercs to wipe out the Khans. Is that such a good idea, with Bitter Springs still on peoples' minds back home?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Man, I'm exhausted. Moore's got us running drills non-stop.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Just between us, Colonel Moore scares me sometimes.

Speaker: [Faction: Caesars Legion Military Dialogue Faction]
EN: Our victory was never in question.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: How did the Legion make it into the power plant?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Let's get going!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: The Crimson Caravan's the biggest merchant outfit in the wasteland.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Damn Brahmin crap everywhere.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm glad Ringo's back. Got a good story to tell, too.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Fucking expensive to get into the Strip these days.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Keep an eye out for wildlife.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: When pay day hits, I'm off to the Strip. Can't wait.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Did you know you have a robot following you?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Whatever you're selling, we have plenty.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Keep your distance, soldier.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {suspicious}A doctor? Who's your supplier?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Idle thumbs tend to get blown off around here. Get moving.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Sorry, I've got work to take care of.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'd keep moving if I was you.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Dismissive}Go back to the Strip where you belong.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You're nothing like us, Outsider.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: We should have never let you in.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You're no different than a common Fiend.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: What are you looking at?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Keep your distance.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm not sure what to make of you, Outsider.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: What do you know about our problems?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Welcome back.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Hey there. Kill any Outsiders lately?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Jovial}You can shoot with me anytime, friend.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Always nice to see you.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Wry}Hope the trip into camp wasn't too eventful!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {friendly}Keep your head down, Outsider.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I've got my sights on you, Outsider.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Stand back where I can see you.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Saw you coming a mile away.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I actually got to fly Pearl for a little bit during that boming run. Hot damn, what an honor.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: All those hours training? Glad they finally paid off.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Did you see it? I hear the suckers burned right through their armor.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: It was wonderful seeing Pearl fly and serve the purpose she was built for.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: It's getting nasty out here. S'times like these I thank god for artillery.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: War's brewing on the horizon, plain as day.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: We've survived out here pretty well so far without any help from the outside.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You should get out of my face before you get yourself hurt.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I don't have anything to say to you, outsider.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I don't know how you survived the bombardment. That's incredible.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I don't think you should be here.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm happy you came along. You are the answer to our dreams.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You've earned our trust, now let's see if you can earn our gratitude.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I can't believe we may see the superfortress built in my lifetime.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Really? So we may see our dream of flight soon?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I hear you're going to help us, I hope you're up for the task.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm happy that we managed to raise the bomber in my lifetime.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Thank you so much for your help.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I didn't think the day would ever come, but thanks to you our dreams have come true!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm amazed that an outsider has proven so helpful.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You've given us the ability to touch the sky! Thank you.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You've done us a great service. Thank you.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You've done us a great service. Thank you for your help.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm not going to take anything from you. Leave me alone!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Hey! You tried to get me sick!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You should learn to give kids nice things... Like toys!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You're the one that tried to give me that yucky stuff.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I don't think I should talk to you. You aren't very nice.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You need to leave me alone. I don't like you anymore.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: You're lots of fun. We should play sometime.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm going to be a hero and travel the wasteland like you when I grow up.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm going to tell Mama Pearl how cool you are.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I bet you have all kinds of fun stories.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I like you, we should play sometime!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Thanks for the toy! It was great!

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: I'm going to play raise the B-29!

Speaker: Pearl
EN: I can't believe Pearl let you stay with us.

Speaker: Pearl
EN: I sure hope Pearl knows what she's doing.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: Fucking Crocker couldn't find his ass if it wasn't on his backside...

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: Don't be carrying any guns into the casino.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: {Not insulting, just commenting}You look like you just crawled out of the desert.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: {Night only}Love how this place comes alive at night.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: {Day only}You should see this place at night.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: {Rueful}Looking to lose a few caps, huh? Just the place.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: I never trusted those Omerta punks, even if I like their girls.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: I don't trust those creeps at the Ultra-Luxe.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: We need more people like you in the NCR.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: {Proud}We should straighten those thugs at Gomorrah.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: We've heard about you from the officers at our embassy.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: You're wasting no time in making a name for yourself around here, huh?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: {Subtly Fearful}The bots have enough firepower to arm a full platoon.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Surprised, then impressed}A Ranger, here in the Strip? Fine company, sir!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Matter of Fact}I won't be missing Mr. House, that's a given. The Strip's better off without him.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Satisfied}It was a matter of time before someone got to Mr. House.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Satisfied}Mr. House won't trouble our plans for the Strip any longer, huh!?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Proud}NCR should take this chance, now that Mr. House's out of the way.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Relieved}Good riddance, Caesar! We can finally enjoy some R&R without worrying about a Legion attack at McCarran.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Exuberant}Fuck that Caesar dog! I'm going to drink in your name, all night!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]

EN: {Player not in NCR gear}{pleased}A customer! Not many people come into Boulder City these days.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: This isn't a public relations office. If you're not here about a bounty, you can go pester the Colonel.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: I see you're still alive, and that's promising. Any luck on that bounty?

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: Got any more good news for me?

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: Still working on that last bounty?

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: Perimeter's been quiet since you left. The Fiends are running scared. I doubt they'll give us any more trouble, not for a long while.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: I haven't got any more bounties for you. It's been quiet and calm since you last reported in. Just how I like it.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: If you're looking for bounties, you're too late. Had a few Fiends on my shitlist, but they either got killed or moved on.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: I hear you killed Driver Nephi. My team would've liked to get a shot at him... but we're still glad he's dead.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: I'm Lieutenant Gorobets, First Recon. If you're looking to collect a bounty, you should talk to Major Dhatri.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: You came through for us. I have to admit... I wasn't sure you'd make it.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: Means a lot, letting my team get payback. Here. We all pitched in some caps for you. Even Sterling, and he's famous for his tight wallet.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: {Moving into position}We'll get ourselves into position. See you at the rock crushing plant.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: {In position}We're all set up. You just lure Nephi close.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: {First Recon member died}It's always hard to lose someone under your command. I hate writing the letter to their folks.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: What can I do for you?

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: Hey, my man! T-t-ten of spades. First Recon sharpshooter. At your s-s-service.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: Hey there, miss! T-t-ten of spades. First Recon sharpshooter. At your s-s-service.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: {Betsy dead}Can't b-b-believe Betsy's gone. S-s-she was a bitch, b-but she was my p-p-partner, you know?

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: {Gorobets dead}S-s-sucks about the {ell-TEE}LT. N-n-nobody can replace him.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: How 'bout you get out of my f-f-face? I'm First Recon. I don't need to t-take shit from civvies.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: {Moving into position}K-killing some Fiendsi? Shit, yeah! It's about t-t-time!

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: {In position}One shot, one kill. That's how Ten of Spades p-p-plays the game.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
ActorNotes: [Nephi dead, 10 of Spades didn't get a hit]
EN: {Nephi dead, 10 of Spades didn't get a hit}{disappointed}Shit. I didn't even get a shot at that Nephi b-b-bastard before he went down.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
ActorNotes: [Nephi dead, 10 of Spades got a hit]
EN: {Nephi dead, 10 of Spades got a hit}Right here, Fiends! This is what payback looks like! First Recon, hooah!

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: {Cook-Cook dead}'B-b-bout time Cook-Cook g-g-g-got what was c-coming to him.

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: You remember me, right? T-t-ten of Spades. First Recon.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {PC is female, CHA 7+}Girl... you are some grade-A poon, anybody ever tell you that?

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Female PC, CHA 7+}You keep talking to me, sweetness, and people are gonna think we're an item. Not that I mind.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Male PC}Never seen you around before. What do you want?

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Moving into position}Cut the chatter. Focus on the job, or you're gonna end up dead.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {In position}Quit talking! We've got a job to do.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Nephi dead, Betsy got a hit}You did good out there. Glad you let me get a piece of Nephi.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
ActorNotes: [Nephi dead, Betsy didn't get a hit]
EN: {Nephi dead, Betsy didn't get a hit}What a pointless trip. Here I thought I'd get a shot at that junkie bastard.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {10 of Spades dead}Damn that 10 of Spades. Just had to go and get himself killed.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Gorobets dead}Gorobets was all right - {lesbian afterthought, with some respect}for a man. Not gonna be the same without him.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: I've been seeing Usanagi, and things are better. I'm not so angry all the time, you know? And, uh, I'm not trying to jump every woman in camp.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: Well, not all the time, anyway,

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
ActorNotes: [a little subdued, but friendly - the player's helped her]
EN: {a little subdued, but friendly - the player's helped her}Hey.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Female PC}{friendly - likes women}Hey, girl. You need something from me?

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: {Male PC}{slight hostility - not fond of men}Yeah?

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
EN: {Corporal Sterling Top Level Topic Holder}

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
EN: Howdy. Name's Sterling, First Recon. Can't say I've seen you before. I'd remember, if I had.

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
ActorNotes: [Nephi dead, Sterling didn't get a hit]
EN: {Nephi dead, Sterling didn't get a hit}Took some skill to bring down that Fiend. You done good.

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
ActorNotes: [Nephi dead, Sterling got in a hit]
EN: {Nephi dead, Sterling got in a hit}Nothing like a job done right. Wish I had a cigar.

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
EN: {Moving into position}Been a while since they let us out of the fence. Brass must really want Nephi dead.

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
EN: {In position}Best you don't worry about us. We'll watch your back.

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
EN: {Gorobets dead}It's always hard when your commander goes down, but we'll pull through all right.

Speaker: Corporal Sterling
EN: Howdy. What brings you back?

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: I'm Bitter-Root. First Recon. You got a reason to talk to me?

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: {Moving into position}Can't talk now. Got to keep my eyes sharp.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: {In position}{quietly warning, it's a combat situation}Eyes sharp, now.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: {Nephi dead, Bitter-Root got a hit}Wish I'd gotten a bullet in that Fiend...

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: {Nephi dead, Bitter-Root got a hit}That's one less drugged-out waster. Best part of this job - shooting folks who deserve it.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: {Gorobets dead}I've never lost a {see-OH: commanding officer}CO before. It doesn't feel right.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: Didn't think you'd be back. What's this about?

Speaker: Little Buster
EN: Let me guess. You got work for me, right?

Speaker: Little Buster
EN: Well, you're too late - I just quit the bounty trade. Soon as I pick up some caps that Dhatri owes me, I'm out of this scrapyard.

Speaker: Little Buster
EN: {Cook-Cook dead}Heard you got Cook-Cook. I hope you roasted that bastard with his own flamer.

Speaker: Little Buster
EN: Yep, I'm still here. Shit, I got nothing better to do, right?

Speaker: Tour Guide
EN: Welcome to REPCONN Headquarters, Rocketeer! Come all this way to see our little facility, have you?

Speaker: Tour Guide
EN: I'm here to answer any and all questions you may have - within specified parameters - and if you'd like, I can provide a tour of our museum.

Speaker: Tour Guide
EN: Welcome back! Interested in a tour of the REPCONN museum? Or did you have a question about the company I could answer?

Speaker: Tour Guide
EN: Yes? Did you have a question?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: Keeping the Strip secure has been hell since the monorail was taken out.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: Did you hear about that Legion POW escape? I don't like our chances of taking him alive twice.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: They're talking about you on the radio. Saving President Kimball. I'm impressed.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: How could we lose Kimball at a time like this?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: Chief Hanlon was a model soldier. We all looked up to him.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: Too bad about Chief Hanlon. He did what he thought was best for us.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: Without Camp Forlorn Hope, it's a matter of time before the Legion surrounds us at the Dam.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: This whole war's gonna change when the Ranger veterans get here. Soon as we see the Black Armor, we can all breathe easier.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: A platoon of veteran Rangers is like a tactical nuke, only tougher to scare.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: This battle... everything's riding on it.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryOfficerDialogueFaction]
EN: That red beret's looking good, soldier.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: The security lapse with the monorail is a huge embarrassment.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: That POW escape presents some real security concerns. That was our base camp, for crying out loud.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: There's something fishy about how Chief Hanlon died. It just doesn't add up.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: Can't believe Hanlon was working against us.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: No hope of securing the border now that Forlorn Hope fell.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: The Ranger veterans have been running ops in Baja. We'll be a different army with them here.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: We've got our best Rangers here now. All of a sudden I like our chances a whole lot better.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: If we lose Hoover Dam, we can kiss Nevada goodbye.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: With House dead, we'll have Vegas annexed before the year's out.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryTrooperDialogueFaction]
EN: It's been a long tour. All I can think about now is going back home.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LATER, BUNKER}Well! You're here ahead of schedule! I suppose it's just as well...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: This is where I wanted you to end up, after all. {self-congratulating}I knew I could rely on Caesar to give you back the Platinum Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LATER, BUNKER, MISSION}I see that you reached your destination safely. Shall we get to work?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BUNKER}Have you come to your senses? It's not too late to upload the Platinum Chip's data to the primary computer.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BUNKER}Stop wasting time. Go upload the data on the Platinum Chip to the facility's primary computer.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BUNKER}As you know, the Platinum Chip upgrades my Securitrons' operating software. Well... there's an army of them here.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The Securitrons policing the Strip are a fraction of the total number manufactured. The rest, I stored here.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BUNKER}The Platinum Chip is a data-storage device.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I need you to manually upload the data from the Chip to the facility's primary computer. There's a terminal at the other end of this facility.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: There's a complication. While I can broadcast to this screen, I can't control any of the facility's systems.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: That means I can't deactivate its security bots... most of which appear to be active, according to the status board I'm looking at.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BUNKER, FORT SECS DEST}{devastated}Do you have the slightest idea of what you've done, of what you've destroyed?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You've doomed Vegas to be ruled by corrupt bureaucrats or fanatical savages.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Singlehandedly, you've brought mankind's best hopes of forward progress crashing down. No punishment would be too severe.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BUNKER}Your work here is done. Return to the Lucky 38 so we can discuss next steps.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You have a very bright future ahead of you. Thanks to your actions today, so does the rest of mankind.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {PLAYER DIDN'T GET CHIP}{Should be Securitron on the Strip}Benny is dead, and yet you don't appear to be carrying the Platinum Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I don't suppose you forgot to search his body?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LOST CHIP}Before we go any further - where is the Platinum Chip?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FIRST, HAS CHIP, FORT SECS UP}{spoke to player at the Fort bunker first}So, we meet in person finally... so to speak. You did well at the Fort - kudos.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {HAD CHIP, REFUSED, RETURNED}Have you come to your senses - or will there be a repeat of the last incident?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FIRST, HAS CHIP, BENNY DEAD TOPS}You've been a busy courier, haven't you? You take your obligation to deliver an package very seriously - an ethic for which I am grateful.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I will admit, when you ignored my invitation, I predicted... negative outcomes. But - you have a way of exceeding expectations, don't you?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Well enough. Let's have the Chip, then.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FIRST, NO TOPS}{even tones, welcoming the player but appraising, too}This meeting has been a long time coming, hasn't it? You've come a long ways, literally and, I suspect, figuratively as well.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {proud of the Vegas you built}I have to ask - now that you've reached your destination, what do you make of what you see?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FIRST, BENNY FLED}The point of my inviting you to visit me here at the Lucky 38 {emphasis}before stomping into the Tops on your own was to help you prepare - tactically.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Now, because of your carelessness, Benny has fled the Strip, taking with him the Platinum Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FIRST DISCUSS, PLAYER VISITED TOPS}{welcoming player, trying to hide irritation}Well... this meeting has been a long time in coming... longer still, since you took time to {disapproving}charge into the Tops before coming to see me.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {putting aside irritation}Before we get down to details, I must ask - now that you've arrived at your destination, what do you make of what you see?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {NO TERMS, NO TOPS}{player walked away without accepting terms last time}Can I look forward to a more {beat, emphasis}substantial conversation this time?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {TERMS, NO TOPS}Have you considered the terms of my offer? There's else little for us to discuss until you have.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {TERMS YES, NO CHIP}What is the purpose of this delay?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LATER, BENNY FLED}Events have transpired in a... {beat}less-than-optimal fashion. Benny has fled the Strip, and the Platinum Chip has not been recovered.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LATER, BENNY FLED}Benny must be pursued, and the Platinum Chip, recovered.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LATER, HAS CHIP, BENNY DEAD TOPS}So... Benny has been {slight beat}handled and you've recovered the Platinum Chip. Let's have it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {LATER, HAS CHIP}I take it you've come to deliver the Platinum Chip?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {HOUSE RECEIVES CHIP}{tenderly regarding the Chip}Such a small thing, isn't it? And yet so... {capacious = inexhaustibly capable}capacious. So very dear.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Decades of hiring salvagers out west to search for this little {beat}relic in the ruins of a place called Sunnyvale. Back then, anyway.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: That's where the Chip was printed, on October 22, 2077. It was to have been hand-delivered to me here, at the Lucky 38, the next day.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: But the bombs fell first. Suffice it to say, the delivery was never made.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {CHIP IN, STRIP SECS NO}{jaunty, eager to share your secret}Come now, come now... get thee to the elevator.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {CHIP IN, STRIP SECS NO}{growing impatient}To the elevator, if you please... Stop dragging your feet.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {STRIP SECS UP}{dry}Trips to the basement are rarely so educational, don't you think?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I've since broadcast the upgrade to every Securitron in range of my transmitters, and I must say, it's causing quite a stir down on the Strip!

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {L38, HAS BUNKER MISSION}Make your way to Caesar's Camp at Fortification Hill. Something very interesting awaits you...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {STRIP SECS UP, GIVES BUNKER MISSION}To secure the future of New Vegas, I must have your assistance. The work ahead is dangerous, but {beat}you weather danger well.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {STRIP SECS UP}Have you found the courage to do what's necessary?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, B4 CHIP}What did you wish to know?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, B4 CHIP}What else did you want to know?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FORT SECS NO}We'll talk again once you've concluded your work in the bunker at Fortification Hill.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FORT SECS UP}The foundation is laid. My Securitrons on the Strip are upgraded, and those at the Fort, ready for action.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Now it's just a matter of adjusting the attitudes of some lesser groups while we wait for Caesar's Legion to attack Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {PLAYER HASN'T ACCEPTED BOOMER QUEST YET}The next step is to add the Boomers' considerable firepower to my growing arsenal... or at the very least, ensure their neutrality.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As I was saying, I need you to enlist or neutralize the Boomers at Nellis Air Force Base.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {BOOMERS QUEST ACTIVE}Any progress with the Boomers?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Your next assignment won't take you far. It concerns the Omertas and their den of vice, Gomorrah.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As the decisive encounter between the bull and the bear looms close, my concerns about the Omertas have grown.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I've never expected loyalty, mind you. A reliably underhanded tribe is just as constant to deal with as one that always run true.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: But that's just it - lately the Omertas' cooperative silence has been deafening. Not a single complaint? They're up to something.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Your next assignment would've been to investigate the Omertas, but you managed to foil their scheme before I could put you to the task.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I should compensate you as though it were an official assignment, however. Wouldn't want to {beat}disincentivize your proactivity.{cash out Omerta quest}

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I'd hoped to have you investigate the Omertas, but after the trouble you caused at Gomorrah, they won't let you in the front door.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I'll see if I can make some progress with informants. You're useless in this matter.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As I said before, I need you to investigate the Omertas, to see what they're up to.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: What do you have to report about the Omertas?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Your next assignment is to locate and destroy remnants of the Mojave chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The NCR nearly did the job at Helios One a few years ago, but there seem to have been survivors, unfortunately.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Given the Brotherhood's fanatical views on technology, they can be counted on to oppose my regime.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Please - put them out of my misery.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As I've said, I need you to locate and destroy the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Have you destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Will you ensure that President Kimball survives his visit to Hoover Dam?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {ALL REPUTATIONS LEAD-IN}Aaron Kimball, the president of the New California Republic, is going to visit Hoover Dam to "boost morale."

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Apparently he hasn't considered the effect on the troops' morale of seeing their beloved leader get his brains blown out by a Legion sniper.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {GOOD REP LEAD-IN}I need you to make sure that no harm comes to President Kimball. It's fortunate that you've maintained good relations with the NCR...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {NCR REPUTATION TERRIBLE}Unfortunately, I can't use you to protect Kimball. The NCR won't let you come within a thousand feet of the President.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Odds are that Caesar will launch his assault on the dam after Kimball's visit is concluded, one way or the other - so be on guard.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {NCR REPUTATION TERRIBLE}{ALTERNATE}Unfortunately, I can't very well send you off to protect Kimball. The NCR won't let you come within a thousand feet of the President.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: This can be used to our advantage, though it'll a {beat}grim business. Go to Hoover Dam and attack the gathering crowd, and his visit will be canceled.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {REPUTATION OKAY}Your reputation with the NCR isn't exactly stellar, so I'll have to vouche for you. It'll make a scene, but it's worth it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Last I knew, President Kimball wasn't scheduled to visit the Lucky 38. Be on your way to Hoover Dam, will you?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: If not for you, President Kimball would be dead. So you needn't feel guilty when the NCR's rout from Hoover Dam demolishes his political career.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Why in the world did you attack President Kimball?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Kimball is dead - what a mess you've made!

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {GIVES EL DORADO SUBSTATION QUEST}Between the Strip and HELIOS One lies the El Dorado electrical substation.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Humble as it appears, the substation has immense strategic value, for it's there that you'll jumpstart the Lucky 38's dormant reactor.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Gain access to the substation's control room and install this override module. Just so you know, there are NCR troops guarding the station.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Until the Lucky 38's reactor has been restarted, we have nothing to discuss.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As you can see, Vegas is humming along. I've tested my c3i broadcasting arrays. Everything is in order.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: And just in time, as it turns out. The forces of Caesar's Legion are on the march, establishing a staging area east of the dam.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Their assault could begin at any moment. So that's where you'll be heading, if you're ready - Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The Legion's assault could begin at any moment.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, STRIP SECS UP}What did you want to discuss?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, STRIP SECS UP}What else did you want to discuss?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {Player fled combat last time}There will be no repeat of the trouble we had last time, I trust?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {Player fled combat last time}I'm optimistic that this conversation will go more smoothly.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}I'd rather you just dealt with the Boomers, but all right...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}I suppose the Omertas can wait a few minutes.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}A few questions, and then you'll handle the Brotherhood, I hope?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}Questions like "Will President Kimball survive his visit to Hoover Dam?"

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {MQN, FORT SECS UP}Even now? On the brink of battle?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I knew you'd make it. Resourceful, as always.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The override module is functioning properly. I'm rerouting power to the Securitron vault at the Fort as we speak...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I just need you to head over to the east power plant and manually activate the switch.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: When you return topside, I think you'll see that my Securitron army is a little more than the Legion was prepared to handle.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Oh, and before you go - grab that print-out spooling from the console here - those papers set the terms for the NCR's unconditional surrender.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I thought you might enjoy the honor of presenting them to the NCR's commanding officer, once the Legion has been defeated. Cheers!

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {Fleshy House}{rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Why have you... done this?... centuries of preparation... so much good, undone...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {Fleshy House}{rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}I have... nothing... to say... to you...

Speaker: Mags
EN: Hey again.

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: It sure is nice to see everybody working together like family. Maybe now the baby Jesus won't cry his self to sleep every night.

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Shooting guns is real scary, but I think I got the hang of it now!

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Razz said the candy he got us was special! I wonder what he- {sudden, psychotic break}Gnaaah, kill, kill, rip and kill! -{right back to normal}meant by that?

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Poindexter says all our troubles is over now, and we won't have to go to war. I guess that's good, but I don't understand why.

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Is it true? The big boss ranger done killed his self?

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Howdy, great to see you!

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Y'all sure are a big ol' hero. I gotta wright my mama and tell her I met you!

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Uh, howdy. Are you gonna be mean or nice this time?

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: You scare and confuse me, and I think you should be nicer to people.

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Go away, you big bully!

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: {Frightened}Ahhh! Somebody call in the Rangers!

Speaker: O'Hanrahan
EN: Howdy.

Speaker: Poindexter

EN: Whatever you're selling, I ain't buying.

Speaker: [Faction: 188 Faction]
EN: Watch yourself if you're heading further south. There's been trouble down by Nelson and Searchlight.

Speaker: [Faction: 188 Faction]
EN: Try not to make any trouble. We like it quiet around here.

Speaker: [Faction: 188 Faction]
EN: If I hear one more loser moan about losing everything they own on the Strip, I may shoot him in the head.

Speaker: [Faction: 188 Faction]
EN: It's quiet out here. We like to keep it that way.

Speaker: [Faction: 188 Faction]

EN: Still making a nuisance of yourself?

EN: I don't work for freelancers. So move along.

EN: Stay out of my way and I'll stay out of yours, got it?

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Fucking geckos.

EN: No way I'm going back to prison.

EN: So much for Lem, you should have seen it, guts flying everywhere.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: We can finally relax with Cooke gone.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Cooke left the vault, good thing too he was going to get us all killed.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Cooke is going to get us all killed.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Lem wants to run back to the NCR and turn himself in, spineless bastard.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: I hear the Great Khans are pretty tough, I hope we can join them.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Join the Great Khans, what the hell is Cooke thinking?

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: I don't know about this whole Great Khan thing...

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Did you hear? We're going to join the Great Khans.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: I don't want to join the Great Khans, but I guess it's better than going back to prison.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: Hmm, join the Great Khans or die in the wasteland? Good fucking plan Cooke.

Speaker: [Faction: vVault19DialogueFaction]
EN: I don't want to join the Great Khans.

Speaker: VHDEastDamLegionary
EN: Try to keep up, if you can.

Speaker: VHDEastDamLegionary
EN: Now is the time for killing, not words!

Speaker: VHDEastDamLegionary
EN: This was all too easy.

Speaker: VHDEastDamLegionary
EN: I long to join my brethren in the power plant below. The fighting's probably fiercer there.

Speaker: VHDEastDamLegionary
EN: Our orders are to take and hold this section of the dam.

Speaker: VHDWestDamLegionary
EN: These men fight hard, and die well.

Speaker: VHDWestDamLegionary
EN: Ha ha, isn't it glorious?

Speaker: VHDWestDamLegionary
EN: These dogs are putting up a fight, I'll give them that.

Speaker: VHDWestDamLegionary
EN: The exterior is ours. The interior will fall soon.

Speaker: VHDWestDamLegionary
EN: There's talk of much land and slaves going to the one who kills Oliver. If only I wasn't assigned here!

Speaker: VHDWestDamLegionary
EN: With the outside secured, the poor fools inside have nowhere to run.

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: Oliver's head is as good as mine!

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: Is it true the fighting outside has stopped already?

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: Upstairs, or down? If I were a coward, where would I hide?

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: Make good use of cover. The time to strike is when they reload.

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: Their guns aren't quite as effective in these close quarters.

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: Soon this place will belong to the Legion.

Speaker: VHDLegionPowerPlant01Legionary
EN: I've added eight notches to my belt already. How many for you?

Speaker: Securitron Mk II
EN: You must get to the control room and install the override chip.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
EN: I will protect you.

Speaker: [Faction: Followers of the Apocalypse]
EN: I hope the Legion doesn't get in here.

Speaker: [Faction: Followers of the Apocalypse]
EN: Sorry, but I'm busy with patients right now.

Speaker: [Faction: Followers of the Apocalypse]
EN: Julie Farkas wasn't kidding when she said we would be needed here.

Speaker: [Faction: Followers of the Apocalypse]
EN: All this bloodshed. Such a waste of human life.

Speaker: [Faction: Followers of the Apocalypse]
EN: Please don't hurt me!

Speaker: [Faction: Followers of the Apocalypse]
EN: I'm just a medic! Please don't hurt me!

Speaker: Casino Guard
EN: {Frowns}Hold up, you look new to Vegas - I'll keep it short: no weapons allowed in the casinos.

Speaker: Casino Guard
EN: Hand them over, you'll get them back when you leave.

Speaker: Casino Guard
EN: Keep to the games, and there won't be any problems.

Speaker: Casino Guard
EN: Back for your gear? Here you go.

Speaker: Mister Holdout
EN: Hey, there, friend, a bit of advice - you look like you could use some *protection.* {Beat, downnote, conspiratiorial}Lucky for you, I got what you need.

Speaker: Mister Holdout
EN: My stock and trade? Alllll kinds of easy-to-hide weapons for slipping into and out of casinos, they won't give you a second glance.

Speaker: Mister Holdout
EN: Heard the Dam finally got what's coming to it. Strange days ahead - and that's why it's best to face the day armed.

Speaker: Mister Holdout
EN: Some crazy days on the Strip. Still... it's good for business.

Speaker: Mister Holdout
EN: {Hey, potential customer, slightly hopeful}Back again? Need a weapon for an emergency, Mister Holdout's your guy.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: Traveling into the Strip just got a lot easier now that the Fiends' leaders are dead.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Congratulatory}Stories of how you saved President Kimball are the talk of the Strip, friend!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Resigned}If someone can blow up the Monorail, I guess we're not safe even in the Strip.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Hopeful}Lady Luck's on your side. I hope some of that rubs off on me, Caesar killer!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Determined}Now that you've killed that Caesar bastard, the Strip's really going to bloom!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Dumbfounded}Someone got Mr. House. The Strip's going to change, I'd bet on it.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Apprehensive}After what happened to Mr. House, nobody knows for sure what's in play for the Strip.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Dumbfounded}The tables turned for Mr. House. What next, huh?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Apprehensive}Looks like Mr. House run out of luck, huh?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Dismissive}Later, uh, whoever you are.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Dismissive}I don't talk to "nobodies," not when I'm having the time of my life!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Dismissive}Sorry, I'm here to have a good time, not talk to random people.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: Howdy, come try your luck? I hope's on your side.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Joyful}That's a true friend of this wonderful place! Lady Luck shines on you.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: One of New Vegas' finest! You are always welcome in the Strip.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Sincerely Excited}It's a pleasure to see you, friend! Best of luck during your stay.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Slightly Disturbed}So, what do you want with me?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Almost Defiant}I'm not scared of you. Give me a good reason to call the law and, I swear, you'll regret it.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Visibly Disturbed}Don't... do anything to me, okay?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Unsettled}Uh-oh, I'll call the Securitrons if you try anything crazy with me, understand?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Disgusted}What the hell do you want?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Agitated}Beat it, or I'll call the bots on you right quick.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Visibly Bothered}I'm not going to talk to you!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Restrained}I swear, I could kill you right now and never look back.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: {Almost Violent}You better scram before I sic the entire Strip after you.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Suspicious}These bots now have eyes on their backs, I swear!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: You're the talk of the day around the casino tables.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Cautionary}I'd not touch Gomorrah's machines until the dust settles.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Suspicious}I could smell something fishy going on at Gomorrah.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: I bet dirty business are going on at Gomorrah.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: I bet dirty business are going on at Gomorrah.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: Come on... time to get lucky.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Determined}Luck's about to change, I can feel it.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Pissed}Damn slots are robbery.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Pleased}Send those chips my way.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Smug}Come to get fleeced like a Bighorner?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: Roulette, blackjack, slots... they have it all here.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: Ready to try your luck?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Sizing the player up}Step up, let's see your game.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Smiling}You look like you got the itch, friend.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: {Smiling}You want to gamble with class? Hit the Ultra-Luxe, if you don't mind being serviced by masked creeps.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianGamblerDialogueFaction]
EN: Watch the slots, they're robbery.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: Wish I could've seen what's inside the 38.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: You've been making a name for yourself around here already.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: Did you hear? Gomorrah's under new management!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: {Helpful, then serious}You look new here - be careful of Gomorrah.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: {Cautioning}Watch your caps - they go quick.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: {Curious}Seeing the sights?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: The Ultra-Luxe is fancy, but I get the shivers when I see their staff wearing masks.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRCivilianTouristDialogueFaction]
EN: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: At this rate, one Securitron is going to be enough to defend the whole Strip.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Admiringly}Good to have you around!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Admiringly}Thanks for helping us keep the Strip safe.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Nods}Sir.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Nods}Miss.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Nods}Ma'am.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Nods}Pleasure.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: {Nods}An NCR welcome to you.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: Help you?

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: Welcome to Vegas - behave yourselves.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMPDialogueFaction]
EN: If you're looking to join up, head on by the Embassy.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Welcome to Vegas. {Beat, slightly threatening}Make your visit a peaceful one.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Monorail transit is safe transit.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Report any suspicious activity near the Monorail.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: No loitering.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Please enjoy the casinos.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Please do not stand in the fountains.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: No violence is permitted on the Strip.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Self-control is a virtue.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Please obey all weapon laws.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Continuing patrol.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: Strip secure.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Area is off-limits, citizen.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Return to the surface, citizen.

Speaker: [Faction: Street Securitron Faction]
EN: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Disobedience will be punished.

Speaker: Mister Holdout
EN: Look,{"friend" is said in a sarcastic, but serious, tone} "friend," don't get near me - you're too well respected for my business.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Hey, think you can walk around here like nothing's happened?

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: See, my friends and I, we were kinda wondering if we should give you a good beating right now, or save it for when we catch you outside.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: We don't like you Mojave scum, and we like you even less when you fuck with our Strip.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: So, you either pay up to walk around here, or we're gonna make you pay up. That clear?

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: You back again, huh? We missed you, we've been waiting for you. Bet you've missed us too.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Fuck off, punk. And pray we don't hear about you doing crazy shit again.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Fuck this. I'm out of here - let them deal with this crazy place.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: I can't believe I put up with this kind of crap.

EN: Hey, think you can walk around here like nothing's happened?

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Well, hello there. What a coincidence, finding you outside the Strip.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: You should've paid your dues, but, no, you had to play hard, huh? Now it's our turn.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Nobody fucks with the NCR and lives to brag about it. You're dead, punk!

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: {Desparate, relieved}Oh, thank God! I didn't think I'd ever see another human face down here.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Got to stay alert...

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Just waiting here seems like a death sentence...

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {concerned}They've got our guys down there.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Fucking monsters butchered the miners down there...

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Wish Renolds would report back soon... he went west a day ago, no word from him.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Worried}We need to move out, we can't hold this position.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Slight frustration}Once the Legion's dug in, we're {emphasis}never getting them out of Nelson.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Puzzled}There used to be two commanders, but I only see one - the other {emphasis}must be nearby somewhere.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Apprehensive}Won't be long before the Legion rolls out of Nelson...

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Someone should go warn Novac.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: We need reinforcements from Camp Forlorn Hope.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Wish we could do something for the troopers down there.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Out on regular patrol, then this shit goes down.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Angry}The Legion'll pay for Nelson.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {surprised, slight fear}Never thought Legion'd be bold enough to strike this far.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Told Milo we have to go, but he won't leave.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: We can't hold this road if they come up through town!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Thanks for the help with the hostages!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Impressed}I can't believe you broke into the mine and saved those miners.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Hope you made the Legion at the mine pay for Nelson.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: The hostages are safe. We owe you.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: You sure cleaned out the Legion in Nelson.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {smug}Legion'll think twice before crossing the river again.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Mocking}Guess Caesar got his tribute after all.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Proud}Nelson'll turn this war around.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Smug}Let's see those fuckers attack Hoover Dam now.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Smug}Nelson's proof payback's a bitch.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Thanks for cleaning up Nelson!

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: Don't know what we would have done if you hadn't come along.

Speaker: [Faction: vNCRMilitaryDialogueFaction]
EN: {Impressed}Wish more people had your kind of guts.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Monorail Destroyed}Careless of the NCR to let their monorail get blown up. Don't they have sentries standing watch?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Caesar dead}The Legion isn't going to go away just because Caesar is dead, if the rumor is even true.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Kimball survives}Kimball's bodyguards are probably pretty thankful they had Gun Runner weapons backing them up.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Kimball dead}Kimball's bodyguards should've been more heavily armed if they wanted to keep him alive.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Legion at Nelson wiped out}It's always good for business when the NCR scores a victory like the one at Nelson.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
ActorNotes: [NCR at Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out]
EN: {NCR at Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out}Damn shame about Camp Forlorn Hope.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Middle Game}Business has been brisk. Something big's coming, I can feel it.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Late Game}The orders for service rifles and ammunition have been pouring in from McCarran so fast we can't keep up. Hell of a fight is coming.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{impressed}First Recon is a top-notch unit. They're always buying sniper rifles from us.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}That Eyebot looks like it's gone through hell.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Companion Reaction - Lily}I had no idea there was such a thing as a friendly Nightkin. Look at that thing.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Companion Reaction - Rex}I've never a dog like that. Who thinks up these things?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Random}Man, I love my guns.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Random}People usually aren't stupid enough to steal from the Gun Runners. Usually.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Random}It's amazing what passes for a firearm around here. You'd be better off throwing rocks.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: The Lucky 38, all lit up in the distance? It's an inviting target.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: Mr. House finally wised up and said he'd join the NCR in a year or something like that. Good news all around.

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Random}Have you seen what one of those anti-materiel rifles can do to a Deathclaw?

Speaker: [Context: GREETING]
EN: {Default}Demand for Gun Runner weapons is high, so don't expect them to stay in stock for very long.

EN: These recruits aren't ready, if the Legion comes knocking.

EN: I'm busy. See the brass if you want to chat.

EN: No time for idle chatter. These boys need whipping into shape.

EN: Either join the recruits running the course or leave the area.

EN: Then what do you propose? Every day that he's here, the risk increases.

EN: And our chances of exposure might be one hundred percent if we act rashly.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Better that than not act at all!

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Boone's a sniper, same as me. Used to spot for him when we were enlisted with the NCR.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: After we got out, I talked him into settling down here. So, here we are.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: I'd introduce you, but uh... we're not so friendly right now.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Why are you on bad terms with Boone?
EN: Me and his wife, we didn't see eye-to-eye on some things. We had some pretty big arguments.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Why are you on bad terms with Boone?
EN: One day she turns up missing, and he hasn't said a word to me since.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did you and Boone's wife argue about?
EN: Man, you name it.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did you and Boone's wife argue about?
EN: See, I grew up in North Vegas. Me and my cousins. We were some bad seeds. Got in with a gang. I loved it.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did you and Boone's wife argue about?
EN: Then something happened, and I couldn't handle it anymore.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did you and Boone's wife argue about?
EN: So, I enlisted. Earned my future. Brought down my best friend to share that future with me.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did you and Boone's wife argue about?
EN: And here was this woman who was too good for it, trying to take him away. So yeah. I didn't see eye-to-eye with the bitch.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Who would want to hurt Boone's wife?
EN: Man, everybody. That girl didn't have one friend in this whole town. She didn't want any.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Who would want to hurt Boone's wife?
EN: She wanted to sit in her room all day and make herself miserable. And she went out of her way to be rude.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Who would want to hurt Boone's wife?
EN: She upset a lot of people. You wouldn't have liked her, either.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Did you have anything to do with Boone's wife's disappearance?
EN: Believe me. When I heard the news, my first thought was, I owe somebody. Big. I figured Boone would come around after a while.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Did you have anything to do with Boone's wife's disappearance?
EN: But he hasn't. And I'm starting to think that if he doesn't find her that things will never go back to the way they were.

Speaker: [Context: RSCharlieAudioLog2Audio]

Speaker: [Context: RSCharlieAudioLog2Audio]
EN: We are coming for you. Run, and we will catch you. Hide, and we will find you. No matter what you do, you are all going to die.

Speaker: [Context: RSCharlieAudioLog2Audio]
EN: We took one of the women alive.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: ...drove the raiders off. No casualties. In the meantime-

Speaker: Dr. Ada Straus

EN: I'd love to help you out, but I'm pretty strapped here as it is. I really don't have anything to sell you.

EN: Here's what I've got.
