Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: Molerat men, come up from the Underneath to steal young women with promises of riches and fancy mud mansions with all the latest designer appliances.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: They covet our ladyfolk's long hair for wigs, it's said, being either bald or balding themselves.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What do you know about the abduction of Boone's wife?
EN: Seen it all. Seen shadowy folk come to his room and leave again in the middle of the night. Thought one might've gone in the lobby, too, for a spell.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What do you know about the abduction of Boone's wife?
EN: Could be that person went in to get something. Or use the john maybe. Mighty interesting either way, you ask me.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What do you know about the abduction of Boone's wife?
EN: I thought it was cannibals, come to eat us all for sure, so I kept out of sight. But now I know better.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Has anybody been acting strange lately?
EN: I don't trust a man that doesn't have something strange going on about him, 'cause it means he's hiding it from you.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Has anybody been acting strange lately?
EN: If a man's wearing his pants on his head or if he says his words backwards from time to time, you know it's all laid out there for you.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Has anybody been acting strange lately?
EN: But if he's friendly to strangers and keeps his home spick-and-span, more often than not he's done something even his own ma couldn't forgive.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
EN: I come face to face with the chupacabra himself one night whilst I was investigating whether this gecko was hiding his treasure from me.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
EN: He was the meanest, ugliest chupacabra you could imagine. Had two heads, and fangs down to the ground.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
EN: Best I could tell, anyways, since when he come up to me he was invisible.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
EN: Had himself a blunderbuss what would rotate and shoot bullets real fast out of a backpack. Never seen nothing like it.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
EN: Walked right past me having an argument with somebody.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
EN: But I only saw the one chupacabra, so I guess the other fella had to be invisible too. Only more invisible than the other one.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What's been going on in town?
EN: There's been things of a disturbing nature going on at the McBride Corral.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What's been going on in town?
EN: Seems every night one of their herd meets a most unnatural death, and always there's holes all over the body.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What's been going on in town?
EN: Work of the chupacabra, the livestock vampire, says No-bark, but they don't pay no mind. Too many holes, they say, and there's bullets in them.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: What's been going on in town?
EN: Well, says No-bark, we got a chupacabra with an automatic weapon. And that's when they get real quiet, 'cause now they see the predicament we're in.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: Good idea. It ain't safe to stay on the same topic for too long.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Who do you think is actually at the factory?
EN: Ghosts. Commie ghosts what don't know they're dead.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Who do you think is actually at the factory?
EN: Hoping to steal our rockets so they can fly up and paint the moon pink and draw a Lenin face on it.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Who do you think is actually at the factory?
EN: I seen one of them disappear and reappear before my very eyes.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Who do you think is actually at the factory?
EN: Although being a scientist, I have to admit I might've just blinked for longer than usual, what with the shock of seeing a commie ghost and so forth.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Is anything interesting happening in the area?
EN: Folks'll tell you that they seen ghouls up near the rocket factory.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Is anything interesting happening in the area?
EN: Sensationalist hooey, cooked up by superstitious yokels seeing phantoms of their own imagining.

Speaker: Alice McBride
EN: I'm not sure who started it. It wasn't a very nice name, but he took to calling himself by it, so we all had to.

Speaker: Alice McBride
EN: I don't even remember what his real name is.

Speaker: Alice McBride
EN: Anyway, I think it comes from that expression that people say when you're crazy - that not all of your dogs are barking. Poor No-bark.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: How did No-bark get his name?

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: 'Cause they know I ain't just barking here. What I say's got bite, 'cause it's the truth.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: Them quack doctors can say what they want about all the radscorpion stings that done pierced my skull. I know what I seen.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Why do they call you No-bark?

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: If you're going to be weird, I'm just going to leave.
EN: Weird's just normal when normal decides to start taking notice of things. You just think about that.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: If you're going to be weird, I'm just going to leave.
EN: Now what'd you come here for?

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: Let me know if you meet anyone suspicious.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: You said you'd stab me with that dirty knife.
EN: Okay, okay. Just speak up a little. But not so much that They hear you. They got people everywhere, always listening.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: We can talk from this distance.
EN: You sure, now? It's kinda hard to hear you.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: I give up! Please don't do no harm to me, mister, leastaways not my face. All I got left is my rugged good looks. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You're going to talk whether you like it or not.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: I give up! Please don't do no harm to me, missy, leastaways not my face. All I got left is my rugged good looks. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You're going to talk whether you like it or not.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Who tried to make you talk?
EN: Confound it, No-bark, you done it again. You let on that you know things. Now they'll never let you be.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: Who tried to make you talk?
EN: All right, stranger, you got me. What do you want to know?

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
EN: We'll just see about that. You come any closer and I'm liable to stick you with my stickin' knife. Ol' Sticky's feeling mighty ornery this day.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
EN: Well don't worry yourself too much over it. We'll get by.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: No one is going to attack your corral from now on.
EN: Well I don't know how you done it, but I do know how I can thank you. Please take this, compliments of Alice and myself.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: No one is going to attack your corral from now on.
EN: And help yourself to anything in that freezer over yonder. We got more steaks in there than we'd be able to eat in a year.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: No one is going to attack your corral from now on.
EN: Well we surely appreciate for what you done for us. Even without our stock, just having peace of mind means the world to us.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: No one is going to attack your corral from now on.
EN: Take this, compliments of Alice and myself. We'd give you more if we could, knowing you risked your neck for us.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: I'll see if I can catch whoever's responsible.
EN: We'd be grateful. Especially if you find 'em before they get my whole stock. But don't go getting yourself killed over it.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: I'll see if I can catch whoever's responsible.
EN: Alice and I'll find a way to make do. Always have.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: Did you get a look at the attacker?
EN: Beg your pardon mister, but them two-headed beeves ain't worth getting shot over.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: Did you get a look at the attacker?
EN: Not to mention what would happen if half of what No-bark says is true.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: Did you get a look at the attacker?
EN: Best we can hope is that whoever's doing this'll move on, or get tired of it. I just hope it happens while we still got animals left.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: Did you get a look at the attacker?
EN: Whoever it is, I don't think they're from around town. Seems like they've taken to shooting from the west side.

Speaker: Dusty McBride

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: Did you get a look at the attacker?
EN: Whoever it is, I don't think they're from around town. Seems like they're usually shooting from the west side.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
EN: You must mean what's left of it. Somebody's been attacking our animals at night. We're down to less than half of what we had a few weeks back.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
EN: Every night around midnight Alice and I'll wake up to some crazy hollering and gun shots. You'd think the world was ending all over again.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
EN: But it's just one animal each night. They don't take it or carve it up or nothing. Just leave it there, all full of holes.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Tell me what you know about the attacks.

Speaker: Alice McBride
EN: Well, it's the strangest thing. Last time it happened I could swear I heard someone cry out for help. Sounded like a big fella.

Speaker: Alice McBride
EN: But when we finally got up the gumption to go look outside all we found was our cattle. And I know what they sound like when they get upset.

Speaker: Alice McBride
EN: I can't imagine what went on. Dusty can probably tell you more about it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: What can you tell me about the attacks on your ranch?

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: What do you do here in Novac?
EN: Oh, I tend to my ranch, that's about it. Alice'll tell you. I don't get out a whole lot.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: I heard you've been losing livestock.
EN: Losing don't describe it. It's a massacre. Few more days and there won't be nothing left to lose.

Speaker: Harland
EN: I'm not expecting good news, but keep looking.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: I'll try to find your friend.
EN: Thanks. Let me know what you find out. Here's hoping she's okay.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the "demons"?

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the "demons"?

Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?
EN: Most of the fight was upstairs, but some folks panicked and made for the basement. And I went after them.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?
EN: Well, turns out there were even more of those bastards down here than upstairs, and things went to shit fast.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?
EN: I'm not delicate. Radroach meat for protein, condensation off the pipes for water, and I do my business over in the far corner.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How did you end up trapped down here?

Speaker: Harland

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How can I help get you out of this room?
EN: I had a friend with me when those mutant bastards came out of nowheres. She panicked and ran the wrong direction - further into the basement.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How can I help get you out of this room?
EN: She's probably dead, but I ain't leaving until I know for sure. I'd have gone looking myself, except I wouldn't last a minute out there.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: How can I help get you out of this room?
EN: You, on the other hand, seem pretty resourceful. Find my friend, and I'll get out of your way.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: Looks like I have to kill you.
EN: Then you're dumber than you look, smoothskin. Eat this!

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: You don't look like the other ghouls from Bright's group.
EN: Guess the outfit gives that away, huh? I never did buy into that religious mumbo-jumbo with the robes and all that shit.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: You don't look like the other ghouls from Bright's group.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: You don't look like the other ghouls from Bright's group.

Speaker: Harland
Topic_Name: You don't look like the other ghouls from Bright's group.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash

Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: I rescued Deputy Beagle.

EN: RobCo industries purchased REPCONN in 2075 to assist with some of RobCo's military projects, as well as developing unmanned space exploration.

Speaker: Tour Guide

Speaker: Tour Guide
ActorNotes: {Becomes a little nostalgic here, not quite as enthusiastic.}

Speaker: Tour Guide
ActorNotes: {Still nostalgic, then a little sad at the end.}

Speaker: Tour Guide

Speaker: Tour Guide

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Congratulations, martyr! Your fantastic journey is only just beginning. Please proceed to the light.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Greetings, martyr, and welcome! If you're here now, it means you've been offered up as a sacrifice so that your vault can continue to thrive.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Currently, you may be feeling sad or angry. Perhaps you never got to have grandkids, or to enjoy the pleasures of a fresh cigar.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: But march with your chin held high, soldier, and remember that each of us has an important role to play.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: For some people, their role might be to heal the sick. For others, it might mean they will drive a racecar or fly a rocket ship.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: And some of us are meant to forfeit our lives for the good of the people.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Sure it might not be as fun as driving a racecar, but it's every bit as important.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Let's take a moment to reflect on the moments that made your life worth living.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Think about that time you kissed your steady girl for the first time under the bleachers at the big game.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Or when you snuck out after curfew to catch that new flick that your parents wouldn't let you see because it was too scary. Boy, were they right!

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: And who could forget when you met the love of your life? What a looker! These are just examples.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Do you feel that feeling stirring in your chest as you think of these things? Good. What you are feeling is peace.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: You've led a great life. Living it has been its own reward. But it is only the beginning.

Speaker: Vault-Tec Recording Speaker
EN: Close your eyes now, and imagine what joys await you in the next life - the afterlife. Can you see them? Good.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: It was Curtis. He's in the Legion. I can prove he tried to blow up the monorail.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: It was Curtis. He's in the Legion. I can prove he tried to blow up the monorail.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: It was Curtis. He's in the Legion. I can prove he tried to blow up the monorail.

EN: I'll have Curtis taken into custody. If he lets himself be taken alive, that is.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: [Attack] I did. Right before I assassinated the colonel.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You're getting ahead of yourself.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: What kind of supplies did you have in mind?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Are you implying I have some kind of secret under-the-table stash I only offer to certain clients? Because that could get a man in trouble.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
EN: What's it look like? I caught one in the leg. I killed a dozen of those degenerates sneaking my way in... but one got a drop on me.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
EN: I holed up in here after I killed that one. They're too stupid to unlock the doors, so I knew they'd figure whoever attacked had just taken off.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
EN: I just need day or two and then I'll take out Motor-Runner myself. I even got the key to his Maintenance Wing. Situation's under control.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Let me take out Motor-Runner for you.
EN: Bad idea on all sorts of levels. Leave it to the professionals, kid.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I won't be able to move fast, but I can more than hold my own in a firefight. Here, take the key...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Here, take this key to the Maintenance Wing. Should make getting to Motor-Runner a whole easier. I'll follow you down.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: The only way you're going to take out Motor-Runner is if we work together.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I won't be able to move fast, but I can more than hold my own in a firefight.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Well, this whole thing's improvised, and now we'll have to improvise some more and find another way through. I'll follow you down.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: The only way you're going to take out Motor-Runner is if we work together.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: [FAILED] Thanks for the offer - but the answer is no. Once my leg is healed up, I'll take care of Motor-Runner easily enough.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Let's you and me take out Motor-Runner together!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I want to help you rescue the hostages.
EN: Yeah? Nice thought, but that's not my primary mission. If you want to go it solo, more power to you.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'm sure you can handle it alone. I'll leave you to it.
EN: Good idea. Try not to get hurt out there.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Colonel Hsu thinks you need additional support.
EN: Is that right? And what sort of support, exactly, is it that you have to offer?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: The Colonel was concerned. You missed your check-in.
EN: You can go back to old Hsu and tell him that the mission will be completed. I just need a couple more days.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: The Fiends are degenerate drug addicts who kill and rape for fun, basically. They're human garbage - though I'm not sure about the human part.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: This was Vault 3, but I'm sure you can tell that by all the 3s all over the damn place. Now it is a drug den for the goddamn Fiends.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what happened here?
EN: The Fiends killed everyone living here, and now they are squatting in their home.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Have you noticed anything suspicious lately?
EN: Now what kind of MP would I be if I didn't notice anything suspicious?

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Have you noticed anything suspicious lately?
EN: I've had soldiers go AWOL, break-ins, thefts, you name it.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: No, I've got this one. I don't think he's going to have much information of value, so I'm just tormenting him for fun. Thanks, though.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Yeah, so far this has gone exactly as expected - poorly. But with the work you've done for NCR already, you might be just what I've been looking for.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: We captured an honest-to-God centurion of Caesar's Legion recently.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Sorry, this is state business, what I'm working on. You'd have to do a lot more NCR ass-kissing before they'd let you help me with this one.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Not big on reading nametags, huh? That's okay, my name is long and difficult to pronounce. Ready for it?

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: It's Boyd. Lieutenant Boyd to my friends. Colonel Hsu has me handling the policing duties for the base.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: I've told him he could make my job a whole lot easier if he would just let me shoot anyone who talks back to me, but you know how colonels can be.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Let me take another look at that leg.
EN: How's it look, doc?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I don't have a spare doctor's bag I can spare.
EN: Yeah? Well, there's a ton of pharmaceuticals out there. Maybe you can find one and bring it back to me. It'd be a great help...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: All right. Let me give you the key to the Maintenance Wing...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: I don't know what to say. You'll have to find your own way to get at that sick bastard. Hope to see you back at McCarran.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: Here, take this. It's the key to the Maintenance Wing. Should make getting to Motor-Runner that much easier. Good luck.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
EN: What are we waiting for? I've got a high-value target to kill!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
EN: Thanks, doc. The Fiends have got a ton of pharmaceuticals out there. Here's hoping a doctor's bag is in the mix.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
EN: You need a doctor's bag. I'll find one and come back.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: If you head for McCarran now, I think you'll make it in time - even at a limp.
EN: Goddammit. Fine. I'll head back. Are you saying you'll handle Motor-Runner yourself?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Goddammit. I know. Was just hoping that, uh...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: Are you trained as a doctor? Can you fix my leg?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm afraid your leg looks - and smells - like it's on the verge of infection.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: [FAILED] The slug went straight through. I'm a goddamned NCR ranger, all right? I'm trained in first aid!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: A day or two of resting up isn't going to heal that leg.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Then you broke our agreement. I want double the caps.
EN: [FAILED] No. Our agreement was very specific. You bring me the data, I give you a reward.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Then you broke our agreement. I want double the caps.
EN: We never discussed the dangers. That's your business, not mine. If you can't provide the data, I'm sure I'll find someone who can.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: It doesn't trouble you that you sent eight or ten people to their deaths?
EN: I have no evidence that they're dead. A thousand things could have happened between here and the Vault.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: It doesn't trouble you that you sent eight or ten people to their deaths?
EN: They could have changed their minds and walked away. I wouldn't be much of a scientist if I leapt to conclusions without proof.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I want double the caps. Or I spread the word that you're full of shit.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right. I'll admit that it's been difficult to find anyone willing to enter the Vault. And I'd rather get the data sooner than later.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I want double the caps. Or I spread the word that you're full of shit.
EN: You have a deal. I'll double your reward, if you bring me the data. But this is as high as my budget will allow.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
EN: Do whatever you think is best. You're under no obligations. If you want the caps, you'll complete the job. Simple.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
EN: Take my advice. Forget about Williams. She's a talented researcher, but she doesn't understand people, and she can't see the big picture.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
EN: Now, I know your time is valuable, so I won't waste any more of it. Feel free to show yourself out...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I prefer to know what I'm getting myself into.
EN: You want certainty? You'll never find it... especially not in the pursuit of science.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: How many others have you sent to the Vault?
EN: I'd have to consult my records. Eight? Ten? Your point is what?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: No, that was me. I fixed HELIOS One.
EN: I... see. Of course you did.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Yes! That was it, exactly.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Directly? No. But we attempt to maximize its output. You have no idea how difficult it is to provide power to an entire nation.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Fortunately, we also have the HELIOS One facility. One of our external contractors recently got the station up and running.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Fortunately, we also have the HELIOS One facility. One of our external contractors recently got the station up and running.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: We were starting to bring the HELIOS One facility online, as well. That might have increased our power output by half.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: But some wasteland scum managed to sabotage the array. Probably got quite a laugh at our expense. Very funny indeed.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: I'd pay a year's salary for a crack at that maniac. Not that he'd ever show his face in a place like this.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: We were starting to bring the HELIOS One facility online, as well. That might have increased our power output by half.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: But some wasteland scum managed to sabotage the array. Probably got quite a laugh at our expense. Very funny indeed.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: I'd pay a year's salary for a crack at that maniac. Not that she'd ever show her face in a place like this.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Our efforts at HELIOS One held a great deal of promise, until some drifter blew in from the waste and managed to reroute the power.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: As to where the power is going... who knows. Can you imagine? A drifter outsmarting professional scientists? Only in New Vegas.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: We'd hoped that HELIOS One would boost power to McCarran and Vegas. Then some damned crusader routed all the power to Freeside.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: I also have high hopes for our HELIOS One facility. Unfortunately, I can't say the same for the two "scientists" who are working there.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: So far, they've only managed to achieve one percent power output. I'd send help, if I could spare the personnel.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: His name was something like... "Exceptional" or "Marvelous" or...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: That's the trouble with this wasteland - too many damned variables. No one can account for them all.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Not yet. But our government understands the value of proactive thought. Our studies project an imbalance between production and consumption.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Or, for a layman such as yourself - not enough food, too many mouths to feed. Mass starvation. In a decade or so.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: You're doing all these things yourself?
EN: Yes. With the assistance of my team, of course.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Yes, I have. What difference does it make?
EN: None at all. Informed speculation on my part. Williams is very good at her job, so it remains secure... despite her best efforts.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Yes, I have. What difference does it make?
EN: No, you aren't the first person I've sent to the Vault. I'm sorry that I neglected to tell you, but I don't see how it makes any difference.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: <Lie> No, Williams didn't tell me anything.
EN: All right. I'll take you at your word. Williams didn't say anything at all, you just came to this conclusion on your own.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I'm the one asking the questions, Dr. Hildern.
EN: Fair enough. Begging your pardon, but this is beginning to feel like an interrogation.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I'm not the first person you've sent to Vault 22... am I?
EN: I never said you were. You've been speaking to Williams, haven't you?

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Oh no! Miss Tabitha is hurt! Someone, get a doctor!

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: There, there Miss Tabitha. It's going to be all right.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Miss Tabitha, your distinct lack of respiration is quite worrisome.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: That's good, Miss Tabitha. It's important that you don't move. You might aggravate your injury.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Where is that doctor?

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Don't worry, Miss Tabitha, I'll keep you warm with my exhaust.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: I do hope the doctor doesn't get lost on the way up here.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, my apologies sir. I was sent here by Colonel Hsu to exterminate Motor-Runner, the leader of the Fiends.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
EN: [FAILED] Your curiosity and a few caps will get you a rat on a stick, but it won't get you fuck all from me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
EN: I'm just curious.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Tell me what an NCR ranger is doing here.
EN: Tell me why I should tell you anything. I don't know you.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: Okay, but make it quick.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: By the way, that Vault was just as dangerous as Williams thought.
EN: I don't see how that's relevant. The dangers of the Vault were your business, not mine. The only question is whether the data is still intact.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: By the way, that Vault was just as dangerous as Williams thought.
EN: Was it? I'm sure I made it very clear... the hazards of the job were your business, not mine. The important question is whether this data is intact.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Damn right. No thanks to you.
EN: I'm sorry you feel that way. But we both came out ahead, so... no harm done, I hope.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Make it fast. I want my caps.
EN: If the data's intact, you'll get your reward. I gave my word. I'm not the kind of wasteland savage you're used to dealing with.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: What else can you tell me about Anders?
EN: I don't know him very well, myself. I seem to remember that he was the man to call on if you needed someone to get in and get out quietly.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: What else can you tell me about Anders?
EN: Colonel Hsu would really be the person to talk to.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Suit yourself.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
EN: Word around the base is he'd been going regularly to visit a hooker named Dazzle at Gomorrah. That's a casino on the Strip. Classy place.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
ActorNotes: "Classy place" is sarcastic. The place is a dump.
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
EN: His belongings are up in the barracks in the concourse building. First bunk on your left if you're facing in from the center.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
EN: I haven't had a chance to look through his things yet, so that might be a good place to begin.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: You said there have been thefts?
EN: Yeah. We keep coming up short on our weekly supply inventory checks. Guns and ammo, mostly. Not the kind of things you like to see go missing.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: You said there have been thefts?
EN: No witnesses yet. I've got my money on Sergeant Contreras, who's supposed to be in charge of distribution, the little weasel.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: You said there have been thefts?
EN: But he's too slick to let anyone catch him doing it. We've searched his possessions a dozen times. Nothing.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Maybe break-in isn't the right word. We didn't find signs of forced entry. But I've had reports of someone sneaking into the control tower at night.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: It's probably just a meeting spot for a steamy military base love affair. <Sighs> Kids today.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: But it bothers me that they didn't break in. It means they have an access code. Most soldiers around the base don't have that.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Well, there's Anders. He's a Ranger. That one's not suspicious so much as worrisome - he left on a dangerous assignment.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Colonel Hsu sent him out. Now I think he feels guilty not having any way to check up on him.

Speaker: Fitz
EN: See you later!

Speaker: Fitz
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Sure thing!

Speaker: Fitz
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Anything else I can do for you?

Speaker: Hector
Topic_Name: Why is this water so special?
EN: 'Cause it's clean. The crops taste funny if you don't use clean water, but the NCR won't give us any and it's too expensive to buy.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: Well, take this goddamn key anyways. It'll get you into the Maintenance Wing. Maybe you'll brave up and do the right thing. Good luck.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: Well, take this goddamn key anyways. It'll get you into the Maintenance Wing.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: That's it. I'm heading for McCarran. Good luck to you.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in doing that right now.
EN: You sure? You're missing out. Well, you're always welcome, if you should change your mind.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: That's the spirit. Okay, I'll go in and have a word with him. Then I'll call you in.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Have you tried calling him hurtful names?
EN: Yes, and one time I thought I saw a tear when I told him his uniform was unflattering. But I think he just got some dust in his eye.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Don't have anything like that. Sounds nice. Like the kind of thing I'd want to take home and use on my husband.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: But even if we did, I don't know that I'd be comfortable using it. If there's any risk of overdose, it's not worth it. Asshole's too valuable.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
EN: I like the way you think. Have I said that yet?

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
EN: Problem is that the NCR frowns on using that sort of tactic. There are some restrictions still in place from President Tandi's administration.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
EN: But here's my favorite thing about you - you're not {emph}in the NCR. Plus, for all this guy knows, you're completely insane. That's a winning combination.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'll keep an eye out for your missing supplies.
EN: Good. The more guns you can recover, the more I'll be able to use to shoot Contreras for being inept.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: The Vault 22 data is gone. Destroyed.
EN: Destroyed. Really. I find that hard to believe. More likely, you failed to locate the proper server.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: [FAILED] That was years ago. No point in discussing it. We have more practical concerns... and more important things to talk about.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Exactly right. Imagine what the Followers could have accomplished if they were properly motivated... if they had a unified purpose!

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
ActorNotes: the player has said something he agrees with - now he's confiding in player
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: Those of us who founded the OSI... we wanted to put our knowledge to work. And we have, to some degree.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: But the execs at OSI Central... they're still bound to the old ideas. Society of equals, and all that. There's still too little direction.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: If I can make real breakthroughs here... show the President what can be done when junior researchers are kept in line... kept focused on task...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: Who knows. Maybe I'll be sitting in OSI Central, in a few years time. And there'll be no more coddling of "free spirits" like our friend, Williams.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: And what do the Followers believe?
EN: Knowledge for knowledge sake. A society of equals. They purport to be intelligent people, and then they spout this old-world dogma.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Before the bombs, I might have studied at any number of colleges, universities. They gave a man a chance to advance himself... or so I've heard.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: But after the bombs - until a few years ago - anyone with half a brain had one choice. The Followers of the Apocalypse.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Didn't matter if you agreed with them or not. You either played along or you were turned away.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: You didn't always work for the OSI?
EN: No, I... no. The OSI hasn't been around for very long. I received my training elsewhere.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Williams has a tendency to feel before she thinks. Not in the lab. But everywhere else.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: That might be forgivable if she kept her concerns to herself. But she doesn't. Not in front of her peers, not even with contractors like yourself.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: That kind of behavior can undermine morale. She convinced my last contractor to quit. Same way she tried with you.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Probably didn't tell you that, did she?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Best of luck to you. Not that you'll need it. You seem like a reasonably competent person...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: No. "Civilized" people stack the deck in their own favor, don't they?
EN: If you're unhappy with the terms of our agreement, then consider this an object lesson.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: No. "Civilized" people stack the deck in their own favor, don't they?
EN: In the future, I'm sure you'll consider your agreements and contracts more carefully. Now, here is the sum we agreed to.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: What do you think of NCR's chances against the Legion?
EN: To be frank, I have no idea. I leave the fighting to Colonel Hsu, and I expect him to leave the science to me.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: What do you think of NCR's chances against the Legion?
EN: Too many people have opinions on things they know nothing about. And the more ignorant they are, the more opinions they have.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Williams is an admirable researcher. If she wasn't, I'd have terminated her contract, and she'd be begging for work from my former employers.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Believe whatever you want. It's the truth.
EN: Keely. It was Keely, wasn't it? Who else would fail to give a fuck that thousands of people are going to starve, without that data?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Believe whatever you want. It's the truth.
EN: And for what? So Keely can wage her selfish little war against me and the OSI.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: The plants in that vault were dangerous. We destroyed the data.
EN: We? We?! You were a part of this? After we made an explicit agreement, you have the fucking gall to destroy priceless scientific data?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: The plants in that vault were dangerous. We destroyed the data.
EN: The authorities are going to hear about this. They're going to know your name, they're going to know your goddamn face.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: Keely. Again. Do you... do you understand what that rotting old bitch has done?! Thousands of people, mass starvation. We had a chance to avoid that.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: And I had a chance to prove that scientists could be more than a bunch of useless idealists. But Keely doesn't give a goddamn about that, does she?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: You're an accomplice in this. Keely is one old woman - you could have easily stopped her. You're either incompetent, or you were on her side.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: Now get out of this office. Get out!

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Right...  Well, I'll keep that in mind.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Be sure you do.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Right...  Well, I'll keep that in mind.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: If you get this last job done, full access to my stash. At a discount, even. Just because I like you.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Right...  Well, I'll keep that in mind.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Get moving, watch out for raiders, and do {emph}not lose that package. Good Luck.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I'm ready for the next task.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Well, I'm not. Come back tomorrow and the stuff will be ready to transport.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I'm ready for the next task.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: All right, I need you to pass something off to a merchant. The guy's name is Price. The exchange goes down at Miguel's Pawn Shop in Westside.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I'm ready for the next task.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: This next bit is very important. He's paranoid. Maybe a little schizo. You have to identify yourself with a passcode or he'll shoot you right there.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I'm ready for the next task.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Just tell him you're looking for some betting advice. Then he'll say the surest move is to bet on the house.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Here are the medical supplies from Blake.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: See, you're practically stealing caps from me, this work is so easy.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Here are the medical supplies from Blake.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: There's one more job. It's a little more complicated, but I think you're up to it.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Here are the medical supplies from Blake.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: I need to get some stuff sorted around. Gonna take me a day or two, so just stop back in a few days.

Speaker: Silus

EN: I can take anything you've got.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: You're about to tell me everything you know, Silus.
EN: Of course, of course. All you had to do was ask. I'll tell you everything I know.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: You're about to tell me everything you know, Silus.
EN: Let's see. I know that you're a brainless cretin. I know that you're wasting your time. I know the lieutenant is going to be disappointed in you.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: You're about to tell me everything you know, Silus.
EN: And I know that by this time next month the streets of New Vegas will be decorated with the decaying heads of NCR soldiers.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: You're about to tell me everything you know, Silus.
EN: Is there anything else you wanted to know?

Speaker: Silus
EN: [FAILED] I must admit that a conversation with an imbecile may be far worse than the kind of torture I was anticipating.

Speaker: Silus
EN: But somehow I think I'll manage.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: [Speech] I think you're confused. I'm with the excrement right now.
EN: [?] You must have some reason to be in your line of work. Tell me, what did the Legion do to you?

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: [Speech] I think you're confused. I'm with the excrement right now.
EN: Did we enslave your children? Slaughter your family before your eyes to teach you a lesson?

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: [Speech] I think you're confused. I'm with the excrement right now.
EN: Whatever it was, I hope I was there to give the order.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.
EN: [?] You're nothing. You're some inept mercenary the NCR is paying to supplement its own incompetent soldiers.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.
EN: [?] What? No! Listen, Caesar's secrets are safe with me. I stayed alive because Caesar would've wanted it. I'm useless to him dead.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: I'm a friend of the Legion. I'm here to help.
EN: Caesar's eyes truly are everywhere. And here I thought they'd send assassins instead. Did the officer send you?

Speaker: Silus
EN: I don't know what name he goes by here. But I saw him when they brought me in, and I recognized him.

Speaker: Silus
EN: When I saw him last it was ages ago. He was training to be an agent of Caesar's {LATIN}frumentarii. Apparently he passed the trials.

Speaker: Silus
EN: And what a job he's done, to achieve such a rank. I have no doubt he'll deliver a crippling blow to the NCR while he's here. Perhaps many.

Speaker: Silus
EN: I have heard that he has been radioing high-level NCR intelligence back to Caesar's camp virtually every night.

Speaker: Silus
EN: But never mind that now. We don't have much time. If you can get me a weapon, the rest will be easy.

Speaker: Silus
EN: In the hall outside, they still have my possessions in a locker. There's a gun in there that should be small enough to get past the lieutenant.

Speaker: Silus
EN: When she comes back, I want you to go and get it for me. Simple enough?

Speaker: Mobile Facial Recognition Scanner
EN: Intruder Alert! Activating Defenses!

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Right. Good luck.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Of course. Anything.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: Not my problem. Keely is on her own.
EN: I know it's not your business to fend for anyone but yourself. If not for her, do it for the caps. That's all I'm asking.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: That's all I ask. She might even be able to help you. As long as you don't speak too well of Dr. Hildern.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: It never came up. Doesn't bother me.
EN: No, I knew the danger wouldn't. I'm not trying to scare you off the job.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: Maybe Hildern and I need to have another talk.
EN: No, wait! I don't mean to see any harm come to Dr. Hildern. Unless by "talk" you just mean... talk.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: All right. I'll look for her.
EN: I had a good feeling about you. Moment you walked in. I mean it.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: No. Hildern didn't mention anyone else.
EN: But now he's hired you. Which means one of two things. Either he heard back from Keely, and she failed, or he's given up on her.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: No. Hildern didn't mention anyone else.
EN: Listen. I make a fair wage, but I'm not rich, not by any means. Maybe my kind of money wouldn't appeal to your average merc.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: No. Hildern didn't mention anyone else.
EN: But I'm willing to pay you, if you'll find Keely and make sure she's safe. Isn't right leaving her out there, no idea if she's alive or dead.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: You're right. It's none of your business.
EN: We shouldn't even be talking about this, I know. But I think someone should tell you. You're not the first one he's sent to Vault 22.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Not interested. More concerned. It's just... you're not the first person he's sent to Vault 22. And I know he'd never tell you.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: Yes. He asked me to get some data from Vault 22.
EN: I shouldn’t say anything, I know that. But you’re not the first person Hildern's sent out to the vault.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: Yes. He asked me to get some data from Vault 22.
EN: There were a lot of mercs. One after another. None of them came back.

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: Yes. He asked me to get some data from Vault 22.
EN: Then, about a week ago, there was a scientist. Keely. She's unusual, not the sort of person you'd expect, but she's an absolute genius, and...

Speaker: Angela Williams
Topic_Name: Yes. He asked me to get some data from Vault 22.
EN: And he didn't mention her? Not even her name? Or any of the other mercs?

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Nice to meet you. If you need anything, I'm almost always in the lab.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: I can't say. We're not supposed to talk about the research. Not the details. If you're interested, I'm sure he'd see you.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: You mean... give you work? No, that'd be up to the administrator. Hildern. He's back there in his office.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Between you and me, I don't think he ever leaves. Plenty of mercs go in to see him, though.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Head researcher. Mostly on the Dam project, but I help out on other things, when they need me. Got to be flexible.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: I know I don't sound the part. Get raised by brahmin ranchers, and you never lose the twang. Drives Hildern crazy.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: But I know every inch of the power grid from Hoover Dam to Shady Sands. That's what we do here - try to optimize the power output from the Dam.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Some of the others are working on an agricultural project, but... truth be told, they aren't making much progress. Not yet, anyway.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: This? The OSI lab. We don't get many visitors. The smell puts people off, I think.

Speaker: Angela Williams
EN: Nobody ever said science would smell clean and fresh. Anyway, you get used to it, if you give it some time.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: What was that about salvage and traps?
EN: That's right, the H&H Tools factory on the main drag. It's been sealed for ages, and it's lousy with traps. Still, might be something valuable to you.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: What is there to do here?
EN: Keep your nose to the ground, stranger, that's what. Mind your own business and let us mind our own, are we clear?

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: What is there to do here?
EN: If you've got a mind to loot the old H&H Tools factory, don't even bother. That place is sealed tighter than a Radscorpion's bunghole.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: What is there to do here?
EN: Every salvager who tries gets blown up, flattened, or gutted by traps. Then he starts to stink up the town and we're the ones to clean up the mess.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: If you've got the caps, I'll back any claim you want.
EN: [FAILED] Hmm. Honesty's a good trait, stranger, but I don't deal with mercenaries unless I'm damn sure they can be trusted.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: If you've got the caps, I'll back any claim you want.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Spoken like a true mercenary. Well, you seem like you can handle yourself, stranger, and we can use people like that.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: If you've got the caps, I'll back any claim you want.
EN: We may not squander our wealth like those fools in the Strip, but we take care of our own business. Consider this a token of good faith.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: If you've got the caps, I'll back any claim you want.
EN: I've got the skills, the will and the firepower. All I expect is a decent reward for my work.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in this, right now.
EN: Suit yourself.

Speaker: Crandon
EN: [FAILED] Really? You'll forgive me if I ask you to back that claim up, won't you?

Speaker: Crandon
EN: [SUCCEEDED] That's the kind of stuff I like to hear, stranger. All right, we could use someone like you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I respect your independence, and I'm good at taking care of troubles.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: Doesn't the NCR keep order around here?
EN: NCR... did you just crawl out from under a rock? Those folks only care about {emphasize all three "theirs"}their business, their people and their pockets.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: Doesn't the NCR keep order around here?
EN: NCR's order? Don't make me laugh, stranger. We work this land, we own these streets, and we yank up the bad weeds ourselves, got it?

Speaker: Crandon
EN: Folks that don't belong. Murderers, rapists, extortionists, and everything in between.

Speaker: Crandon
EN: You know, business as usual in North Vegas, stranger.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: Need a hand with any trouble?
EN: You want to help us out? What makes you think we want you around here, huh?

Speaker: Crandon
EN: Name's Crandon, stranger. I keep an eye out for trouble around here.

Speaker: Crandon
EN: We've been here for a few years, just looking for a place we can call our own.

Speaker: Crandon
EN: Life's harsh, but still, it beats the hell out of the desert. We've got numbers, we've got food, and we've got trade. That's progress, stranger.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: Tell me more about your role here.
EN: Jules, myself, and a few others patrol the streets and sewers. Any punks come up out of the rest of the city, we give 'em the run off.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: Tell me more about your role here.
EN: Like I told you, we look out for each other here. Me, Jules, and a few others make sure any trouble stays the hell out of our streets.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Don't worry.  I paid him off.  He won't be a problem.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: You bribed a {emph}Ranger? Ha! That's gotta be some kind of special talent.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Sounds simple enough. I'll get right on it.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Thanks. Don't come back until you have it. Crimson Caravan is just northeast of the Gun Runners. Blake's usually in the main office.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Great. The Crimson Caravan has something ready for me.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Look for Blake and let him know you're picking up Contreras' medical supplies.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Don't worry.  He won't be telling anyone anything ever again.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Good to hear.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: <Hand Contreras the package> Nah, but he is definitely looking for you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Thank God. You're going to need to take him out.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: <Hand Contreras the package> Nah, but he is definitely looking for you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Topic_Name: I didn't really have a choice.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I didn't really have a choice.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: ...and I don't think you want to go in front of a firing squad either. You take care of this, my entire stock is available to you.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I didn't really have a choice.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Hell, I might even throw in something extra to sweeten the deal.

Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Topic_Name: Just some supplies for McCarran from the Crimson Caravan.

Topic_Name: Ok. I'll just be on my way then.

EN: Stay out of trouble.

Speaker: Keller
Topic_Name: What's going to happen to him?

EN: He'll be shot. We have no tolerance for chem dealers in the military.

Speaker: Keller
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: [SUCCEEDED] It might work since he's acting as a major hub for this activity. It's not like he has much choice now that we have evidence.

Speaker: Keller
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: If you can convince Contreras to work with the Rangers to break up the drug ring, I'll call off the firing squad.

Speaker: Keller
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Just report back to me when he's agreed to make the deal.  Otherwise, he's dead.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: I'm sure Contreras could work with you.

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: Can anything be done to improve your supplies?

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales

Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: {Done joking, serious}Just kidding. Haven't you heard? With few shipments from home and little variety, the troops are getting restless for some quality grub.

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: {Matter of fact}You can only do so much as a chef with just corn, beans, onions, and peppers.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Then you're not from the colonel's office? Sorry... I shouldn't have bothered you.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: Sorry, I don't have time to help you out.
EN: We are going to die in here. Please, if you find the key let us out. We'll find our own way to safety.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the Fiends?
EN: They are a bunch of junkies that do whatever they can to get money for chems.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the Fiends?
EN: I hear they are lead by a guy calling himself Motor-Runner. I think he is in one of the other wings, although I haven't seen him myself.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: I need to know a little more about Vault 3.
EN: I don't know much, only that the people who lived in here originally were killed by the Fiends. Carter there escaped and managed to explore for a bit.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: I need to know a little more about Vault 3.
EN: He hacked a password off of the computer, and found the location of some guns. He was on his way to get them when the Fiends caught him again.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: Yeah, I'll see what I can do.
EN: Thanks partner. I think the Fiend with the key is back in one of the bedrooms somewhere, someone called him Daniel. If that helps.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
EN: We were part of a caravan heading into New Vegas from down south. They are holding us hostage, trying to get some ransom.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
EN: Anyone willing to pay for us died in the attack. Once the Fiends figure that out, we are as good as dead.

Speaker: Rick Lancer
EN: Can you set us free now?

Speaker: Crandon
EN: That's good to hear. Can't ever be too careful with strangers around here.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I've dealt with those newcomers.

Speaker: Crandon

EN: Not yet. I'll get on it.

Speaker: Crandon
EN: That's good to hear. Can't ever keep too many eyes on strangers around here.

Speaker: Crandon
EN: I take care of those who help with that. Here, you earned it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I've dealt with those newcomers.

Speaker: Crandon

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I haven't sent them to the sewers, yet.

Speaker: Ruby Nash
Topic_Name: McCarran has more vegetables and water than they know what to do with...
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fresh food and water is worth it's weight in gold... You've got yourself a deal.

Speaker: Ruby Nash
Topic_Name: McCarran has more vegetables and water than they know what to do with...
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
