Speaker: Ruby Nash
Topic_Name: Maybe we could work something out later.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Suit yourself.  I'm always open to more business.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: The scientists here must have made some useful discoveries.
EN: Oh, they did. I've taken extensive notes of all their successful experiments. Their research won't go to waste. As for the file erasure...

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Never mind. Go ahead and delete the files.
EN: You're pretty highstrung for a youngster. In any case, just a few more moments and...

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: <Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?
EN: It's possible. I have spent the last few days in a cave, after all.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: <Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?
EN: For all we know, that man sent someone immediately after you to swipe the data while you posed as mantis bait.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: <Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?
EN: Nothing to be done about it, I suppose. All we can do is delete what's here, and that's done.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Good riddance. Those files have caused enough trouble.
EN: Indeed. This should only take a minute. Just a few more moments and...

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: On second thought, go ahead and erase the data.
EN: Glad you're thinking clearly. I was afraid to blink there for a second.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: On second thought, go ahead and erase the data.
EN: There, all done. That wasn't so bad, was it?

Speaker: Keely
EN: Then you give me no choice.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: I'm afraid I can't let you do that.
EN: So you're going to be stubborn about it, eh? You're sure I can't change your mind about this?

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Actually, I copied the files. Hildern sent me here to get them.
EN: Yes, that sounds like something he'd do. Well, there's nothing for it, then.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Actually, I copied the files. Hildern sent me here to get them.
EN: Those files need to be erased. Hold out your arm and I'll have it done in a flash.

Speaker: Keely
EN: No, it shouldn't take all that long. Just a few more moments and...

Speaker: Keely
EN: ...it's done. We can rest easy.

Speaker: Keely
EN: ...that's strange. The system says that the files were accessed recently, and copied to an external source.

Speaker: Keely
EN: You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?

Speaker: Keely
EN: I've unlocked the door so you're free to run along now. Although it pains me to say it, I wouldn't have made it out of here without your help.

Speaker: Keely
EN: If you're heading back toward McCarran, tell Dr. Williams that she has my thanks as well.

Speaker: Keely
EN: If you're in the neighborhood of Camp McCarran anytime soon, look for a Dr. Williams. She was one of the few people there I could tolerate.

Speaker: Keely
EN: She seemed genuinely worried when I agreed to come out here, so if you could be a dear and let her know I'm okay, I'd be most grateful.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Exactly. Without that knowledge, something similar is bound to occur.
EN: All right. You convinced me. Take the files back to that buffoon. You make a good point, but I still honestly hope you know what you're doing.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Science isn't just about success. Failures are just as important to learn from.
EN: I suppose the data here could serve as a warning to other scientists. Tell them what paths of research not to follow.

Speaker: Keely
EN: How do you figure that?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Deleting those files makes it more likely that this will happen again.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain.
EN: No, these people died trying to stop a monster of their own creation. Failing to complete their work would mean they died in vain.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain.
EN: And that's what I intend to do. And...

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: I need those files. Dr. Hildern specifically sent me here to find them.
EN: Don't you realize what those files represent? If they get into the wrong hands, this could happen all over again.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: I need those files. Dr. Hildern specifically sent me here to find them.
EN: Only this time, the madness won't just be confined to a musty vault. Do you really want that on your conscience? I sure as hell don't.

Speaker: Keely
EN: What's got you so flustered? You just about scared me to death shouting like that.

Speaker: Keely
EN: I've managed to create a connection to the vault's backup system from here. I just have to remotely delete all the files, and we're done here.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?
EN: I set the gas to pump into the fifth level since that's where the concentration of spores was highest. I'd start looking there.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?
EN: Typically, these vaults use circular vents in their air circulation systems. Look for a wall with two of them almost side by side.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?
EN: There's one just around the corner outside this lab if you need an example.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: Know where I can find a doctor?
EN: I'm pretty sure they've got a doc over at Camp McCarran, but I don't know if he'll treat just anybody.

Speaker: Lupe
EN: The Crimson Caravan Company's the big dog around here. Keep following the road north and you'll eventually come across their camp.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: That's all I want to know right now.
EN: All right.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: I have some general questions for you.
EN: Shoot.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: What do you know about the NCR?
EN: Their main base is right over there by the old airport - it's called Camp McCarran now. Some people like to paint 'em all as a bunch of bullies.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: What do you know about the NCR?
EN: Me, I'm glad they're around. They do what they can to keep things safe and orderly.

Speaker: Lupe
EN: They're a bunch of crazies hopped up on all kind of drugs. Apparently, they're using one of the old vaults as a hideout.

Speaker: Lupe
EN: The army should really get in there and wipe 'em all out, but I guess they've got more than enough trouble to deal with right now.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: Anything I should know about New Vegas?
EN: They won't just let anybody into the Strip, but you should be able to have a good time in Freeside itself. Just, uh, keep a close eye on your caps.

Speaker: Keely
EN: Well, if they had any manners they would. In my day, if an old lady went missing for a spell, people cared.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: What? You idiot! I spent years earning his trust. The whole point of your heading up this operation was to preserve that trust!

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Now they'll replace him in a week with some other colonel and I'll be back to square one. You've set me back years today. Years!

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Get the hell out of my sight.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Hsu bought it. You should be in the clear.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Perfect. This has turned out better than I'd ever imagined.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Hsu bought it. You should be in the clear.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: This will pay dividends for the Legion for a long time to come. I was with Hsu when the bomb went off. He'll never think to investigate me for it.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Hsu bought it. You should be in the clear.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I'll make sure Caesar himself hears about your success today. And take this, courtesy of the NCR. I'm sure they won't miss it.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Who should I be talking to about the intelligence leaks again?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Well, I'll leave that to you. But I would recommend Lieutenant Boyd and Sergeant Contreras as two people who usually know what's going on around here.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I don't. I was just trying to get myself out of trouble.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I can't let you leave.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Very well. Let me know if you should change your mind.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in helping you. You're on your own.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Are you sure? Because I think the Legion would frown upon that decision.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Could you go over that again?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Yeah, let's make sure you have it down pat.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Good. Try to plant the explosives quietly if you can - you'll make both our lives easier.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But first things first. Go offer your services to Colonel Hsu. Tell him you'll work independently to find the leak.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: He's running out of options. He'll accept as long as you don't give him a reason not to.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If he doesn't, then don't be surprised if you're the new scapegoat. So don't fuck this up.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: The scapegoat isn't me, is it?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: No, no. I wouldn't do that. Not unless I didn't have better options, anyway. And I do.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Tell me what I need to do.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I have the explosives stashed in a trash can next to the ticketing counter along with some incriminating documents.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Tell me what I need to do.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You'll pick them up and make your way upstairs to the monorail terminal.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Tell me what I need to do.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: They change the guard there at 0900 and 1800 hours. There'll be a small window where there's no one guarding the train.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I told you I think they're starting to suspect me. You're going to help me cast away those suspicions.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You're going to put the bomb on that train.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I'll be sure to be in the presence of several reliable eyewitnesses when it happens. Then we're going to pin this on a scapegoat.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I'd planned on disappearing after this operation. It'd be a matter of time before they traced it to me. Figured out I was a {LATIN}frumentarius.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But with your help, maybe I can stay on after all. Make plans for something... grander.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If you haven't noticed, the NCR bolsters its presence on the Strip from here. Sends troopers on the monorail in shifts.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: The monorail lets them occupy two positions for the price of one. It's a supply line that's immune to raiders and other hindrances on the ground.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If someone were to cut that line, both positions would be much weaker. Fragile. They know this, and they watch it like hawks.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But I've been here a long time, and I've learned everything there is to know about it. And I'm going to blow up that train.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: How many years have you been on this assignment?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Took me three-and-a-half years, just to make Captain. Usually takes four, but I made sure there was an early vacancy.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
ActorNotes: the second sentence is a euphemism - he murdered a guy.
Topic_Name: How many years have you been on this assignment?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Caesar sees threats before they're even aware of him. He sent me long before we moved to occupy the eastern riverbank.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: How many years have you been on this assignment?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: And now all my work, all the waiting, is about to pay off.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Is that right? No one has any business being in there after dusk. I wonder...

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: There's a lot of communications equipment up there. He could be using it to touch base with whoever sent him.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You've already done us a lot of good, but I'm afraid to move on this myself. We've tried catching this guy before and he can always smell a trap.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But he may not know about you. I need you to follow him into the tower. See if you can discover his identity. Report back and I'll have him arrested.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Report back when you've got it and I'll have him arrested.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: It's done. The evidence is in Crenshaw's locker and Crenshaw is dead.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Poor Crenshaw. He's pulled his last prank.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
ActorNotes: Curtis ordered Crenshaw's death. This is said with a smirk.
Topic_Name: It's done. The evidence is in Crenshaw's locker and Crenshaw is dead.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Go and tell Colonel Hsu you found the bomber. Once Hsu's convinced, we can breathe easy.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: You don't seem like you're supposed to be here, either.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Really? And how would you know where I'm supposed to be?

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have clearance for catching spies.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I don't know what you mean.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Bye.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Officially I'm in charge of Bravo Company. But since General Oliver has Bravo and most of our forces here garrisoned, I'm free to do other things.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: So I work with Colonel Hsu on logistics. Patrols, supply lines, reinforcements, that sort of thing.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Hell of a position to be in when you're working for the other side. But I have to sabotage with a light touch, or else my guilt would be obvious.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Lately it's been less about that and more about figuring out how that information is getting leaked to raiders.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: It's a big base with a lot of unhappy soldiers. They get stir-crazy. Hard to separate the malcontents from the actual culprit.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Christ, keep it down! You want to blow the whole thing? We've worked years for this.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But maybe it's good you're here. Hsu knows about the leaks, and I'm supposed to find the spy for him.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
ActorNotes: Thinking during the first sentence. Hsu = "shoo"
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: At first I couldn't believe my luck. But since I haven't produced results - for obvious reasons - I feel him looking at me differently now.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Maybe he's just thinking about putting someone else in charge, maybe he's starting to suspect. Either way it's bad for me.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Especially once this next part goes down.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Colonel Hsu wanted me to help you look into the recent intelligence leaks.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Smart man. I could use somebody who can operate under the radar around here.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Colonel Hsu wanted me to help you look into the recent intelligence leaks.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Whoever our mole is, he's been slippery. Whenever one of the MP's gets too close, he changes his habits. Our last lead went cold weeks ago.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in this right now.
EN: Suit yourself.

Speaker: Mrs. Hostetler
Topic_Name: You mentioned your husband works for the caravans?
EN: Yes, he's an account manager for the Crimson Caravan Company. He works such long ours to provide for our daughter and me.

Speaker: Mrs. Hostetler
Topic_Name: You mentioned your husband works for the caravans?
EN: You should speak to him if you get the chance - he's always saying how badly understaffed they are.

EN: Your wife and one of your children are dead.

Speaker: Frank Weathers

EN: I... God help me, I ran! I abandoned my family to those butchers. Not a day goes by I don't hate myself for that.

Speaker: Frank Weathers

EN: You'd do that for a complete stranger? Thank you, friend. The army says they don't have the available manpower - as if this city is more important.

Speaker: Frank Weathers

EN: From what I've gathered from NCR rangers, they were most likely taken to Cottonwood Cove. You might start there.

Speaker: Frank Weathers
Topic_Name: Wow, some protector you turned out to be.
EN: Go ahead, mock me. Nothing you say can be worse than my own shame.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Get it done.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras

EN: You had your chance.

Speaker: NCR Trooper

EN: Go on through, soldier.

Speaker: NCR Ranger

EN: Go right ahead, trooper.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Hold it. NCR only beyond this point. Keep your distance or I {emph}will fire.

Speaker: NCR Trooper

EN: Sorry. No civilians on the monorail. Any closer and I am authorized to use deadly force.

Speaker: Pretty Sarah
Topic_Name: You sure know how to make a girl feel welcome.
EN: Just needed to make the situation clear is all. How can I help you?

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: In the right hands, it could do a lot of good. I'll see it gets there.
EN: I suppose you've given me no reason not to trust you. Fine, take the data and go. I hope you know what you're doing.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Do you know how many caps I can get for it?
EN: Ah, I should have known. Well, in that case...

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: That data is valuable to me.
EN: What do you mean?

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Why is the door to the entrance locked?
EN: Are you kidding me? This place is under quarantine! We can't let a single spore get out of this place if we can help it.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What were you doing down in that cave?
EN: The mantises and spore plants virtually ignored me for most of the time that I've been here.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What were you doing down in that cave?
EN: It was only once I began to investigate the fifth level that my presence began to agitate them. I guess I was a little too close to home for them.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What were you doing down in that cave?
EN: A few days ago, I was attacked by a large number of mantises and was knocked unconscious. When I woke up, I was in that cave.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What were you doing down in that cave?
EN: The mantises seem to feed some of their prey to the plants. Fortunately for me, it appears the plants are disinclined to eat ghoul meat.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What happened to the scientists, then?
EN: Something prevented them from igniting the gas, obviously. I suppose it's possible that the gas triggered some kind of defensive reaction.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What happened to the scientists, then?
EN: Hordes of previously slumbering creatures may have awoken and entered a killing frenzy, ripping the hapless scientists into quivering, bloody chunks.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: What happened to the scientists, then?
EN: You'll have to let me know when you get back from going downstairs.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How did you get this whole gas thing set up so quickly?
EN: That's a very good question! Actually, I didn't come up with it. The systems were already set up to pump the gas when I first arrived here.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How did you get this whole gas thing set up so quickly?
EN: I believe the scientists were in the process of attempting to ignite the gas just as we're about to do. And by we, I mean you, of course.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Where did these plants come from?
EN: From what I've been able to determine, the scientists here managed to breed them by combining traits from two distinct plant species.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Where did these plants come from?
EN: The resulting hybrid proved more adaptable than expected, however, and soon became a threat to humans.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Where did these plants come from?
EN: It's sad, really. All those wonderful minds, undone by their own irresponsibility.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: No way. I'm not going to torch myself for your amusement.
EN: It would be pretty funny, wouldn't it? Oh, don't look at me that way. I'm sure you'll be fine.

Speaker: Keely
EN: What? Do I have to figure everything out for you? Fine, let me think for a second.

Speaker: Keely
EN: Yes, there'll be an explosion when the gas is ignited. But I'm sure you'll be fine. Now leave me to my work.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to survive that?
EN: That does pose a problem, doesn't it?

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to survive that?
EN: If you could seal yourself inside a room before the explosion went off, you might be protected from the blast.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to survive that?
EN: Then again, the flames will probably blow into the rooms down there. Maybe if there were a room that was reinforced...

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How am I supposed to survive that?
EN: Well, I'm sure you'll figure something out.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Did you say there'd be a blast?
EN: Oh yes, I imagine there'll be quite an explosion when the gas gets set off. Fire will probably expand throughout the entire level in mere moments.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How exactly should I ignite the gas?
EN: In the area where the gas is active, any kind of fire or explosion should do the trick. Hell, even lasers would do the job.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: How exactly should I ignite the gas?
EN: If you don't have anything like that, I've got some grenades in my bag in the corner that you can use.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: No questions right now. I'll be going.
EN: Well in that case, leave me to my work.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: Get your rifles and move out, First Recon. We've got a Fiend to kill.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: Fascinating. Let's talk about something else.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Sure thing. Careful, though. I'll talk your ear off.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Aww.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: [Attack] The bad news is I'm here to relieve you of your life.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: What- What are you doing?

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: Good news, private. I'm here to relieve you.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Really? That's great. I was getting so sick of this.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: [Attack] I'm going to get you in trouble for blowing up the monorail.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: What? Like hell you are.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: <Pull Pin>I just pulled the pin out of somebody's grenade.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Man, I can't wait to see the look on his face!

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: That's great because I'm in the middle of pulling a prank right now.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: No kidding! What'd you cook up?

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: What kinds of pranks have you pulled?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Aw, usual stuff. Brought a brahmin upstairs in the terminal once. They can go upstairs but not down. Two heads and both of 'em dumb as stumps.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: What kinds of pranks have you pulled?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: That got me some detention time, but it was worth it 'cause they couldn't get the brahmin back down, so it visited me a few times in my cell.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: What kinds of pranks have you pulled?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Dropped some firecrackers in the toilets too. That was the real bad one for me.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: What kinds of pranks have you pulled?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Turns out there's no way to replace the toilets now. Toilet company blew up in the War. I think they'd just have shot me if they weren't shorthanded.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Topic_Name: I've heard you're kind of a prankster.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Heh. My reputation precedes me, I see. Yeah I pulled a few pranks in my time.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: It's in the main concourse. That's the building just across the skybridge. There's a barracks area that'll be behind you on the left when you enter.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: His stuff will be at the foot of one of the beds.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Where can I find Private Crenshaw again?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: He's stationed just inside the south wall of the base. Should be on patrol, if he isn't screwing around.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: All right, you can stop for a sec.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: All right. Goodbye.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Never mind. Forget I mentioned it.
EN: Okay. I will. Guess that's something I'd rather not talk about, that's all.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: I really don't know. Come on, Sergeant, you can tell me.
EN: [FAILED] No. What's it matter to you? Why's everybody care so much about other people's business?

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: I really don't know. Come on, Sergeant, you can tell me.
EN: Just leave it lie. And leave me be.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You're not telling me something. You couldn't have forgotten the whole massacre.
EN: It's like I tell Major Dhatri. Best not look under a rock, if you don't really want to know what's there.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
ActorNotes: player is getting into dangerous - and deeply hidden - territory
Topic_Name: You're not telling me something. You couldn't have forgotten the whole massacre.
EN: Could be that NCR found some blood on me, and none of it mine. Could be that a few of those Khans didn't die from NCR bullets.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
ActorNotes: player is getting into dangerous - and deeply hidden - territory
Topic_Name: You're not telling me something. You couldn't have forgotten the whole massacre.
EN: I had scores of my own to settle... deeper ones than NCR ever had. Don't bother asking who they were with.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How did you survive the massacre?
EN: Guess I could tell a pretty good story, if I had a mind. But the truth is, I don't know. Just got lucky.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How did you survive the massacre?
EN: They brought me to Dhatri after the battle. He was just a Captain, back then. Guess he saw something in me... knew I didn't belong with the Khans.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How did you survive the massacre?
EN: Maybe he felt bad, too. About how his men killed my folks. I told him he did me a service, but he didn't believe me. Still doesn't.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How did you survive the massacre?
EN: He's a good man, Dhatri. Doesn't act like it sometimes, I know. But he didn't have to take me in.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: So your name... it comes from Bitter Springs.
EN: In the Khans, you're not fully grown 'til you've taken a beat-down. Everybody gathers round and hits you until you're damn near dead.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: So your name... it comes from Bitter Springs.
EN: After that - if you haven't begged for mercy - you get to choose a new name. One you'll use for the rest of your life.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: So your name... it comes from Bitter Springs.
EN: When NCR slaughtered the Khans at Bitter Springs, I hadn't got my beat-down yet. I was still too young.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: So your name... it comes from Bitter Springs.
EN: Way I see it, Bitter Springs was my beat-down. So afterward... I gave myself a name. It's all I've got from the Khans, and it's all I ever want.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: Don't I? Mister, you never met my parents.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: Don't I? Beg pardon, ma'am, but you never met my parents.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: My dad, he got himself fucked up, every chance he got. Always started with folk for no reason.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: Hell, he was the one who taught me to shoot. You know how? By taking potshots at NCR. And not just soldiers. Civilians, too. Even kids.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: Then he'd get high with his buddies and swap tales about the folk they killed. Bunch of animals.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: And my mom... couple times she tried to sell me to some waster, just to score some Jet. Even the other Khans said she was useless.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: You don't really mean that, do you?
EN: Only reason they kept her around was because she was a... how'd my dad say it... "a smokin' piece of ass."

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Losing your parents must have been hard for you. I'm sorry.
EN: You're sorry? Well, that makes one of us. Bitter Springs was the best thing that ever happened to me.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Losing your parents must have been hard for you. I'm sorry.
EN: Best thing that ever happened to my parents, too. They were as bad as the rest. Worse, maybe.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: I've heard enough. Let's talk about something else.
EN: Yeah. That's probably best.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Tell me about happened to them at Bitter Springs.
EN: It was massacre. That's what a lot of NCR folk will tell you. Most of them feel plenty bad about what happened.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Tell me about happened to them at Bitter Springs.
EN: But I was there. Saw it myself. I don't care what anybody says. The Khans asked for Bitter Springs. They wouldn't leave the NCR be.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
ActorNotes: quietly bitter - he's talking about the people who raised him, but he's convinced himself he hates them
Topic_Name: Tell me about happened to them at Bitter Springs.
EN: My damn parents, too. They were just as bad as the rest.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Great Khans?
EN: They're scum. Lazy, trumped-up Raiders. Most of the time, they're drunk or high, and when they're not shooting chems, they're selling them.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Great Khans?
EN: Used to have a settlement up at Bitter Springs, 'til they pissed off NCR and got slaughtered for their trouble.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Great Khans?
EN: Lot of us got killed at Bitter Springs. Lot of them, I mean. My parents died, too.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: They're dead. Got themselves killed at Bitter Springs. Served them right, if you ask me.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: I didn't mean to offend. You don't have to tell me, if you'd rather not.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] It's a Khan name. You know... the "Great Khans." That's what my parents were.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
ActorNotes: A little reluctant to reveal this. Hates the Great Khans.
Topic_Name: I didn't mean to offend. You don't have to tell me, if you'd rather not.
EN: I figured I grew up around the bastards... they owed me a name, after all they put me through.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Bitter-Root. You have an unusual name.
EN: You trying to start trouble? Or do you really not know where I got that name?

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How long have you been with the First Recon?
EN: A while, I guess. I don't keep too careful track of time.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How long have you been with the First Recon?
EN: I like to keep things simple. Just focus on now. That's why they made me a sniper.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: How long have you been with the First Recon?
EN: You let your mind wander back a ways, and you lose sight of what's in front of your eyes. Good way to miss a mark.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Your father is your commanding officer? Is that allowed?
EN: Yeah, look... he's not my real father. He just looked after me, for a while.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Your father is your commanding officer? Is that allowed?
EN: It's a long story. And I'd get tired of talking before it was through.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Your father is your commanding officer? Is that allowed?
EN: It's like I told you. Dhatri's not my real father. He just looked after me for a while.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: Where can I find some work around here?
EN: You a merc? Then I guess you'd want to talk to my, uh... father. Major Dhatri. He's our CO.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: Guess not. I don't mean nothing by it.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: You really want to talk to somebody, try 10 of Spades. He's always got plenty to say.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: Me, I'm here to do my job. For now, that job is shootin' Fiends.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
EN: {10 of Spades dead}10 of Spades always had plenty to say, before he got himself killed. Me, I'm just here to do my job.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I don't really agree with you, but I'm not interested in moving drugs for you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Fine, piss off then. I thought we had a good thing going here, but it looks like you're just a goody-goody.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: The law is the law.  I'm done doing business with you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Now see, that's just downright unfriendly of you. I can't just let you go shooting your mouth off to Boyd now can I?

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Lying bastard.  I want cut in on this action.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: You're one pushy son of a bitch, I'll give you that. Alright, here are some caps to keep your mouth shut.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Lying bastard.  I want cut in on this action.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: There is a lot of money to be made, and I'm not afraid to share it with reliable folks. Just keep the busters out of this and we're good.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Lying bastard.  I want cut in on this action.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: So you've got the package then? I need to get that sorted and then sent off in a few days.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Bullshit.  If you're moving drugs, I'm going to have to report you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Whoa there, kiddo. No need to blow things out of proportion. I'm just selling certain ingredients on the side, not chems.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Bullshit.  If you're moving drugs, I'm going to have to report you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Besides, it's not like drugs are a big deal. Alcohol is just as bad yet it is perfectly legal in the NCR. I'm just a businessman doing business.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: All right.  I guess I believe you.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Good. Does that mean you have those supplies?

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Hey, these medical supplies look like chem ingredients.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Really? I never noticed that. I'm just following orders here, moving supplies as needed.

Speaker: Monorail Recording
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: The tram is about to depart. Please keep clear of the doors, and restrain any young children.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You're getting too close, shamus!

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: This is where your trail runs cold.

Speaker: Little Buster
EN: Hey, yeah. Next time you see me, maybe I'll be rolling in a shitload of caps, right?

Speaker: Little Buster
Topic_Name: You've worked a lot of different trades?
EN: Oh, yeah. A lot. Like, before I was a bounty hunter, I worked as a caravan guard. You'd think that was a cakewalk, right? Wrong.

Speaker: Little Buster
Topic_Name: You've worked a lot of different trades?
EN: Crazy bastards expected me to wake up at dawn. Forget it. That's about two hours after this guy hits the sack.

Speaker: Little Buster
Topic_Name: You've worked a lot of different trades?
EN: And I need at least ten, twelve hours of sleep to do my job. Price of excellence.

Speaker: Little Buster
Topic_Name: How long have you been a bounty hunter?
EN: Oh, shit, I don't know.  Got to be at least a month. Longer than I last at most jobs.

Speaker: Little Buster
Topic_Name: What are you going to do now?
EN: Simple. I'm going to make myself some easy money. I got a plan.

Speaker: Little Buster
Topic_Name: What are you going to do now?
EN: Once I get my caps from Dhatri, I'm going to head on over to Gomorrah and win big at cards.

Speaker: Little Buster
ActorNotes: thinks this is a pretty clever plan
Topic_Name: What are you going to do now?
EN: There's not as many people playing at Gomorrah, so that means I've got better odds of winning big. I got this figured out.

Speaker: Little Buster
EN: 'Course you didn't. 'Cause they crossed paths with Little Buster. Bam! Dead, finished, over.

Speaker: Little Buster

Speaker: Rotface
EN: People in Freeside generally fall into one of two categories. Those who've been here all their lives call themselves Locals.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: When people from the NCR and other places started pouring in, the Locals began referring to them as Squatters, and the name stuck.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Locals blame the Squatters for the scarcity of resources in Freeside, and the Squatters blame any act of violence against them on the Locals.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: They're both right to some extent, and violent outbreaks between the two are all too common these days.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: If you've been around the Kings, you may have met one of them named Pacer. He's always stomping around trying show off his authority.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Being new, you weren't around when it happened, but a few months ago Pacer pissed off the Van Graff family big time.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: No one knows what went down, but word is the Van Graffs still want him dead.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Drugs are everywhere in Freeside, and even people you might not expect have become addicts.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Jacob Hoff, for instance. That man was a brilliant chemist before he picked up the habit. Now, just another junkie.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: That King Pacer's a fan of Jet, too, though I heard one of the Followers talking about it being dangerous for him. Something about his heart.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Do yourself a favor, and stay away from that stuff, okay?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: In the area between the north and east gates is the Old Mormon Fort, where the Followers of the Apocalypse have set themselves up.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Followers aren't a bad bunch, and provide healing and supplies to the people of Freeside as they can.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I've heard the Garrets over at the Atomic Wrangler are having a hard time collecting some money owed to them.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: An enterprising person like yourself might be able to make some caps helping them with their little problem.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Caught a rumor the other day that some of the clientele over at the Wrangler have been making some rather strange requests.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Stuff like weirdos wanting the, ahem, services of ghouls and such. I almost have half a mind to volunteer myself, sexy beast that I am.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Have you tried going to the Strip, only to be stopped by those big metal murder machines? Happens every day around here.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: But if you know the right people, you can get through the gate without being a rich man.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I probably don't have to tell you that Freeside's dangerous, but you might want to think twice about hiring one of those guards at the gates.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: They're not all saints, is all I'm saying.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Have you been to Mick & Ralph's yet? They run a store just down the street, and sell some things you might not expect.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There's a guy out on the main drag who sells second hand adventuring gear. He's got an okay selection, but where does it come from?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: He might not look it, but Ralph from Mick & Ralph's is no slouch with a keyboard. I've heard he's helped reprogram several robots in his time.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Saw a strange thing the other day. The King took that robo-dog of his over to the Old Mormon Fort.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Weird thing was that the dog was flipping out, and had to be restrained by a few of the King's men. Hope he doesn't get loose.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Things have generally been bad here for the Squatters, the people who came here hoping for a better life and just got stuck.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: But lately the mood has changed. The Squatters seem to be a bit more optimistic. I wonder what happened?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Mention the NCR and people around here get a little on edge. There's talk that they're going to take over all of New Vegas.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: It doesn't help that they've got military camps all over the place, and more troops pour into the area daily.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There's a rumor that a huge army is camped to the east, massing to attack the NCR. Like that'd ever happen.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Who in the world could stand up to the NCR and win?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: While everyone knows Mr. House runs New Vegas, no one knows the first thing about him.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: He just sort of showed up a few years back, and everything you see around you is the result. Just who in the hell is he?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Strip is run by the Three Families, who owe their allegiance to Mr. House.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: When he first showed up, he gave the local tribes the choice of working with him or getting the hell out of his way.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Given how things turned out, I know which way I'd have gone, but hindsight's twenty-twenty, right?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Omertas, one of Mr. House's Three Families, run a casino called Gomorrah on the Strip.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: If you thought the Wrangler was something, you owe it to yourself to go there.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Chairmen run a casino on the Strip called the Tops. It's a pretty classy place, by all reports.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I haven't been there myself, but I hear security there is kinda tight. Don't expect to bring your weapons in there.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There was a rumor a while back that the White Glove Society was really an all-ghoul gang, which is why they wear those weird masks of theirs.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: What do you think, would I look good in a mask? Maybe I'd make more caps...

Speaker: Rotface
EN: A traveler that passed through here not long ago told everyone he met that there's some kind of plant paradise to the west where food is abundant.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: All the people foolish enough to listen to him and head out that way never came back.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Ever hear of the Gun Runners? They sell just about every kind of firearm you can imagine, and some you probably couldn't.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I've heard people passing through mention some kind of underground fights pitting creatures of the waste against one another for sport.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: And when I say "underground," that's their word I'm using, not my own.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: East of Freeside there's an old air force base, judging by the road signs.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: No one knows for sure what's in there, though, on account of anyone approaching the place getting violently blown up.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I heard something about a town south of here being attacked, but details are sketchy. All I know is there haven't been any refugees showing up here.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Which means either the attack wasn't too bad, or it was very, very bad.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Traders have been griping for a while now about the 15 being too dangerous to travel. I'd steer clear of it unless you're armed to the teeth.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The NCR used to run a prison to the southwest, but something happened a little while back, and now all you'll get is hard looks if you ask about it.

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: Oh, I should mention that I don't go where I'm not invited, so don't count on me following you inside private property. Ready to get going?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Here's the money. It sounds like I could use a bodyguard.

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: That is most regrettable, my friend. I wish you well in the meantime.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'd hire you, but I don't have the caps.

EN: Need a bodyguard?

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: You got the caps, I got the guns!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: These guys couldn't keep fleas off a dog. Hire me!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: Protection services for hire over here!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: Safe travel through Freeside!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: You need the best. Hire me!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: Your safety guaranteed!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: Freeside's a dangerous place, my friend!

Speaker: Bodyguard For Hire
EN: Only I can keep you safe, my friend!

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Heck Gunderson said he was here to talk business with you. What business?

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Heck Gunderson said he was here to talk business with you. What business?

Speaker: Marjorie

Speaker: Marjorie

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Who did you talk to about the disappearance?
EN: Well you can already guess what probably happened, can't you? It seems perfectly likely that she got cold feet and ran off.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Who did you talk to about the disappearance?
EN: And that young groom just didn't have a clue, the poor dear.

Speaker: Marjorie

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society used to eat human flesh?

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society used to eat human flesh?

Speaker: Marjorie

Speaker: Marjorie

Speaker: Marjorie

Speaker: Heck Gunderson

Speaker: Heck Gunderson

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
EN: My boy, Ted. He was right here. I didn't leave him but a minute. I told him to stay put while I talked some things over with the White Glove folks.

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
EN: He never was one to stay tied down to a spot, though. Gets that from his mother.

EN: In that case, I suppose you're here to collect. I apologize, but I simply do not have enough caps on me to cover the debt.

Speaker: Lady Jane
Topic_Name: I was hired by the Garrets to track you down.
EN: If someone were to recover my caravan from that cave, I could easily pay in full, but who would bother with such a mess?

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: I can collect from your corpse, if you prefer.
EN: Here are the caps I owe! No need for violence!

Speaker: Santiago
EN: [SUCCEEDED] When did this happen?! Hey, look. I only do the Santiago bit as a way of getting free stuff. I didn't think it would get me in trouble.

Speaker: Santiago
ActorNotes: Spoken plainly without the rico-suave tone.
EN: Here is everything I have on me. Keep the extra for yourself! The last thing I need is a constant stream of bounty hunters after me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: With a price on your head, you should be paying me to say you're dead.

Speaker: Santiago
EN: [FAILED] You are not a VIP. You do not tell Santiago what he needs to do.

Speaker: Santiago
EN: Leave me now. Santiago grows bored of this exchange.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You need to pay me to pay the Garrets right now.

Speaker: Santiago
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I didn't think she was upset enough to have me killed... Here are the caps I owe.

Speaker: Santiago
EN: I do the Santiago act to get out of paying for services every once in a while. I didn't think it could possibly get me killed.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'd rather not kill you, but Francine put a bounty on your head.

Speaker: Santiago
EN: [FAILED]You think Santiago is susceptible to such idle threats? Santiago laughs at your silly bluff.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm going to... Well, I'm sure it will be very painful if you don't pay.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: <Punch Santiago in the face> I won't ask again, Santiago.
EN: Ow! Okay. Here! Take the caps, just don't hurt Santiago again!

Speaker: Santiago
EN: Santiago is offended that you would opine such slander.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: Santiago is dead if he doesn’t cough up what he owes the Garrets.
EN: Sir, Santiago does not know what he has done to offend, but he can explain everything.

Speaker: Santiago
EN: [SUCCEEDED] 25 caps will do. Tell Mick Santiago sent you and the code word is 'extravaganza'. He will set you up.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I don't even know this discount is worth 50.  How about 25 caps?

Speaker: Santiago
EN: [FAILED] Sorry, my friend. 50 caps is the price to be a VIP.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: What kind of moron would pay 50 caps for information?  25 caps.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: 50 Caps is a bit steep, but okay. Here, now what is it?
EN: Santiago thanks you. Tell Mick Santiago sent you and the code word is 'extravaganza'.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: VIP? The Garrets said nothing about VIP status.
EN: Yes indeed, Santiago is very important. I even have a discount at Mick & Ralph's.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: VIP? The Garrets said nothing about VIP status.
EN: Perhaps you could use Santiago's discount? For 50 caps, Santiago will tell you the super secret code word to get a discount with Mick.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: Francine warned me that you're a smooth-talker.
EN: Indeed, Santiago is a poet among pretenders. If you are here to collect for the Garrets, Santiago is debt free.

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: You owe the Garrets a bunch of caps.
EN: Santiago does not owe anyone. Santiago is a Freeside VIP.

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Oh, by the way. That damn eye of yours is creepy. Get it checked out.
EN: <Twitches> A scum-humping water baron did this to me. No one trash-talks the eye.

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Seriously zombie, are you looking at me or someone off that direction?!
EN: That's it! No one insults the eye!

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Yeah, and your eye! That shit is hilarious!
EN: <Twitches> My eye? A scum-humping water baron did this to me. No one talks trash about my eye.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: What? Thank you Mr. Obvious. I haven't heard that in a while.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: What? Thank you Mrs. Obvious. I haven't heard that in a while.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Anything, take it! Just don't kill me, man!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Heh, I think I'll make an example of you. Give me your clothes, or you get dead.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: [FAILED] You're freaking crazy. I'm not stripping for you. I'm already broke.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You cheapass zombie.  You need to pay my extra fee.

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Thanks for the caps, now enjoy the zombie afterlife.
EN: Oh God! Help! Help!

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: That'll do. Mess with the Garrets again and you're dead.
EN: I won't. Thanks for not killing me.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Okay! Here. That's everything I've got except the clothes on my back. I'm sorry about this.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You don't cheat the Garrets and walk away. Cough up the rest or you're rat bait.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: [FAILED] Hey, I'm tapped out, man. I've got nothing left but the clothes on my back.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You cheapass zombie.  You need to pay my extra fee.

Speaker: Grecks
EN: Interest?! The Garrets said nothing about interest on their tabs. Look man, I've got the caps right here, just don't hurt me.

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: You owe the Garrets a good lump of caps. I'm here to collect.
EN: Ah crap. I was hoping they'd forget about my tab. Look, I've got the caps right here, just don't hurt me.

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Your hangman, if you don't start being straight with me.
EN: Whoa, yeah. I guess the Garrets sent you after me? Look, I've got the caps right here, just don't hurt me.

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Sure, man. Here you go. <Punch Grecks in the face>
EN: Ow! What the hell was that for?!

Speaker: Grecks
Topic_Name: Are you the Grecks who owes the Garrets?
EN: That all depends on who's asking.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: I operate the radio and call it in if we see any Great Khans moving out in large groups from Red Rock Canyon.

Speaker: Comm Officer Green
EN: Ranger military outpost. We're keeping an eye on the Legion activities south of here at Cottonwood Cove.

Speaker: Comm Officer Green
EN: Nothing going on down there at the moment - just the usual slave trafficking. Poor bastards.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: All quiet at the moment. Ranger {BOH-mont}Beaumont is in charge here, but he's off leading a patrol.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: It was quiet until those rockets blasted off over our heads.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: There was a hell of a boom over at REPCONN. Looks like the ghouls had some sort of accident with their rockets.

Speaker: Comm Officer Tilden
Topic_Name: What do you do out here?
EN: This is the frontier of NCR territory, and we're the first line of defense. You won't find much in the way of civilization east of here.

Speaker: Comm Officer Tilden
Topic_Name: What do you do out here?
EN: South of here is Camp Guardian, but they've been having radio trouble so they've been silent for awhile now.

Speaker: Comm Officer Tilden
Topic_Name: Sergeant Reyes sent me here. I've got a security update for your radio.
EN: No problem. Hey, do me a favor when you get back to Reyes and tell her that we don't need any more damn ammo. Wouldn't mind more water, though.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why the VIP treatment? I'm just a courier.
EN: Oh, don't be coy. You've been playing a high-stakes game ever since Victor dug you out of the ground. Don't be afraid to admit it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Can we get down to business?
EN: Oh, by all means - yes. That's refreshing.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Can we get down to business?
EN: The business is this. One of my employees has stolen an item of extraordinary value from me, and I want it recovered.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Can we get down to business?
EN: Simple enough?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Can we get down to business?
EN: You're ready to move forward, then?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I prefer the wasteland, to be honest.
EN: {arch}You aren't going to ramble on about the virtues of life out in the wastes, are you? It's a desert, you do realize?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I prefer the wasteland, to be honest.
EN: A radioactive desert where humans subsist in a barbaric state? Difficult to glorify convincingly. They are, however, aptly named.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I prefer the wasteland, to be honest.
EN: For that's what you'd be out there - wasted. Here on the Strip, your talents can be put to use.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: A city devoted to vice and sin - what's not to love?
EN: {not buying it}Oh, come now - don't play the fool. Vegas has fools enough, a superfluity of them. They're what makes it so profitable.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: A city devoted to vice and sin - what's not to love?
EN: They come to Vegas chasing penny-ante dreams of high-living, to feel like they're big shots, like they're winners.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: A city devoted to vice and sin - what's not to love?
EN: You see that you and I are of a different stripe, don't you? We don't have to {emphasis}dream that we're important. We {emphasis}are.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I've never seen anything like this place.
EN: Of course you haven't. Vegas always was one of a kind.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I've never seen anything like this place.
EN: What you see down on the Strip is just a fraction of the city's former glory, and yet... {beat}more than an echo. I preserved its spirit.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I've never seen anything like this place.
EN: Or perhaps you were referring to the Lucky 38? The years haven't been kind to her, but still she manages to impress.

Speaker: The King
EN: Like what?

Speaker: The King
EN: What about him?

Speaker: The King
EN: I completely understand. No reason you should take on someone else's problems. Let me know if you change your mind, though.

Speaker: The King
EN: Now, was there anything else you wanted to talk about?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
EN: I can't thank you enough. Now, there's a few things you should know about ol' Rex here if you're going to be traveling together.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
EN: First, he hates rats. Can't stand the things. Giant rats, molerats, doesn't matter. He catches a whiff of one and he's off like a shot after them.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
EN: He's normally pretty obedient, but you might have to chase him some if he goes after one of the little varmints.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
EN: Second, he doesn't like hats, or the people wearing them. Don't ask. I have no idea why. Maybe because it rhymes with "rats".

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
EN: That should be it, though. Other than the occasional bad spot when his brain starts hurting him, that is, but I'm hoping you'll see to that.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
EN: I wish you both luck. Take care of my Rex now, y'hear?

Speaker: The King
EN: I don't know. Maybe. If you found a way to help my poor Rex here, I'd be much obliged.

Speaker: The King
EN: Your best bet would be to talk to Julie Farkas over at the Old Mormon Fort north of here. Maybe you'll have better luck than I did.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Is he going to be okay?
EN: For now, but they said eventually he's going to get worse. I don't know what to do.

Speaker: The King
EN: No, they said they don't have the tools to help him.

Speaker: The King
EN: We're different than other gangs, and not just because we dress better. We're not just a group of thugs looking for our next fight.

Speaker: The King
EN: The Kings are about an idea, you see? Where every man is free to follow his own path, do his own thing. Where every man is a king in his own right.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Freeside?
EN: To understand Freeside, you have to look back a few years. Originally, we were all just tribes making a living in this area.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Freeside?
EN: That all changed when Mr. House came around. He made an offer to the three biggest tribes that were willing to listen to him.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Freeside?
EN: Today, everyone calls those tribes the Three Families, and they live in luxury and run their own casinos in the Strip.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Freeside?
EN: The rest of us were left to fight over the crumbs, living in the shadow of those more fortunate. Things got pretty nasty for a while.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Freeside?
EN: But we wanted more. A place of our own. A place where no one could tell us what to do. And we didn't want to go elsewhere to find it.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Freeside?
EN: So we took control of this place, and made it our own. And that's really all Freeside is, the best of a bad situation.

Speaker: The King
EN: Sure, what's on your mind?

Speaker: The King
EN: He goes through spells like this from time to time. The Followers said his brain is going bad or something.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Is there something wrong with him?
EN: He's been acting peculiar for some time now. I took him to the Followers and had him checked out, and they said his brain is bad or something.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Where did you get the robot dog?
EN: I got Rex here from a salvager a few years ago. He was a little dinged up when I got him, but one of the Followers fixed him right up.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: I've got a few guys already waiting to go.

Speaker: The King
EN: Pace, I want you to take some guys down there and seize half of those supplies.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: The NCR is distributing supplies in a building down by the old train station.
EN: Handing out supplies? Like food and stuff? That ain't nothing to get ruffled over. You find anything else?

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Then go someplace else.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: I guess you're not getting in here then, are you?

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Go ahead.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Head on through.

Speaker: Elizabeth Kieran
Topic_Name: Are you with the NCR military?
EN: Yes, I'm a major in the supply corps, which is where this food and water comes from.

Speaker: Elizabeth Kieran
EN: You're quite welcome. If you meet anyone who needs food or water in the area, please tell them about this place.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Then I can't help you with that, but I do have lots of other tips that come much, much cheaper...

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Thanks, I'll go check it out.
EN: Good luck!

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Wow, I might have to head down to the Wrangler tonight with all these caps weighing me down.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Much appreciated. The guys you're talking about have been spotted near the old train station in the northwest.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There've been more and more Squatters heading that way each night, too. Word is, there's a password to get into the building.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, fine. One hundred it is, but only because you're a good customer.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I've already paid good money for this information. A hundred more caps, no more.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: [FAILED] I've got a business to run here, you know. The price is 250.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You want even more money? Are you insane?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: It'll cost you 250 caps.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Then I can't help you with that, but I do have lots of other tips that come much, much cheaper...

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Much appreciated. The guys you're talking about have been spotted near the old train station in the northwest.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There've been more and more Squatters from around here heading that way each night, too. Word is, there's a password to get into the building.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You're a scoundrel. I'll let it go for 50, but no lower.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: If you ever want me to buy another tip from you, that price'll come down.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: [FAILED] How about 200 since you're such a smartass?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: How about 15 caps since we both know you need the money?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: You drive a hard bargain. Here you go.
EN: Much appreciated. The guys you're talking about have been spotted near the old train station in the northwest.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: You drive a hard bargain. Here you go.
EN: There've been more and more Squatters heading that way each night, too. Word is, there's a password to get into the building.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: {Ask if he's heard about NCR soldiers in the area.}
EN: Could be. Could be. That kind of information doesn't come cheap, though. I'll need at least 150 caps for this one.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Ask if he's heard about NCR soldiers in the area.}
EN: You know anything about NCR soldiers prowling the area?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: {Ask if he's heard about NCR soldiers in the area.}
EN: Could be. Could be. That kind of information doesn't come cheap, though. I'll need at least 150 caps for this one.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Ask if he's heard about NCR soldiers in the area.}
EN: You still have some info on those NCR soldiers that have been about?

Speaker: Francine Garret
EN: This is great news. No one screws with the Garret Twins and gets away with it. I need to find a place on the wall for this.

Speaker: Francine Garret
EN: And for your reward... Here's 150 caps. I trust there were also some valuables on McCaffery. Also, we would like to set you up with a room.

Speaker: Francine Garret
EN: You can have the corner room, rent free. It was McCaffery's. Now that he's dead, we're happy to let you use it. Thanks for helping us.

Speaker: Francine Garret
EN: Yes! Where is his hat?!

Speaker: Francine Garret
Topic_Name: I have some other business to handle, maybe later.
EN: Just bring back his hat if you decide to take care of him for us. He stole 2,000 caps.

Speaker: Francine Garret
Topic_Name: I have some other business to handle, maybe later.
EN: I doubt much of that will be on him if you find him. If you kill him, keep whatever is on him, and I'll reward you for his hat.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: Oh man, I don't even like to think about it. All that goddamn blood. It was just in the hotel like any other night.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: I took some chems with the girl I was with, but I never {stressed:Never}black out. I did this time though.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: Next thing I knew I woke up and she was lying next to me stabbed dead. There was a knife next to the bed and I was covered in her blood.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.

Speaker: Troike
EN: Hey man, I don't know nothing. Let me have some peace here, buddy.

Speaker: Troike
EN: Hey man, I don't know nothing. Let me have some peace here, lady.

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: Who do you think you are, talking to me that way?
EN: Who do-? Who the fuck do you think I am? I'm the fucking god of New Vegas brahmin fusion cuisine, that's who.

Speaker: Philippe
ActorNotes: Repeating back "who do you think you are?" stunned that someone would dare ask.
Topic_Name: Who do you think you are, talking to me that way?
EN: No. No. That doesn't even give me the credit I deserve. I fucking invented edible food!

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: Who do you think you are, talking to me that way?
EN: Do you like eating? Good. You owe me your entire goddamned garbage existence.

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: I think you may have me confused with someone else.
EN: Oh really? So despite your filthy face and your vacant expression and your complete lack of human dignity, you're telling me you're not a server?

Speaker: Philippe
EN: Don't make eye contact with me! Look at the floor. And get back to work!

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: Not quite. When I kill you, however, the job will get done right.
EN: You think you can take me, punk?

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I'm unable to work out a deal. The Great Khans are all yours.
EN: It was worth a try. I'll have to proceed with the attack as ordered, then.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: What are you going to do about the hostages?
EN: "Acceptable casualties," I've been told. I don't like it, but the brass has their reasons.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: Good luck.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I could sneak in there and try to get your people out.
EN: As soon as you free them, the rest of my squad will move in and provide covering fire.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I could sneak in there and try to get your people out.
EN: You should wait until it's darker so that you have the best chance to pull this off.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I could sneak in there and try to get your people out.
EN: You should go now, while it's still dark. That way, you'll have the best chance to pull this off.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
EN: Normally, I'd turn you down since I have no idea who you are, but considering that the hostages are as good as dead when we attack...

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
EN: All right, I'm going to give you a chance to talk to the Great Khans. Their leader is a man named Jessup.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
EN: If we hear shooting, we'll be coming in, but it'll probably be late for you.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: That's a conversation we might be able to have some day - once you've shown more respect for my country.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: I can provide a quick history lesson, if that's what you're looking for.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: In 2274, President Kimball sent the NCR army into the Mojave in force, with the objective of occupying and repairing Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Rangers and army scouts had confirmed that the dam was basically unoccupied and could be restored to an operable condition.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Upon arriving at the dam, however, they discovered that a large force of tribals and robots had occupied it.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: This was our introduction to the Three Families, the Securitrons, and, of course, Mr. House.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Using his Securitrons as intermediaries, Mr. House called for parlay.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: He claimed his forces had occupied Hoover Dam in order to safeguard it for our arrival.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: And that he was ready to turn it over to us, so long as we could agree to terms.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Those terms became the Treaty of New Vegas.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The Treaty recognized Mr. House's sovereignty over the Strip and granted us rights to establish military bases at the Dam and McCarran Airport.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The NCR is legally permitted to send 95% of the electricity produced by the dam to our home states.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The remaining 5% goes to the Strip.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The treaty actually makes it illegal for the NCR to prevent its citizens, or troops on furlough, from visiting the Strip.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Once on the Strip, our citizens are subject to arrest - or punishment - by House's Securitrons, though that's a rare occurrence.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Our troops enjoy a different status. It's illegal for the Securitrons to take action against them.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Of course, it's also illegal for our troops to carry firearms on the Strip, so there isn't much trouble they can get into.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Our military police does an adequate job of keeping the troops on furlough in line. I don't envy them that task.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The embassy was established a few weeks after the Treaty was signed.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Basically Mr. House handed us a dumpy little building he had no interest in renovating.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: I'm the third ambassador to hold this post. And the first, I think, to accept its limitations.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: My predecessors had ambitions of engineering the annexation of the Mojave. They thought they'd convince Mr. House to join up.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: I've never even spoken to the man - or whatever he is. Maybe the situation will change once we've beaten the Legion once and for all.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: If that's all you came here to talk about, you're wasting my time. Get to the point, or get out of my office.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I know you have a penchant for getting into trouble, but I'd recommend against that here. The Securitrons on the Strip aren't to be trifled with.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Perhaps I'll have Captain Pappas keep an eye on you. For your own safety, of course.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: It's the same old stuff around here. Gambling, debauchery, drunkenness. It's all here. I'm getting a little old for it, however.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: If you want more information try talking to some of the other guys around here. I don't get out of the office much anymore.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Interested in Politics, huh? Well, grab a seat and get comfortable.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I've been in politics quite a while now. Always had the drive to do it, even when I was young. It's just something I was drawn to.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
