Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I wanted to talk to you about the Boomers.
EN: I hope you've returned with good news. Are they willing to help the NCR?

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I wanted to talk to you about the Boomers.
EN: What's the word with the Boomers? Have you talked with them yet?

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: I know I'm not the scheduled speaker, but I have a few words, if I may.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: There was a time not so long ago when we were bound together not as members but as family. As a clan.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: And when Mr. House came to us with his proposal, we accepted, knowing we stood to gain much.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: Little did we know how much we'd lose in the process.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: As a society, we've endeavored to sample the finest food and drink the world has to offer. But we are living a lie.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: There is a meat sweeter than the most cornfed livestock. Most of you have tasted it. All of you have coveted it.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: Among us, it is a crime to discuss a return to the old ways that unified our people.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: Tonight, that all changes. The taboo ends. {aside, preventing an interruption}Let me finish, Marjorie.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: You don't know it yet, but you are all now guilty of a greater crime. One that ordinarily bears the harshest of punishments.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: Surely that you are all guilty warrants not only universal amnesty but also a renewed discussion.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: For our society to be truly elite, we must dine on the most delicious, the most exclusive food known to us.

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: And tonight, for the first time as a society, you are sampling that very dish, the meat we are forbidden to taste, the way it was meant to be eaten!

Speaker: Mortimer
EN: Fellow members of the White Glove Society, bon appetit!

Speaker: Head Waiter
EN: Very well.

Speaker: Head Waiter
EN: At once.

Speaker: Head Waiter
EN: But no one is in their chairs yet. Surely we should wait until 7 when the dinner guests arrive.

Speaker: Head Waiter
EN: I'll be ready when you need me.

Speaker: Head Waiter
Topic_Name: The wine is ready to be brought out.
EN: Right away.

Speaker: Head Waiter
Topic_Name: The wine is ready to be brought out.
EN: But no one is in their chairs yet. Surely we should wait until 7 when the dinner guests arrive.

Speaker: Head Waiter
Topic_Name: The wine is ready to be brought out.
EN: I'll be ready when you need me.

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: Would you, uh, go step in the pantry for a minute?
EN: [FAILED] Now why the fuck would I do that? I don't have time for games. Stop wasting my time.

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: I think I saw a radroach in the pantry. You should check it out.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] No! It'll ruin my ingredients!

Speaker: Ike
EN: The NCR has been constructing bunkers up and down the river. From what I've heard, it's a little late for that.

Speaker: Ike
EN: Travelers over at the 188 - just up the road - said that the Legion has overrun a couple of towns to the south.

Speaker: Ike
EN: Most of the town is rubble - destroyed during the Battle of Hoover Dam - and the only other thing around here is the concrete mixing yard.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: How have you stayed alive all this time?
EN: Let's just say it was very... {beat}costly. But I was willing to make the sacrifices longevity entailed, financial and otherwise.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I see you've made a study of the topic. My knowledge of the science of longevity would fill several text books...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
EN: Perhaps, after a decade or two of economic reconstruction, I can commercialize these technologies and offer to others, such as yourself.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
EN: The lifespan you're claiming is impossible, except for ghouls and super mutants.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
EN: [FAILED] No. While brains demonstrated some use as organic processors in the robots produced by General Atomics International...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
EN: They never retained personality once removed from the human body.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Use Medicine skill to surmise House's condition.
EN: You must be, like... a brain in a jar!

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You appear to be a computer, not a man.
EN: Don't let the video screens and computer terminals fool you. I'm flesh and blood, not silicon.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use [Speech] to press Mr. House about the Chip.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You might keep an eye out for any computers that Benny's been using. Maybe even a computer lab of some sort...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Use [Speech] to press Mr. House about the Chip.
EN: The more I know about the Chip, the easier I can find it...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use [Speech] to press Mr. House about the Chip.
EN: [FAILED] You have a contract to fulfill, a delivery to make.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Use [Speech] to press Mr. House about the Chip.
EN: If you can't hold to a contract, simply for the ethic of holding to a contract, you're worthless to me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Use [Speech] to press Mr. House about the Chip.
EN: The less I know, the less I care. Know what I mean?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Tell me about the factions vying for New Vegas.
EN: It's understandable that you'd be curious about this topic, but we'll hold off until the Platinum Chip has been recovered.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Who exactly are you, Mr. House?{Before Chip turned in.}
EN: I am Robert Edwin House, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the New Vegas Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Who exactly are you, Mr. House?{Before Chip turned in.}
EN: I oversaw the city's renovations starting from 2274 onward. The Three Families are my employees.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Who exactly are you, Mr. House?{Before Chip turned in.}
EN: Before the Great War of 2077, I was the founder, President and CEO of RobCo Industries, a vast computer and robotics corporation.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was your relationship with Benny... back when he was breathing?
EN: Benny was the leader of the Chairmen for seven years, ever since I recruited the tribe. I considered him something of a protege.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: It's a very special item. There's nothing else like it in the entire world. It was lost a long time, and difficult to find.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: That's all you need to know about it, for this stage of our enterprise. Fulfill your contract, deliver the Chip, and good things will come your way.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Benny has led the Chairmen ever since I recruited his tribe seven years ago.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Until his recent misbehavior, I'd planned to make him my protege. Maybe if I'd begun grooming him sooner, none of this would've happened...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: My only concern is the recovery of the Platinum Chip. What happens to Benny, I leave to your discretion.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: When you bring the Chip to me, I will pay you four times the delivery bonus stipulated in your contract. How's that?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As I said before, Benny's fate is yours to decide. Once you've delivered the Chip, I will pay you the amount agreed-upon.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Tell me your terms again?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: I've resurrected Vegas, spirit intact. What I need now is the ability to enforce my rightful claim.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Not just against Caesar's Legion, by the way. In fact, the NCR is a more present and insidious threat.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: To enforce, one must have force - a position of strength.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Years ago, when I detected NCR scouts roaming the Mojave, I could tell from their uniforms that these were no mere tribesmen.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: I knew it was only a matter of time before an army appeared, to take control of the dam. And I knew my Securitrons wouldn't be enough to oppose them.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: And so I recruited the Three Families. Vegas belongs to me because I mustered enough strength to bring the NCR to the bargaining table.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: How do you intend to enforce your claim on the city?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Indeed it was - and still is. But not without taking significant casualties.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Would Kimball and Oliver have traded the lives of hundreds of soldiers for absolute control of Hoover Dam? Oh yes.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: They weren't afraid of me, they were afraid of Caesar - that attacking me would leave them vulnerable to a Legion offensive.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: And so they negotiated. Not out of the kindness of their hearts, as they try to make it seem. Because the calculus of power left no other choice.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Wasn't the NCR's army big enough to defeat your Securitrons and the Three Families?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: NCR forces were permitted to occupy Hoover Dam and establish a military base at McCarran Airport. {not an airport anymore}Well, it used to be one.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: They recognized my sovereignty over the Vegas Strip and agreed to supply electricity and water once their engineers repaired the dam.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Written into the treaty were provisions that the NCR do nothing to prevent its soldiers and civilians from visiting the Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: That's how I harnessed the NCR to my endeavor. Their occupation has been the engine of my growing economy.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: What were the terms of your treaty with the NCR?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: The salient issue is that they will go to war with me, if given the chance.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: There's just one reason why the NCR hasn't contrived some outrage to justify invading the Strip - Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: The final battle between those two armies is fast approaching. I can't afford to let either side win on their terms.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: You would go to war against the NCR?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: New Vegas is more than a city - it's the remedy to mankind's {beat}derailment.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: The city's economy is a blast furnace in which can be forged the steel of a new rail line, running straight to a new horizon.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: What is the NCR? A society of people desperate to experience comfort, ease, luxury... A society of customers.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: With all that money pouring in? Give me 20 years, and I'll reignite the high technology development sectors. 50 years, and I'll have people in orbit.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: 100 years, and my colony ships will be heading for the stars, to search for planets unpolluted by the wrath and folly of a bygone generation.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Say you keep control of New Vegas. What happens next?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: I prefer the term "autocrat."

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: I would rule as a chief executive. I would not answer to a board of directors or any other entity.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Nothing to impede progress. If you want to see the fate of democracies, look out the windows.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: In the meantime, you'd rule Vegas as some kind of dictator?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: My judgement.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: I have no interest in abusing others, just as I have no interest in legislating or otherwise dictating what people do in their private time.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Nor have I any interest in being worshipped as some kind of machine god messiah. I am impervious to such corrupting ambitions.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: But autocracy? Firm control in the hands of a technological and economic visionary? Yes, that Vegas shall have.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: What's to keep you from abusing your power?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll return when I have the Chip.
EN: Until then.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Very well, five times the bonus. {with finality}Not one cap more.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: It's a good start... but well below market price.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: [FAILED] Is that an attempt at...{beat}{distaste} humor?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I've always taken business negotiations very seriously. I advise you to do the same.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Raise your price or... or, uh... you're "chip outta luck."

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: My offer far exceeds the original terms of your contract, which, I will remind you, already obligate you to deliver the Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {satisfied}Well enough.  Return to me when you have the Platinum Chip in your possession. Any final matters for us to discuss?

Speaker: Orris
EN: You idiot! What part of "play dead" do you not understand?

Speaker: Orris
EN: It's regrettable, but it looks like I'm about to lose another customer.

Speaker: Centurion
EN: Okay, that's it. Orris isn't paying us enough to put up with this shit. Let's just kill this one and be done with it.

Speaker: Orris
EN: Nothing to worry about. If you had hired one of those other hacks, you'd be up to your ass in lowlife right about now.

Speaker: Orris
EN: Leave them to me!

Speaker: Orris
EN: That was rather invigorating, wasn't it? Let's keep moving, it's only a little further to the gate.

Speaker: Orris
EN: Gotcha! Thought you could ambush us, huh?

Speaker: Orris
EN: I'll scout ahead. You follow at a distance.

Speaker: Orris
EN: Well, here we are. No worse for wear, are you? I trust that if you need to cross Freeside again, you'll know who to hire.

Speaker: Orris
EN: Well, here we are. I trust you'll keep your mouth shut about the topic we were just discussing, or else.

Speaker: Orris
EN: Hey, slow down. I don't like the look of some of those men ahead. Let's take a different way around.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: No, you haven't.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: This is the second time you've promised to deliver the Platinum Chip. Even if you don't hold yourself to your promises, I will.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {impatient}Please focus on the task at hand - for both our sakes.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You signed a contract in good faith to deliver that Chip. You're going to have a hard time on the Strip if you are so incautious of making enemies...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: So you've said before. You're making a habit of wasting my time.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Okay. See you soon!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: 20 caps for a crappy rat-hole? C'mon, you can do better than that.
EN: [FAILED] What? A crappy... rat-hole!? My vault!? You are cruisin' for a bruisin', shuckster! The price stays.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Sarah, I plan on staying here often - got a special price for a special client?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well. Sure! You seem pretty special. But that will be our secret, okay?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: On second thought, I don't need a room right now.
EN: Okay! How can I help you?

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Go all the way down to the Vault's main hub. Your room's in the hallway to the left. Enjoy your stay!

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Okay! You know where to go. See you soon!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I have Vault gear for you.
EN: You do? That's wonderful! Let's see what you brought.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I have Vault gear for you.
EN: All right! That's going to net you lots of caps, my friend. Do you want to trade all your vault suits right now?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: There are some things I wanted to know about you.
EN: I see. Okay, your move.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I would like to ask you some questions about Vault 21.
EN: All right! What would you like to know?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Let's see what you have for sale.
EN: Take a look at this.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Are you the owner of this hotel and shop?
EN: Well... it is my vault, all right. I mean, yeah. That is, no.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Are you the owner of this hotel and shop?
EN: I take care of it but I suppose you could say that it belongs to Mr. House.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: What kinds of things do you sell in this gift shop?
EN: I have all sorts of things. Vault souvenirs, vault wares, vault machines, vault mementos and vault suits! And, well, lots of other vault things, too.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: A vault hotel? Was it like this before the war?
EN: No, silly! Of course it wasn't always a hotel.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: A vault hotel? Was it like this before the war?
EN: I grew up in it. I love it - my favorite place in the world!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: A vault hotel? Was it like this before the war?
EN: Not that I know much of the world - I never left this place, come to think of it... but it is the most special vault, ever!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I would like a room, please.
EN: All right! We have an available room for you. That will be just 20 caps.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I would like a room, please.
EN: A special room for a special client!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I would like a room, please.
EN: For The Strip VIPs, like you, I've got just the right room - at half the price.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I would like a room, please.
EN: My shop's open for you, but not my Vault. I don't need trouble-makers staying at my home, no thanks.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I would like a room, please.
EN: Having you tonight is my pleasure. Your room is ready!

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Hey, you there! I have a message for you.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: It's from Ambassador Crocker. Very important. Here you go.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: [Attack] Doesn't matter. I'm going to finish what they started.
EN: The hell you will.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: I could always leave you here if you aren't going to listen.
EN: All right, all right. But there's gonna be some justice one way or another. I'll see to that.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: I could always leave you here if you aren't going to listen.
EN: Let's go. I'll be right behind you.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: You're right. Let's make sure they're all killed.
EN: Damn right, I'm right.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: You're right. Let's make sure they're all killed.
EN: All right, let's get out while the getting's good.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: You should have them all killed. It would serve them right.
EN: I never liked them White Shoes in the first place. We'd be doing the Strip a service.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: You should have them all killed. It would serve them right.
EN: Let's go. I'll be right behind you.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society isn't to blame. Just Mortimer and a few others.
EN: To hell with that. You've seen those freaks. They dress the same, talk the same. You can bet they all eat the same, too.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society isn't to blame. Just Mortimer and a few others.
EN: They deserve what my daddy's gonna have coming for them.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: Some members of the White Glove Society. They were going to eat you.
EN: What in the sam hell? Eat me? What kind of sick bastards would eat a person?

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: Some members of the White Glove Society. They were going to eat you.
EN: I'll tell you what. Soon as I'm out of here and my daddy knows the story, you can bet there ain't gonna be no White Hat Society no more.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: There's no time to explain. We have to go now.
EN: All right, fine. I'm right behind you.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: Calm down. I've come to get you out of here.
EN: My daddy sent you?

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: Calm down. I've come to get you out of here.
EN: Goddamn it, I almost died in here! What the hell took you so long? It's just one damn hotel.

Speaker: Ted Gunderson
Topic_Name: Calm down. I've come to get you out of here.
EN: Who did this to me, anyway? They hit me over the head before I got a look at 'em.

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: On second thought, let's talk about something else.
EN: Okay, what's on your mind?

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: Something about his story doesn't sit right with me.
EN: What? That he's a murdering Jet-head? Not a new story around here.

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: Actually, I'd like to see about getting him out of his obligations to you.
EN: {laughs}Why would I want to do that?

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: What kind of business do you do here?
EN: We run a hotel. What do you think our business is?

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: I'd like to talk to you about Troike.
EN: Ah, Troike? What's he want? Some more Jet, a fresh batch of girls? Maybe a guy or two this time?

Speaker: Nero
Topic_Name: I'd like to talk to you about Troike.
EN: My associate Big Sal deals with Troike and his business. When my shift down here is done you can talk to him.

Speaker: Cachino
Topic_Name: Um, nevermind. Sorry I said something.
EN: Damn right you're sorry.

Speaker: Troike
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I guess if Cachino trusts you I can tell you a little of what happened. It all started with a prostitute in here.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Cachino forgot to tell me what they have on you.

Speaker: Troike
EN: [FAILED] No way, man. I don't want to think about it, much less talk about it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Err... I know what they have on you... Well I know, but I forgot. Tell me again.

Speaker: Troike
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Great. So I'm fucked either way. I guess I don't have any choice but to help you. Just try not to get me killed here.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> If you don't help me, I'll report your work here to NCR.

Speaker: Troike
EN: [FAILED] Nothing you could do scares me as much as the Omertas.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Tell me what you know or I'll, um... break your nose.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Maybe I can help you out of your contract with the family.
EN: More power to you if you can, but keep me out of it. I've been doing business with Big Sal, so he's going to be your man.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: I'm looking to help Cachino break up whatever the Bosses are planning.
EN: Yeah? Well fuck that. The bosses have my number, and I'm a company man while they've got the goods on me.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: Seems you need to work on your marksmanship.
EN: {amused, keeping voice down}I hit what I was aiming for. Guess you had brains to spare. Or are you just thick-skulled?

Speaker: Benny
ActorNotes: [trying to swing this to your advantage]
Topic_Name: Seems you need to work on your marksmanship.
EN: {trying to swing this to your advantage}Either way, baby, this is good news. {lying}Maybe I can finally sleep at night, knowing you didn't die.

Speaker: Benny
ActorNotes: [fleeing in terror; "cash me out" is slang for leaving]
Topic_Name: I dug myself out of that grave to plant you in yours, Benny. <Attack.>
EN: {fleeing in terror; "cash me out" is slang for leaving}Cash me outta this mess!

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: I want the Platinum Chip and I want it now.
EN: {keeping voice down}I can't do that, baby, and you know it. There's a lot of angles to this caper - complexities aplenty.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: I want the Platinum Chip and I want it now.
EN: But plenty of action, too - enough for both of us. But we don't jabber about that out here in public.

Speaker: Benny
EN: {amused}You making a pass at me, sister? {Cuz}Because I'm out of your league.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: When you shot me, you ran off so fast I never got your name.

Speaker: Benny
ActorNotes: [wary confusion - is she really coming on to you?]
EN: {wary confusion - is she really coming on to you?}Did those bullets scramble your egg? {starting to get turned on despite yourself}Or have you always been a naughty broad...?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Is it wrong to want a guy who'd shoot me in the head?

Speaker: Benny
EN: {aroused despite yourself}You're one sick pussycat, baby. There's {derisive term for an easy pick-up}quins and then there's... I don't even know what to call you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Girls like bad boys. And you've been downright awful.

Speaker: Benny
EN: {referring to her burial}I hear "dig" from you, babe, and all I can think of is a shovel. How can this be? This ain't forgiveness, it's something... wrong.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: Okay. What'd you want know?

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: All right, kid! Be good.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: I'd like to ask you some other questions.
EN: I got some time - what's eating you?

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: Then have, I don't know, some water or something.
EN: [FAILED] A drink? Nonsense. All I need right now is to settle a score. We didn't come a long ways just to stroll our best clothes around.

Speaker: Walter Phebus

EN: [SUCCEEDED] Sharp eyes on you, all right. We've gone through a heap of trouble to get in town. Ethel says I just need to wet my throat.

Speaker: Carlitos

EN: Hey, that's great. What's going on?

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: Dammit! You're going to leave me hanging, uh? Don't know how else I can get her back.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: All right. I'll talk to her.
EN: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?

Speaker: Carlitos

EN: Don't know... She's a dream to me now... If I, I mean if I could have her again I'd be a made man.

Speaker: Carlitos
ActorNotes: [Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through]

EN: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}Why am I even scared of Cachino and all those fuckers? Joana and I are dead anyway if we don't get the hell out of here.

Speaker: Carlitos

EN: Have you made up your mind?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: I can talk to Joana for you.
EN: Have you made up your mind?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: How did Cachino get you out of the way?
EN: He's a cunning bastard, Cachino. Told Nero and Big Sal he caught me spring cleaning my tributes to the family - can't do nothing against that viper.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Why don't you get her out of Gomorrah?
EN: What, you think I can just waltz in there and take her away? She's their doll now, okay?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Why don't you get her out of Gomorrah?
EN: Besides, I step in Gomorrah and I'm as good as dead, you hear? You don't just leave the Omertas unless it's in a body bag.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Don't talk to me like that or I'll... I'll... have to get tough with you.
EN: [FAILED] Ha ha ha! Okay, okay... stop or I'll choke, I swear. Listen, kid - I'll cut you some slack because nothing else in this town will, you hear?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Tell me again about the girl at Gomorrah that worries you.
EN: What about Joana?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: What did you say about working at Gomorrah?
EN: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: This place has come a long way. Sarah takes care of it and she lets me stay, for now.

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}This place has come a long way, but ever since Sarah's death it is not the same.

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: You know - straightening up bets, Gomorrah, success, women, all that shiny stuff.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Wait a minute. What's that name again?
EN: No dice. I already opened my trap more than I should. Walls have ears even all the way down in this hole, you know? Can't trust nobody.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: I can keep a secret, Carlitos. About whom are you worried?
EN: I... Okay, it's Joana. She... works at Gomorrah. But it's all my fault! I met her at the Atomic Wrangler - beautiful doesn't even come close.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: I can keep a secret, Carlitos. About whom are you worried?
EN: I moved her into Gomorrah. I was in love, okay? Then Cachino, backstabbing snake, got me out of the way so that he could have my girl.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?
EN: Because Mr. House ripped this place to shreds before filling it with concrete. Hey, I was untouchable once, but Mr. House's a god - you got that?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: What does Sarah do around here?
EN: What doesn't she do, huh? Sarah makes this hole look like a palace - damn nice pair of gams on her too. She never walks outside, though.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Anyone in Gomorrah you'd recommend for a good time?
EN: I'd recommend you save your caps and your skin. Check The Tops - no big time wiseguys there. Freeside's also fun, you know?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Anyone in Gomorrah you'd recommend for a good time?
EN: There's too much shit and despair at Gomorrah already. I don't want anybody making it worse for Jo... for the girls, you know?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Any important "wiseguys" that I should know about?
EN: Now, if you have to ask, you probably don't know shit about who you're dealing with, huh? Listen up - watch out for Cachino, that's all I'm saying.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: You spent some time at Gomorrah, then. What was it like?
EN: I didn't just spend time there, I lived there, okay? I was family. All I wanted, I had. Caps, booze, drugs, women, power, you name it.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: You spent some time at Gomorrah, then. What was it like?
EN: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: You worked in Gomorrah as a Croupier, uh? What was it like?
EN: Hey, you're smart. Okay, it was like finding diamonds in your vodka and showgirls under your card-table. You want it, Gomorrah has it.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: You worked in Gomorrah as a Croupier, uh? What was it like?
EN: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Any recommendations on where to go for some fun?
EN: My recommendation, get the fuck out of town while you can. It'll leave you hanging in the wind or, worse, add your body to a concrete wall, okay?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: What are the important players in town?
EN: Ha! There's only one important player in town, and that's Mr. House. Everyone keeps clean around him, the families, the barons - fuck, even the NCR.

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: If you're smart, the Strip's all flash and noise. If not, luck's your dame, your hot date, until you find she's a cheap whore high on Jet.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Let me ask you about New Vegas.
EN: All right. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: If Vault 21 is your "bottom of the barrel" then I'd say you could've done worse.
EN: Yeah, I could've ended buried in the sands with just my head sticking out. Ants love that - a riot, know what I mean?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: If Vault 21 is your "bottom of the barrel" then I'd say you could've done worse.
EN: This place has come a long way. Sarah takes care of it and she lets me stay, for now.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: If Vault 21 is your "bottom of the barrel" then I'd say you could've done worse.
EN: Yeah, I could've ended buried in the sands with just my head sticking out. Ants love that - a riot, know what I mean?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: If Vault 21 is your "bottom of the barrel" then I'd say you could've done worse.
EN: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}This place has come a long way, but ever since Sarah's death it is not the same.

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: From the top! Where else, uh? I am Carlitos - my fingers work the magic and my hands deal the luck!

Speaker: Carlitos
EN: There was no player who'd stood a chance, no wiseguy who didn't fear me, and no doll who could resist me. Gomorrah was my kingdom, Carlitos' turf!

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?
EN: Who isn't in trouble in New Vegas, uh? Sooner or later, you hit the bottom of the barrel - I just happened to fall harder than most, is all.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?
EN: I am just one more loser that got the evil-eye from Lady Luck - hard fall. Now I lay at the bottom and keep to myself.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?
EN: All right. About what do you want to know?

Speaker: The King
EN: Wrong, huh? And I suppose they sent all of these soldiers just to make nice. Lucky me.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Actually, they want to make you an offer.
EN: An offer, huh? All right, let's hear it.

Speaker: The King
EN: Let me guess. The NCR couldn't get me to dance to their tune so now they're asking again a little less nicely, right?

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Sounds like he's not going to cooperate, men. Open fire!

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: The NCR is just trying to protect its people.
EN: And I'm trying to protect mine. If the NCR wants peace so much, the first step would be to get these soldiers out of here.

Speaker: The King
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Honestly, I hadn't thought it through that far. I'd guess someone would come and take over this place.

Speaker: The King
EN: And you can be damn sure they won't run it like the King, baby. They might run everyone out, or enslave them, or worse.

Speaker: The King
EN: I guess I have no choice. Tell your NCR masters that I accept their terms. I'll see that violence against their people is dealt with.

Speaker: The King
EN: Now take these fools and get out of here before they start a riot.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: And when you're dead? What will happen to their freedom then?

Speaker: The King
EN: [FAILED] My momma didn't raise no quitter, and I stand by my beliefs. The answer is no.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: The NCR is far too powerful. Just give up.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: These men have orders to kill you all if you refuse. Are you sure?
EN: That I don't want to sign away my freedom and that of all the people I'm responsible for at gunpoint? Yeah, I'm sure.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: There's still time to solve this peacefully.
EN: Says the one with a squad of armed soldiers behind them. No, I don't think a peaceful solution is possible. Not anymore.

Speaker: The King
EN: And whose job is it to stop it? Yours? Mine? Who are we to tell people what to do? No man has that right.

Speaker: The King
EN: Then I must refuse. The people here have the right to do what they want and are beholden to none. I won't take that away from them.

Speaker: The King
EN: Let me guess. The NCR couldn't get me to dance to their tune so now they're asking again a little less nicely, right?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings.
EN: Not exactly. Give them the chance to do the right thing at least. Personally, I doubt they'll do it.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings.
EN: Crocker's been making overtures to these savages for months and gotten nowhere. Expect a fight, but don't look for one.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings.
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Do you have any idea what our current situation is? As we speak there is a huge army of madmen not ten miles from here waiting to kill us all.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: We don't have the luxury of long-term diplomacy any longer. Anyone that could prove a hindrance in the battle to come must be dealt with swiftly.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: You have your orders. I expect you to carry them out.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Good. When the task is done, report back to Crocker. My men have other orders and will return here on their own to make their report.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: You say Crocker sent you? Let me see... I just received a memo regarding him recently and haven't had a chance to read it in detail.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: Ah, the matter with the so-called Kings. Crocker's been wringing his hands while good people die for too long, and now the matter's fallen to me.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: Unlike the good ambassador, I don't intend to blink. Tell the leader of this gang to stand down or face annihilation.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: That is his choice. If he chooses the latter, a squad of my men will be there to back you up. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: You know, I just received the strangest memo about Freeside. It said that Colonel Hsu has already dispatched a squad to take care of the problem.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: I'll let Hsu's men deal with things, but the good ambassador is going to learn a harsh lesson regarding protocol.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
EN: I trust you can find your own way out.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I was, uh, just sightseeing. Sorry to bother you.
EN: Then I suggest you make your way back outside. My men have orders to shoot anyone caught sneaking around in sensitive areas.

Speaker: Clanden
Topic_Name: I think the authorities would like to hear these tapes I found in your safe.
EN: I think I should kill you before you have a chance to show those tapes to anyone. What do I have to lose?

Speaker: Clanden
EN: {Angry}What the fuck are you trying to pull here? Where is my girl? Now I'm gonna have to kill your sorry ass.

Speaker: Clanden
EN: Ok little lady, let's get started. You look like a tough piece of meat, I'm going to enjoy tenderizing you.

Speaker: Clanden
EN: Get lost.

Speaker: Clanden
Topic_Name: Sorry, I was thinking about someone else. I have a different question though.
EN: Alright, but you're starting to get on my nerves.

Speaker: Clanden
Topic_Name: I thought that maybe I could be your next playtoy. Your exploits are well known.
EN: Well, look at you! It's so rare I get a volunteer. Yes, let's head to my special room. Follow me, we'll talk there.

Speaker: Clanden
EN: [SUCCEEDED]{Excited} Oh, already? I figured it would be a couple days. Well, let's go meet the lucky lady.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Oh, I was just told to deliver a girl to the spare room you keep up here.

Speaker: Clanden
EN: [FAILED]{Laughs} I don't care much about your tastes. Get lost and leave me alone.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Well... I... I have some exotic tastes too!

Speaker: Clanden
Topic_Name: I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women.
EN: {Annoyed}Oh did you now? What business is that of yours, and why the fuck should I care?

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: Clanden, under the authority of the New California Republic, I place you under arrest for murder.

Speaker: Clanden
EN: What? Are you fucking kidding me? You can't do this, the Omertas aren't going to stand by and let you arrest me.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: The Omertas have no say in this matter. This is a legal matter now. You'll have to come with us.

Speaker: Clanden
EN: Alright. I'll come quietly, but this fucked.

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: Never mind, I have some other questions though.
EN: Ok, ask away.

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
Topic_Name: It is a guy named Clanden.
EN: Clanden? Okay, I'll send some troops over there to bring him in.

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
Topic_Name: No, but I'll find out for you.
EN: Come back here as soon as you do, I'd like to see this asshole behind bars.

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
EN: Well come back here when you can. I'd like to take care of this as soon as possible.

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
EN: These are terrifying. Do you have any idea who the man is speaking on this tape?

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
Topic_Name: I found a dead girl in Gomorrah.
EN: Well that's something, but I can't go in there without proof of foul play.

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
EN: Okay, this is a very serious accusation. Please be sure to bring me something concrete.

Speaker: Captain Marie Pappas
Topic_Name: I'd like to report a murder at Gomorrah.
EN: Murder? What kind of Murder? Do you have any proof?

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: It turns out that Ted Gunderson's disappeared. Heck's looking for him.
EN: I'll be damned! You mean the young Gunderson? That's a shave tail if I ever saw one - he's got less sense than a Brahmin at a crossroads.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: It turns out that Ted Gunderson's disappeared. Heck's looking for him.
EN: I'd not be one to complain if he got lost for good, kid... If it makes Heck suffer then I'm all for it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm surprised you haven't asked what became of Benny.
EN: That's because he ceased to be relevant when you recovered the Platinum Chip. Revenge doesn't interest me, progress does.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm surprised you haven't asked what became of Benny.
EN: Sorry to deny you a moment of primate triumph, but you'll have to go elsewhere to sound your barbaric yawp.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Something very important. I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise - so don't bother asking.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Here, take the Platinum Chip again. You will need it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Upon arrival at the Fort, it's likely that you'll be searched and the Chip taken from you. Don't worry - it will come back to you.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I expect that if Benny doesn't have the Chip, Caesar will make sure you get it. More on that later. Be off.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: If you find Caesar's Legion so frightening at this remove, imagine them rampaging across the Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: We have a chance to see them detroyed, to see New Vegas become the harbinger of a new age.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I've already visited Caesar.{Kill Benny at Tops, see CL 1st}
EN: {nonplussed}You have? So you have the means to gain entry?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar has already invited me to the Fort.
EN: I'm not surprised. The Legion has spies on the Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What do you want me to do there?
EN: I want you to open a hatch in the basement of the derelict weather station atop Fortification Hill.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What do you want me to do there?
EN: You'll recognize it on sight. The hatch bears the logo of the Lucky 38, same as the Platinum Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Not if you've been invited. You realize that you've made quite a splash here in New Vegas?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I can predict with a high degree of confidence that you'll receive an official summons from Caesar. If you haven't already, that is.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Chip's been delivered. We're through.
EN: Do you have any idea how prodigious is the opportunity you're casting aside here?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The next step will require you to infiltrate Caesar's camp at Fortification Hill.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You'll have to return to Caesar's camp at Fortification Hill.{Player got Chip at CL Fort, didn't activate bunker army}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, Mr. House.
EN: No no no, you'll want to hear this out...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, Mr. House.
EN: Disappointing. In the extreme.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You think your Securitrons can defeat Caesar's Legion *and* the NCR?
EN: Why would I want to go to war against the NCR? They're my best customers.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You think your Securitrons can defeat Caesar's Legion *and* the NCR?
EN: If their leaders weren't scheming to steal Vegas out from under me, I'd have no troubles with the NCR at all.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why show your hand like that? Now your enemies know what you're up to.
EN: I'm surprised you can still underestimate me after everything you've seen.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why show your hand like that? Now your enemies know what you're up to.
EN: I haven't shown my hand - I've shown one card. I've given my enemies a single, provocative datum upon which to fixate.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why show your hand like that? Now your enemies know what you're up to.
EN: They have no idea what other cards I'm holding. It's a strong hand, believe me - I dealt it to myself.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, then...
EN: {FORT SECS UP}I must insist that you stay long for me to show you that the Platinum Chip does more than change the pictures on the Securitrons' face screens.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, then...
EN: Events of great import are about to unfold, with you taking a central role. To get started, all you need do is take the elevator all the way down...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, then...
EN: I must insist that you stay long for me to show you what the Chip does. I promise you'll like what you see...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, then...
EN: Events of great import are about to unfold, with you taking a central role.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll be on my way, then...
EN: To get started, all you need to do is take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What does the Chip do, exactly?
EN: {FORT SECS UP}Yes, so far as you've seen, all it does is change the picture on the Securitrons' face screens from policemen to soldiers. But as you'll see...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What does the Chip do, exactly?
EN: Some things are more easily shown than told. Take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level, and you'll see what I mean.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What does the Chip do, exactly?
EN: Don't worry, you'll like what you see. We have much to accomplish, you and I...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FORT SECS NO}A great deal shall be happening - a cascade of events, with you taking a central role.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: At the moment, however, all you need to do is take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level. You'll understand soon enough...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {FORT SECS UP}A great deal shall be happening - a cascade of events, with you taking a central role.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: At the moment, however, all you need to do is take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: What you see there will help you understand the significance of what you accomplished at the Fort.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm still not giving you the Chip.
EN: {exasperated sigh}Then this is a waste of time.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Here, take it. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
EN: Well enough. We can put the past behind us, I think.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I have some questions to ask first...
EN: This is not the time for Q&A. Kindly hand over the Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I have some questions to ask first...
EN: This is not the time for Q&A. Kindly hand over the Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm not afraid of you, Mr. House. The Platinum Chip belongs to me.
EN: {ordering attack}You needn't be afraid of me. It's my Securitrons that are going to kill you.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Here it is. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
EN: {sarcastic}Why, thank you so much. You played that {beat}very poorly, you realize?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Here it is. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
EN: You're fortunate that I have a certain {beat}tolerance for greed. I expect my business partners to be self-interested - but {unlike you}smartly so.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Attack me and you risk destroying the Chip.
EN: {restraining anger}By the time I was 30 years old, I was a billionaire 30 times over. I founded and ran a vast economic empire.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Attack me and you risk destroying the Chip.
EN: {restraining anger}Do you really think I'm going to let an upstart come into my home and ransom my property to me?

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [restraining anger, losing it a little towards end]
Topic_Name: Attack me and you risk destroying the Chip.
EN: {restraining anger, losing it a little towards end}I spent two centuries searching for the Platinum Chip. It's my invention, my property - mine. Now be a good courier and deliver it!

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm not going to give you the Chip.
EN: {drawn out}Hmm... {to yourself}How shall I put this?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm not going to give you the Chip.
EN: {taking time, spelling it out}Delivery of the Platinum Chip is non-negotiable.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm not going to give you the Chip.
EN: I invite you to think carefully about what you do next... standing alone before me, surrounded by my heavily-armed Securitron guards.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Not so fast, Mr. House. We need to discuss payment.
EN: Our terms were clear. Now that you have the Chip in your possession, any attempt to "re-negotiate" payment would be tantamount to blackmail.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I haven't talked to either Colonel Moore or Colonel Hsu yet.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: Oh, a good ways west of here, in a place you've never been. Far as we concerned, only name it ever had was "Phebus Ranch."

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: That was before we lost some land to Heck Gunderson. The bank demanded payment in full the day after the Stockmen's Association bailed it out.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus

Speaker: Ethel Phebus

Speaker: Ethel Phebus

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: I used imperial Rome as the model for my Legion precisely because it was so foreign, so {beat}alien.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: I'd seen what had become of the NCR's attempts to emulate the culture of Pre-War America - the in-fighting, the corruption.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Rome was a highly militarized autocracy that effectively integrated the foreign cultures it conquered.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: It dedicated its citizens to something higher than themselves - to the idea of Rome itself.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: In Rome I found a template for a society equal to the challenges of the post-apocalyptic world - a society that could and would survive.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: A society that could prevent mankind from fracturing and destroying itself in this new world, by establishing a new {packs Ro-MAH-na}Pax Romana.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: It means a {taking time with each term}nationalist, imperialist, totalitarian, homogenous culture that obliterates the identity of every group it conquers.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Long-term stability at all costs. The individual has no value beyond his utility to the state, whether as an instrument of war, or production.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: What does "Pax Romana" mean?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: No, I'll destroy it because it's inevitable that it be destroyed. It's {heh-GEHL-ee-an}Hegelian Dialectics, not personal animosity.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: So you'll destroy the NCR because you hate its inefficiencies?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: {enjoying the superiority of teacher}How do I put this basically enough? It's a philosophical theory, the kind you might encounter if you took time to read some books.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: The fundamental premise is to envision history as a sequence of "dialectical" conflicts. Each dialectic begins with a proposition, a {emphasis}thesis...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: ...which inherently contains, or creates, its opposite - an antithesis. Thesis and antithesis. The conflict is inevitable.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: But the resolution of the conflict yields something new - a synthesis - eliminating the flaws in each, leaving behind common elements and ideas.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: "Hegelian Dialectics?" What are those?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: The bombs wiped the slate clean. Human civilization descended to a level of ignorance that effectively set our cultural progress back to zero.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: The NCR has all of the problems of the ancient Roman Republic - extreme bureaucracy, corruption, extensive senatorial infighting.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Just as with the ancient Republic, it is natural that a military force should conquer and transform the NCR into a military dictatorship.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Thesis and antithesis. The Colorado River is my Rubicon. The NCR council will be {beat}eradicated, but the new synthesis will change the Legion as well...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: ...from a basically nomadic army to a standing military force that protects its citizens, {finality}and the power of its dictator.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: So what's "dialectic" about you and the NCR?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Ironically, I was born a Profligate myself, a citizen of the NCR.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: My family lived not far from the great Boneyard. After Raiders killed my father, my mother sought the Followers' protection. I was two years old.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: She found work at their Library, cooking and cleaning. I learned how to read and soon I was taking courses, free of charge.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Oh yes, raised in that tradition. And the teaching stuck. I was taught it was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: {joking about your conquests}I may have taken the torch part more literally than they intended.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: You were a Follower of the Apocalypse?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: When I was 20, the Followers sent me East to Grand Canyon. It was my first expedition, just me and a physician named Calhoun.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: As an anthropologist and linguist, my assignment was to learn the dialects of the Grand Canyon tribes. What a fucking waste of time!{get alternate take with "What a waste of time that would've been!"}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What changed you from a Follower to dictator?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: If you think it's worthwhile to make smart people learn how to talk like backward savages, you're a Follower of the Apocalypse... or an idiot.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Anyway, we met up with a Mormon missionary who already knew a bunch of dialects - Joshua Graham. He was supposed to teach me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: But before that went too far, the Blackfoot tribe captured us, to hold us for ransom.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: They were a backward bunch. But the real problem was, they didn't know how to fight.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Why would learning dialects be a waste of time?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: The Blackfoot were at war with seven other tribes, each just as pissant as they were. But outnumbered like that, they weren't going to last long.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: It's one thing to be taken hostage, another to be lashed to a sinking ship. So over Calhoun's objections, I decided to take certain steps.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What was wrong with the Blackfoot?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I taught them how to use the guns they already had - how to strip and clean them, how to breathe when pulling a trigger, how to reload ammunition.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: They looked at me like I was some kind of a sorcerer. So I taught them how to make explosives, and started drilling them on small unit tactics.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: {amused}If there's anything I learned as a Follower of the Apocalypse, it's that there's a lot of good information in old books.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What steps did you take?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: {LATIN}{dih-WE-day et im-PEER-ah}Divide et impera - divide and conquer. I led the Blackfoot against the Ridgers, their weakest enemy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: When they refused to surrender, I ordered every man, woman, and child killed. When next we surrounded the Kaibabs and they likewise refused...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I took one of their envoys to the Ridgers' village and showed him the corpse piles.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: This was new for the tribes, you see. They played at war, raiding each other, a little rape and pillage here, a little ransoming there.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I showed them total warfare. Like I said, there's a lot you can learn from old books.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What happened after you trained the Blackfoot?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: The Kaibabs joined me, and the Fredonians after that - all the pissant tribes, with names that should be forgotten.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I knew from the start I'd need to eradicate this plague of tribal identities, replacing them with a monolithic culture, a uniform identity.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: So that's what I did, once my confederation of tribes was large enough. I crowned myself {KAI-zar}Caesar and created a single Great Tribe - my Legion.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I sent Calhoun, the Follower captured with me, back West with a message that I should not be interfered with.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Joshua Graham, the Mormon interpreter, stayed with me and served as my first {leh-GAH-tus}Legatus.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What happened to the tribes?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: That's right. Decades of warfare, absorbing lesser tribes, gathering power. Forging the dross into a vast, razor-sharp scythe.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: My Legion's expansion has never ceased. Much of the Utah and Colorado, and all of Arizona and New Mexico, are mine.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: We have cities of our own, but nothing compared to Vegas. Finally, my Legion will have its Rome.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: And since forming the Legion, all you've done is conquer other tribes?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: I've analyzed the region's tribes to determine how they might be useful. I may tell you more at a later time, if it suits me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: {Safety lines}Here, this document has clear instructions on what to do next.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Here, these written orders make it plain.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: These written orders will tell you what to do next.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: See {WULH-pace}Vulpes for details about your next mission.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: For further instructions, see {WULH-pace}Vulpes.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Go see {WULH-pace}Vulpes. He'll brief you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Go see Lucius for details about your next mission.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: For further instructions, see Lucius.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Go see Lucius. He'll brief you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: I know he's a coward, hiding behind an army of robots, ensconced in that tower of his like {beat as you think of it}a wizard in one of those Grognak comic books.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: Some say he's a man, others, a machine. I don't care. He's in the way.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: I know he's dead. I know he's no longer a factor. That's all I need to know.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: Losers don't matter in the history books. He's a fucking footnote.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: What did you know about Mr. House?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Do you want my opinion as a former citizen, or future conqueror? {shrug}Actually, my opinion's the same either way.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: As a young man I was taught to venerate {mocking slightly}President Tandi of Shady Sands. "The Founding Mother of the New California Republic."

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Did you know her Presidency lasted 52 years? And that her father, Aradesh, was the Republic's first President?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Does that sound like democracy to you, or a hereditary dictatorship?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Thank you, Colonel Moore. And thank you, my fellow Californians, who have come so far to answer the call to service put forth by the republic.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: It is for you that I have come here, and it is because of you that I am able to do so.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: We enjoy our privileges because you take the greatest of risks and are prepared to make the most noble of sacrifices.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: It is because of men and women like Private First Class Jeremy Watson that Nevada and the New California Republic remain free and secure.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Born in a tin shack on the outskirts of One Pine, Jeremy Watson never had it easy.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: His father worked as a caravan guard on the Short Loop, and his mother, like many Californians, braved the ruins of the Old World as a prospector.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: They suffered through water shortages, raider attacks, and the Brotherhood War. Like our mighty Sierra Nevadas, they endured.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: But the time came when they could no longer shoulder the burden alone.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Twelve years ago, they called out for help, and the republic heard them. Troopers and rangers, just like you, answered the clarion call.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Men and women stepped forward to say, "I will carry the weight."

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: And at Owen's Lake, we made true on our promise, driving out the raider tribes to establish a lasting peace in the eastern Sierra Nevadas.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: We carried the weight, and though we left behind many of our brothers and sisters on that battlefield, it did not break us.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Ten years ago, Chief Elise met with representatives of the Desert Rangers to discuss terms of what would become the Ranger Unification Treaty.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: The treaty was more than a resolution to welcome the Desert Rangers into the republic.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: It was a covenant to protect southern Nevada against Caesar's Legion and the tyranny of his regime.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: There are some back home who ask me, "But who are we protecting?  What is Nevada to us?"

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Sometimes we forget that the light of our society shines beyond our borders.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Sometimes we take those privileges for granted that our forebears fought so hard to achieve.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: We must always remember that wherever Californians stand, we carry our principles with us:

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: equal respect, representation, and protection under the laws of a just republic.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: This was the same fire that burned in the heart of the Old World that preceded us.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: We are the heirs of that civilization, torchbearers eastward of the Pacific, into the darkness of this wasted land.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: When the republic called on the men and women of California to carry that fire across the Mojave, Jeremy Watson answered. You answered.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Together, you carried the weight. And when PFC Watson's platoon came under attack at Forlorn Hope, he took the greatest risk,

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: not only for his fellow Californians, but for California itself.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: He was prepared to make the most noble of sacrifices, to defend the principles of our republic, even here, on Nevada soil.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: His actions are a beacon to all of us who stand here today in tribute to his valor.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Private First Class Jeremy Watson, on behalf of the senate and people of the New California Republic,

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: it is my honor to present you with the Star of Sierra Madre.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Not far from this spot, a monument stands as a tribute to the sacrifice made by those who came before us,

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: the men and women who fulfilled the promise we made to the Desert Rangers.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Its back is inscribed with the names of the troopers and rangers who carried the weight.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: And because they made the most noble of sacrifices, it did not break us.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Four years ago, we held this dam. Four years ago, we carried the weight.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Four years ago, we drew a line through the Mojave as clear as the Colorado River, a line that Caesar cannot cross.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Today, you stand here with our brothers and sisters to hold that line. Today, you honor all Californians by carrying that weight.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Today, you are the waves of the Pacific, pushing ever eastward. You are the sequoias rising from the Sierra Nevadas, defiant and enduring.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: You are the great western light of California, torchbearers in the darkness, living reminders of all that is best in our republic.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Thank you. Thank you.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Okay, let's get the fuck out of here. What the hell are you waiting for? You think I want to get shot?  Let's go!

EN: We can go right over here, baby.

EN: Yeah, you're right. For you, and just you, fifty caps. Don't tell anyone.

EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well... no I guess not. Okay - you show me a good time, and I'll return the favor.

EN: I wouldn't offer if it wasn't safe.  Do I look like someone who would hurt you?

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: [FAILED] Um... it's sweet of you to offer, but no thanks.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Mess you up? Nah, it's probably fine. Trust me.

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well, if you know what you're doing... okay. You show me a good time, and I'll return the favor.

EN: I know the right dose for a little thing like you. Medical training, you know.

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: [FAILED] That's nice, honey, but no thanks.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I used, like, a whole bunch of this stuff and I'm still fine.

Topic_Name: Uhh... twenty, twenty five... yeah, I have enough. Here you go.
EN: We can go right over here, baby.

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: Suit yourself. The offer's always open if you feel like changing your mind.

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: Well now, that's unusual. Normally no one cares enough to ask. To be honest, I don't rightly know. My mama was from around these parts.

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: I can remember her face, but not her name. More than I can remember of my daddy, I guess. We lived in Westside before the Omertas bought me.

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: As bad as it can be some days in here, it's better than living in that dump.

Speaker: Dazzle
Topic_Name: Let's party. Here's the hundred caps.
EN: We can go right over here, baby.

Topic_Name: How much for a good time?

Speaker: Dazzle
Topic_Name: How much for a good time?

Speaker: Dazzle
EN: Don't be a stranger.

Speaker: Dazzle
Topic_Name: He's gone missing, and I'm trying to track him down. Any ideas?
EN: He used to go on and on about water and the farms east of the Strip. He was talking to one of the farmers named Bascom, had some problem with NCR.

Speaker: Dazzle
Topic_Name: He's gone missing, and I'm trying to track him down. Any ideas?
EN: Boring as hell, but it was his money and his time, so I let him talk about whatever.

Speaker: Dazzle
Topic_Name: You ever spend time with a trooper named White?
EN: Yeah, he used to come around here a lot. Haven't seen him in a while, though. Why?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <SPEECH - player tells CR the daughter has an incurable STD>

Speaker: Canyon Runner
Topic_Name: <SPEECH - player tells CR the daughter has an incurable STD>

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <SPEECH - player tells CR the daughter has an incurable STD>
EN: But the girl is sick. With classic symptoms of, uh... Vagina Dentata?

Speaker: Canyon Runner
EN: Here's the key to their collars. You want to take those off before you've gone far, trust me.

Topic_Name: I'll give you 150 caps for the lot.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Frank sent me to free you.
EN: At least he's too much of a coward to come after us himself. What if he'd ended up in this pen with us?

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: I've paid for the three of you. You are free to go.
EN: {shocked disbelief}Th-thank you! I don't know that we'll ever be able to repay you, but we'll do our best one day once I've found a place to settle.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: <SPEECH - Player tells her to make a run for it>

Speaker: Player / Courier

EN: Perhaps a partnership in the co-op would be enough. Say, ten percent of daily profits?

Topic_Name: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
EN: This is no time for questions! Get back topside and protect the president!

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I don't know. The visit is still going on up there.
EN: Then what the hell are you doing down here? Get back topside and protect the president!

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The president was killed by assassins.
EN: Damn it! The timing couldn't be any worse. I tried to warn those buffoons, but they insisted on this little show.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The president was killed by assassins.
EN: We'll be lucky if the men don't throw down their guns and surrender as the Legion approaches. I guess there's nothing to be done about it now.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Good, his death could have had a major impact on morale. This whole affair was ill-advised from the start, and I for one am glad it's over.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: While you were out, General Oliver arrived and briefed all senior officers regarding a change in our strategy.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: I'm not at liberty to divulge what was said, but I've been instructed to send you to him immediately.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: He's set up his camp in the office area at the south end of this power plant.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: {She is not pleased}And you believed them? Do you have any idea how long we've been fighting those bastards?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: Ugh, Crocker will have a field day with this. He'll want to establish diplomatic relations with them, for pete's sake.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: But we've got more important matters to attend to. The president is due to arrive soon, and we're sure the Legion won't waste such an opportunity.
