EN: I want you to assist the security detail we've prepared for the president. His safety is critical to maintaining the mens' fighting spirit.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: Go up to the visitor center and speak to Ranger Grant. He's in charge of security during the president's visit. Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Don't give up. They're out there, somewhere, and we're not safe until they've been destroyed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: {Triumph, relief}Ah, that's a relief. A Brotherhood attack while we're busy with the Legion would be catastrophic.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: The situation being what it is, we can't afford to lose even a single man unnecessarily.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: After the battle, we consolidated our hold on the plant before pursuing our enemies.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: It was a mistake, to be sure, but there wasn't really any place for them to go. When we finally gave chase, however, they had simply vanished.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: Some of our people think they had some means of conveyance, like the vertibirds the Enclave used, and hightailed it out of here.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: I think that they found someplace to hide close to HELIOS, and never went that far at all. Any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: A fair question, and one I've had our strategists think about for some time. Their consensus is that we must focus on the one thing we can count on.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: With the Brotherhood that's their obsessive attachment to technology. They'd never go anywhere that didn't have working power.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: I'm willing to bet that wherever they're hiding, there's a working reactor powering their equipment. That's their vulnerability.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: Detonate that reactor, and we can safely cross the Brotherhood off our list of concerns. Was there anything else?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: {Player talked Khans into helping}No, just because you secured the aid of the Khans, {said under her breath}assuming they don't try to kill us, don't think the Brotherhood will be so easily swayed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: These are people that both hate us *and* outgun us. There can be no compromise. Anything else?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: Don't even think about it. Any Brotherhood survivors likely harbor a deep grudge against us. We can't afford to leave such an enemy alive.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: Any other objections? Maybe you'd like to bring the Brotherhood some flowers?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: I shouldn't have to say this, but please don't bother me until the mission is completed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Then that's one more nuisance we won't have to worry about. Good work. Our efforts haven't gone unnoticed, either.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: But he's still alive? I'll have to remember to send someone to follow up on that later. Anyway, at least he's out of the picture for the time being.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: You might be happy to know that your efforts haven't gone unnoticed, either.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: The brass have been throwing around the idea of having the president visit the dam for a while now. To rally the troops and boost morale and such.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: With our recent achievements, they finally feel secure enough to stage the damn thing. But while it's being planned, I have one last mission for you.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: Several years ago, we managed to wrest the HELIOS One solar power station from the Brotherhood of Steel chapter local to this area.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: It was a crushing victory, but no one's heard a peep from the Brotherhood since. Most people assume the Brotherhood is scattered and not a threat.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: Recently we've had scouts go missing in an area west of HELIOS, and I'm concerned that the Brotherhood is involved.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: I want you to find them, and once you do, finish them for good. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
EN: If you must, but please keep it brief.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I wouldn't dismiss it that lightly, but it's nothing we need get involved with for now. Good work, I suppose.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> The Omertas are planning to attack New Reno. It's none of NCR's concern.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: [FAILED] I highly doubt that. You'd do well to report only facts to me, otherwise we might have ourselves a problem.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: However, their activity has quieted down some so maybe my original information was wrong.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> You've got nothing to worry about. The Omertas are perfectly clean.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: The next time we speak, I expect you to have something for me.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Excellent. You'd think living in the lap of luxury and power would be enough for some people, but no.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: But we have other problems. While investigating the Omertas, what little I could on my end, I came across something much more sinister.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Evidence suggests that Mr. House is planning to make some kind of move when the battle breaks out, and I'm guessing he won't be coming to our rescue.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: While we don't know what his exact plans are, my orders are to avoid all risks. I'm sending you to take Mr. House out of the equation. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Now that that's out of the way, let's see... Mr. House {emph}was a concern, but someone conveniently dealt with him for us.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Oh, that reminds me, you might be happy to know that your efforts haven't gone unnoticed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Can you give me any leads?
EN: Our preliminary research shows that the Omertas used to do some business in Freeside, mostly buying weapons. Any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Head to their casino, Gomorrah, and ask around. If you discover that what they're up to threatens the NCR, stop it.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: The Omertas themselves likely won't be forthcoming, so you may need to talk to some of their help to pick up a trail. Anything else?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again.
EN: Good riddance. We've had reports for years that they're the ones who supply the Fiends with chems, but no one's done anything about it.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again.
EN: In any event, no one will miss them. And I've got another mission for you.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Good. I look forward to hearing of your progress.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Will I have any NCR support in this?
EN: I can't lend you any troops, but I've already sent word to quartermaster Bardon that you're to be given full access to our hardware.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Will I have any NCR support in this?
EN: You'll have to pay for what you take, however. We can't afford to give away equipment. Did you have any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: What if I find they're committed to joining Caesar?
EN: Then you'll need to make sure none of them are left to do so. Any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I might have heard of them. Remind me.
EN: They're a rowdy bunch, and pride themselves as warriors. The dark leather and horned helmets they wear are pretty distinctive.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I have a score to settle with them.
EN: Good, that anger is something I can use, and I think you may get a chance to settle your score sooner than you might have planned.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: Then I don't need to tell you that they can be a pain in the ass.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: The NCR has a rather sordid history with them, and I'm concerned that we'll find them aiding our enemies when the Legion attack comes.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: That is, unless we get to them first. I want you to visit them in their canyons to the far west and make sure they're in no shape to join the Legion.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: They're just another gang of raiders as far as I'm concerned, so deal with them appropriately. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I'm a little busy at the moment.
EN: But not too busy to come all the way out here? I don't think so. Stay a while, and listen to my offer.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Since the majority of my men are on assignment dealing with the Legion, I need someone to handle other matters that have arisen.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Make no mistake, there's a battle coming, and I intend to make sure there are no loose ends when the time comes.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: One such loose end is a gang known as the Great Khans. Have you heard of them?

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Looks tougher than I thought. We'll have to find another solution.
EN: {pleading}Anything that gets us out of here, please.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] My goodness! I swear my heart skipped a beat!

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [FAILED] That's enough of that! If you're going to get us out of here, it'll have to be another way.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: No way. If the guard catches you, we'll be beaten.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: If you want to help, get that gate unlocked or see if you can get the one they call Canyon Runner to let us go.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
ActorNotes: [player killed one of your children doing this]
EN: {player killed one of your children doing this}All you're doing is killing us! Leave us alone!

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: If there's any chance you can free us, it's worth the risk...

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
EN: Sorry, I'm just glad someone is doing something. The last thing I need is to be made some legionaire's bitch and sent off to God knows where.

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Never mind. I'll see if there is another way to free you.
EN: Good idea. I'd like to keep my head intact.

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, you did it! Nice work!

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: RF detonator? Give me a second.<Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: [FAILED] Forget it, I'm not gonna get my head blown off just because you don't know what you're doing!

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: Hold still! <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
EN: No way! I seen what happens when you mess with these collars!

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
EN: Sounds like I don't have much choice.

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Never mind. I'll see if there is another way to free you.
EN: Yeah, like get the key from the slavemaster or pay him to release us?

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You did it! Thank you so much!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [FAILED] Okay, I'm gonna stop you right there. It is obvious you don't know what you're doing!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
EN: Hurry up. The guards keep eyeing me like I'm a piece of meat.

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
ActorNotes: [player already killed your mother or brother doing this]
EN: {player already killed your mother or brother doing this}So you can kill more of us? Get away from me!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
EN: If you say so... you know these collars have a bomb in them, don't you?

Speaker: Private Renolds
EN: Legion bastards. They'll pay for that.

Speaker: Private Renolds
Topic_Name: Were they the NCR hostages in the mine?
EN: Were? What do you mean were?

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Relax, this'll be over quickly. <Set off the explosive in his collar>
EN: {panicking}What have you done?

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Relax, this'll be over quickly. <Set off the explosive in his collar>
EN: {close call}Are you trying to get me killed? Get away from me!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Don't worry your little head, Sammy. <Set off the explosive in her collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Why? {sobbing}Why?

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Don't worry your little head, Sammy. <Set off the explosive in her collar>
EN: [FAILED] Okay, you can quit. I don't know what you're trying to do, but it ain't helping.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: I'm getting ready to run a caravan up towards Utah. There's a town called New Canaan which is supposed to be pretty prosperous.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: The Crimson Caravan doesn't have any branches out that way, so it'll be up to me get to things started.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: Alice McLafferty runs the Crimson Caravan. You can find her over in the main office.

Speaker: Benny
EN: Ta-ta.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Watch out for her - she's one of the deadliest fighters I've ever seen.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Careful in there - he's tougher than he looks.

Speaker: Otho
EN: All right. Did you want something else?

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I need some time to prepare.
EN: Very well.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Good luck.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Remember the rules: light armor and machetes only. And, of course, to the death.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: {Player is a woman}Know your place, woman. Unlike the Profligates of the NCR, only {emphasis "men"}men fight in the Legion.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: {Player has companion}Only you may enter. Tell your companion to wait and speak to me again.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: That can be arranged. You will be facing off against a couple of disobedient slaves - not much of challenge, but it might be entertaining to watch.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: There's a captured NCR trooper available - Sergeant Andrews. He's already been challenged once and survived, so he should be a worthy opponent.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: I have a dangerous one for you - an NCR Ranger by the name of Stella. We got lucky, since we rarely capture Rangers alive.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: Even though she's a woman, she's killed every man who's faced her in the arena, even one of the elite Centurions. With her bare hands.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: I'd like to fight in the arena.
EN: Sorry, but there's nobody left who'd even be a challenge for you.

Speaker: Otho
EN: I set up the fights, keep track of prisoners available, and make sure the arena's cleaned up.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Most of the time it's some young Legionary trying to make a name for himself, hoping to get noticed by Caesar or the Praetorians.

Speaker: Otho
EN: We pit slaves or prisoners against each other once in awhile, but it's not much of a show. They're usually too reluctant to kill each other.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Light armor and machetes only. The challenger - the one who asks to enter the arena - may be pitted against one or more opponents.

Speaker: Otho
EN: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: That's enough about the arena. Let's talk about something else.
EN: Like what?

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: Tell me more about the arena.
EN: Such as?

Speaker: Lieutenant Markland
Topic_Name: Any idea where I might find those books?
EN: {Thoughtful}Caravan companies are probably your best bet. Smaller traders aren't likely to have anything that esoteric.

Speaker: Private Renolds
EN: I was worried Alexus had already thrown them down a mineshaft. I'll run by camp and see how they're doing when I get a chance. Thanks for the help.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Liza O'Malley at the Embassy may have some information for you as well.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Boone
EN: I think we're clear.

Speaker: Boone
EN: More coming!

Speaker: Boone
EN: We need to get to the camp before they do!

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Get over it. It's war. People die. Why should it matter whether they're soldiers or civilians?
EN: With the Khans, the only difference between a soldier and a civilian is that the civilian is more likely to miss when he shoots at you.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Get over it. It's war. People die. Why should it matter whether they're soldiers or civilians?
EN: {searching}Maybe Bitter Springs just seemed different. {then, going ice cold}Maybe it's the same as killing legionaries.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Get over it. It's war. People die. Why should it matter whether they're soldiers or civilians?
EN: They'd have died whether or not they were soldiers. Whether or not I was there. And my leaving the NCR hasn't stopped any wars or saved any lives.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Get over it. It's war. People die. Why should it matter whether they're soldiers or civilians?
EN: There's no controlling war. No sense regretting what you can't stop.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: You can't take back what you've done. But your regrets can set you on a better path.
EN: I guess they brought us here. One less Legion raiding party running loose now. Never a bad thing, you can take my word for that.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: You can't take back what you've done. But your regrets can set you on a better path.
EN: Still feels like I'm living on borrowed time. But I don't see any reason not to take a lot more of those sons of bitches with me.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: You can't take back what you've done. But your regrets can set you on a better path.
EN: You got a point. There's still some things I can do before all this is over.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Having to live with what you've done is your punishment.
EN: I never thought of it that way. Always expected something... more final. But maybe it is.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: No one is judging or punishing you. Things just happen.
EN: If that's how it is, there's not a lot of comfort in knowing it.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Maybe it's just not your time yet.
EN: <Sighs> Goddamn it. It's like I'm being toyed with.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Maybe it's just not your time yet.
EN: I don't know what I'm supposed to do about all this.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I wasn't going to let you die.
EN: I don't mean disrespect. It's a hell of a thing having someone with your ability looking out for me.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I wasn't going to let you die.
EN: But I've come to believe that there are things nobody can stop. I thought for sure that's what we'd finally come up against today.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I wasn't going to let you die.
EN: It would've made sense for things to end here. But now... I'm still waiting.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Guess I did. Guess I figured whatever we could handle, this time the Legion was going to send more.

Speaker: Boone
EN: I should've died here a long time ago. When I spotted the legionaries today I thought I understood. Things were finally going to even out.

Speaker: Boone
EN: But I'm still here and nothing's changed.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Thought my time had come. For a minute there everything made sense. I could feel the end coming. I was ready for it.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Now... I'm back where I was.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: Are you the one who's been raiding the refugee camp at Bitter Springs?
EN: {Disdainful}Refugee camp? Is that what they're calling it? Good old NCR, they can whitewash anything.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: Are you the one who's been raiding the refugee camp at Bitter Springs?
EN: Let me tell you something, that refugee camp? It's built on the blood and tears of my people. Nobody likes to talk about it, but I remember.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
EN: {Proud}We were the Flails of God. The scourge of the Mojave, the best warriors and raiders in the Wasteland. Until the NCR tracked us back to Bitter Springs.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
EN: {Sad}The main force hit the canyon by surprise. While our warriors tried to hold them off, we sent our women, our children, our old through the Red Pass.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
EN: NCR's First Recon Battalion was waiting for them on Coyote Tail Ridge. No Khan left alive, that was the order. {Broken}My family....

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
EN: Come for me then. {Intense, half battle cry, half prayer}Flails of God!

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
EN: Come for me then. {Intense, half battle cry, half prayer}Flails of God!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Spare me your sob story, it's time to die.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'm still looking for the Deathclaw Eggs.
EN: Your loss. Come back to me when you have something to offer.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'm still looking for the Cazador Eggs.
EN: Your loss. Come back to me when you have something to offer.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'm still looking for the Night Stalker Eggs.
EN: Your loss. Come back to me when you have something to offer.

Speaker: Red Lucy
EN: Thank you, my brave hunter.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: Is there anything else I can do to help The Thorn?
EN: You've done enough to last many lifetimes, stranger. But{slight pause, hesitant to speak so unfamiliar words}... I'd like you to come see me, again.

Speaker: Red Lucy
ActorNotes: [A hint of sincere emotion shows through her otherwise stoic mask]
Topic_Name: I'll find this great prize for you.
EN: {A hint of sincere emotion shows through her otherwise stoic mask}I've come to expect nothing less from you, brave stranger.

Speaker: Red Lucy
ActorNotes: [A hint of sincere emotion shows through her otherwise stoic mask]
Topic_Name: I'll find this great prize for you.
EN: {A hint of sincere emotion shows through her otherwise stoic mask}I've come to expect nothing less from you, brave stranger.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: Where can I find Deathclaw Eggs?
EN: Quarry Junction is overrun with Deathclaws, but you may stand a better chance at a nest near the Repconn Test Site.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I don't need anything in return. Take the eggs.
EN: {Brief pause, surprised that players succeeded}That actually manages to surprise me, stranger. I'm starting to believe that there's something special about you.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: A 1000 caps will do. Take the eggs.
EN: Thank you, stranger. The Thorn thanks you.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: Those Cazadores almost killed me. Pay me more or... just pay me more, alright?
EN: Those are the risks of a hunter's life. I've delivered as promised, but perhaps I should better search for someone with greater resolve and honor?

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: There's almost nothing worse than Cazadores in The Wasteland. Great deeds deserve great rewards.
EN: You are a match to my elite, but don't congratulate yourself so profusely just yet. Still, your valor deserves recognition and I shall honor it.

Speaker: Red Lucy
EN: Good work, stranger. The Thorn will nurture these eggs until their hatchlings are ready to bleed for us.

Speaker: Red Lucy
EN: Here's a compensation for your service. I trust that we're in agreement over it.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'll find the Cazador Eggs for you.
EN: The crowd loves your bravery.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'll find the Cazador Eggs for you.
EN: So long, stranger.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'll find the Cazador Eggs for you.
EN: So long, stranger.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: Where can I find Cazador Eggs?
EN: Cazadores are extremely deadly, but they are also reclusive. Try looking near the Red Rock's canyons.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I don't need anything in return. Take the eggs.
EN: {Brief pause, surprised that players succeeded}That actually manages to surprise me, stranger. I'm starting to believe that there's something special about you.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: 700 caps will do. Take the eggs.
EN: Thank you, stranger. The Thorn thanks you.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'm getting tired of running around all over The Wasteland for a handful of caps. I want more.
EN: Those are the risks of a hunter's life. I've delivered as promised, but perhaps I should better search for someone with greater resolve and honor?

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I've braved packs of Night Stalkers to get these eggs. My reward should match this effort.
EN: You speak the truth, stranger, and The Thorn lives by the justice that honor and strength dispense. Here's a more fitting sum.

Speaker: Red Lucy
EN: Do you have good news for The Thorn?

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'm still looking for the Fire Gecko eggs.
EN: Your loss. Come back to me when you have something to offer.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I don't need anything in return. Take the eggs.
EN: Don't think your servile gesture earns my respect, stranger. But if that's how you want it, so it'll be.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: 500 caps sound good. Take the eggs.
EN: Thank you, stranger. The Thorn thanks you.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'll find the Night Stalker Eggs for you.
EN: Confident, I like that.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'll find the Night Stalker Eggs for you.
EN: So long, stranger.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: I'll find the Night Stalker Eggs for you.
EN: So long, stranger.

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: Where can I find Night Stalker Eggs?

Speaker: Red Lucy

Speaker: Red Lucy
Topic_Name: Perhaps, I'll keep the eggs for now.

Topic_Name: There are a lot of tents here.
EN: This also only one camp of many. You might have noticed the other camps down by the river.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Sure thing.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did happen at Bitter Springs?
EN: I still don't know exactly. Just that a lot of people died who didn't want to be part of the fighting at all.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did happen at Bitter Springs?
EN: I don't blame anybody for it. There's so much chaos when you're fighting, you're lucky not to shoot your own guys.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What did happen at Bitter Springs?
EN: But it did take something out of it for me. Just wasn't the same. So when it came time to re-enlist, I just took my papers and walked.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Ah, well... I just felt like it was time, you know? Wanted to have a home.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Plus I was up at Camp Golf when Bitter Springs went down. I faked like I was sick to get out of going, because I knew some of the people there.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: But when everybody came back nobody would tell me what happened. And people would call us murderers sometimes when we showed up to secure towns.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What was your tour with the NCR like?
EN: Oh, it was great. I wouldn't trade it.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: What was your tour with the NCR like?
EN: Something about that lifestyle, the discipline. Seeing new places, making people safe. What's not to like?

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I found a detonator on that man over there.
EN: What the hell? This must control some sort of bomb that he was going to use to kill the President.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I found a detonator on that man over there.
EN: Nice work catching this. I'll have my Rangers go deal with this man right away.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I found a bomb on the President's vertibird.
EN: A bomb on the President's vertibird? Only a limited number of people had access to the vertibird.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I found a bomb on the President's vertibird.
EN: We have to get the President out of here now. I'll cancel the speech and have security search the area.

Speaker: Ranger Grant

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Trust me, your troubles are over. <Set off the explosive in her collar>
EN: [FAILED] I appreciate you trying, but you'll have to find another way to get us out of here.

Speaker: Boxcars
Topic_Name: I took care of that slave caravan.
EN: {surly, sarcastic}You know what I'd be real excited about? If you'd showed up and saved me before they smashed my legs.

Speaker: Boxcars
Topic_Name: I took care of that slave caravan.
EN: {surly, sarcastic}Now why don't you fuck off and let me sleep, hero? That'd be real exciting, too.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Goodbye.

Speaker: Captain Gilles
Topic_Name: I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more.
EN: You did? Who was it? Any information you can give me would be a big help for my reports.

Speaker: Captain Gilles
Topic_Name: I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more.
EN: I appreciate the information, but I really wasn't kidding when I said I didn't have the manpower. If you could deal with him, I'd be in your debt.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've dealt with the attacks on the camp. They won't be a problem any more.
EN: I found your attacker. There's a Great Khan hiding out in the mountains. I can lead your men there.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: I understand. I'll leave you to your grief, then.
EN: {Accepting}As you wish.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: Let's not be hasty. I'll be back.
EN: {Suspicious}Why should I let you leave? You could lead the NCR right to me. I should kill you now.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: I promised Captain Gilles I'd stop the attacks on Bitter Springs.
EN: {Resigned}Then you'll have to kill me. My vengeance will not be stayed.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: Take revenge on the people actually responsible: Go attack Camp McCarran.
EN: {Proud anger}You're right. A Khan's vengeance should be direct and bloody. No more skulking in caves - I'll remind the NCR why they feared us!

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: The Khans settled in Red Rock Canyon years ago. It's time to let go of your hate and join them.
EN: {Sad, thoughtful}Maybe... maybe you're right. Maybe three years is vengeance enough. Thank you for helping me see that.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: The Khans settled in Red Rock Canyon years ago. It's time to let go of your hate and join them.
EN: Here. This will unlock the supply caches we left in caves around these mountains. You might get some use out of them.

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Bitter}I know that. But what else can I do?

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees.
EN: [FAILED] {Bitter}Keep deluding yourself if you want. I've seen the NCR's true face.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: The people at this camp aren't responsible for your family's death. They're refugees.
EN: But the NCR are trying to help! They're good people, fighting for civilization in a lawless waste!

Speaker: Oscar Velasco
Topic_Name: So you've been hiding in these mountains ever since? Why?
EN: {Righteous anger}For revenge! The NCR committed an atrocity here, an atrocity that they tried to bury and forget. I'm going to remind them.

Speaker: Aurelius of Phoenix
Topic_Name: How do I reach Fortification Hill?
EN: Cursor {Luh-CUH-lus}Lucullus is waiting for you at the docks. He'll take you to {KAI-zar}Caesar.

Speaker: Antony

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Potentially losing four dogs is a very high price to pay for a toy. What about two?

Speaker: Antony
EN: [FAILED] No deal. You and four of my dogs. Not two, not three - four.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Can't we make some kind of deal?

Speaker: Boone
EN: The big one. The one the NCR is trying to hold onto, that the Legion's pushing for. Whole war depends on holding it.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Do you know Colonel Hsu at all?
EN: Yeah. He introduced himself to me once. I shook his hand. Doubt he'd remember me now, though.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Do you know Colonel Hsu at all?
EN: When he looked at you, you could see he understood. After some of the things we'd seen, that meant something.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Do you know Colonel Hsu at all?
EN: What I heard, he'd be a general right now if Oliver didn't know the president.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: What do you think of General Oliver?
EN: Didn't know him. He's a signature on my discharge papers.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: What do you think of General Oliver?
EN: Wasn't real popular, though. Even overheard my C.O. complain about him once.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: What do you think of General Oliver?
EN: "General Wait-and-see," he called him.

Speaker: Boone
EN: It was on the front line for a while. Only resort in New Vegas no one wanted to get sent to.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Doesn't have that kind of importance anymore, though. They pulled most of the troops out of there after we took the Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Was an airport before the war. Command liked it because it was already fortified and it let them keep an eye on the Strip.

Speaker: Boone
EN: They've got an old monorail that still runs between them. Used mostly for supplies and deployment. But if you get leave you're allowed to go gamble.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Was General Oliver's post, but I heard he's been up at the Dam a lot lately. Guessing Colonel Hsu is running it.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Is that a First Recon beret?
EN: Yeah. You can tell by the patch. Bear skull with crossed rifles behind it. Slogan underneath.

Speaker: Boone
EN: "The last thing you never see."

Speaker: Boone
EN: Pretty accurate, and so were we.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: How did you happen to join First Recon?
EN: They pick you out if you do well at the firing range. Pays a little better, so I said okay.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: What outfit did you serve in the military with?
EN: First NCR Recon. It's a sniper battalion. Sees a lot of action.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: What outfit did you serve in the military with?
EN: They moved us around a lot. I was stationed at Camp Golf for a while. Last I heard they were at Camp McCarran.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: That's not how I want to approach this. You'd better go your own way for now.
EN: Better be a good reason. I didn't join up with you to go on nature walks.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I'm not ready to attack it. We'll keep our distance.
EN: If you're sure. There's a lot of high ground around the town. We could do a lot of damage.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I'm not ready to attack it. We'll keep our distance.
EN: Just saying.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: No, that's not a problem. That's a solution.
EN: Damn right. You and I, we're just a couple of problem solvers.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I'm ready. Caesar won't know what hit him.
EN: That's what the scope's for.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: No, I'm not going in right now.
EN: You ever change your mind, I'll be right there with you.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Yes, but you're not coming with me.
EN: You're making a mistake. I want to be a part of this.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: I don't want any trouble. We should part ways for now.
EN: Fine. But if you make any new friends in there, all bets are off.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: As long as you don't mind me joining the fun.
EN: I don't think I'd hold it against you.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Don't worry, I'm not going in there right now.
EN: Okay. But let's make sure and come back here. I'd love to wipe this place off the map.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I'm ready. When will the President be here?
EN: Looks like that's his vertibird coming right now. It's show time, let's not mess this up.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I'm ready. When will the President be here?
EN: Now if you'll excuse me I've got some security procedures to oversee.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: I've heard of you. I'm glad you're here to help us out. This is a delicate matter and we need all the help we can get from people we can trust.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: We've got a lot to do to prepare for the President's visit and not much time. Once we start we'll be on a strict timetable.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: So you're the one Mr. House sent. His Securitron here informed me of what's going on.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Since Mr. House has helped me in the past, I'll let you help us during the President's visit. However, I will be keeping an eye on you.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: We've got a lot to do to prepare for the President's visit and not much time. Once we start we'll be on a strict timetable.

EN: We've got a lot to do to prepare for the President's visit and not much time. Once we start we'll be on a strict timetable.

Speaker: Melody
EN: Um... can you help me?

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
Topic_Name: Legion's attacked Nipton, burned and killed everyone.
EN: {To himself}...we'll never stop them, not at this rate. We're doomed. {To player}Thanks for bringing the word - even if the news is bad, I'll let the men know.

Speaker: Boone
EN: You'll be glad you did this. I'm gonna put a hole through Caesar's head.

Topic_Name: I'm going to do this my way. I can't bring you.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Great Khan, looks like. Guess he fought at Bitter Springs. Or saw it happen.

Speaker: Boone
EN: If I was the assassin, I'd be up on that ridge. Or if I didn't care about escaping, maybe that near tower, or the landing pad behind us.

Topic_Name: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
EN: Thanks. Anything else?

Speaker: Lieutenant Markland
EN: Doctor's Bags would be a huge help too.

Speaker: Lieutenant Markland
EN: {Grateful}I think that should just about cover us. I really don't know how to thank you, bringing me these supplies saved a lot of people.

Speaker: Canyon Runner
EN: Let me know if you change your mind.

Speaker: Decanus Severus
EN: {gruff}Wasting my time is more like it.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Wish there was more of them. I wasn't done yet.

Speaker: Boone
EN: Thumbs down, you son of a bitch.

Speaker: Legionary Main Gate Guard

Speaker: Boone

EN: Yeah, it does. But we got these bastards pretty good today.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Why wouldn't this stop the Legion?
EN: Intel we had back in the NCR said they had a whole succession lined up. They'll replace him as soon as word gets out.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Why wouldn't this stop the Legion?
EN: The other thing I heard is that he wasn't really commanding the army anymore. Guess we made sure of that.

Speaker: Boone
Topic_Name: Still feels pretty good, though, doesn't it?

Speaker: Boone

Speaker: Boone

Topic_Name: It was a Great Khan named Oscar Velasco. His family was killed by the NCR, and he wanted revenge.

Topic_Name: It was a Great Khan named Oscar Velasco. His family was killed by the NCR, and he wanted revenge.

EN: Their very existence is a blight on the common good. Even worse are the Profligates, the subtype of Dissolute one finds this side of the river.

EN: Nobody threatens me and walks away alive!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler

Speaker: Alice Hostetler

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: They care for you, in their own way.
EN: My Father? A trading business that he'll never own, risking his neck every day against Wastelanders and cut-throat "merchants."

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: They care for you, in their own way.
EN: And I'm supposed to be part of those dreams? What about my dreams, stranger? What about me?

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: What do you really want, Alice?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I... I don't know what I want. But I hate this place, and I hate these people.

Speaker: Alice Hostetler

EN: It all used to be so simple. Why did they change? Why can't they see my pain?

Speaker: Alice Hostetler

EN: She's locked the bedroom door - like that's going to stop me. I was... I've got a gun, I'm going to make her give it to me!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
EN: She's locked the bedroom door - like that's going to stop me. I was... I've got a gun, I'm going to make her give it to me!

EN: So, where's the money?

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: Alice, Andy's just using you to get the money.
EN: Wh-What are you talking about? Andy wants to help me leave this hole... doesn't he?

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: I just want to talk, that's all.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Okay, but this better not be a trick!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: I just want to talk, that's all.
EN: [FAILED] I'm not stupid little girl anymore, you can't talk me out of this!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: I'm here to help you. Andy sent me.
EN: Dammit, I can take care of this by myself! That bitch is going to pay for all these years of bossing me around.

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
EN: You too? Think I'm just a little girl? I'll show you!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
EN: It's payback time, that's what! They've got no right to screw me over, and I'm tired of it!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: I'm not here to hurt you.
EN: Then what the hell {emphasis}do you want? Don't try anything, I mean it!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
Topic_Name: I should've known you don't have what it takes.
EN: Oh, you think I won't do it? You think I'm not right in wanting back my life!? I'll show you!

Speaker: Alice Hostetler
EN: Fine. Take it. But what the hell am I supposed to do now?

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: {Relieved}You must be the backup I've been calling for. Where are the rest of your men?

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: I heard your radio broadcast. I'm here to help.
EN: Thank God. I hoped someone would come eventually, but where are the rest of your men?

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: {Urgent}Shit. Have you any damn idea what lives in these caves!? We need to get out of...{cut short realizing he's yelling}

Speaker: Private Halford
ActorNotes: [Urgent hushed tone, fearful monsters will hear]
EN: {Urgent hushed tone, fearful monsters will hear}We need to go now!

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: {anxious}I don't know. Some kind of man-fish freak like the one I killed over there.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I'd heard fishermen spin old tales of 'Lakelurks' swimming in the water, but I always thought they were just bullshit mermaid stories.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I managed to kill that thing, but not before it mangled my leg all up. No way I'm walking out of here like this.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I've been keeping quiet and hoping they don't realize one of their buddies is missing. We need to get out of here before they come back.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: How did you kill that thing?
EN: With my bare hands. I would have shot it, but I was cleaning my gun when they swarmed the camp.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: How did you kill that thing?
EN: The ugly bastard knocked me down and started dragging me down into these caves. I managed to get my knife out and get a good throw into it's back.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: How did you kill that thing?
EN: Once he was on the ground, all it took was a bit of choking and punching to finish him off.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Thanks a lot, doc. I think I should be able to walk out of here, now.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I don't want to risk running into a pack of those freaks alone, though. Could you escort me out of here?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Looks like some nasty lacerations and a dislocated joint. You're lucky I found you.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: [FAILED] Whoa there, buddy. What you're suggesting is downright archaic.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I think my tourniquet will work for now, but I still can't walk like this.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: If I had a doctor's bag, I could probaly fix it up myself.

EN: I think I've got a dull needle and twine in one of my pockets.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: Great, just leave me here, then.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: That's a nice gun you've got there.
EN: You can have it if you get me out of here alive. I won't have a use for it when I get back to California.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: You're free to leave. The way up is clear.
EN: Great, I'll start heading back to California now. I'm not about to let myself get killed by future NCR incompetence.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: You're free to leave. The way up is clear.
EN: If you find my friends, please return their dogtags to the NCR. People need to know what happened here.

Speaker: Private Halford
Topic_Name: You're free to leave. The way up is clear.
EN: If they won't listen, do what you can to make them listen. The dead need to be avenged.

Topic_Name: We need to clear the caves first.
EN: Are you crazy? No way in hell am I going deeper into these caves.

Topic_Name: We need to clear the caves first.
EN: You haven't seen what they did to the other troopers, and I'd rather not find out why they took all of the bodies.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right, you have a point. They were good men and deserved better.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I can't guarantee I'll be much help against their numbers, but I'll do what I can. Chances are we won't get out of here alive anyway.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: [FAILED] Hey, I'm all for being a hero when the time is right, but there are at least 12 of those bastards lurking around in here.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I'd rather not join my buddies any time soon.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Grrr! Lily smash! Haha.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Turning it on. Urgh... feels strange. Strange but good.

Topic_Name: I'm looking into the Nightstalker mutation. Want to come along with me?
EN: Oh no, dearie, three makes a crowd.

EN: I've compared the brain chemistry of a Nightkin to one of the local Nightstalkers we killed. They both exhibit similar neurochemical changes.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
Topic_Name: What makes you think that the Nightstalker mutation isn't natural?
EN: Now, I'm not claiming that Nightstalkers are running around wearing Stealth Boys, mind you. I just don't think it's all a coincidence.

Speaker: Cato Hostilius
EN: Well hurry it up and get your shit together.

EN: [FAILED] Some choice. I can't stay here now, and I don't have the means to leave.

EN: I... guess that's your choice.

Topic_Name: You should stay with your family - reconcile with them.
EN: Maybe you're right... but what will they think? How can I look them in the face ever again?

Topic_Name: You should stay with your family - reconcile with them.
EN: Well, I guess I don't deserve any better, huh? So be it...

Speaker: Keene
EN: Bah! Humans.

EN: It is different! Right now I'm trying very hard to remain civil, and you're not making it easy with your incessant questions!

Speaker: Keene
Topic_Name: Do you have a problem with humans?
EN: Humans are always staring at things. We Nightkin don't like being stared at. Is is... uncomfortable.

Speaker: Keene
EN: Well, well. Congratulations on getting the Mark II prototype functional, doctor. Now just hand it over and we'll be on our way.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: What do you do in Jacobstown?
EN: I watch over the Bighorners. They're sweet, gentle creatures, but sometimes they get ornery. Just like my grandkids!

Speaker: James Garret

Speaker: Trent Bascom
EN: Can do.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: What kind of crops do you grow?
EN: Everything I can. Farmers out here don't have the luxury of being picky. I get by mostly on maize and tobacco.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: What are NCR troopers doing here?
EN: They're part of the deal, the Thaler Act. We work the fields while they protect the crops and the water.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: What are NCR troopers doing here?
EN: Lotta folks come to New Vegas and lose everything in Freeside or the Strip. They get hungry, desperate, and try to take our hard work.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: What are NCR troopers doing here?
EN: Much as I sympathize, their theft would put me in a bad spot. I got a crop quota to meet.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: Why is this work a bum deal?
EN: Bad soil and rationed water. It's to be expected around here, but the rationing's off. Worst part is NCR won't admit it.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: Why is this work a bum deal?
EN: Pretty hard to meet their crop quotas with twenty percent less water than we're supposed to be getting. Not that OSI cares about any of this.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
EN: Something the politicians back in Shady Sands came up with. They pay us to move here and farm the land. They even protect the fields.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
EN: Sure do. Came from The Hub on account of the Thaler Act. Farming's decent work, but the whole thing's a bum deal.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
EN: Adios.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water.
EN: The Office of Science and Industry has carefully calculated the amount of water needed for these crops. The whole thing is handled by computer.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water.
EN: Besides, most of these crops look fine to me. If the farmers can't handle the job, they shouldn't have signed up in the first place.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water.
EN: If there really is a problem, they can take it up with Lieutenant Boyd at McCarran. Farming isn't my department.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about these fields?
EN: Impressive, aren't they? You don't see anything like this outside of NCR territory, that's for sure.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about these fields?
EN: We get the water - clean water - pumped in from Lake Mead. If you follow the big pipes, they'll take you all the way to the Lake.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: Why are these fields being guarded?
EN: A lot of the crops grown here support the various NCR camps in the region - McCarran, Golf, and Forlorn Hope, to name a few.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: Why are these fields being guarded?
EN: We can't have wastelanders popping in here for a free meal, so my squad and I are assigned to keep things from going to hell.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
EN: Carry on.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: That happens, there's a good chance other Nightkin will follow. It'll make it hard to get a cure to them.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {Wary}Worse, if Keene and the Nightkin tear up the Mojave hunting for Stealth Boys, people are going get killed.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: Most humans can't tell the difference between mutants. Might come here looking for payback.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Why does Keene want to leave?
EN: Because of a promise. One I haven't been able to keep. The Nightkin all suffer from schizophrenia. It's the Stealth Boys they use, used to use.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Why does Keene want to leave?
EN: Nightkin have a hard time being seen like normal folks. Can't stand it. A few already left to try and find more Stealth Boys.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Why does Keene want to leave?
EN: Miserable situation. They either stay here and suffer, or dig up Stealth Boys and lose their minds. Not much of a choice.

Speaker: Trent Bascom

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: I'm looking for Corporal White. I was told that he'd spoken to you.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: I'm looking for Corporal White. I was told that he'd spoken to you.
EN: The last person I saw him talking to was Lieutenant Romanowski. Romanowski's around here somewhere. Sorry I couldn't be more helpful.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: Can't you just grow less crops?
EN: I wouldn't be able to meet the quota, and the NCR would kick me out of my job, anyway. Nah, it's better I get out on my own terms.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
EN: Good luck to you out here.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: What are you going to do now?
EN: I hear the Brahmin ranchers out in Redding are looking for some hard workers, so I might try there first. I hate working with Brahmin, though.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: Me? I have no idea what you're talking about.
EN: Sure you don't. All just a happy coincidence, am I right?

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: <Lie> The NCR admitted there's bad pipes somewhere, and took care of the problem.
EN: That's what I figured. Don't know why the heck they're so stubborn they couldn't just admit it.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem.

Speaker: Trent Bascom
Topic_Name: Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem.
EN: Maybe you don't want for food much, but you can sell these on the market for a good price. Like I said, we're much obliged for the help.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski

Speaker: Jas Wilkins

Speaker: Jas Wilkins

Speaker: Jas Wilkins

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: What does the NCR need with the cement?

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: This is Sloan, a camp for us quarry workers. The actual quarry, Quarry Junction, is up the road north of here. The whole thing is an NCR operation.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: Okay.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: Have you had problems with Deathclaws before?

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Powder Gangers.
EN: They're a bunch of escaped cons from down south. The NCR was using them to maintain the railways as part of their sentence.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Powder Gangers.
EN: I don't know who screwed up, but the Powder Gangers are loose. It was one group that attacked us and took our entire supply of dynamite.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: They moved into the quarry after the Powder Gangers came through and made off with most of our dynamite.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: We shut the quarry down while we waited for the NCR to get us some more blasting sticks, but now the Deathclaws have shown up.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: The NCR's a no-show, and my men and I have got nothing to do but sit on our asses all day. It's damn frustrating.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about New Vegas?

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about New Vegas?
EN: I've seen a lot of folks come through here thinking they'll have the easy life once they get there. It never happens.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: If you insist on going north, don't be expecting a rescue when you get into trouble.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: Yep.

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Speaker: Cato Hostilius
EN: They're probably afraid something is going to happen. For good reason.

Speaker: Cato Hostilius
EN: I wasn't able to find a final itinerary for his visit, but if you can find one, you can get more details on what's going to happen.

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Speaker: Cato Hostilius
Topic_Name: Do you have any suggestions about the assassination?

Speaker: Cato Hostilius
Topic_Name: Do you have any suggestions about the assassination?

Speaker: Cato Hostilius

Topic_Name: Well, I am expecting to be paid, of course.
EN: That's a motive I can understand.

Speaker: Melissa
EN: All right, fair enough. You help us out, and I'll owe you one.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: No angle. I just want to help.
EN: {still not trusting}Right. All right, here's the deal.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: No angle. I just want to help.
EN: I was expecting a shipment of chemicals. It's usually in a suitcase dropped off in one of the big machines up here.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: No angle. I just want to help.
EN: Because of the Deathclaws, I have to assume that the suitcase is still in Sloan. Snoop around the place and get it for me.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Seems like an odd place to pick up a delivery.
EN: The Khans and the NCR don't get along - they prefer to shoot us on sight, even if we're not looking for a fight.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: What kind of delivery are you expecting?
EN: Supplies to make chems. The NCR's the best source since they're hard to come by anywhere else.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: What kind of delivery are you expecting?
EN: We don't really use the chems ourselves, just sell them to anybody with the caps. If it ends up hurting the NCR in the process, that's a bonus.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I'll help you with your problem.
EN: {not trusting player}Is that right? What's your angle?

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I'll help you with your problem.
EN: {Great Khans - Vilified}I know something of your reputation with my gang, and I can't be seen working with you. Sorry, but I'll handle this.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: What are you doing up here?
EN: Awaiting a delivery, but it's a no-show. I'm guessing that the Deathclaws in the quarry have something to do with that.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I'm looking for some Great Khans who stole something from me in Goodsprings.
EN: The only Khans this far into NCR territory is me and my crew, and I didn't steal squat from you.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I'm looking for some Great Khans who stole something from me in Goodsprings.
EN: Besides, even if some of my gang did steal from you, I wouldn't rat them out. Loyalty actually means something to the Great Khans.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I'm looking for some Great Khans who stole something from me in Goodsprings.
EN: As far as I know, it's just me and my crew out here, and if it really was Great Khans who mugged you, they didn't come this way. I'd have seen 'em.

Speaker: Melissa
EN: Don't leave a trail.

Speaker: Snuffles
EN: [SUCCEEDED] <snuffle!>

EN: [Clean the wound with antibiotics and expertly bind Snuffles' injured leg.]

EN: [FAILED] <whuff!>

EN: [Do your best attempts at first aid to treat Snuffles' injured leg.]

Speaker: Snuffles
EN: <whuff>

EN: <snuffle!>
