Topic_Name: Hmmm... your leg appears to be injured.
EN: <whuff>

Speaker: Snuffles
EN: <snuffle>

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will the White Glove Society ally with Caesar now?
EN: I should think so, but it would be up to Marjorie.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will the White Glove Society ally with Caesar now?
EN: I have, however, told her how instrumental you were in revolutionizing our cuisine. And she knows what we stand to gain from a ruler who supports it.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will the White Glove Society ally with Caesar now?
EN: Have a word with her, see what she says. I daresay she'll be more receptive with these new developments.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: Tell your ruler we have no interest in such ties. Caesar's Legion is a collection of unclean barbarians.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: Any time the White Glove Society is mentioned in the same breath, it sullies our good name.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: As much as Mortimer and some of the other members have tried to convince me otherwise, I will not have us seen as savages.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: Looking to elevate his social status, is he?

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: I'll admit, I could see benefits to living under his rule. Certain... transgressions he'd be willing to overlook.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: But that's neither here nor there, I'm afraid. Marjorie won't have it, as long as she fails to see the wisdom of my perspective.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: I don't care for their incivility or the hodgepodge of sporting equipment that passes for fashion with them.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: Nevertheless, I have heard Caesar has a stately dignity about him. And I understand his policies will agree with our new menu.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
EN: I prefer Mr. House, of course, but he may not be around forever. And the NCR will surely set back our cuisine. Tell your Mr. Caesar we are with him.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
EN: Momma always told me not to talk to strangers, but you seem like a nice person.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
EN: Momma left me on a farm when she went out prospecting, but when she never came back, the owner didn't want me around and kicked me out on my own.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
EN: A nice guy came up and asked me if I wanted to join the NCR so I did. Now the Troopers are my family. I like it here. Everyone is so nice.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: What do you know about the President's visit?
EN: He's coming to give a big fancy speech to all of us troops stationed here at the dam.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: What do you know about the President's visit?
EN: I'm pretty excited. He seems like such a nice guy and I get to meet him.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: What do you know about the President's visit?
EN: He's giving me a medal. I don't know why though. I'm just doing my job like all the other guys. I'm still excited though.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: What do you know about the President's visit?
EN: I can't believe someone killed President Kimball. He was such a nice guy, why would anyone want to hurt him?

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: What do you know about the President's visit?
EN: I can't believe someone wanted to kill President Kimball. I'm glad he got out of here safe.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: Your helmet is right over there.
EN: {confused}It's always in the last place you look. I wonder why that is.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: Your helmet is right over there.
EN: Thanks mister, you're the greatest.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: Your helmet is right over there.
EN: {confused}It's always in the last place you look. I wonder why that is.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: Your helmet is right over there.
EN: There it is! Thanks lady, you're the greatest.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: So you have to do whatever Lawson tells you.
EN: No, man. That's just what I'm supposed to do.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: So you have to do whatever Lawson tells you.
EN: But when he tells me to push the middle button to divert the intake, and the right button feels nicer when I touch it, I know where my loyalty is.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: So you have to do whatever Lawson tells you.
EN: Man, I just don't know how an idiot like that gets put in charge of anything.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: They put you in charge of Hoover Dam?
EN: They sure as shit did. I mean there's still formalities, like I have to run everything by Lawson before I do it.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: They put you in charge of Hoover Dam?
EN: But do I ever do that? Is his name Fantastic?

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: Man, what aren't my responsibilities? Dam overflow, dam underflow. Dam leakage. Sometimes the dam gets too big and I have to shrink it down.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: People come to me to resolve their disputes with my wisdom.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: Like, hey  Fantastic, who gets to keep this doodad we found? Or, yo, Fantastic, when will you accept that you're the father of my child? It's crazy.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: Get this straight. You're not my master.
EN: Whoa, hey. All right, man. It's cool. Who said anything about being your master?

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: Get this straight. You're not my master.
EN: I'm just the guy who tells you to do the stuff you do before you do it.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: Fantastic? What are you doing here?
EN: What's it look like, man? I'm fucking king of the NCR. Caesar's Legion has Caesar, the NCR's got Fantastic. It's Fantastic's NCR now.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: Fantastic? What are you doing here?
EN: This whole war's about power, man. Caesar wants it. NCR wants it. Fantastic's got it.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: Fantastic? What are you doing here?
EN: After I fixed HELIOS One and basically saved the NCR from the dumbshits who run it, I got myself a little promotion. Now I run the whole shebang.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: Ever since he lost his job a few years back he hasn't been the same. He took a switch to us for the tiniest things.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: We were trying to get away when the legion showed up. I'm glad he ran off like a coward, but slavery wasn't the kind of escape I was looking for.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: Anything you can do to help, just please get us out of here.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: [Lie] Do you mean the helmet I just threw off the dam?
EN: Ha ha, you big joker you. You're funny. I like you.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
Topic_Name: [Lie] Do you mean the helmet I just threw off the dam?
EN: I really need to find my helmet though. Thanks anyway.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
EN: That's too bad. I need it for the ceremony. I need to look my best and I need my lucky helmet.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
EN: I'll just have to keep looking. Thanks anyway.

Speaker: Private Jeremy Watson
EN: Have you seen my helmet? I can't seem to find it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {nonplussed}You have?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: It's a good thing we stopped the Omertas in time.
EN: Indeed. Moving on...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Omertas were clever, but no match for me.
EN: Arrogance was their undoing. {referring to the player}There might be a lesson in that. But moving on...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm going to kill you now, Mr. House.
EN: After all that we've accomplished?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The Omertas are fanatically loyal to each other. Still, among any group, one can find the occasional degenerate.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Gomorrah's receptionist happens to be one. For years she passed on whispers of what was taking place at the casino, in exchange for payment.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: A few months ago, she clammed up. Odds are she's scared, but I've had no way of approaching her. Start with her.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: The print-out I've given you lists every lead I've been able to uncover. See what you can find out.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: There's nothing to think about. You have a job to do, so do it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What do you want me to do?
EN: Simple - an NCR Ranger named Grant is in charge of security arrangements for the visit. Present yourself to him, let him know you want to help.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What do you want me to do?
EN: Given your reputation, it's a near-certainty that he'll accept your offer.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What do you want me to do?
EN: Don't dally. The precise time of Kimball's visit is a closely-guarded secret, but it will happen soon.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I don't want to kill off the entire Brotherhood.
EN: Don't tell me that you've fallen for the stories of noble paladins on crusade, preserving mankind's technology in a benighted age? Dross!

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I don't want to kill off the entire Brotherhood.
EN: {not unkindly}In any case... this is an employer - employee relationship. I've given you an assignment, and the directions are clear.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Any possibility of a diplomatic solution?
EN: We're talking about a {COAT-ah-ree}coterie of bulging-eyed fanatics who think all Pre-War technology belongs to them.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Any possibility of a diplomatic solution?
EN: They'll never accept my using an army of robots to defend New Vegas. While it's a fight I can win, I'd rather sidestep it altogether.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Where do you want me to start?
EN: Since 2278, I've lost five roaming Securitrons near Hidden Valley.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Where do you want me to start?
EN: I didn't receive any clear video of the incidents, but telemetry from the units destroyed indicates they were attacked with energy weapons.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Where do you want me to start?
EN: It's obvious that the Brotherhood has a base in Hidden Valley or thereabouts. Finding it won't be easy, but getting inside will be the real trick.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: If I want more work, I'll come see you.
EN: You laid the foundation for my victory, so fine - I'll permit some {beat, begrudging}latitude in how you schedule your work.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: If I want more work, I'll come see you.
EN: You're welcome.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll make sure they support the right side.
EN: Use extreme caution when approaching the base. Their firepower is... considerable.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll make sure they support the right side.
EN: Recently, one of my roaming Securitrons observed a man near the base studying the pattern of its artillery fire. Maybe he's learned something.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I've come here to kill you, Mr. House. <Attack Mr. House.>
EN: {first Benny, now the player}Why is good help so impossible to find?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I've done enough work for you.
EN: I offer many benefits, but vacation time isn't one of them.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Outside New Vegas, at what was once called Nellis Air Force Base, resides an unusual tribe known as the Boomers.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: They are, shall we say, {understating}aggressively reclusive? They have several howitzers they fire at anyone who dares approach the base.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Artillery of this sort has a range of several miles. If it's going to fire on Hoover Dam, I want it firing at my targets.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: If not, then I want to make sure that the Boomers don't sign similar treaties to fire their guns in support of the NCR or Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: This is getting creepy. I'm leaving, and don't follow me.
EN: Fine. Just do me a favor. If you find more of those things, and plan on keeping them, watch out for a man named Allen Marks.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: This is getting creepy. I'm leaving, and don't follow me.
EN: He's killed more than a few people to collect as many of those caps as he can, and your ignorance as to what they are won't protect you.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Why didn't you say anything then and there?
EN: I had to make sure of your disposition. There's a lot of jumpy folks out there that'd shoot a man as soon as talk to him.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Why didn't you say anything then and there?
EN: Now that's we're conversing, though, I can tell you what I know about those caps.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: What's so special about these caps?
EN: There's an old wasteland legend that says somewhere out there is a fabulous treasure from before the war.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: What's so special about these caps?
EN: Those caps with the blue star on them, the tale goes, are the key to that treasure. They're called Sunset Sarsaparilla Stars.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Don't follow me. You'll live longer.
EN: Okay, you're a dangerous sort. I get that. But I have some information I think you'll find useful, which made me follow you for a spell.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
EN: It started off innocently enough. I was traveling, as I often do, and happened to observe you picking up one of those blue-star caps.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
EN: You didn't show any reaction to it, so I figured you didn't know what you'd gotten your hands on.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Same stuff. Any NCR weapons, computer parts, or radio parts.

Speaker: Logan
EN: I'll need more than that. Keep looking.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Alright, thanks for the help. Time to die loser.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Anything branded by the NCR related to weapons, computers, or radios.

Speaker: Logan
EN: There's gotta be more than that, keep looking.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Alright, we can move on now. Here's the key to the Fire Station.

Speaker: Logan
EN: It's about damn time. You ready to go?

Speaker: Logan
EN: Tell you what. Bring us those suits, and you can come with us while we loot the town. You can keep a share.

Speaker: Logan
EN: That's none of your damn business.

Speaker: Logan
Topic_Name: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
EN: Name's Logan. What the hell do you want?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Not much, I'm afraid. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Yeah, I am. What of it?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Are you sure about that?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: I'm here because I have nowhere else to go.

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: No, I'm not. Not yet anyway. I'm Private Kyle Edwards, former NCR trooper.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: The rangers at Echo have been keeping an eye on that place. It's relatively new, but those bastards have already dug in.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: They appear to be running a slave-trading operation and it also seems to be one of the primary crossing points for Legion raiding parties.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Let's hear it.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Let's hear it.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Better get back to it then, I don't want those poor soldiers suffering for longer than they have to.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: How did you meet Doctor Henry?
EN: He and I had joined up with the same caravan. Add in a lot of whiskey, and, well, let's just say we got to know each other.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Like I said before, give me 700 caps and Rey's brain is yours.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: All right, then.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fair enough. {to a dog}Here, Rey! Mama's got something for you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm offering Rey immortality of a sort. Are you really going to put a price on that?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [FAILED] I happen to disagree. 700 caps, and that's my one and only offer.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: It's just a dog's brain. I don't think it's worth that many caps.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: {to a dog}Here, Rey! Mama's got something for you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: I don't have the caps with me right now.
EN: No worries. I'll hold onto those parts for you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Why do they call you Old Lady Gibson?
EN: Well, I'll give you a hint - they used to just call me Gibson. I hope you can figure out the rest.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Why do they call you Old Lady Gibson?
EN: I don't mind, to be honest. Living long is a real accomplishment these days. Remains to be seen if I end up dying peaceful in my bed.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: 250 caps it is. Here you go.
EN: A pleasure doing business with you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Okay.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: 500 caps it is. Here you go.
EN: Pleasure doing business with you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Ha! Yes, you are quite the smoothtalker. What the hell - 250 it is.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: But you're going to cut the price to 250 because I'm just that charming, right?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [FAILED] Oh, you're charming in your own way, I suppose. Not budging on the price for those parts, though.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: How about a discount? I'm a nice person.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Eh, fair enough. It's not like anyone's ever wanted to buy them before. 250 caps it is.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: 250 caps. Unless you think you'll find another buyer soon for such specialized parts?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [FAILED] Oh, I don't know about that. Lots of folks travel by on their way to New Vegas.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You should cut down the price. It's not like anyone will probably buy them.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about REPCONN?
EN: Sometimes it seems like I spent the better portion of my youth in that old wreck of a building.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about REPCONN?
EN: Me and my hubby, may the man rest in peace, used to scavenge there. If it weren't bolted down, you can bet we took it and sold it.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about REPCONN?
EN: A lot of the scrap you see around here is from REPCONN, even my favorite chair.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Still got them. 250 caps and they're yours.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Still got them. 500 caps and they're yours.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Do you have any thrust control modules from REPCONN in stock?
EN: As it so happens, I do have some thrust modules, but they're expensive. 500 caps worth of expensive.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: Certainly did. Hubby and me had an old rad meter to help us tell the difference between what you could salvage and what'd kill you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: I kept a glowing container from REPCONN around here for years serving no better purpose than a nightlight. Damn thing wouldn't sell.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: Then along comes the most peculiar-looking fellow, all decked out in a yellow radiation suit, of which he was proud all out of proportion.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: The man outright asked if I had anything radioactive for sale - imagine that! But he paid handsome for that jar of goop.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: Only saw him that once. He said something about heading over to Clark Field to put his suit through its paces. A strange one, he was...

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Doctor Henry sent me. I need a new brain for my cyber-dog.
EN: Doctor Henry? Now there's a name I haven't heard in years. Hard to believe he's still alive.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Doctor Henry sent me. I need a new brain for my cyber-dog.
EN: As for your request, it's, uh, a bit ghoulish if you ask me, but Rey is pretty old and I'll probably have to put him down soon enough.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Doctor Henry sent me. I need a new brain for my cyber-dog.
EN: As for the price for this favor, 700 caps sounds about right. Rey's like family, and I've got other dogs to take care of.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Take care, now.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Sure thing. Let me have a look.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Happy to do it.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: An attractive woman like yourself all alone? Maybe you and I could work out some kind of trade...
EN: I know I'm not young and pretty any more, but I appreciate the thought all the same. {grinning}Here, take the parts, you flatterer.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What do you know about HELIOS One?
EN: The way I heard it, the Brotherhood of Steel ran the place before the NCR took it away from them. I'm not sure who started shooting first.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What do you know about HELIOS One?
EN: But, when it was over, the Brotherhood, with all their fancy armor and weapons, was on the run. Nobody's heard from them since.

Speaker: Lt. Haggerty
Topic_Name: I don't need your help. I'm going to carve myself a key from your bones.
EN: {Slightly fearful}Jesus. You're a real goddamn psycho.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: It'll be more fun if we keep it a mystery. Besides, I'm more interested in you.
EN: You're right. I'm sorry. That imbecile in the next room has me on edge. I used to be more fun.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: It'll be more fun if we keep it a mystery. Besides, I'm more interested in you.
EN: I'm still passionate about my work though. Otherwise I wouldn't be here.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: It'll be more fun if we keep it a mystery. Besides, I'm more interested in you.
EN: I'm in the Followers of the Apocalypse. How about you?

Speaker: Tyrone
Topic_Name: How about you and I come to another arrangement. It'll be worth it - trust me.
EN: {Black Widow}Well, it has been awhile. All right, let's do this.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: You mentioned someone named Festus. Who's that?
EN: It's said that the treasure is guarded by a man named Festus, and he's the one who asks for the blue-star caps.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: You mentioned someone named Festus. Who's that?
EN: It's also said that he's been around since the war, standing a lonely vigil, waiting for someone to come and take the treasure off his hands.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: You mentioned someone named Festus. Who's that?
EN: That'd make him pretty damn old, but I've met a few people in my travels who claimed they actually met him, and they weren't the lying type either.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: What kind of treasure are we talking about?
EN: No one knows. Money? Weapons? Water? It is, or maybe was, something of value, and that's enough to get people motivated.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: So you collect these caps too?
EN: Nah, I gave it up years ago. Too dangerous. And even if I did still collect them, I'd tell you the same.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: So you collect these caps too?
EN: There's people out there so mad with the idea of treasure that they'll attack strangers just on the suspicion that they have some of those caps.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: All over the place. The easiest place to find them is unopened bottles of Sunset Sarsaparilla.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: You'd think they'd all have been picked clean by now, but somehow new bottles keep appearing in the machines.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: Some say it's old Festus that does it, hoping someone will finally collect enough caps to earn the treasure.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: Other than bottles, you'll just have to scavenge. You can find caps in the unlikeliest of places, and blue-star caps are no exception.

Speaker: Festus
EN: If this is your first rodeo with the ol' horseshoes, say "How do I play?". Otherwise, say "Lucky Horseshoes" to begin.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I feel lucky.

Speaker: Festus

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: The Old Mormon Fort serves as the regional hub for the Followers of the Apocalypse. I am the administrator for this region.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: The Followers of the Apocalypse aren't just interested in research. We care for our fellow man and do everything we can to help humanity.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: Here in Freeside, we provide food and medical services for those in need. We have also organized reconstruction efforts.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Who are the Followers of the Apocalypse?

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Who are the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: We hope to forge a brave new world free of war and poverty by sharing knowledge and resources. Our primary goal is the free exchange of ideas.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: They're based out of the old fort in Freeside. They supposedly helped the NCR out at some point, but they go their own way now.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: They know stuff about tech and medicine and usually help out anybody who asks. Can't say I know any more than that.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: They're based out of the old fort in Freeside. They supposedly helped the NCR out at some point, but they go their own way now.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: They know stuff about tech and medicine and usually help out anybody who asks. Can't say I know any more than that.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You want me to kill Caesar?
EN: Absolutely not! Caesar is of great use to me.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You want me to kill Caesar?
EN: I don't want you harming a hair on that man's head - assuming you can find one.

Speaker: Melissa
EN: I don't think that's the whole story, but fuck it. I'm going back to Red Rock. I've had enough of this place.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: He was sloppy and trusted the wrong person.
EN: {annoyed}Well, fuck. I can't believe I'm going back to Red Rock empty-handed. Thanks for trying to help.

Speaker: Melissa
EN: {furious}I knew I shouldn't have trusted you! You're going to pay for that!

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Your supplier was exposed. There won't be any more chemical supplies.
EN: {suspicious}Uh-huh. And how exactly was he exposed?

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: All right. Thanks for all your help.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> No, there wasn't anyone else.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: All right. I'll have him brought in for questioning.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Chomps Lewis, the foreman at Sloan, was also involved.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: Tyrone wasn't authorized to deliver any of this. There were reports of our supplies being used by the Great Khans to make illegal chems.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: Until now, we've never had any hard evidence. Most of the chems end up with the Fiends, a group of crazies the NCR tangles with regularly.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: We'll have to conduct a thorough investigation of all our quartermasters, and crack down on sloppy record-keeping. Thank you.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: Other than Tyrone, were any other NCR citizens involved in this smuggling operation?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Tyrone has been selling chemical supplies to the Great Khans. Here - I got these from him.

Speaker: Tyrone
Topic_Name: I'm sorry, but all these muscles make it hard to hear sometimes. What was that about risk?
EN: {Strength 7+}{intimidated by player's strength}Uh, never mind. Take the supplies. All yours, friend.

Speaker: Lieutenant Markland
EN: {Happy}Thank you, that was very helpful. I don't think I'll need those books after all.

Speaker: Captain Gilles
Topic_Name: Not yet, but I had some questions.
EN: Sure, just make them quick.

Speaker: Anders
EN: Thanks. See you around.

Speaker: Anders
Topic_Name: Actually, I have a few questions first.
EN: Okay, but keep it quick. I'd like to get out of here before the Legionnaires come to check on me.

Speaker: Anders
Topic_Name: I think you're better off where you are. Hang around, I'll be back.
EN: {In agony}No! God, please!

Speaker: Anders
Topic_Name: Are you Anders? Jack and Diane sent me to look for you.
EN: {In agony}Thank God. Let me down, please!

Speaker: Anders
Topic_Name: Are you Anders? Jack and Diane sent me to look for you.
EN: They did? Heh. Probably mostly Jack's idea, he always was the soft touch.

Speaker: Anders
Topic_Name: Are you Anders? Jack and Diane sent me to look for you.
EN: Thanks. You've saved my life, and done the Great Khans a huge favor. I'll be heading back to Red Rock Canyon now - maybe we'll see each other there.

Speaker: Anders
Topic_Name: Let's get you down from there.
EN: Unnnh.

Speaker: Anders
EN: {In agony}Please... for the love of God, let me down!

Speaker: Anders
EN: Well, not exactly. More like... trying to expand our markets. I heard there was a lot of untapped territory down south, but the Legion caught me.

Speaker: Anders
EN: {In agony}Unh... Legion caught me. Said this... was the penalty for drug runners. Please... let me down.

Speaker: Anders
EN: A Legion patrol caught me trying to cross the river. When they found the, umm, package I was carrying, they strung me up there.

Speaker: Karl
ActorNotes: [Shifty, doesn't really believe what he's saying.]
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Great Khans?
EN: {Shifty, doesn't really believe what he's saying.}They're a tribe of fine warriors, with many proud traditions and a glorious history. They will be worthy additions to the Legion.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Great Khans?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Join? Oh, no, I simply couldn't. That is... I'm {choking on this, REALLY hates to say it}not worthy of such an honor.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Great Khans?
EN: I've been wondering why you don't petition the Khans for membership as a show of allegiance.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Great Khans?
EN: [FAILED] Alas, my first loyalty is to Caesar, and a soldier cannot have two masters.

Speaker: Karl
EN: My name is Karl. Glorious Caesar has sent me as an emissary to the Great Khans as a token of our alliance.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Amused}You march all the way out to Red Rock Canyon, enter my home as bold as you please, and you have no idea who I am? You've got guts, I'll give you that.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: Well, then, let me educate you: I am the chief of the Great Khans - the Khan of Khans, if you like. This is my tribe and these are my people.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Name's Regis - I'm Papa Khan's advisor and right-hand man. I'm also the chief enforcer of the tribe's laws - so watch your behavior.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Regis says I should talk to you about speaking against the Great Khans' alliance with Caesar.
EN: You can ask, but why would I do that? Karl's told me all about life in the Legion! He says I've got all the makings of a {SPECK-you-la-tore-ay; over-enunciate like she's not familiar with the word}speculatore.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
EN: Don't worry, Jack and I have talked it over. We'll talk up the idea of breaking the alliance.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
EN: So, about the alliance with Caesar's Legion....

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
EN: Anders got back a little while before you did, he told me what happened. If that's how the Legion treats my people, I don't want any part of them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
EN: So, about the alliance with Caesar's Legion....

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: I've been told you're someone I should talk to about stopping the Khans' alliance with Caesar.
EN: Hey, it's not like I'm super-attached to working with Caesar or anything, but if it'll stop his patrols from harassing my runners, I'm all for it.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Oh, it's cool, man. Diane passed me the haps on that fandango with Anders. I got your back.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Oh, it's cool, man, I got your back.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Huh? Look, man, me and Diane, we don't dig on that politics stuff, savvy? We just make the product and make it get to a good home.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Sure, Caesar's a drag, but as long as we got each other, we don't care who the top dogs roll with.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Oh, it's cool, kitten. Diane passed me the haps on that fandango with Anders. I got your back.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Oh, it's cool, kitty cat, I got your back.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Huh? Look, kitty cat, me and Diane, we don't dig on that politics stuff, savvy? We just make the product and make it get to a good home.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'm here to ask you to publicly oppose Papa Khan's alliance with Caesar.
EN: Sure, Caesar's a drag, but as long as we got each other, we don't care who the top dogs roll with.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Papa is one of the best leaders the Khans have ever had. He's kept us together through all of our hardships, ever since we left California.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Bitter Springs changed him, though. He started to really hate the NCR after the Massacre, and sometimes I worry that's poisoned his mind.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of the NCR?
EN: That's a complicated question. They've done horrible things to our people to be sure, and I've gladly killed many of their soldiers in battle.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of the NCR?
EN: But I can't bring myself to hate them the way Papa does. Things would damn sure be better for us if they were in charge than Caesar.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of the NCR?
EN: You're the chief now. What do we do?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of the NCR?
EN: I want to talk to you about the fate of the Great Khans.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of the NCR?
EN: Without Papa Khan's guidance, I don't know what else to do. All right - you can tell the NCR the Great Khans will fight for them when Caesar attacks.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of the NCR?
EN: Now that you're in command, will you lead the Khans against Caesar and fight for the NCR?

Speaker: Regis
EN: I heard you try to convince Papa Khan not to join with Caesar's Legion. I'd like to talk to you about that for a moment.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Let me see. {Thoughtful, dawning horror}My God, this is even worse than I thought. Okay, you have my support. I'll tell Papa the alliance is a bad idea.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Have a look at this book. It will show you what happens to tribes that "ally" with Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Regis
EN: What do you want to know?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'd like to talk more about the Great Khans' alliance with Caesar.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You should look at this. It's Karl's journal, and it's very revealing of his true opinions.
EN: Let me see that... "filthy savages? Probably have to decimate the lot of them?" Are these the words of our "friend," Caesar?

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You should look at this. It's Karl's journal, and it's very revealing of his true opinions.
EN: Great Khans! Drive Caesar's dog out of our camp! If he's too slow to flee, kill him!

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You should look at this. It's Karl's journal, and it's very revealing of his true opinions.
EN: What's this? Ah, yes, I've heard that the Legion has sometimes had to quell tribes that did not share its vision.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You should look at this. It's Karl's journal, and it's very revealing of his true opinions.
EN: The Khans, though, are protected by Caesar's emissary - I have Karl's word we will remain our own tribe as long as we remain loyal to Caesar.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You should look at this. It's Karl's journal, and it's very revealing of his true opinions.
EN: Take your slander elsewhere.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You should look at this. It's Karl's journal, and it's very revealing of his true opinions.
EN: This is a ledger from Caesar's camp, showing what Karl really has planned for the Great Khans.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about your people?
EN: You want to hear the story of the Great Khans? It's a long one, full of honor, glory and betrayal. We have suffered, but we will regain our glory.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: I've come to ask the Great Khans to break their alliance with Caesar's Legion.
EN: Have you now? Hmm. Well, you're a bold one, I'll give you that, but why should I do this for you?

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: I've come to ask the Great Khans to break their alliance with Caesar's Legion.
EN: Hmm. I have heard some things from my most trusted Khans that makes me wonder whether this alliance is a good idea after all.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: I've come to ask the Great Khans to break their alliance with Caesar's Legion.
EN: But I want to leave a legacy of greatness when I die. My tribe deserves better than this, cowering in a canyon and living on scraps.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: I've come to ask the Great Khans to break their alliance with Caesar's Legion.
EN: Tell me then, if I don't join with Caesar's Legion, where will I find my tribe's lost glory?

Speaker: Melissa
EN: I doubt the NCR thinks so. Heh.

Speaker: Private Jensen
EN: Yeah, but those are the rules.

Speaker: Private Jensen
EN: Not a chance.

Speaker: Private Jensen
EN: Okay, just this once. Make it quick though, I don't want to get in trouble for this.

Speaker: Private Jensen
Topic_Name: I've always wanted to see the President's vertibird.
EN: Sorry, no can do.

Speaker: Private Jensen
EN: Only NCR engineers or people with explicit permission from Ranger Grant are allowed roof access.

Speaker: Private Jensen
EN: If you have to ask, you're not authorized.

Speaker: Private Jensen
EN: The President is visiting today. Ranger Grant doesn't want anyone snooping around up there that doesn't have authorization.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood of Steel knew about ARCHIMEDES?
EN: I would think you'd know better than I. But perhaps they kept their operation here a secret, even from members of their own order.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood of Steel knew about ARCHIMEDES?
EN: They weren't here for me to ask, but I doubt they were here for electricity.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood of Steel knew about ARCHIMEDES?
EN: When the NCR first came here, it was under Brotherhood control. They usually steer clear of one another, but something here changed their minds.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood of Steel knew about ARCHIMEDES?
EN: The Brotherhood's interest in Pre-War technology has always been in weapons. It's likely they were trying to reclaim ARCHIMEDES when the NCR arrived.

Speaker: Lt. Haggerty
Topic_Name: Why was the Brotherhood of Steel here?
EN: Damned if I know. Put up a hell of a fight, though. We had them outnumbered, I don't know, twenty to one, maybe.

Speaker: Lt. Haggerty
Topic_Name: Why was the Brotherhood of Steel here?
EN: They held out as long as they could. Lost most of their force before they retreated. Gave us a little parting gift, too.

Speaker: Lt. Haggerty
Topic_Name: Why was the Brotherhood of Steel here?
EN: They had some of the plant running, but they shut it all down. Enabled an old security system, too, to keep us away from the controls. Jerkoffs.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
EN: By all means.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
EN: Other things weren't lost, but were blocked from our collective memory. Knowledge of what we're capable of, and how things spiral out of control.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
EN: It's in our nature to want to forget truths that keep us awake at night.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
EN: And for that reason it's all the more important that the Followers walk the wastes to remind people of them.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: Do the Followers work together with the NCR?
EN: We did, for a time. But our goals differ. The NCR only cares to expand their wealth and their reach.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: Do the Followers work together with the NCR?
EN: For us, territorial boundaries mean nothing. And prosperity has to be for everyone, not just citizens of the NCR.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: Do the Followers work together with the NCR?
EN: So a parting was inevitable. While the NCR pushes east, we clean up the mess they leave behind. Try to provide some stability.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: Where are the Followers based around here?
EN: We're scattered, mostly. We go where we're needed. Our largest presence is in Freeside at Old Mormon Fort.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: Where are the Followers based around here?
EN: Other than that, I know Dr. Usanagi set up a practice near the Crimson Caravan. And a man we trained is operating out of the Aerotech building.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: Where are the Followers based around here?
EN: Another man, Tom Anderson, was looking into water supply problems in Westside. But that was a while ago.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: How did you end up joining the Great Khans?
EN: {slight wincing}It wasn't easy. There's a lot of initiation rituals to go through, and I've got the scars to prove it.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: How did you end up joining the Great Khans?
EN: {pride}But, in the end, I was tough enough to be made a member. Proudest day of my life.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: If the area is filled with radiation, why are you still here?
EN: I was stationed at Camp Searchlight before the incident.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: If the area is filled with radiation, why are you still here?
EN: I've since taken it upon myself to keep travelers away from the area.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Who is Private Edwards?

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Head north toward Novac. Look for a big dinosaur, can't miss it.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Can I ask you something else?
EN: Sure, what's on your mind?

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Some Legionaries snuck into the camp and set off some kind of radiation bomb.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: I don't know where they got it, but it was damn effective. Killed almost everyone and turned the rest into ghouls.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: None that aren't feral ghouls. Those poor bastards - I can't imagine how they must be suffering.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: I'd like to put them out of their misery but I don't have the heart to do it. Can you do me a favor?

Speaker: Allen Marks
EN: I guess this is it. Not much air left now. Minutes, maybe. And this is what I have to show for it.

Speaker: Allen Marks
EN: Guess the joke's <gasps air> on me. Prolly shouldn't have killed... all those people. Prolly shoulda stayed at home... and taken care of my ma.

Speaker: Allen Marks
EN: She... always used to say people who... murder and steal... die bad in the end. Said they...

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: I see. Thanks for saving us the trouble.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: There was another man involved at Sloan, but he's dead.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Why do you want to kill them?
EN: Those boys aren't themselves anymore. They're in pain, and you don't let good men suffer like that.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Why do you want to kill them?
EN: Those troopers deserve a clean death.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Thank you. Could you bring me their dog tags? Some of the troopers should still be wearing them.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: I'll give you some caps for each one you bring back to me. There's an old rifle in it for you if you can bring me at least 10.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Oh and take these radiation supplies. You'll need them.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: I'm gonna need more than that if you want my help.
EN: [FAILED] Sorry I don't have anything else to offer.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: I'm gonna need more than that if you want my help.
EN: [SUCCEEDED]I can't offer much more aside from some extra ammo.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Sorry, I can't help you right now.
EN: I understand.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: We don't get many supplies out here, but I can offer you some caps and maybe some old gear.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: I want you to put down the troopers that... changed. Turned into ghouls.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: How did they get into the camp?
EN: I don't know, unfortunately. There may be clues somewhere inside the camp, but I'm not about to run in there to find out.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: I was out on patrol at the time so I wasn't in the camp when it happened.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: There were a few others with me after it happened, including some of my superiors.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Between radiation poisoning and attacks by the Legion they all died out.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Can I ask you something else?
EN: Sure.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: I'll go ask him about it.
EN: Good luck with that.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Is there somewhere else he can go?
EN: There's a ranger station north of here that has a few ghouls running it. Maybe they'll take him in.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: He isn't showing any signs of going feral.
EN: [FAILED] Sorry, I can't take that risk.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: He isn't showing any signs of going feral.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well, maybe I can give him a chance.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: [FAILED] I'd rather not take the chance.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, I'll give him a shot.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Can I ask you something else?
EN: Sure.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Doesn't mean he isn't suffering, or that he won't go feral eventually.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: Nevermind, can I ask you something else?
EN: Sure.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: He is a ghoul in Camp Searchlight.
EN: If he's a ghoul he should be put down. I can't let a rabid dog suffer.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Mostly ghouls, and a handful of radscorps. I think some geckos moved in not too long ago.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: They seem to stick mostly to the south end of the camp.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Because it's a far safer place to be than here.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: What's so dangerous about this place?
EN: The whole area is irradiated and filled with mutated creatures.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: You're a mutant, too. Wouldn't the Nightkin listen to you?
EN: {Chuckles, player's being naive}That's like saying Caesar and Kimball would listen to each other. {Beat, explaining}Nightkin don't have a lot of trust for others, mutants included.

Speaker: Pearl
Topic_Name: There may be a battle in the near future at the Hoover Dam, can you offer any assistance?
EN: Of course my child. After all that you have done for us we would love to help you in the upcoming battle.

Speaker: Pearl
Topic_Name: There may be a battle in the near future at the Hoover Dam, can you offer any assistance?
EN: After all the training in virtual reality, the young ones would relish an opportunity to put their skills to battle. We'll be there when you need us.

Speaker: Pearl
Topic_Name: There may be a battle in the near future at the Hoover Dam, can you offer any assistance?
EN: We have our ears on the radio waves. When the fighting starts you can count on our air support.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: There may be a battle in the near future at the Hoover Dam, can you offer any assistance?
EN: Are you and your people still ready to help in the upcoming battle at Hoover Dam?

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
EN: Keeping watch, mostly. Trying to make sure the dangers of this plant are minimized.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: I'm working on some top secret shit I can't even tell you about, it's so mind-blowing.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: But here's a little taste. You know how you can only collect sunlight during the day? What if you could make it daytime all the time?

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: Crazy, right? Or is it? I'm gonna find somebody smart and ask him that question, see what he says. It'll be fucking intense.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: Shh. You feel that? That's the winds of change, baby, and Fantastic's riding them with his magic angel wings.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: They saw the shit I did for the NCR, how I carried them on my back, brought fire to the heathens. I wasn't gonna help them but they begged.

Speaker: Fantastic
EN: Well, somebody begged. Couldn't say who for sure. It's all a blur, you know? Chems, man. What a trip.

Speaker: Fantastic
Topic_Name: Is Ignacio dead over there? Did you kill him?
EN: Man, I don't even know. It's crazy.

Speaker: Decanus Severus
Topic_Name: Do you see much action against the NCR?
EN: As much as their cowardice will allow. The Profligates avoid open battle, but on good days we find one of their patrols.

Speaker: Decanus Severus
Topic_Name: Do you see much action against the NCR?
EN: Their landmines have caused us more trouble than their marksmanship - which is lacking.

Speaker: Decanus Severus
EN: I'm an officer of the Legion, of the rank {de-CAN-us}Decanus. When we encamped, I commanded a {con-too-BER-nee-um}contubernium of eight Legionaries.

Speaker: Decanus Severus
EN: So I command what's left. Under the wise leadership of {Ken-TOO-ree-on Aw-REL-ee-us}Centurion Aurelius, of course.

Speaker: Decanus Severus
EN: {irritated by player's stupidity}A Legion outpost. What's it look like?

Speaker: Decanus Severus

Speaker: Marcus

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar will kill me unless he believes I blew something up down here.
EN: Go ahead and destroy one. The explosion will be large enough to be heard and felt aboveground.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Nope, I'm going to blow it all up anyways.
EN: Then there will be no safe haven for you.{monitor goes dark}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm going to do as Caesar asks and blow everything up down here.
EN: Listen to me, very carefully. I've waited too long for this moment for you to go fouling it up on a lark.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm going to do as Caesar asks and blow everything up down here.
EN: Do as I say, and your rewards will be immense. Thwart me, and your punishment will become the purpose of my existence.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was that you said about security systems?
EN: The same equipment failure that prevents me from remotely operating this facility seems to have activated its security robots and turrets.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was that you said about security systems?
EN: There's a security room near the base of the stairs... perhaps you can deactivate them yourself.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What will you do with your Securitrons?
EN: My army will do what an army does best - defend territory from invaders... and maintain order.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: It is obvious to you that I built this place? The Platinum Chip opened it, after all?{sigh - the burdens of intelligence}

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: In any case, you're here. So let's get to it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I've spent too many years waiting for this moment to see it fumbled by an insubordinate contractor.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I can't reach through this monitor and compell you to follow instructions, but know this - if you disappoint me, you will pay for it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Goodbye? Is that some kind of joke? You barely understand what I want you to accomplish down there.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You're asking me to commit suicide. The Legion will attack me on sight.
EN: Then gather together the firepower or explosives or whatever else you need and improvise.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You're asking me to commit suicide. The Legion will attack me on sight.
EN: I don't care if you have to kill every Legionary at the Fort. Get the job done.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: That would make for a welcome change.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm not sure what happened to it.
EN: Are you a child? The Platinum Chip was taken from you, obviously.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Legion took it from me at the Fort.
EN: So what are you doing here? Return to the Fort at once.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Legion took it from me at the Fort.
EN: Recover the Platinum Chip. Once you've entered the bunker hidden beneath the weather station, you'll receive further instructions.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I like to think you have enough sense to do the right thing. The rewards for doing so are immense... as are the punishments for not doing so.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll upload the data, as you ask.
EN: Good. I won't hold you up any longer.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, you'll receive a nice bonus when the work is done. And speaking of getting it done...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: This work sounds important - and expensive.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: [FAILED] You signed a contract to deliver the Platinum Chip, and you'll be paid when the delivery is made.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: I could use a raise!

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Maybe I should destroy everything down here.
EN: {steely}I don't respond well to threats. {moving on}Now, where were we...?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar wants me to destroy this place.
EN: Was that meant to be a shocking revelation? Of course Caesar wants it destroyed - he's afraid of what the bunker might hold, and rightly so.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar wants me to destroy this place.
EN: But you're not going to do that. You're going to do the smart thing, and work for me.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: It's a facility I built many years before you were born. You might think of it as a barracks. You'll understand soon enough.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {impatient to make progress}It's a facility I built many years before you were born. You might think of it as a kind of barracks. You'll understand soon enough.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {don't play dumb}Surely you know that I am Robert Edwin House, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the New Vegas Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I oversaw the city's renovations starting from 2274 onward. The Three Families are my employees.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You wanted me to come down here?
EN: {are you dense?}That's rather obvious, isn't it?

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [sigh of impatience - oh, the burden of intelligence]
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: {sigh of impatience - oh, the burden of intelligence}The Platinum Chip unlocks this bunker. Hence, you have it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: Hence, Benny was captured or killed - possibly by you, but by my estimates, far more probably by Caesar's Legion. Hence, Caesar gave you the Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: Hence, Caesar wants you to destroy whatever you find in this bunker.

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [sigh of impatience - oh, the burdens of intelligence]
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: {sigh of impatience - oh, the burdens of intelligence}That you were searched very thoroughly when you arrived at the Fort is a certainty. And as the Chip is a little too large to be {beat, implying hiding it up rectum}secreted away...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: I also regard it a certainty that the Chip was discovered, taken from you, and given to Caesar - who returned it to you.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: Two plus two equaling four, Caesar wants you to destroy whatever you find in this bunker.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: But that's not going to happen, because {confident, not bossy}you're going to work for me.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: You're the only one who can make this decision.
EN: Not even a hint, huh? Geez, I really am all alone on this one.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: You're the only one who can make this decision.
EN: I guess I'll stay. If I left there wouldn't be any coming back. It might be something I'd instantly regret.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: You're the only one who can make this decision.
EN: Things are going to get harder for the Brotherhood before they get easier. I should support them in whatever way I can.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Leaving now is your only shot at a future.
EN: There's no getting around that, is there? What would my life be like here, knowing what's to come?

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Leaving now is your only shot at a future.
EN: They're not going to like this. We're given a chance when we're young to choose whether to stay. If we do, it's supposed to be for life.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Leaving now is your only shot at a future.
EN: But they haven't left me any choice. It's this or a lifetime of scavenging and watching my friends die in losing battles. {beat}I guess it's settled, then.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: They may be a bunch of wooden conformists, but anything I did without them would feel... empty.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: I'd always be reminded of this day. How I wasn't strong enough to stand by them.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: So I guess I'll stay. Won't be easy, but at least I won't feel guilty about the choice.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: Let's get going. I'd like to get my mind off all this. And some fresh air would do me some good right about now.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Ha! Well that's... imaginative. But it's not really for me.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I couldn't get one of their most reasonable members to accept a rational argument. I don't see them coming out in droves to support my coup.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: And that's really not what the Brotherhood needs right now anyway. They're hanging by a thread.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I... {beat}I don't know if I can stay. Maybe it'd be better for everyone if I left. Spent my life... somewhere else.

Speaker: Veronica
ActorNotes: This'd be a big deal for her. First sentence is a revelation.
EN: Work with the Followers of the Apocalypse, maybe. Put my knowledge to some good use.

Speaker: Veronica
ActorNotes: Offhand, Not with a lot of hope
EN: Or I can stay here with the people I care about and do... whatever I can, until it comes to a slow or sudden end.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Would someone else listen to you?
EN: It wouldn't matter. The Elder has final say.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Would someone else listen to you?
EN: The hell of it is he's one of our most progressive members. If I can't get him to agree, it's hopeless.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Would someone else listen to you?
EN: He won't tolerate any resistance. If he catches wind I've been talking to people, he'll charge me with sedition.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Well I {emph}knew he wouldn't listen to {slight emph}me. That's why we went out of our way to find something that he couldn't ignore.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: But it didn't make any difference.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: How can I help them when they won't accept it?

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Maybe if we make a stronger case, he'll change his mind.
EN: No. Our case wouldn't be any stronger if tomorrow they all died when their energy weapons backfired.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Maybe if we make a stronger case, he'll change his mind.
EN: I just didn't expect that. There was no getting through to him.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: There was never any chance. His mind was made up from the start.
EN: I see that now. I thought I knew him better than that. But it was like talking to a stranger.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: What does the Codex say?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: {Losing patience}The Codex is clear on this. It's-

Speaker: Veronica
EN: A bunch of closed-minded bullshit.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We do not help them, or let them in.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It says they can't be trusted.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: But-

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We keep knowledge they must never have.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It says that we are to protect humanity from them at all costs.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Give it a chance. For me. I can't stay here and watch us waste away.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: I'm sorry.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I can't.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Softly, a last-ditch argument}We'll die out.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Sadly}<Sighs> I know.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: {Slightly Sad}Then we will accept that fate with honor.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Come on. I can't listen to this anymore.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We unlocked the secret of HELIOS One.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: What? Wonderful news!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Then we have a game-changing weapon.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: No. It's not. ARCHIMEDES II is an orbital laser. Effective only outdoors in a limited radius and requiring a long recharge.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In the hands of the enemy-

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It was worth keeping from our enemies. If they had it-

Speaker: Veronica
EN: They'd be marginally more effective. We lost most of the chapter defending glorified artillery.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We couldn't have known. We fought for what we believed in.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: We did as the Codex dictated.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: And nearly died for it. Tomorrow you'd do it all over again, having learned nothing.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Are you trying to shame me?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: {Fuming}How dare you insult the honor of the brothers and sisters who died there!

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I'm trying to open your eyes.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We need to engage the outside world. We can't win without new recruits.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We found a gun that disables power armor. One of these could defeat the whole Brotherhood.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We have to stop limiting our focus to military technology. It won't save us.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: That could be the only one of its kind.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Then it's a good thing this weapon has fallen into the right hands.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: That's not the point. Technology won't win our wars. We need numbers. New recruits.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: This disk has secrets to breeding plants that can thrive in the wasteland.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: High Elder Maxson didn't found us to be botanists, Veronica.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I'm waiting to hear why this deserves our attention.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Think about it. No more trading guns for food. Total self-sufficiency. It's what we always wanted.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: This won't get us Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: This won't defeat our enemies.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {argumentative}Yes it will. If we feed people, they'll support us. They'll join us.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Veronica. I hope-

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Shouldn't you be securing supplies for us?

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I brought you a present.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: My friend is part of a group that can develop it into something safe everyone can benefit from.
EN: I suppose you've given me no reason not to trust you. Fine, take the data and go. I hope you know what you're doing.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
EN: That's the PHOENIX Monocyte Breeder. The implant speeds up cell regeneration, an effect similar to that of some lizards and sea creatures.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
EN: The implant is very expensive, however - 12,000 caps.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I'm interested in the sub-dermal implant.
EN: That would be the NEMEAN Sub-Dermal Armor. It's a bit pricey - 8,000 caps - but the implant causes your skin cells to be bolstered with iron.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I'm interested in the sub-dermal implant.
EN: It won't make you bulletproof, but it will make you a little harder to injure.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
EN: {Charisma 10}You're already quite charming. The Empathy Synthesizer would just be a waste of caps, I'm afraid.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
EN: The Empathy Synthesizer will allow you to more easily pick up on subtle emotions and body language. The price is 4,000 caps.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: One other thing I forgot to mention - your body may be able to handle only a limited number of implants.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: The healthier you are, the more implants I'll be able give you. Now, what surgery are you considering?

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: {no implants}Which surgery option are you considering?

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: {max implants}There aren't any more implants I can give you - you've already bought everything I had available.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
ActorNotes: [at least one implant, not at limit]
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: {at least one implant, not at limit}All right, let me do a quick test to make sure your body can handle another implant...

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: All right, you're healthy enough to handle another one. Which surgery are you considering?

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: {at least one implant, at limit}All right, let me do a quick test to make sure your body can handle another implant...

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
Topic_Name: I want to buy an implant.
EN: I'm afraid you can't handle any more implants right now. Your body isn't durable enough to take it. Sorry.

Speaker: Miguel
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold to you?
EN: Antique rangefinder? I'm trying to think of something that'd be more worthless.

Speaker: Miguel
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold to you?
EN: Maybe an antique horoscope. Or an antique sandwich.

Speaker: Miguel
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold to you?
EN: I'll tell you something. Good luck finding that thing. But if you do find it, don't waste your time trying to sell it to me.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
EN: Very well.

Speaker: Doctor Usanagi
EN: Have a seat in the Auto-Doc. This will take a few hours.

Speaker: Regis
ActorNotes: [Uncertain, thinks this is probably a suicide attack]
Topic_Name: We fight for ourselves. Bring our warriors to the battle and kill everyone.
EN: {Uncertain, thinks this is probably a suicide attack}As you wish, chieftain.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: I'm giving leadership to you. I want you to take the tribe north, and find yourselves a new life.
EN: {Surprised, didn't expect this}I... very well. If that's what you want, that's what we'll do.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: I'm giving leadership to you. I want you to take the tribe north, and find yourselves a new life.
EN: I'll start the preparations and we'll leave when the NCR is distracted by Caesar's attack.

Speaker: Regis
EN: As you wish. When the Republic goes to war, we go with it.

Speaker: Regis
EN: As you wish. When Caesar goes to war, we go with him.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: I don't want that kind of responsibility.
EN: Then when I die, you can pass control of the Great Khans on to Regis. For now you are my heir, and will be accorded the honor of that position.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: This is a great honor. I don't know what to say.
EN: You don't have to say anything - I am Papa Khan, and I have spoken. When I'm gone, you will lead the tribe.

Speaker: Great Khan
EN: That's too bad. I hope you'll change your mind.

Speaker: Great Khan
Topic_Name: Okay, I'll go visit him as soon as I can.
EN: Excellent. I'll let him know you're coming. Good luck out there.

Speaker: Great Khan
EN: He didn't say, but it sounded very important.

Speaker: Great Khan
EN: I've got a message for you from Papa Khan. He wants you to return to Red Rock Canyon and speak to him as soon as possible.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: The Followers have agreed to take you on as a member. Head to the Old Mormon Fort.
EN: They did? That's great! Thank you! I'm out of this crummy camp!

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: Ah. Well... I suppose we could always find him a place. Maybe doing inventory on the Pre-War Unexploded Munitions Collection back West.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: All right, tell the boy to report here, he can leave on the next caravan.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: He's obviously a bright, sensitive soul, and he loves literature.
EN: Excellent! Ezekiel's been after me to find him a new assistant for ages. Tell the boy we'll take him.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Well, he's a poet. Kind of.
EN: Hmm. Well, I suppose we could always use another junior archivist in the library. All right, tell him we'll accept him as a probationary initiate.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: I met a kid who's unsatisfied with life in the Great Khans. Will you take him on as a Follower?
EN: We're always looking for new members. Does he have any particular talent?

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: Not much. They found us when we came to the Mojave, gave us a bunch of books on science and history - I guess they're like teachers or something?

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: That's not really my problem, is it?
EN: No, I suppose not.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: Probably. You seem like their type.
EN: You think so? I mean, I'd go myself, but what if they said no? The Khans wouldn't take me back, and then I'd have nobody.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: Why don't you go there and find out?
EN: I don't know. I mean, I'd go myself, but what if they said no? The Khans wouldn't take me back, and then I'd have nobody.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I could ask them for you.
EN: You'd do that? Thanks! I mean, I'd go myself, but what if they said no? The Khans wouldn't take me back, and then I'd have nobody.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
EN: Have you seen this tribe? If it's not an epic drunken ballad of cracking skulls and hearing lamentations they think it's a waste of time.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I had some other questions, actually.
EN: Sure, okay.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: You don't sound too eager for your initiation.
EN: Yeah, well, I guess maybe I'm not. But what else can I do?

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: It sounded like you were writing poetry.
EN: Oh. You heard that, huh? Okay, so yeah, I was writing poetry. I know, I know, it's not a very Great Khan-like thing to do.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: It sounded like you were writing poetry.
EN: The Followers of the Apocalypse came to our camp when I was a kid, and they brought a bunch of old books. I used to read pre-War poetry for hours.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: You would? Really? Okay, well then, here goes:

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: This one's a haiku.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: {Clear throat, begin reciting}Radscorpion bites,

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: my foot in the box canyon.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: Ow, ow, ow, ow... ow.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: {Clear throat, begin reciting}I wrote this limerick the last time I went to Freeside.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: There once was a fellow called Garret,

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: whose sister she did love to bare it.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: She flashed it around, all over town,

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: so if you would screw her, beware it.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: {back to normal speaking}I, uh, got kicked out of the Atomic Wrangler for that one.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: This is a poem I wrote about the dark loneliness that suffuses my soul.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: {Clear throat, begin reciting}Rainclouds wrap my heart in sorrow black as silk,

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: My empty scream does not echo, even though we're in a canyon.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: My soul aches, but not as much as my limbs, because I've been beaten severely.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: Here's one about the girl I love.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: {Clear throat, begin reciting}Her hair stands tall, like the spiky bits on a Deathclaw.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: Her eyes are bright as radioactive sludge, glowing with the light of love.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: But when I talk to her, she laughs and mocks and has her brothers beat me.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: Oh, why do nice girls hate me?

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear some of your poetry.
EN: That's it. What do you think?

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: What do you think about the Khans' alliance with Caesar?
EN: Huh? Wait, what are you talking about? We're allied with Caesar now? Psh. Typical. Nobody tells me anything.

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: I can tell you they're a bunch of big dumb jerks with no appreciation for art. I mean, can you believe their initiation?

Speaker: Jerry the Punk
EN: Oh, nothing really. Just trying to psych myself up to try my initiation. Again. {Totally unconvincing roar}Raaaar!

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Oh he was pretty average, I'd say. Average height, average age. Dark hair. Beard of some kind.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: I said I didn't know about anything like that around here. But if he wanted to live for free, a lot of people do that in Freeside.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: I know there's a concrete building there across from Mick and Ralph's. No ceiling, but I think it still counts.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Went up there one time to try and... you know... meet my neighbors in the biz. But you know, I don't think they took me very seriously.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Did you happen to find out where he was from?
EN: No, but I know where he was going. He asked me if I knew of any place where he could hide out for a while.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Did you happen to find out where he was from?
EN: Wanted somewhere with concrete walls. Something about airwaves. I forget.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Did you happen to find out where he was from?
EN: But I guess he spent all his money on the rangefinder, because he said it had to be somewhere free to stay.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Well it was metal, and kind of thick. At first I thought he'd come from Gomorrah, but they're more into leather there.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: Didn't look comfortable. He kept reaching up like he was gonna itch it, but he always stopped himself.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you.
EN: Wow, I wish I had more of them. All this interest. It'd be my biggest seller.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you.
EN: I sold it to a man not too long ago. Real twitchy, nervous sort of guy. Kinda seemed like he was wiggin' out about something.

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you.
EN: Had a funny collar on. I wanted to ask him about it but I figured maybe I'd regret asking. People are weird around here.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: {anxious}I don't know. Some kind of man-fish freak like the one I killed over there.

Speaker: Private Halford
EN: I'd heard fishermen spin old tales of 'Lakelurks' swimming in the water, but I always thought they were just bullshit mermaid stories.
