Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: It was a place of splendor. As magnificent as today's Strip may seem, it's but a shadow of the neon paradise that was Las Vegas.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I grew up not far from here, and though I traveled the old world extensively, I never found another place like it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: By 2065 I deemed it a mathematical certainty that an atomic war would devastate the Earth within 15 years. Every projection I ran confirmed it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I knew I couldn't "save the world," nor did I care to. But I could save Vegas, and in the process, perhaps, save mankind.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I set to work immediately. I thought I had plenty of time to prepare. As it turned out, I was 20 hours short.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: You say that you saved Las Vegas. How?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: On the day of the Great War, 77 atomic warheads targeted Las Vegas and its surrounding areas.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: My networked mainframes were able to predict and force-transmit disarm code subsets to 59 warheads, neutralizing them before impact.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Laser cannons mounted on the roof of the Lucky 38 destroyed another 9 warheads. The rest got through, though none hit the city itself.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: A sub-optimal performance, admittedly. If only the Platinum Chip had arrived a day sooner...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: What preparations did you make to save Las Vegas?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: The Platinum Chip was printed in Sunnyvale, California on October 22nd, 2077 - the day before the Great War.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: It was to have been delivered by courier the following afternoon... but by then, the world had ended.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: The Chip contained vital software upgrades, but not just for my Securitrons. Every aspect of the missile defense grid would have been upgraded, too.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Given that I had to make do with buggy software, the outcome could have been worse. I nearly died as it was.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Why didn't the Platinum Chip arrive on time?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Software glitches set off a cascade of system crashes. I had to take the Lucky 38's reactor offline, lest it melt down.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: For nearly five years I battled power outages and more system crashes until I finally managed to reboot my data core with an older version of the OS.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I spent the next few decades in a veritable coma. But I survived, obviously - and eventually thrived.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: How did you nearly die, defending Vegas?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Not interested? {louder}Not interested?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You have an interest in this even if you're too stupid to know it. If you have an interest in breathing, you have an interest in this.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Return to the Fort and do whatever it takes to recover the Chip.

Topic_Name: Maybe we can make a deal. What do you want from the Crimson Caravan in exchange for quitting?

Topic_Name: I want to know more about the problem with Henry Jamison.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: I care because he is a known quantity - not the man so much as the political context he inhabits.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: Kimball rose to prominence as the "Hero of the Mojave" when he led a campaign of reprisals against tribals who dared to attack NCR citizens.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: Ordering the occupation of Hoover Dam was his first act of office. As water and electricity flowed to NCR cities, his popularity soared.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: Conversely, his failure to annex the Mojave these seven years, and the immense costs of occupying a foreign land, have eroded his popular support.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: {Oh, the burdens of intelligence}Kimball's entire political career is inextricably bound up with the NCR's occupation of the Mojave. It's his war.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: If I compell the NCR to retreat, Kimball will be the sacrifice offered to the gods, so decent NCR citizens can get on with their lives.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: In retrospect, the Mojave and Hoover Dam will seem like one man's misadventure. Kimball will be blamed, not me. Not New Vegas.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: So why don't you want the NCR President to die?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: Then the Hero of the Mojave would become the Martyr of Hoover Dam. And when, subsequently, I force the NCR to retreat...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: They lick their wounds, and dream of righteous vengeance against New Vegas. Hello, embargo, farewell, tourist economy.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: I've calculated and re-calculated these probabilities. Kimball must live.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why do you care whether Kimball lives or dies?
EN: And if Kimball were to be assassinated?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.
EN: Because they're ridiculous! Because they galavant around the Mojave pretending to be Knights of Yore.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.
EN: Or did, until the NCR showed them that ideological purity and shiny power armor don't count for much when you're outnumbered 15:1.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.
EN: The world has no use for emotionally unstable techno-fetishists. Just wipe them out, will you?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel.
EN: Why do you hate the Brotherhood so much?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: Yes, though at the time they called themselves the "Slither Kin." A vicious clan, not that that's changed, exactly.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: They were nomads, capable fighters, but their specialty was betrayal. They'd invite travelers into their yurts, drug them, murder or enslave them.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: They took pride in their craft. I don't think Omertas saw other people as people at all. Everyone else was just... prey.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: They reminded me of a certain criminal element Vegas used to attract. I told them some stories, gave them some clothes - and they ran with it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: The Chairmen, as we know them now, went by the unfortunate appellation of the "Mojave Boot-Riders." They were nomads, too.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: As for the White Glove Society, I afraid I'm contractually obligated not to reveal their original name.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You recruited the Omertas as one of the Three Families?
EN: What were the original names of the other tribes?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: They occupied Nellis Air Force Base a little over 50 years ago. One of my Securitrons got some video of their arrival - and then... exploded.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Odds are they were Vault dwellers. That's everything I know about them, really.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Only if you come within a mile or so of them.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Given their history of extreme isolationism, it's tempting to leave them be. But those howitzers of theirs...

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: The Boomers sound dangerous.

Topic_Name: Try to throw me out and you'll be leaving - in pieces.
EN: {Terrified}Jesus Christ!

Speaker: The Tops Floor Manager
Topic_Name: Fuck off, creep, I'm not going anywhere.
EN: Fine, then, you want to play rough? We'll play rough!

Speaker: The Tops Floor Manager
Topic_Name: Sure, okay, I'm out of here.
EN: Smart move, kid. We're happy to have you come on in and spend some dough at the bar, take in a show, whatever - but you're cut off from the games.

Speaker: The Tops Floor Manager
EN: Let's be straight, baby: there's lucky and there's *too* lucky. You keep up like this and you're gonna break the bank.

Speaker: The Tops Floor Manager
EN: Now, we're happy to have you come on in and spend some dough at the bar, take in a show, whatever - but you're cut off from the games.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
Topic_Name: I have a dog tag for you.
EN: Thank you, every tag you bring me is one more soldier at peace.

Speaker: The Tops Floor Manager
EN: You've taken us for a ride, and we want you out.

Speaker: The Tops Floor Manager
EN: You're free to enjoy the shows and the bar, but no more games for you at The Tops. Thanks for playing.

Speaker: Comm Officer Tilden
Topic_Name: What was that about the surplus ammo?
EN: We keep getting deliveries of ammunition for some reason. I don't mind target practice, but there isn't all that much to shoot at out here.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: Ranger Station Charlie. We're responsible for keeping the highway up through Novac civilized.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: Radio signal out here can be pretty spotty because of all the hills. Sometimes our scheduled updates don't go through.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: When it happens enough times, they send someone over to check up on us. Lately, we've been getting extra medical supplies for some reason.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: I'm in no rush to give the supplies back, either.

Speaker: Ranger Kudlow
EN: Yeah, it's a damn shame. There was a lot of talk about expelling her from the Rangers, especially once the gambling and drinking started.

Speaker: Ranger Kudlow
EN: Being posted here is her second and last chance, and so far, I'm not impressed. Lenk's jumpy all the time, and the others are sick of it.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: Pathetic. The Rangers should never have let you become one in the first place.
EN: {mournful}I... I was different back then.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: Interesting. Let's move on to something else.
EN: {relieved}Yeah.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: You were too tough to kill, and you'll get payback on the Legion some day.
EN: Maybe. But, thanks for saying it, anyway.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: [SUCCEEDED] We were on patrol near the Dam when a Legion raiding party jumped us. Didn't even have to time to radio it in.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: I was hit in the head with a machete and knocked out. Didn't kill me, though some nights I wish it had. When I woke up, my nerve was gone.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: The rest of my squad was crucified, butchered, mutilated. I don't know how they missed me. Maybe they didn't. Maybe they knew they'd broken me.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: I gambled and drank a lot after that. Got into trouble, but the Rangers gave me a second chance instead of kicking me out. So, here I am.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: If you don't tell me, someone else will. I'd rather hear your version.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: [FAILED] No, I'm not going to bring it up.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You sure? I'd love to hear that story.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: Fine. Let's talk about something else.
EN: Yes.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: I thought NCR Rangers were supposed to be tough and fearless.
EN: I... don't want to talk about it.

Speaker: Ranger Kudlow
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Great Khans?
EN: Tough, independent, and as ruthless as they come. They're holed up in Red Rock Canyon, and it's this station's job to keep an eye on them.

Speaker: Ranger Kudlow
Topic_Name: I need to confirm your report about Great Khans with trained Deathclaws.
EN: You must be mistaken - I haven't filed any report like that. Trained deathclaws? I would have remembered that.

Speaker: Ranger Kudlow
Topic_Name: I need to confirm your report about Great Khans with trained Deathclaws.
EN: If someone is saying I filed that report, that's a load of crap. I won't have my name attached to a clerical error.

Speaker: Ranger Kudlow
EN: Be careful out there.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: What happened between you and the Omertas?
EN: I talked to the cashier at Gomorrah into forwarding me some chips - I was convinced I was due for a hot streak.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: What happened between you and the Omertas?
EN: It, uh, didn't go so well. The Omertas were nice and said they'd give me some time to pay them back.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: What happened between you and the Omertas?
EN: They also said if they had to talk to me about my debt again, they wouldn't be nice the next time.

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm here because of your debt to the Omertas. Pay me what you've got and you'll get more time.
EN: Here's all the caps I've saved up so far. See? That's a pretty good chunk of what I owe right there!

Speaker: Comm Officer Lenk
EN: Watch out for Great Khans.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
Topic_Name: Mind if I take some of those extra medical supplies?
EN: {NCR - Devil}Something tells me this isn't the first time you've done things that the NCR would find... objectionable.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
Topic_Name: Mind if I take some of those extra medical supplies?
EN: Here, take some of these. And don't tell anyone where you got them.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
Topic_Name: Mind if I take some of those extra medical supplies?
EN: {NCR - not Devil}I shouldn't have said anything in the first place, and I'd rather not get you into the habit of crossing the NCR.

Speaker: Ranger Erasmus
Topic_Name: Has there been much fighting around here?
EN: Skirmishes, mostly. The Legion raiding parties usually fall back when they know it's us they're up against.

Speaker: Ranger Erasmus
EN: The Legion's been sending raiding parties across the river in larger numbers lately. We don't have the men at this post to intercept them all.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I'm still working on the Boomers.
EN: I expect results sooner rather than later.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way.
EN: Oh, I'll give you the Platinum Chip. And then you'll use it exactly like I tell you to.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {putting player in his/her place}You should be listening, that's what you should be doing.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {keeping player in his/her place}That's right, you should be going - because you have work to do.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
EN: Benny is my prisoner. You don't "deal with him" unless you've dealt with me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
EN: {I can read your mind}Don't worry, you'll get the Platinum Chip he was carrying. And then you'll use it like I tell you to.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I won't fight for the Legion.
EN: What did you just say?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: What else, then?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
EN: That's right. Under normal circumstances, the reason it wouldn't happen again is that you'd be crucified - or worse.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
EN: Only in light of the extraordinary service you've rendered unto me am I going to overlook this failure.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
EN: Bear in mind how much you have to make up for, how much you have to prove yourself in your next task...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Understand this. From this moment forward, any other crimes will be punished by death. No exceptions.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: I will have you hacked into pieces by my Praetorians - for my amusement. Understand?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Now getting back to business...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I defused the bomb on the monorail.
EN: Do you have any idea how much effort it took to place a mole at Camp McCarran? What else have you done?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The Legionaries at Nelson attacked me, so I had to fight back...
EN: And so you wiped out the garrison I placed at Nelson? That strategically vital garrison? {beat}What else?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I may have disrupted plans to recruit the Great Khans to your cause.
EN: Weeks of effort to convince those miserable Khans to join the Legion - ruined. Any other crimes?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I killed the Omertas who were scheming to attack the Strip.
EN: Months spent feeding the Omertas bribes, nursing their betrayal - all for nothing. Any other crimes?

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [what the fuck are you doing talking to me, then?]
Topic_Name: I'm still working on the White Glove Society.
EN: {what the fuck are you doing talking to me, then?}Then get to it.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: There's no way the White Glove Society will be cannibals again - I've already seen to that.
EN: You've been resourceful in the past. Why are you a failure now?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: There's no way the White Glove Society will be cannibals again - I've already seen to that.
EN: You'd best step up your performance with this next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society has agreed to an alliance with Caesar's Legion.
EN: {satisfied}Good. It will be valuable to have allies on the Strip when Hoover Dam is taken. {beat}Now, as for your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The cannibals among the White Glove Society are dead.
EN: They'll be of no use to the Legion, then.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The cannibals among the White Glove Society are dead.
EN: You squandered a potentially valuable resource. {direct}Do better with your next assignment or there will be trouble...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society won't listen to me - I've caused them too much trouble.
EN: So what you're telling me is, you're useless. You have no ability to influence events, so I'm forced to work around your incompetence.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society won't listen to me - I've caused them too much trouble.
EN: Try to do better with your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The Boomers hate me. They'll never follow my lead.
EN: {irritated - the solution is obvious}Then you'll have to be extraordinarily persuasive. Or kill them - their leaders, at least.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The Boomers hate me. They'll never follow my lead.
EN: Get to it, will you? You're wasting my time.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say.
EN: Good. Make sure they help the Legion when the time comes. As for your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I had to wipe out the Boomers' leaders.
EN: A perfectly satisfactory way of resolving the threat they posed. It's impressive that you made it through their barrage.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I had to wipe out the Boomers' leaders.
EN: Now, as for your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Mark my words, you piece of shit. This is the last time you will ever refuse to perform an order I've given you.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: If you meant what you said, you best be on your way, and at good speed. And forget all that I could have given you.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: If you ever - ever - disobey me again, I will order my Praetorians to hack you to death with their machetes for my entertainment.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: I warned you about the price of disobedience. I guess you weren't listening.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Praetorians! Kill this nuisance!

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why must Mr. House be killed?
EN: Because he complicates the equation of force. He's a free agent, an unpredictable element.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why must Mr. House be killed?
EN: I'm sure he's trying to sit out this battle, just as he did four years ago, hoping the Legion and Profligates will wipe each other out.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why must Mr. House be killed?
EN: When he sees the Profligates losing this battle, however, he might throw his support behind them. Except he won't, because he'll be dead.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What should I expect at the dam?
EN: {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius will be waiting for you. Your arrival will signal to him that it's time to launch the attack.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What should I expect at the dam?
EN: As for what to expect, it's going to be the greatest battle - and victory - mankind has seen since it almost wiped itself off the face of this Earth.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What should I expect at the dam?
EN: Tactically, it's simple - kill and kill some more. I may have a few surprises in store for the NCR, but that won't concern you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: My Praetorians embody the martial ideals of my Legion. Each one of them has done enough conquering and killing to deserve the rank of {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: Instead, I invited them to join my guard. So the invitee chooses whichever current guard he thinks is weakest - and challenges him.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: The fight is to the death. It keeps them from getting complacent.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: Lucius has been the head of my guard for five years now. He was a subordinate guard for eight before that.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: No invitee has dared to challenge him yet. Maybe it's an issue of respect - he is getting on in years.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: How long has Lucius been the head of your Praetorians?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {WUHL-pace}Vulpes is the best of my {Froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii. A remarkable individual from an unremarkable tribe south of the Utah.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: He was brought into the Legion as a boy, survived training, fought well enough as Legionary to be promoted to the rank of {deh-CAN-us}Decanus.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Then, in battle against an {dismissive}unimportant tribe, he broke ranks and led his {con-too-BUR-nee-um - a Roman squad}contubernium through a hole in their defenses to capture its chieftain.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {amused}Well, his {ken-too-REE-on}Centurion wanted him crucified for disobedience. So I made him a {froo-men-TAR-eye}Frumentari.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Whatever I require. Infiltration, assassination, dramatic atrocities to break the spirit of the enemy - {souless, matter of fact}et {KEH-tur-ah}cetera.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: They're mentally flexible. They operate behind enemy lines for extended periods, imitating the enemy's customs without becoming {slight beat}sullied.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: In all these things, {WUHL-pace}Vulpes is a master.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: What do the Frumentarii do?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is the greatest of my battlefield commanders. Some might call him a great man, but I'm not sure he qualifies.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: Once, he was the greatest warrior of the Hidebarks, a tribe of the Arizona. Maniacal in battle. Sometimes he'd ambush Legion patrols {emphasis}by himself.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: When, after several {emphasis, usually campaigns are faster}months we found and surrounded the Hidebarks' camp, their Chieftain raised a banner of surrender.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: The warrior who was not yet {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius went insane with rage. {a pleasing memory}He struck down his Chieftain and attacked his own tribe.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He killed fifteen before they brought him down. He didn't die, obviously.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: I had him tended to. He was {beat}maimed, most of face torn off. It was days before he regained consciousness.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: When he did, I went to his bedside and showed him the helmet I'd had forged to cover his face. I said he could have it if he'd fight for me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He accepted... on condition that he be allowed to kill the surviving males of his tribe. {chuckle}I said, make it the {emph}adult males and you have a deal.{Children are malleable and thus valuable to the Legion.}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: What happened when Lanius attacked his own tribe?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is savage. Savagely loyal, too, but only to me - he has no love for my Legion. But this has its uses.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He has no attachment to his men, no compunction about battlefield losses. All he cares about is destroying the enemy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: When another legatus or a {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion fails to achieve results, I send {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to make things right.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: His first step is to beat the failed commander to death in front of his assembled troops. Then he orders the ritual of {deck-ih-MAH-tee-oh}decimatio.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He sounds more like a savage than a general.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: It means "decimation," but in ancient Rome the word had a very specific meaning - a punishment for cowardice.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: The Legionaries are lined up in ranks. Every tenth man steps forward and is beaten to death by his brothers.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: It instills a certain... robust obedience.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: What is "decimatio?"

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: {Lan-ee-OOS}Yes. This time my Legionaries will be more frightened of the commander behind them than the enemy before them.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: There will be no failure this time, no retreat, no years of gathering slaves and resources for another assault.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: With {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to drive the Legion forward, the dam will be taken. It will be our {slight beat}bridgehead across the Colorado.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: Lanius will lead the assault on Hoover Dam?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: It's not going to happen again. That's all I have to say about it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: Why did the Legion lose the first battle?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: And I've heard it's a bad idea to tempt the wrath of {KAI-zar}Caesar. Change the subject.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: I've heard the commander of the first battle called "The Burned Man."

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: A man of potential, held back by the {slight beat}craven political context he inhabits. You realize he was a general? "The Hero of the Mojave," they called him.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: A title he earned by extirpating lesser tribes that dared attack NCR citizens. His responses were {approving}swift and draconian.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: President Tandi, the "founding mother," coddled hostile tribes... but her successors were less naive, so they gave Kimball free rein.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: And after a respectable military career, what does he do? Become a {distaste}politician.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: But he did so by {disapproving}election. What better way to stunt the growth of leaders, not to mention whole cultures?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: A leader shouldn't have to kowtow to those who serve him. With so much energy wasted on those below, how is he ever to move forward?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: Had he taken the government by force, used his army to stage a coup, things would be very different.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: I'll just have to do it for him.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: Isn't it natural for someone like Kimball to seek greater power?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: It'll frighten them. If I can reach out and kill whomever I choose, then they know the only reason they're alive is I haven't tried yet.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: You have to understand that Kimball is a symbol. Without him, there would be no NCR occupation of the Mojave.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: He mustered the troops - {distaste}as many as his senate would allow - and sent them in. All the right reasons, done all the wrong ways.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: Any invasion by a democracy is a half-measure. When Kimball dies, the NCR will {emphasis}recoil from the Mojave, and from his legacy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: By the time they recover and try to strike back, I'll be invading them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: How will the NCR react to Kimball's death? Won't it just anger them?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: The worst impulses of mankind, concentrated in one insane, backward tribe.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: The Brotherhood seems to have formed not long after the great atomic war. It's hard to know - they care little for history.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: Some of the Brotherhood scribes we captured further East didn't even know the name of their founder, Roger Maxson.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: They like to pretty up their mission with trappings of chivalry, but the truth is they're horders. They horde technology.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: It's been 200 years, and they still have the mentality of scavengers. They say they're preserving these technologies, but for what?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: They have no vision. They offer no future. They're a dead end.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: You don't think very far ahead, do you?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: Sure, their hatred of the NCR would seem to qualify them for use as proxies. But then what do you do with them? Each paladin is quite powerful.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: I'd have to be convinced that present benefits outweighed future costs.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: Couldn't you use the Brotherhood to your advantage?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: The Boomers settled at the old air base northeast of Vegas many years ago. No one knows exactly how long it's been.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: It may be that no one's traded with them or even spoken to them that entire time. If so, they're sitting on one hell of a stockpile of ammunition...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: My scouts have seen people moving around the base. The perimeter is guarded, with spotters in towers directing the artillery fire.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: They must have extraordinary vision. Some of my scouts were targeted at extreme distances.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: So no, I can't tell you what to expect inside the base. No one's been inside it, except them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Don't you know anything about their society?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: You don't get it, do you? The weapons I wield are forged from blood, flesh, sinew, bone - mortal stuff. Fragile, even.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: And yet my Legion obeys me, even unto death. Why? Because they live to serve the greater good, and they know of no alternatives.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: House's machines, his technologies - what do they propose? The possibility of victory without sacrifice. No blood spilled, just... rivets.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: That's not an idea to be put in circulation. If mankind's going to survive this moment in history, it needs warriors, not {contempt}gadgets.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Maybe Benny could do this for you.
EN: I wouldn't trust Benny to lick my boots clean. This one falls to you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Can't your Legionaries take care of this?
EN: Yes. But then I'd have to kill them.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: Benny's theory, if I understood it through all the screaming, was that Mr. House stashed some kind of ultimate weapon down there.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: A gigantic robot to stomp us all to death, who cares? Whatever it is, House built it, so I want it destroyed.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: I don't know. And I don't like not knowing.

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [there's an alternate take with "couldn't" instead of "can't"]
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: {there's an alternate take with "couldn't" instead of "can't"}I know Mr. House built it. I'm thinking it's probably some kind of weapon that he can't activate from a distance.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How do you know so much about me?
EN: I have eyes and ears everywhere. {kind of obvious}It behooves me not to invade the west blind and deaf.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How do you know so much about me?
EN: It hasn't been hard to track your progress. It's not as though you've been keeping a low profile.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What were you looking to start?
EN: The time is fast approaching when my Legion will assault the great dam and invade the west.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What were you looking to start?
EN: Before that happens, I want Mr. House knocked out of the game, a quick one-two punch - with you doing the punching.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What were you looking to start?
EN: Before that happens, I want Mr. House erased from the picture. Not just the man you killed, but what he left behind. His legacy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How may I serve your Legion, Caesar?
EN: {pleased}I like the servile attitude. Keep it up.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: You spread word of the massacre of Nipton, just like {WUHL-pace}Vulpes asked you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: Beams of light shot down from the sky over HELIOS One, killing who knows how many Profligate troops.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: Silus, the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion who let himself get captured, died at McCarran before he could reveal sensitive information.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: You freed the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion Silus from McCarran so that he might be punished for his cowardice.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: The monorail that the Profligates rode from McCarran to the Strip has been destroyed.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: You turned Camp Forlorn Hope into a mass grave.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: Chief Hanlon, a nemesis of my Legion, died the humiliating death he deserved.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: In Boulder City, you let the renegade Khans go free, but left NCR troopers gurgling on the ground, drowning in their own blood.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: A number of NCR Ranger stations have been wiped off the face of the Mojave, thanks to you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: {ironic}The Profligates still hate me more than they hate you, I think, but I've been at this longer than you have.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: I get it. We share a common enemy. And now you come before the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar to what - offer your services?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: {WUHL-pace in-CUHL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, the best of my {froo-men-TAR-ee}frumentarii, is dead.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: {player killed Omerta leaders}All the bribes I sent to the Omertas ended up buying me {beat}nothing.

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [Player spoiled his plans for the Great Khans.]
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: {Player spoiled his plans for the Great Khans.}The Great Khans aren't exactly clamoring to fight for my Legion now.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: The garrison I established at Nelson has been wiped out.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: Years of meticulous scheming to place a mole at Camp McCarran - wasted.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: The Kings of Freeside are cooperating with the NCR now, which frees up soldiers to defend the dam.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: You even disrupted a promising weapons deal with the Van Graffs.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: Is it any wonder my Legion has so little love for you?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: So tell me this, because I really want to know. I am feared - with good reason.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: But you - of all people - dare to come here and stand before me, the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar. {beat}What were you thinking?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: That I'd decorate this tent with your guts.
EN: {Pray-TOR-ee-ahns}Praetorians, to me!

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Praetorians, to arms!

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I had to see the Mighty Caesar with my own eyes.
EN: Maybe I should have you struck blind so my face is the last sight you ever behold. {tiring of the jest, to business}Look...{transitioning to "You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?"}

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You're in possession of something that interests me.
EN: We'll deal with Benny when the time comes. In the meantime...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You're in possession of something that interests me.
EN: We'll talk about the Platinum Chip when the time comes. In the meantime...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You're in possession of something that interests me.
EN: I need to get that Platinum Chip back.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: And you fell for that? Really? Because I'm going to have you killed now.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: A man nearly kills you, so you track him across the breadth of the Mojave?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: You arrive on the Strip and waltz into the Lucky 38 like someone left you a key under the doormat?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: You assassinate the head of the Chairmen {emphasis}in his own casino - and get away with it?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: You visit the Tops, and next thing you know, the head of the Chairmen is fleeing the Strip like a whimpering little pup?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Then something happens to Mr. House's robots - some kind of military upgrade?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: But the topper, the {coo de gras, "s" not silent}coup de grâce? Mr. House dies - while you're visiting him at the Lucky 38.{grunt of admiration}

Speaker: Caesar
EN: When you set your mind to something, you get results. I like that.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {beat}...Relax. I'm fucking with you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Mr. House sent me to infiltrate your camp.
EN: Mission accomplished, asshole. {playing with him}I never would've suspected a thing if you hadn't told me - but now I'll have to have you killed.

Speaker: Comm Officer Scheffer
EN: I'm in charge of the radio - hence the title "Comm Officer." I'd much rather be out on patrol, since nothing much happens around here.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Come back when you have news about the Boomers.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Come back when you know more about the White Glove Society.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Return to me when you've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Come back when you've destroyed whatever you find down in that bunker.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Complete your mission, then return to me.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {WAHL-ay}Vale.

Speaker: Omerta Thug
EN: All right, come back any time.

Speaker: Ranger Lineholm
EN: Have you ever heard the story of the bomber that crashed into the lake before the War? Supposedly it's mostly intact, even after all that time.

Speaker: Tech Sergeant Reyes
EN: {disappointed}Oh. Well, thanks for helping get to the bottom of this, I guess.

Speaker: Tech Sergeant Reyes
EN: I handle communications for Camp Forlorn Hope, compiling reports I've received from the Rangers at Camp Golf as well as the brass at McCarran.

Speaker: Tech Sergeant Reyes
EN: {annoyed and underappreciated}Unofficially, I'm also in charge of radio security. No one else seems to take it as seriously as I do.

Speaker: Tech Sergeant Reyes
Topic_Name: Have you heard anything unusual about any of the other Ranger stations?
EN: Nothing as severe. Charlie seems to be getting a lot of extra medical supplies for some reason, while Bravo hasn't requested a resupply in awhile.

Speaker: Tech Sergeant Reyes
Topic_Name: Have you heard anything unusual about any of the other Ranger stations?
EN: Echo has been reporting heavy Legion activity down on their end, but that's about it.

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: Good thing you're wearing a skirt, makes pissing yourself go easier. <Attack.>
EN: {Afraid}Brothers, help!

Speaker: Legion Explorer
EN: {outraged by player's ignorance}My commander, you ignorant degenerate! {final chance}Now, will you go before Dead Sea?

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: Yes, I'll go before your Decanus.
EN: Follow me. {warning}Make any trouble, and you'll wind up on a cross - if you're lucky.

Speaker: Legion Explorer
EN: The Legion will decide that, Profligate, not you. Will you go before my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus for judgement, or be killed where you stand?

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: I came seeking yours, skirt boy. <Attack.>
EN: {Afraid}Brothers, help!

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: You just messed with the wrong gal. <Attack.>
EN: {call to arms}Brothers! Attack!

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: You just messed with the wrong guy. <Attack.>
EN: <Brothers! Attack!>

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: Easy, I'm a friend of the Legion.
EN: {recognizing player}Ah - you must be the courier who's been of service to us lately. I'll take you to my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus at once.

Speaker: Legion Explorer
Topic_Name: I bear the Mark of Caesar.
EN: {surprised}Forgive my challenge. I'll take you to my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus at once.

Speaker: The Tops Cashier
Topic_Name: [PRESS DEMO] Enough gambling, more fighting. Take me to the no man's land near Camp Forlorn Hope.
EN: You'll need someone to watch your back - Craig Boone, an NCR sniper, will be joining you. Keep your head down out there!

Speaker: Comm Officer Scheffer
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the Rangers.
EN: Well, when there's trouble regular NCR troops can't handle, they send in a Ranger. Problem solved.

Speaker: Comm Officer Scheffer
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the Rangers.
EN: We're also responsible for keeping the borders of the NCR secure, scouting out threats, that sort of thing.

Speaker: Ranger Pason
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR Rangers.
EN: Best of the best, that's all there is to it. Really nothing more to say than that.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
Topic_Name: How does someone become a Ranger?
EN: The Rangers mostly draw from the basic NCR army. A trooper who shows exceptional skill at fighting and scouting can be nominated for the training.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
Topic_Name: Are there a lot of Rangers in the Mojave?
EN: Couple dozen, I'd say, most of them posted at stations like this one. We either man the station or patrol the immediate area.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: Sure.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: We're part scout, part commando, part sheriff. The training is brutal, and I'd say eight out of ten recruits washes out before the end.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
EN: Before you get your Ranger badge, you've got to prove you can be quieter than a shadow and more ferocious than a Deathclaw.

Speaker: Ranger Lineholm
EN: For about ten years now. Toughest training I've ever done, and was the proudest day of my life when I got my Ranger badge.

Speaker: Ranger Lineholm
EN: Did you know that the first battle at Hoover Dam was won because of the Rangers? Legion had the numbers, but we had the skill.

Speaker: Comm Officer Castillo
EN: I'm not really much of a historian. The short version is that the Rangers are the elite of the NCR military. Best fighters in the wasteland.

Speaker: Comm Officer Castillo
EN: Ranger Station Alpha. Ranger Lineholm is in command here.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Later.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: Can I ask you some questions?
EN: Shoot.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: {nodding}Goodbye.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: What's going on with the Great Khans?
EN: One of my patrols was on its way back from Novac when it came under fire from the Great Khans.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: What's going on with the Great Khans?
EN: They radioed for reinforcements, but instead of waiting for us, they chased the Khans into the ruins where they were caught in a crossfire.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: What's going on with the Great Khans?
EN: No deaths, but not all of the squad got out. The Khans have Private Ackerman and Private Gilbert as hostages.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: I'm sure you have all the good dirt on what goes on around here.
EN: I sure do, but loose lips{giggle} sink ships.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, you look pretty trustworthy.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Don't worry about me, I can keep your secrets.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: [FAILED] Sorry, but the Omertas don't look very kindly upon gossiping.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: A little gossip never hurt anyone.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: I...{stammer} well, since you ask so nicely, and I'm not sure I could resist those pretty eyes. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Beautiful, I would love to help you loosen those lips.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: I've heard some pretty shady rumors about the Ultra Luxe.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: I'm not sure what the deal is, but although they try to put on airs, that place is just plain creepy. Maybe it's the masks.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: Not much of a rumor, but I hear the Tops is always looking for new talent. Lord knows they've needed it for a long time.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: I'm not sure what's going on at Lucky 38. That place is weird. Nobody ever goes in. Nobody ever comes out.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: I hear you've actually been inside Lucky 38? You're the first person who's been in there in as long as anybody can remember.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: It's hard to believe that not too long ago most of the families on the Strip were little more than warring tribes.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: The Omertas even had a big war with the Khans, once upon a time.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
EN: Sorry, that's all the news worth talking about. All I have at least.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
EN: Gossip is one thing, dirt on the Family is something else totally.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
EN: {sigh}I knew someone would call in that mark soon. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
EN: I'm calling in for an outstanding balance for some information. Tell me what the Omertas are up to.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
EN: That was one of my sisters, but my family always repays our debts. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
EN: I'm calling in for an outstanding balance for some information. Tell me what the Omertas are up to.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Can you help me find someone?
EN: Depends on who you're looking for.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: Cachino is usually on this floor in Brimstone, having drinks. If he isn't there then he's probably in his room upstairs.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Can you tell me where Troike is?
EN: Troike spends all his days down in Zoara on the lower level.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Can you tell me where Troike is?
EN: Troike is dead, but I'm sure you know that.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Do you know someone named Clanden?
EN: Yeah. I know him.{unhappy, spoken with contempt} You'll probably find him in his room upstairs. He usually just sends down for girls or food.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Do you know someone named Clanden?
EN: I knew someone named Clanden. Good fucking riddance.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Where can I find the management?
EN: Big Sal and Nero split their time in Zoara overlooking the main casino floor from the balcony. No one but Family is allowed up there, though.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: I need to know who to talk to about what's been going on in Gomorrah.
EN: All I can tell you is to find Cachino. He's the lowest level Lieutenant you're going to be able to talk to.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: I need to know who to talk to about what's been going on in Gomorrah.
EN: Some of the girls say he's been involved in some shady business the Family wouldn't really like. Ask him about it.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Tell me what the Family is up to.
EN: Sorry, they don't tell me their plans and I don't want to know. I'm just happy they don't make me fuck anybody anymore.

Speaker: Liza O'Malley
Topic_Name: Moore sent me to talk to you about the Omertas.
EN: Ah, excellent. I received word you may be coming. We helped the receptionist over at Gomorrah with some thugs that were taking advantage of her.

Speaker: Liza O'Malley
Topic_Name: Moore sent me to talk to you about the Omertas.
EN: She owes us a favor. Go talk to her, she'll be able to point you in the right direction.

Speaker: Receptionist
Topic_Name: Let me ask you about something else.
EN: Fire away.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: Enjoy yourself.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: Be careful.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: Well, I'm not, and I believe you have something of mine.
EN: Yeah... about that...

Speaker: Jessup
EN: He's a snake, that's why. He owed us the rest of the pay for the job, so maybe he didn't want to pay up.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Platinum Chip?
EN: Just a big, fancy poker chip as far as I know. Don't know why anyone would make one out of platinum, though.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
EN: Fine.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Benny?
EN: He's one of the Chairmen, big shots who run The Tops casino in New Vegas. A friend from the city contacted me with info on a big job.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Benny?
EN: I should've known that the caps were too good to be true, but there was still no way I could pass up the chance.

Speaker: Jessup
EN: Yeah? On what?

Speaker: Jessup
EN: Don't have it. Benny stole it, right before he stabbed us in the back. He's probably back at the Strip by now, laughing at me.

Speaker: Jessup
EN: And here I thought us Great Khans were tough to kill. So, what happens now?

Speaker: Benny
EN: {frustrated the player's taking so long}What ya talking about? I been ready!

Speaker: Benny
EN: {enraged}Thanks for nothing, you fink!

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: What happens if I let you go?
EN: Baby, that can go any direction you want. We can take Vegas together, or I can head for the nearest sunset. Your call.

Speaker: Benny
EN: Baby, you can't just leave me tied up! Those Legion boys'll hoist me up on a cross for the mess you made - if I'm lucky!

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: Here, I'll set you free. <Untie Benny.>
EN: That's it, baby! Time to vacate these premises!

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: Actually... I'd rather kill you now.
EN: {outraged}You fink! Murdering me like this, down on my knees?

Speaker: Benny
EN: Ring-a-ding-ding, baby. I've got your back.

Speaker: Benny
EN: What am I gonna say? {sarcastic}"No thanks?"

Speaker: Benny
EN: If you can get these ropes off, I'll do my best to take down my share of the guards.

Speaker: Benny
ActorNotes: [I can't believe you're bringing this up]
Topic_Name: We talked about how you might sneak out of here...
EN: {I can't believe you're bringing this up}Yeah, we talked about it, but that went a big fat nowhere.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: We talked about how you might sneak out of here...
EN: It's too late for that, baby. This decision you gotta make is going down {emphasis}now. So what's it gonna be?

Speaker: Benny
ActorNotes: [ambushing the player while using Stealth Boy]
EN: {ambushing the player while using Stealth Boy}Thanks for getting me outta that cage! Now for once will you just {emphasis, player's resilience is vexing}lay down and stay down?

Speaker: Benny
EN: No one rules Vegas {'cept}except me, got it? You're a lowdown gofer! You deliver mail!

Speaker: Benny
EN: How ya like being Mister Good-Two-Shoes, hey? How's it feeling?

Speaker: Benny
EN: How ya like being Miss Good-Two-Shoes, hey? How's it feeling?

Speaker: Benny
EN: Yeah? What about it?

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: Check's in the mail, hey? Don't get my hopes up.

Speaker: Benny
EN: No one likes a tease, baby.

Speaker: Benny
EN: Then stop bringing it up!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You're not getting out of that cage.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: If I help you escape, what will you do next?
EN: Baby, if you show me the door to scramsville, that's where I'll go - out of your hair, never to return.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: If I help you escape, what will you do next?
EN: I been a fink to you, caused more than my share of grief by a hard mile. Let me go, you won't see me again.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: Here's the Stealth Boy and Bobby Pin you need to escape.
EN: Baby... your generosity and spirit of forgiveness? Off the charts.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: Here's the Stealth Boy and Bobby Pin you need to escape.
EN: This little care package is everything I need. I'll take it from here.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: What if I helped you escape?
EN: Sweet to offer, baby, but if you cut these ropes every Legionary in this camp's gonna come running. With machetes.

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: What if I helped you escape?
EN: Now on the other hand, if I had a Stealth Boy and a Bobby Pin, I could see myself out. Know what I mean?

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: What if I helped you escape?
EN: I know I been bad, but it's cruel to jerk me around like this...

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: What if I helped you escape?
EN: Like I said, baby, all Benny needs is a Stealth Boy and a Bobby Pin.

Speaker: Benny
EN: That's it, baby! Show these punks what you got!

Speaker: Benny
EN: Groovy, baby! Plant these losers in the ground!

Speaker: Benny
EN: That's it - sock it to the Legion, baby!

Speaker: Benny
EN: Keep it up! Show these finks what's what!

Speaker: Benny
EN: They got nothing on you, baby! Keep it up!

Speaker: Benny
EN: Yeah! Give these {preh-TOR-ee-an}Praetorian bums the big send-off, baby!

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: Forget what I said. Kill them all.
EN: I don't like it, but orders are orders.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: If you have any integrity, then you'll honor the deal.
EN: You're right. The Great Khans are free to go.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: 500 caps was the amount requested.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: We agreed on 400 caps.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: I'm a ghost, here to haunt you. Oooooh...
EN: {annoyed at the player's flippant reaction}All right, quit fucking around. You survived and you tracked us down. What now?

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: This doesn't feel quite right, but it resolves things and gets my troopers back in one piece.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: [SUCCEEDED] That makes sense, and it's still more than these troopers see in a month.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: 400 caps is a less suspicious amount. You have enough trouble here as it is.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: [FAILED] You're asking me to accept a bribe. I'd like to make sure the risk to my career - and freedom - benefits the families of my troops.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Way too much. Bring that price down and I'll consider it.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I'll be back with the caps.
EN: All right.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: This doesn't feel quite right, but it resolves things and gets my troopers back in one piece.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: Never mind. Forget I said anything.
EN: Right.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: Look at it this way - nobody dies.
EN: 500 caps would go a long way for some soldier's families.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: How much money would it take for you to look the other way while the Great Khans left?
EN: You mean... just let them go? How would I explain this to my superiors?

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: How much money would it take for you to look the other way while the Great Khans left?
EN: I've been thinking about it since you brought it up earlier. 500 caps would go a long way for some soldier's families.

Speaker: Jessup
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I can't believe I'm doing this, but all right, the hostages can go. The NCR had better keep their end of the deal, though.

Speaker: Jessup
EN: Here - a souvenir for you. It's Benny's lighter. Shove it up his ass when you catch up with him.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Free the hostages now, and I'll have the NCR escort you out of their territory.

Speaker: Jessup
EN: [FAILED] Right, and they'd probably give us all medals, too. Maybe I should kill a hostage because you wasted my time with this shit.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: If you let the hostages free now, maybe the NCR would just let you go.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: I'm willing to hear other suggestions.
EN: {Jessup mentions bribe option}We'd try to bribe our way out, but seeing as how Benny didn't pay us yet, that won't happen.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: Any chance you're willing to surrender?
EN: And face NCR "justice?" No thanks. I'd rather not spend the next ten years doing hard labor.

Speaker: Victor
EN: See that you do.

Speaker: [Context: WranglerResponses]
EN: Where else?

Speaker: [Context: WranglerResponses]
EN: Nah, I'm gonna chill with my girl.

Speaker: [Context: WranglerResponses]
EN: Can't. The King's got me busy on something.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: Glory? Glory's fucking {heavyily stressed}crazy.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: Some of my siblings are real pieces of work, but I'd bet on Glory if she were facing down a deathclaw with a plastic spoon.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: She's got the smarts to do whatever she wants, but she and momma are always butting heads, so she gets all the shit jobs.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: Make it quick. I got shit to do.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: I'm not one for running a business. Never really had a head for numbers or smooth-talk. My talents are a little more... direct.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: Mama always said that was my gift. When we were kids, the others used to fight over and steal one another's toys. I always broke mine.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: And if any of the others messed with me, I broke theirs too. Sometimes I'd break them even if they were nice to me, just to show them what's what.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: One day mama took me aside and said, "Boy, you're never going to go very far, but you're going to make a whole lotta people come up short."

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: Why don't you just shoot your way out of here?
EN: I'm not afraid of a gunfight, but I'd rather get back to Red Rock without a few extra holes in me if I can help it.

Speaker: Melody
Topic_Name: Why did Antony take him away?
EN: Antony said he was punishing me for trying to hide it from the Legion.

Speaker: Antony
Topic_Name: How did you end up joining the Legion?
EN: When the Legion showed up, we fought, most tribes did. Hangdogs hung out longer than most... {beat}broke us by throwing our dogs on the fire.

Speaker: Antony
ActorNotes: [A little quiet, to himself, painful memory - scornful he ever believed this]
Topic_Name: How did you end up joining the Legion?
EN: {A little quiet, to himself, painful memory - scornful he ever believed this}So we gave up, our elders couldn't bear the idea of our spirit animals burning in the afterlife.

Speaker: Antony
Topic_Name: How did you end up joining the Legion?
EN: {Rallies}Still, Caesar was impressed enough to conscript us, use our skills with dogs to join the Legion as houndmasters.

Speaker: Antony
EN: I've been around dogs all my life. They're my life, always were - {pauses, thinking back, as if he's forgotten}all the way back when I was a tribal, one of the Hangdogs, outside Denver.

Speaker: Antony
EN: {Still thinking back}Dogs roamed that city. Our tribe made peace with them. {Scoffs, trying to dismiss painful memory}Thought they were our spirit animals - helped us hunt, provided for us in some lean times.

Speaker: Antony
EN: Then the Legion came. {Beat}Good thing, too. {Trying to convince himself}Stronger now, don't need those beliefs anymore.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: Do you have a problem with women?
EN: {Female PC}Women are beneath notice, as {KAI-zar}Caesar has taught us. I'm only allowing you to speak to me because you are {KAI-zar's}Caesar's guest.

Speaker: Otho
Topic_Name: Do you have a problem with women?
EN: I may yet, if {KAI-zar}Caesar commands it.

Speaker: Dawes
Topic_Name: Who's in charge of the prison now?
EN: {Eddie alive}That'll be Eddie. You can usually find him sitting in the warden's old chair up in the main building.

Speaker: Dawes
Topic_Name: Who's in charge of the prison now?
EN: {Eddie dead}Not sure who's gonna take over with Eddie dead.

Speaker: Dawes
Topic_Name: What exactly is a Powder Ganger?
EN: That's us. We got sent here to fix the rails and make some new ones, and for that we got to use dynamite.

Speaker: Dawes
Topic_Name: What exactly is a Powder Ganger?
EN: Of course, dynamite works pretty good against caravan guards, too. So, that's what we do - rob and blow things up.

Speaker: Dawes
Topic_Name: If you're free, why are you sticking around?
EN: We've got the biggest, baddest fort in the wasteland. There's water and power, and if we need grub, we just go out and steal it.

Speaker: Dawes
Topic_Name: What did you do to end up in here?
EN: Me? I ran with the toughest gang in the Hub. You've heard of the Hub, right? It's, uh, west of here, I think, back in California.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: Quit wasting my time.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: All right, you can go on in. Can't guarantee your safety, though. Just saying.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: {he does know}Well, I don't know. Depends on if you can make it worth my time. A hundred caps sounds right to me.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: {Helped Powder Gangers in Goodsprings}Yeah, all right. Figure you could help us out the way you helped out Cobb's crew over in Goodsprings.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: This? This is - or was - the big house. The New California Republic Correctional Facility. Not much "correcting" went on here, just slave labor.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: One day, us prisoners decided to liberate ourselves. Killed the warden, killed the guards, took over the whole damn territory.

Speaker: Dawes
EN: Yup.

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
EN: You and me at Gomorrah, rolled up in those silk sheets. I got leave coming up in a bit, so let me know if you'll be around.

Speaker: Alerio
Topic_Name: Tell Caesar I accept his invitation.
EN: {Strip}Seek {KAI-zar}Caesar by way of Cottonwood Cove, south of Nelson. The Cursor Lucullus will be waiting.

Speaker: Alerio
Topic_Name: If this is a trap, I'm going to take a lot of you with me.
EN: {offended}The mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar has bestowed upon you his Mark and guaranteed safe-conduct. If he wanted you dead, you would be dead already.

Speaker: Alerio
Topic_Name: You said Caesar has an offer for me. What kind of offer?
EN: {KAI-zar}Caesar chose not to give me that information. I was only told to find you and bring you the message.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: {WAH-lay}Vale.

Speaker: Vulpes Inculta
EN: We are soldiers of a different stripe, capable in battle, but skilled as infiltrators and agents as well.

Speaker: Vulpes Inculta
EN: I am {WUHL-pace In-CUL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, of {KAI-zar's}Caesar's Legion. I serve my master as the greatest of his {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii.

Speaker: Vulpes Inculta
EN: {WAH-lay}Vale.

Speaker: Dale Barton
EN: Be seeing you around.

Speaker: Dale Barton
EN: I'll grab my tools.

Speaker: Dale Barton
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Have a look.

Speaker: Michael Angelo
EN: {Surprised}You mean, Mitch? It's been ages since I've heard the name. My sister and I used to call him "Mole-butt." Don't ask.

Speaker: Michael Angelo
EN: That was a long time ago, before we exchanged the warmth of our home for the thin air of the Wasteland.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
Topic_Name: I don't have enough for a room.
EN: Vault 21 hopes to service your needs in the future. Goodbye.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
EN: Proceed to your accomodations. Please, enjoy your stay at Vault 21.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
EN: Observe the rules, citizen.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
EN: Vault 21's previous manager is no longer capable of servicing your needs. Hotel arrangement functions are now purview of Mr. House.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: {Surprised, Excitedly}Mitch!? You know "mole-butt?"

Speaker: Sarah
EN: I hadn't thought about that name in a long time. I was just a child, and he had a big mole in his rear bumper.

Speaker: Sarah
EN: You understand, kids and all that. Everyone knows about each other in a Vault, there's no other way. I hope mol... I mean Mitch, is doing well!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I'm looking for Carlitos. Do you know him?
EN: {Almost Suspicious}Carlitos, huh? Yeah, I do. Try the diner, but don't start any trouble, you hear?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: I'll let you in, later, when you're ready for a night to remember.
EN: {Playful Seduction}You're kicking me into gear, huh? I think I'll drive my chassis over to your pad. Wait for me down there, and don't forget the oil.

Speaker: Mini Boomer
Topic_Name: Oh mighty Fantoma, I hope one day I can fight for the forces of good by your side!
EN: Yes! It has been a long time since La Fantoma had a good sidekick!

Speaker: Mini Boomer
Topic_Name: <Mock Surrender> Woah, no way I'm fighting with the mighty Red-Brick.
EN: You better believe it. I'll knock your block off!

Speaker: Mini Boomer
Topic_Name: I have no money for your toll, surely you will let a fair traveller pass through your gate.
EN: {Thoughtful}Very well traveller{difficulty with the word}. You may pass.{laughs}

Speaker: Mini Boomer
Topic_Name: I bet when you get bigger you'll be able to fly your own plane.
EN: You bet I will, I'm almost old enough to fly in the VR sims. That'll be awesome!

Speaker: Mini Boomer
EN: Ooo, you know a lot about dinosaurs.

Speaker: Mini Boomer
Topic_Name: You don't need toys, I bet you can get a fun game of Boomers and targets.
EN: That is a neat idea. I'll be the spotter. I'll find someone to play the target.

Speaker: Mini Boomer
Topic_Name: That's right. I've battled giant mutated animals, crazed raiders, and braved many other dangers.
EN: {Awed}Wow, you sound {emphasized}awesome.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: You make an excellent point. I never liked that Cachino fuck anyway. Here you go.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I know you feel safe here, but I could crush your windpipe before anyone noticed.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: With those skinny little arms? Not before the bouncer put two in the back of your head. Now stop being stupid.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I bet I could beat you up.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: You make an excellent point. I never liked that Cachino fuck anyway. Here you go.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I know you feel safe here, but I could crush your windpipe before anyone noticed.

Speaker: Receptionist
EN: With those skinny little arms? Not before the bouncer put two in the back of your head. Now stop being stupid.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I bet I could beat you up.

Speaker: Cachino
Topic_Name: I'm planning on playing some games in the Casino.
EN: Of course, after all you did for me, here are some chips for you. Play, have some fun.

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: I'm planning on playing some games in the Casino.
EN: You play some games, have some fun. You did right by us.

Speaker: Nero
Topic_Name: I'm planning on playing some games in the Casino.
EN: {Laughs}Real subtle. Here you go. Play some games. Have some fun.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'd have given the money away.
EN: ...Really? Wow, it never occurred to me to actually give the money away. Do people really do things like that?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'd have saved the money, so I could someday get the hell out of here.
EN: Hmmm... you're a long-term thinker, man. I like that. You might be on to something there.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Probably a weapon, given how dangerous it is around here.
EN: Yeah... that's a good idea... no sense making money and waiting for someone to just come and take it, right?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Yeah, it does look pretty sweet, doesn't {it}i- hey, screw you! Who asked you anyway? The crap I put up with...

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: It's not exactly what I would have bought for myself.
EN: Oh yeah, what would you have gotten?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Exactly what I was thinking. It's nice to have a little style, you know?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: But you're probably here for more of my special commodity, and luckily for you, I haven't been idle since last we spoke.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: However, all that hard work on my part means that the price has gone up. 100 a tip, now. You game?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Hey, listen, I'd love to sell you some more info, but you've tapped everything I've heard lately.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Come back in a few days. I'll put my ear to the ground and hopefully have heard a few more things by then.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: What do ya say, want another tip?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I got more where that came from. Want another?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: That one was pretty good, right? How about another?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I've heard here and there that the word "Hope" has recently become quite popular with the Squatters.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: But that's all I've heard. If I knew more, I'd try to bilk you out of more caps. You interested in one of my other tips?

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Tell me about the other attractions.
EN: Well, let's see: the NCR has an embassy here, but why you'd want to go talk to a bunch of boring old politicians I surely don't know.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Tell me about the other attractions.
EN: Oh, and the Vault 21 Hotel and Gift Shop has an adorable collection of old Vault-Tec memorabilia.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Tell me about the other attractions.
EN: And I suppose if you like neon signs, you might check out Michael Angelo's sign shop.

Speaker: Jane
EN: Well, of course there used to be a lot more of them, but these days there are three open to the public: The Tops, the Ultra-Luxe, and Gomorrah.

Speaker: Jane
EN: And the Lucky 38 of course, but we're not open to the public. You're a special case, sugar.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Three Families.
EN: They're just new money, sugar. They might pretend they're sophisticated, but between you and me, they're not far off from tribals.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Three Families.
EN: The Omertas especially are just awful brutes. The Chairmen and the White Glove Society at least pretend to have some culture.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: I really don't want to think about that.
EN: Then maybe you shouldn't pry into a lady's particulars, hmm?

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: So you're... a copy of a dead woman? What exactly do you do for Mr. House?
EN: Mr. House has a lot of needs, sugar. I take care of all of them, and a lady doesn't kiss and tell.

Speaker: Jane
EN: Anything you like, sugar.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: I didn't realize robots could have such strong feelings about people.
EN: Sugar, I may be a robot on the outside, but on the inside, my neuro-computational matrix is an exact copy of Mr. House's favorite girl.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Sounds like you're pretty fond of him.
EN: Well, of course I am, silly! Mr. House is just the smartest, most wonderful man there ever was!

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Sounds like you're pretty fond of him.
EN: Why, did you know he single-handedly reclaimed New Vegas from all those nasty tribes that used to live here?

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: Sounds like you're pretty fond of him.
EN: Well, he single-handedly sent in his Securitrons to do it, but that counts in my book.

Speaker: Jane
EN: Not many people know this, but Mr. House is one of the world's biggest collectors of antique snow globes!

Speaker: Jane
EN: If you happen to find any out in the Wasteland, you can bring them to me and I'll add them to his collection! You'll get a reward, of course.

Speaker: Jane
EN: In fact, one of Mr. House's favorites went missing when we moved the collection. If you have a look around the Lucky 38, you might even find it!

Speaker: Jane
EN: You do? Why, that's just wonderful! I'll take it and put it with the rest of the collection.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I've got a snowglobe for Mr. House's collection.

Speaker: Jane
EN: You do? Why, that's just wonderful! I'll take them and put them with the rest of the collection.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I've got some snowglobes for Mr. House's collection.

Speaker: Jane
EN: Aw, sugar, why'd you have to go make Mr. House mad? Now we've got to get all messy shooting you to little bits.

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: What kind of robots are you?
EN: Why I'm a RobCo PDQ-88b {Mark}Mk I Securitron, you silly goose! We're the finest in personal or civil robotic security on the market!

Speaker: Jane
Topic_Name: What kind of robots are you?
