EN: {Rhonda} Ooh, how insightful! So then how do you think this misunderstanding came about?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} My guess is that it has something to do with the fact that every mutant in the State of Utobitha  has been give explicit orders regarding security.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Those orders naturally include shooting humans on sight. Or pounding them with whatever happens to be handy. Guns being in short supply, you see.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} As I've explained, there are numerous dangers to humans here, and we have a duty to drive them away. It's for their own good, really.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Makes sense to me! And the silly humans think we don't care. {said dramatically}For shame. Stick around, Utobitha, for more after this!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} We're back with Best Friend Tabitha, who was telling us why humans should {cue angry Tabitha voice}STAY THE HELL AWAY, {back to normal Rhonda voice}ier, keep their distance from the State of Utobitha.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. As you know, one of the many benefits of living in Utobitha is the ready availability of pet centaurs.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Ooh, I love the centaurs. They're just so cute!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Exactly, Rhonda, who could resist those sweet little faces, and that cute way they shuffle around on all those hands they have.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} But humans must be so caught up with their pleasant features that they forget the most important thing about centaurs.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And what might that be, Best Friend Tabitha?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Centaurs {stressed}eat humans, Rhonda! You see, humans are a lot smaller, and much more tender than you or I, so centaurs naturally see them as food.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Ah, that *would* make it hard for them to get along, wouldn't it?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Indeed. Given the situation, I had to make a hard choice when I created Utobitha - do we invite weak, greedy humans who would just die anyway?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Or cute, loveable centaurs, who fight and die for us and ask nothing in return? After much deliberation, I went with the centaurs.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And there you have it, Utobitha. The next time you play with a huggable, loveable centaur, remember that Best Friend Tabitha made it all possible.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Did you have something to do with that NCR messenger getting attacked?
EN: Look, I already told you that was bullshit. Probably just an excuse those lying soldier scum made up to not share their grub with us.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Did you have something to do with that NCR messenger getting attacked?
EN: So don't ask me about it again, you hear me?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?
EN: Mick and Ralph sell all sorts of things at a small store over by the east gate. They've done all right by us, and they'll do all right by you.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?
EN: You want to know about anyone else?

Speaker: The King
EN: They're a family-run business from out west that deal in weapons mostly. A word of caution, though. They're not a friendly bunch. Not at all.

Speaker: The King
EN: Their store is just past the Wrangler, and sells all kinds of fancy weapons that most people around here can't afford.

Speaker: The King
EN: Anyone else you wanted to know about?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins.
EN: Them twins run the Atomic Wrangler, the only working casino here in Freeside. It's become pretty much {thee}the place to go around these parts.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins.
EN: Give it a whirl when you've got some time.  Now, was there anyone else you wanted to know about?

Speaker: The King
EN: Julie represents the Followers of the Apocalypse. They're a group that tries to help people out whenever they can, so we get along just fine.

Speaker: The King
EN: If you ever need to get patched up, one of their docs'll have you right as rain in no time flat. They sell supplies, too. Or used to.

Speaker: The King
EN: Heard they were having trouble bringing stuff in, or keeping up with the demand, or something, lately.

Speaker: The King
EN: Did you want to know about anyone else?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Who are the important people in Freeside?
EN: There's me, but I don't really like talking about myself. There's Julie Farkas and the other Followers down at the ol' Mormon Fort.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Who are the important people in Freeside?
EN: The Garret Twins up at the Wrangler deserve mention. Wouldn't be right not mentioning the Van Graffs, I suppose.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Who are the important people in Freeside?
EN: And while they're not important in the overall scheme of things, there's Mick and Ralph, too. Just don't tell them I said that.

Speaker: The King
ActorNotes: The last sentence is spoken slightly lower, in a conspiratorial tone.
Topic_Name: Who are the important people in Freeside?
EN: Who all did you want to know about?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Pacer?
EN: Pace? He and I grew up together around here. We've been through a lot together, and there's no man I'd rather have at my side in a pinch.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Pacer?
EN: Don't judge him too harshly for trying to get some caps out of you. He probably took you for a squatter, looking for a place to settle down.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Pacer?
EN: There've been a lot of people moving into the area lately, and it's got some people riled. Can't blame 'em myself. There's only so much to go around.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?
EN: We've tried to pass our philosophy on to the people of Freeside, but not everyone is ready to be a King.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?
EN: The kids love us, but the old-timers tend to shy away and keep to themselves. They probably couldn't pull off the look, anyway.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?
EN: As for the others, some people just plain don't respect others, and that's a no-no. If there's one thing I won't tolerate, it's lack of respect.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?
EN: Aside from this place, there's the Atomic Wrangler just up the street. Women, gambling, booze, you name it, they got you covered.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?
EN: If you're more of a prude, the Followers run a mission out of the Old Mormon Fort up toward the north gate. Great place if you're hurt, I guess.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?
EN: If you like things dangerous, just past the Wrangler is the Silver Rush, where the Van Graff family peddles their weapons.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?
EN: Their stuff is outrageously priced, but if you want to shoot something hi-tech, they're the best game in town.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: So there's no law here at all?
EN: People can do whatever they want, they just have to keep in mind what'll happen afterward.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: So there's no law here at all?
EN: I guess you could say we don't have law so much as consequences.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
EN: Well, the Van Graffs for one. We had a slight difference of opinion when they first showed up.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
EN: Changed our minds pretty quick after a brief demonstration of how much firepower they're packing.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
EN: We could probably take them, but we'd lose a lotta guys doing it.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: NCR can't hold the Mojave already, and now you're threatening me?
EN: I'm not going to throw away the lives of my men just to make a point. And there'll be other days.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: No, General, you keep it in mind - and our conversation is over.
EN: Well, at least I can talk to you unlike that bastard Caesar and that plate-faced general. It'll do.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: No, General, you keep it in mind - and our conversation is over.
EN: {Chuckles}Guess sometimes you get the bull, other times you get the horns. Still, at least some lives got saved this day.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: Oh man, Gloria's going to be pissed when she hears about this. Still, he started it, so we probably won't go to war with the Kings.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: What the hell are you doing?

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: Way to keep your head, rookie. There's hope for you yet.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Spoken like a chump. A King doesn't have to grovel before others to get paid. Anyway, I've got better things to do than shoot the shit with you.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Nah, I've just risen up in the world.
EN: Ha, you've got yourself a live one here, Simon. Anyway, I've got things to do. Later.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Do you ever stop talking tough?
EN: Yeah, right before I beat somebody down. Let's take this fool, boys.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Never mind. Just forget I said anything.
EN: Yeah, that's what I thought.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Actually, it does. What are you going to do about it?
EN: You asked for it, punk!

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Apparently I do. Something wrong with that?
EN: No, nothing wrong at all. By all means, carry on.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Why don't you just get the hell out of here?
EN: Who do you think you're talking to? Just because the King happens to like you, doesn't mean you can run your mouth any way you damn like.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Good to see you, too, Pacer.
EN: I'm sure it's the highlight of your day. Anyway, I've gotta bounce. Things to do, and all that.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Let's take this chump, guys!

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Get out of here before you get hurt.
EN: Ouch, this one's got a bite, Simon! Call him off, or he'll get put down.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Get out of here before you get hurt.
EN: Ouch, this one's got a bite, Simon! Call her off, or she'll get put down.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: I would, but I tend to distract the boss lady a little too much. She can't help herself.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Anyway, I've got things to do. Later, Simon.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: I'll be sure to pass it along.
EN: That's a good dog. Well, I'm out of here. Later, Simon.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Actually, I've got a better idea. Make the new hire tell her. You'll do that for me, won't you?

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Hey, I've seen you before around our place. You've really fallen on hard times if you're working for these clowns.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Hey, you're the one who helped us out with those NCR chumps. You really get around, don't you?

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Hey, Simon. How's it hanging? Looks like you've got a little helper today.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
ActorNotes: [Tiny bit of distaste here, he doesn't like Pacer]
EN: {Tiny bit of distaste here, he doesn't like Pacer}What can I say? Business has been good lately. We can afford the help.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Good to hear, buddy. So is the boss lady in?

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
ActorNotes: [mood gets darker, Simon doesn't like Pacer talking about Gloria]
EN: {mood gets darker, Simon doesn't like Pacer talking about Gloria}You know she is. {This is a threat, Pacer's dead if he goes inside}Why don't you go in and say hi?

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Nah, I've got some rounds to run. But do pass along that I'm always thinking of her.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: Crap. {stressed}This I do not need today. Keep your head straight, rookie. Things are about to get interesting.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: Heads up. Looks like we've got another customer.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: You don't listen too well, do you? We're supposed to pat everyone down. That's going in my report.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: You keep losing us business like that, and you can forget about being paid.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: He's clean.

Speaker: Gambler
EN: See? Told you so.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: You just going to let everyone in without checking them? Bad move, rookie. That's going in my report.

Speaker: Van Graff Thug
EN: Wow, you're a real people person, aren't you?

Speaker: Gambler
Topic_Name: Pardon me, sir my mistake. Go on in.
EN: Hmph. That's better.

Speaker: Gambler
Topic_Name: I think you may be drunk, sir.
EN: I haven't had a drink all day! Screw this place, I'll go spend my money elsewhere!

Speaker: Gambler
EN: If that's the case, then I guess I'll go spend my money elsewhere.

Speaker: Gambler
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I suppose it's all right, if there's no other choice.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm sure you're a man of your word, sir, but we still need to pat you down. No exceptions.

Speaker: Gambler
EN: [FAILED] I just don't see why it's necessary. Now, are you going to let me in or not?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Your word doesn't matter. It's just company policy.

Speaker: Gambler
Topic_Name: Sorry, sir. I can't let you in.
EN: What? Why the hell not?

Speaker: Gambler
Topic_Name: Welcome to the Silver Rush. Go on in.
EN: Thank you kindly.

Speaker: Gambler
Topic_Name: Certainly, sir. We need to pat you down for weapons first.
EN: Now hold on there, I'm not packing any heat. Ain't my word good enough for you?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: As long as that's not a "no," then I'd take that doubt to your superiors.
EN: No, no, no... you've given me enough ammo for the Republic... but what one head may like, the other bear head may not.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: As long as that's not a "no," then I'd take that doubt to your superiors.
EN: Still, I'm not about to add blood to the mix since you could've done us like the Legion now if you wanted.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hmmm. Well... Vegas burns brighter than most cities West of the Divide, and that glitter has its appeal.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: Not sure that's going to mend fences with the folks back West, though. But...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: There are... technologies in Vegas we may be able to provide to NCR. Not all, but some.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: [FAILED] No, you tricked us once, and taking more gifts from you deeper into NCR's just asking for trouble by my book.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] So you're saying without you, Hoover Dam just beats slower and dies. I believe it, I saw it myself this day, you woke it up, true enough.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: Still, even power from the Dam - that's not enough to wash the salt out of the wound here, and it only benefits NCR in the Mojave, not the West.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
EN: [FAILED] Well, that kind of fence-sitting is exactly what makes me think we can make use of the... improvements here. Without you.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, we might be able to open the East up faster if we work harder at it.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. Willing to tackle the caravan families? Keeping that bunch in line... well, that's no easy job.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, we might be able to open the East up faster if we work harder at it.
EN: In fact, that's such a shitty job, those caravan families will be the one bottlecapping you to death inch by inch - and that sounds good to me.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, we might be able to open the East up faster if we work harder at it.
EN: Be a nice turnabout from your friend, House, and all the bottlecapping he's been doing to NCR for years. Sounds sweet to me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Well, we might be able to open the East up faster if we work harder at it.
EN: We'd also guarantee protection to the caravans - and enforcement of fair trade practices.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, we might be able to open the East up faster if we work harder at it.
EN: [FAILED] {Snorts}With your wheeled buddies as merchants? No, the East is going to be a hard nut to crack, and I don't think you know what you're in for.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Maybe we could... give you some caps, from the battle?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] If you're buying our ear for the moment, Hoover Dam's more than a fistful of caps to my superiors. Vegas is interesting... the East...

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Maybe we could... give you some caps, from the battle?
EN: That'll take too long to build up to generate capital - 'course, since you'd have to guard it during that time... don't know, could go either way.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Maybe we could... give you some caps, from the battle?
EN: What if we give NCR some concessions in trade with Vegas - and the East?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Maybe we could... give you some caps, from the battle?
EN: [FAILED] {Irritated}What, loot we'd get anyway once we kicked your ass and more? No, I don't think so.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: We want the Dam, but the power it generates can be shared.
EN: You sure got its heart beating in new ways... but that just makes me want all of it, not handouts.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: I have no intention of leaving you empty-handed.
EN: {Frowns}Looking to make a deal, then? All right... let's hear it.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, I guess we can talk some more, if it'll settle things.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] True, guess I'm a little too used to seeing Securitrons in Vegas to think they'd turn and be bad news - and I know how bad they can get.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Well, I guess we can talk some more, if it'll settle things.
EN: <Bluff> The fact you're talking me with me says a lot about your willingness to fight.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, I guess we can talk some more, if it'll settle things.
EN: [FAILED] {Chuckles}If that's your idea of diplomacy, then things are looking miles better on my side of the fence.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Look, you've got two choices - leave, or fight.
EN: I think you're cashed out enough that my chances are pretty good. And like I said, I'm not leaving the Dam now the Legion's been broken.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: <Attack> Actually, nothing of the sort. We've come to exterminate you.
EN: Figured as much. Come on, you sons of bitches, we're ready.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The Boomers might be willing, too... if I ask them. Which I will.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated}This has been a fuck of a day.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: The Boomers might be willing, too... if I ask them. Which I will.
EN: And once the Boomers join them?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: The Boomers might be willing, too... if I ask them. Which I will.
EN: [FAILED] You go on and do that. Me? I think they shot their last wad today... from now on, they'll prefer targets closer to home.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Oh, I think it is... numbers aren't everything, really.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated}First the Legion, then the Brotherhood hitting us is about the last thing the Republic needs right now.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Oh, I think it is... numbers aren't everything, really.
EN: Exactly - and while you've been occupied here, they're ready.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Oh, I think it is... numbers aren't everything, really.
EN: [FAILED] Yeah, and we'll kick their ass again like we did at HELIOS One - tell them to come, we got a whole mess of armor-piercing rounds.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Then... the Brotherhood might be willing to help me, I think.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] The Brotherhood? {Beat}Last thing we fucking need now.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Then... the Brotherhood might be willing to help me, I think.
EN: Then maybe the Brotherhood would have more incentive.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Then... the Brotherhood might be willing to help me, I think.
EN: [FAILED] Yeah, and we'll kick their ass again like we did at HELIOS One - tell them to come, we got a whole mess of armor-piercing rounds.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, uh, one percent... are you sure? Seems weak to me.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Gives up, he's been beaten}Godammit.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Well, uh, one percent... are you sure? Seems weak to me.
EN: Really? We should play cards some time, you're bluffing.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Well, uh, one percent... are you sure? Seems weak to me.
EN: [FAILED] If that's the best you can muster, then it's you who should be backing up slow, and your buddies with you.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Look, either you're going to leave, or you're going to fight. So decide.
EN: I think you're cashed out enough that my chances are pretty good. And like I said, I'm not leaving the Dam now the Legion's been broken.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Um, well, I'm sure if ask them they'll be on board.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated, pissed}This has been a fuck of a day.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Um, well, I'm sure if ask them they'll be on board.
EN: Who's to say? I just suggested coming to Hoover Dam to them, and BOOM.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Um, well, I'm sure if ask them they'll be on board.
EN: [FAILED] No, I think they blew their load here today with their fireworks... they'll prefer targets closer to home.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Once I radio the Brotherhood, they can handle the fighting elsewhere.
EN: The Brotherhood? On the attack? I think we would have heard something from them by now.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: I think how I handled the Legate should be enough for you.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated, downcast}No... no, you're here in the Legate's camp first, I think that says enough.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I think how I handled the Legate should be enough for you.
EN: I just stood down Caesar's toughest General... you think I won't?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: I think how I handled the Legate should be enough for you.
EN: [FAILED] And maybe you fed him a line of Brahmin shit, too, enough to make his dumb ass think twice... I ain't Legion, and I need more than words.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: While the Boomers fly West? Works for me.
EN: They wouldn't.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: I doubt you know how bad the generator is by looking at it, trust me.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Beaten}No... I can tell it'd just be a wasted trip.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I doubt you know how bad the generator is by looking at it, trust me.
EN: Send an engineer down to inspect the turbine and the housing - let them tell you.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: I doubt you know how bad the generator is by looking at it, trust me.
EN: [FAILED] Considering how long we've been here, we know it well. We've patched this place up plenty - we'll get it running again.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Even if you fixed the generators, hacking the code won't be easy.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fucking PreWar RobCo pieces of shit...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Even if you fixed the generators, hacking the code won't be easy.
EN: Even if you fix it, you couldn't re-program the power grid, the systems are fried.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Even if you fixed the generators, hacking the code won't be easy.
EN: [FAILED] {Sarcastic}Yeah, now where would we find an experienced computer specialist in the NCR? We'll find one, don't you worry.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Last I looked, that generator was on its last legs.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {He's beaten}Of all the goddamn luck...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Last I looked, that generator was on its last legs.
EN: <Bluff> The generator is beyond repair, trust me.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Last I looked, that generator was on its last legs.
EN: [FAILED] Oh, "last you looked," huh? Yeah, we'll take another look... after you haul ass outta here.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Oh, with a crack squad like at HELIOS One? Try it.
EN: Even if we're running at one percent for a year, it's still worth holding this place.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Is talking all you can do? I can talk tough, too - real tough.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah... but I wasn't expecting a fight when I came up here. {Beat}And now that we're talking, I don't like the sound of things.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Is talking all you can do? I can talk tough, too - real tough.
EN: <Bluff> Because you're talking and not attacking?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Is talking all you can do? I can talk tough, too - real tough.
EN: [FAILED] {Chuckles}That so, well, if all you brought is words, then this is going to be one short conversation.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: You think these robots are all the forces I have?
EN: Right now, they're all that's standing here - well, except for the corpses. So that's your plan, hold the Dam here all by your lonesome?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Because the Generator's destroyed, the Dam is useless to you.
EN: Lot of PreWar factories and tech lying around the Mojave, our engineers'll get it running again, no matter how much damage you've done down there.

Speaker: James Garret
Topic_Name: I wasn't able to find all of the escorts you're looking for.
EN: That's unfortunate, but it's not like we're losing any existing business over it. Thanks for looking.

EN: That's unfortunate, but it's not like we're losing any existing business over it. Thanks for looking.

EN: {Narrating}Shaped up by the Courier's advice, the Misfits distinguished themselves during the Legion's attack on Camp Golf.

EN: Mags was finally promoted to Sergeant, and the rest of the Misfits received an official commendation.

Speaker: Mags
EN: They continued to serve with distinction for many years.

Speaker: Mags
EN: {Narrating}Though Camp Golf fell to Caesar, the Misfits distinguished themselves during the Legion's attack.

Speaker: Mags
EN: Mags and her soldiers were posthumously recognized for their valor by NCR.

Speaker: Mags
EN: {Narrating}The Misfits' laziness caught up with them when the Legion attacked Camp Golf.

Speaker: Mags
EN: Those who weren't killed in the attack attempted to flee, but were caught at Mojave Outpost, court-martialed, and hanged from the ranger monument.

Speaker: Mags
EN: {Narrating}Driven into a frenzy by their use of Psycho, the Misfits inflicted heavy casualties on the Legion during the defense of Camp Golf.

Speaker: Mags
EN: At first they were commended for their valor, but eventually, desperate for more of the chem, they turned on travelers in Outer Vegas.

Speaker: Mags
EN: For their dishonorable conduct, the NCR court-martialed and executed them by firing squad.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}With the King dead and most of their gang slain by the Courier, the remaining Kings fled the area, never to be heard from again.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}After the NCR victory at Hoover Dam, the temporary truce between them and the Kings blossomed into a full-scale relief effort for the people.

Speaker: The King
EN: While the NCR made repeated entreaties that Freeside join the Republic, the Kings steadfastly maintained their independence.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}Accusing the Kings of lying with a foreign invader for their newfound ties to the NCR, Mr. House punished them by ordering their forced removal.

Speaker: The King
EN: The Kings, defiant to the end, were destroyed to the last man by House's Securitrons.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}Following the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, Freeside came to be known as one of the more stable areas in the region.

Speaker: The King
EN: Ironically, NCR refugees found Freeside safer than most of the rest of New Vegas, where resentment still lingers.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}After their victory at Hoover Dam, the Legion quickly set about destroying all remaining resistance, including any groups with ties to the NCR.

Speaker: The King
EN: Upon discovering the Kings' newfound relationship with the NCR, Legionaires flooded the streets of Freeside, and the Kings were quickly destroyed.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}While the NCR was busy fighting the Legion at Hoover Dam, some Kings took it upon themselves to attack NCR citizens and soldiers around Freeside.

Speaker: The King
EN: When the NCR moved to secure the region, they cracked down the hardest on Freeside, sending a full platoon to sweep the neighborhood.

Speaker: The King
EN: Most of the Kings were killed, with the few survivors driven out into the wastes.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}During the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, some Kings took it upon themselves to launch several attacks on NCR citizens and soldiers around Freeside.

Speaker: The King
EN: Mr. House looked on these actions favorably, seeing them as proof of the Kings' loyalty to New Vegas, and decided to leave them alone.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}In the aftermath of the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, the Kings took the opportunity to viciously force all NCR citizens out of Freeside.

Speaker: The King
EN: Travelers from the Republic quickly learned to avoid Freeside if they valued their safety.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}Impressed with the Kings' continued attacks upon NCR citizens and soldiers, the Legion offered them the option of being assimilated into the Legion.

Speaker: The King
EN: The Kings refused, and briefly became slaves in the Legion, but after failed escape attempt, they were all put to death.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}As the NCR moved to secure the region, the occupation of Freeside proved especially problematic.

Speaker: The King
EN: Things remained tense due to numerous incidents, though the Kings were still in nominal control of the area.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}Flush with his victory, Mr. House sent Securitrons into Freeside, thinking to increase his control over the area.

Speaker: The King
EN: When fighting broke out, the Kings fought valiantly, but were no match for the armored killing machines, and were wiped out to the last man.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}The Kings retained their control of Freeside, and while they continued to favor the needs of locals, they tolerated the citizens of the defeated NCR.

Speaker: The King
EN: {Narrating}After their victory at Hoover Dam, Legion troops rolled through Freeside.

Speaker: The King
EN: The Kings tried to fight back, but most were killed, and the rest fled into the wasteland.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}With Jacobstown's leadership destroyed, the remaining Super Mutants and Nightkin of the west scattered across the wasteland.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Jacobstown withered away, its death going unnoticed by the rest of the Mojave.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Thanks to the Courier and Lily, a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia was found shortly after Doctor Henry's experiment concluded.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Nightkin and other Super Mutants in the wasteland flocked to Jacobstown, and the town became known as a haven where a mutant could find peace.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Though a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia was eventually found, it became a case of too little, too late for Jacobstown.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Disgruntled by the death of their leader, Keene, most of the Nightkin scattered into the wasteland, their insanity worsening with each day.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Jacobstown, constantly on guard for anti-mutant reprisals, never truly prospered.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Though a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia was eventually found, it became a case of too little, too late for Jacobstown.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Most Nightkin at Jacobstown followed their leader Keene out into the wasteland, terrorizing the Mojave for years to come.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Jacobstown, constantly on guard for anti-mutant reprisals, never truly prospered.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}It took more time than anticipated for a cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia to be found, but in the end it was beneficial to Jacobstown.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}The presence of the Nightkin leader, Keene, persuaded Nightkin from across the wasteland to make the journey to the town.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}Jacobstown prospered, becoming known as a fair - if somewhat intimidating - place for a trader to do business.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}With no cure for the Nightkin schizophrenia in sight, the disgruntled Nightkin left Jacobstown. Without a treatment, their insanity grew.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}The crazed Nightkin terrorized the wasteland, and Jacobstown suffered repeated reprisals from mutant-hating humans.

Speaker: Marcus
EN: {narrating}In the end, the surviving mutants abandoned Jacobstown entirely, its existence quickly forgotten by the rest of the wasteland.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {narrating}After generations of being beaten down, the Great Khans were finally broken by the Courier.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: Those few who avoided the Courier's wrath moved north, into the wilderness of Idaho, where they tried once more to rebuild.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Narrating}After the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, the Great Khans returned for a time to Red Rock Canyon.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: The NCR's pressing need to expand proved greater than its promise of amnesty, and before long the government decided the Khans had to go.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: The surviving Great Khans were relocated to an isolated, barren reservation, well north of NCR trade routes.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Narrating}For supporting the NCR, the Great Khans were ruthlessly hunted down by the victorious Legion.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: Caesar destroyed all evidence of their existence at Red Rock Canyon, and forbade mention of their name in any history.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: The Great Khans' legacy was swiftly forgotten.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Narrating}As reward for their loyal service, Caesar forcibly integrated the Great Khans into the Legion.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: The sick and elderly were killed, the women sold as wives to ranking officers, and the tribe's identity was annihilated.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: Though many Great Khans mourned the death of their tribe, many more were ultimately satisfied with their revenge against NCR.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Narrating}After driving the Legion out of the Mojave Wasteland, the victorious NCR turned its attention to those who had allied themselves with Caesar.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: The Great Khans were among the first tribes to suffer this fate, and the few who survived Hoover Dam were driven north, into the wilderness of Idaho.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Narrating}During the Battle of Hoover Dam, the Great Khans quickly evacuated Red Rock Canyon and headed north and east into the plains of Wyoming.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: There, they reconnected with the Followers of the Apocalypse and rebuilt their strength.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: Bolstered by ancient knowledge of governance, economics, and transportation, they carved a mighty empire out of the ruins of the Northwest.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: {Narrating}After their suicidal last stand at Hoover Dam, the Great Khans ceased to exist as a tribe.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: The few surviving members dispersed, joining up with other tribes and gangs across the Mojave, and quickly forgot their heritage.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}Travelers continued to stop by Goodsprings Source for water on the Long 15, but rarely would anyone venture into the ruins of Goodsprings itself.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}Those who did were almost always tourists, come to visit the graveyard where the Courier "rose from the dead."

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}Goodsprings saw more trade along I-15 after NCR gained control of the Mojave Wasteland, but with that came a heavy burden of the Republic's taxes.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}Some old-timers, unable to handle the cost, were forced to move on, grumbling all the while.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}The Legion, preoccupied with its acquisition of New Vegas, scarcely took notice of the town of Goodsprings.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}Many locals moved on, fearful of Caesar's long shadow. Only the old and the stubborn remained.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}After Mr. House gained control of New Vegas, he sent a Securitron to Goodsprings as a token of appreciation for helping the Courier.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}Victor was a mixed blessing, however, as he continually monitored the town for Mr. House.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}With New Vegas' independence formally declared, Goodsprings thrived.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: {narrating}More travelers stopped by Goodsprings on their way to and from the Strip, and the locals grew prosperous from the traffic.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}With no clear leader to guide efforts in Freeside, the Followers of the Apocalypse lost control of Old Mormon Fort to local thugs and junkies.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}Eventually, using the Followers' remaining supplies to manufacture drugs, the Old Mormon Fort quickly devolved into little more than a junkie den.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}After the NCR's victory at the dam, the Followers of the Apocalypse were pushed out of Old Mormon Fort during its occupation by NCR forces.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}NCR further "encouraged" them to leave Outer Vegas entirely, and the Followers had no choice but to comply.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}After the NCR's victory at the dam, in part thanks to Follower medical support, NCR allowed the Followers to care for refugees as they see fit.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}Old Mormon Fort expanded its services and was able to aid more people, becoming a refuge for the less fortunate citizens of New Vegas.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}After the Legion's victory, the new Caesar learned the Followers had "defamed" the original Caesar's noble origins.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}The Followers of the Apocalypse were hunted down and exterminated, and Old Mormon Fort was turned into a pile of rubble.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}After the Legion's victory, Caesar, out of a strange respect for his old fellows, allowed the Followers safe passage out of the wasteland.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}Reluctantly, the Followers accepted the offer and abandoned Old Mormon Fort to the Legion.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}After the Courier ensured New Vegas remain free, the Followers found that independent Vegas was even more unstable and violent than before.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: {narrating}Old Mormon Fort became excessively burdened by the influx of patients, struggling to provide even the most basic of services.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}Their leaders destroyed by the Courier, the Fiends scattered throughout the wasteland.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: Without the organization of Motor-Runner, Cook-Cook, Violet, and Driver Nephi, they were easy prey.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}Never weakened by NCR, the Fiends staged an attack against Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: Though NCR repulsed the Fiends, they suffered heavy losses in the process.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}The Fiends staged an attack against Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: During the NCR's retreat, the Fiends overwhelmed many of the troopers before Mr. House's Securitrons could deal with them.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}The Fiends overran Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: In the anarchic months that followed, the Fiends asserted dominance over Outer Vegas.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}Though weakened, the Fiends attacked McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: NCR repulsed the attack with minimal losses and, in the following days, destroyed the remaining Fiend leaders, breaking their power forever.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam and suffered heavy losses.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: Caesar, unimpressed with their performance and their dependence on chems, had them exterminated.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam, but the NCR repulsed the attack with minimal losses.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: When Mr. House asserted control over Outer Vegas, his Securitrons eradicated the remaining Fiends entirely.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: {Narrating}The Fiends attacked Camp McCarran during the second Battle of Hoover Dam and, despite suffering heavy losses, overran it.

Speaker: Motor-Runner
EN: They continued to be a nuisance throughout Outer Vegas, but never established full control over the area.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Narrating}Buried beneath tons of rubble, the Mojave chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel was no more.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Those few who were outside the Hidden Valley bunker when it was destroyed settled into new lives, or headed west to find a new chapter to join.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Narrating}During the fight for Hoover Dam, the Brotherhood took HELIOS One, inflicting heavy damage on retreating NCR forces, but it was a pyrrhic victory.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Once The Strip was secured, Caesar's forces overwhelmed and eventually routed the Brotherhood from HELIOS One and Hidden Valley.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Narrating}The Brotherhood used the battle of Hoover Dam as an opportunity to retake HELIOS One, and came to control the area between it and Hidden Valley.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: With no organized opposition, their patrols began monitoring trade along I-15 and 95, seizing any items of technology they deemed inappropriate.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Narrating}The Brotherhood and the NCR in the Mojave Wasteland declared an official truce, despite continued hostilities between the two in the west.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As per their agreement, the NCR handed over all suits of salvaged power armor and in return the Brotherhood helped patrol I-15 and Highway 95.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Narrating}Due to their temporary truce, the Brotherhood allowed the NCR to retreat from the Mojave Wasteland without incident.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In the relative peace that followed, Brotherhood patrols appeared along major roads, harassing travelers over any bits of technology they had.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}Without organized leadership, the remaining Boomers slowly drifted away, leaving Nellis Air Force Base to be flooded by prospectors and scavengers.

Speaker: Pete
EN: All of the Boomers' accumulated knowledge quickly scattered, and their existence slowly faded from memory.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}After the battle of Hoover Dam, the NCR mounted several campaigns against the Boomers, but all were quickly ended by the Boomers' artillery.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}Over time, as the Boomers found a need for gun powder, they developed a relationship with the Gun Runners, trading their surplus crops for munitions.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}Mr. House showed little interest in the Boomers and left them to themselves in Nellis.

Speaker: Pete
EN: The tribe remained fortified in Nellis with their backs to the world.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}The Boomers defended themselves against many attacks from the Legion, but they eventually fell to the Legion's superior numbers.

Speaker: Pete
EN: The Legion enslaved the Boomers and erased any memory of their existence from the wasteland.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}With little law left in the wasteland, the Boomers continued to defend themselves against the prospectors and scavengers invading their territory.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}With the help of the Gun Runners, the Boomers developed a healthy trading relationship with the NCR.

Speaker: Pete
EN: Eventually the Boomers began wandering out into the wasteland, while still preventing outsiders from entering Nellis.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}Mr. House showed little interest on the Boomers, who eventually began venturing out of Nellis to meet and trade with travelers.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}Cautious after the Boomers' display of power at Hoover Dam, Caesar chose to leave the Boomers alone.

Speaker: Pete
EN: The Boomers remained isolated but have been seen flying over the Mojave Desert from time to time.

Speaker: Pete
EN: {Narrating}Though the Wasteland became anarchic after Hoover Dam, the Boomers' display of power dissuaded fortune seekers from attempting to penetrate Nellis.

Speaker: Neil
EN: {Narrating}Though some Super Mutants and Nightkin continued to journey to the legendary Utobitha, they found little trace of its existence.

Speaker: Neil
EN: Some eventually found their way to Jacobstown, but many wandered off into the wastes, confused and disheartened.

Speaker: Neil
EN: {Narrating}Tabitha and Rhonda went east, through Caesar's land. Occasionally tales of their exploits found their way back west, though few believed them.

Speaker: Neil
EN: Eventually the stories concerning the duo were collected and published, and proved to be quite popular with children.

Speaker: Neil
EN: {Narrating}Black Mountain Radio continued to broadcast its peculiar form of propaganda. Raul Tejada faced his execution each day, though pardoned in the end.

Speaker: Neil
EN: Travelers venturing too near Black Mountain continue to be harassed by Tabitha's followers.

Speaker: Neil
EN: {Narrating}Tabitha, enraged by Raul's escape, took the remaining Nightkin of Black Mountain with her and vanished without a trace.

Speaker: Neil
EN: Travelers in the region soon learned to avoid the roads at night, as caravans were repeatedly attacked by unseen assailants.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}He was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the republic.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, NCR Victory, Male}Though the Courier's agenda was debated by many, he was honored by NCR for his support of the military at Hoover Dam.

EN: {Narration}He was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.

EN: {Narration, Good Karma, House Victory, Male}The Courier, fair and kind-hearted to those in the Wasteland, ensured that Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable and secure for future generations.

EN: {Narration}Mr. House afforded him every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, out of gratitude - and a quiet sense of pride for his choice in lieutenants.

EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, House Victory, Male}The Courier, who had a mixed history in the Wasteland, kept the status quo at Hoover Dam.

EN: {Narration}Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable, if not free, for generations. Mr. House afforded the Courier every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Evil Karma, House Victory, Male}The Courier, cruel and merciless, had ensured that Mr. House would maintain complete control over New Vegas and everyone in it.

EN: {Narration}Mr. House afforded him every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, partly out of gratitude, and party out of fear.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Good Karma, Indy Vegas, Male}Supporting the ideals of independence, the Courier was recognized as the man responsible for a truly free New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}He ensured Mr. House's tyranny was broken and neither Caesar's Legion nor NCR would ever gain control over New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Indy Vegas, Male}Preferring neither the best of the NCR nor the worst of the Legion, the Courier was the man responsible for a truly independent New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}He had removed Mr. House from power over the Strip and broken the influence of the NCR and Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Evil Karma, Indy Vegas, Male}Supporting all the chaos that comes with independence, the Courier was the man responsible for a truly free New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}He ensured the fall of Mr. House and the end of the Legion's and NCR's influence over New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}The New California Republic celebrated its second victory at Hoover Dam, establishing definitive control over the entire Mojave Wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}Soon after, they negotiated terms to annex The Strip, Freeside, and many surrounding communities.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}The Mojave wasteland, at long last, had entirely fallen under the NCR's banner.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}Mr. House's Securitron army took control of Hoover Dam and The Strip, pushing both the Legion and the exhausted NCR out of New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}Mr. House continued to run New Vegas his way, a despotic vision of Pre-War glory. The streets were orderly, efficient, cold.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}New Vegas continued to be the sole place in the wasteland where fortunes were won and lost in the blink of an eye.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}The Courier, with the aid of Yes Man, drove both the Legion and the NCR from Hoover Dam, securing New Vegas' independence from both factions.

EN: {Narration}With Mr. House out of the picture, the remaining Securitrons on The Strip were hard-pressed to keep order. {Beat}Anarchy ruled the streets.

EN: {Narration}When the fires died, New Vegas remained, assuming its position as an independent power in the Mojave.

EN: {Narration}The Courier, with the aid of Yes Man, drove both the Legion and the NCR from Hoover Dam, securing New Vegas' independence from both factions.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}With Mr. House out of the picture, part of the Securitron army was diverted to the Strip to keep order. {Beat, slightly lower}Any chaos on the streets was ended, quickly.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Chaos became uncertainty, then acceptance, with minimal loss of life. {Beat}New Vegas assumed its position as an independent power in the Mojave.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}The Legate is crowned as the new Caesar. He entered The Strip as though it was a military target, destroying anyone who resisted him.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}The Legion brutally occupied all major locations, killing and enslaving a large amount of the population.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}Under the Legion's banner, civilization - savage as it was - finally came to the Mojave wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}Caesar entered The Strip as though it was his Triumph. The Legion pushed the NCR out of New Vegas entirely, driving them back to the Mojave Outpost.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}The Legion occupied all major locations, enslaving much of the population and peacefully lording over the rest.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {narrating}Under the Legion's banner, civilization - unforgiving as it was - finally came to the Mojave wasteland.

Speaker: Raul
EN: {Narrating}After a long and eventful life, Raul's luck finally ran out during his time with the Courier.

Speaker: Raul
EN: {Narrating}Still grappling with self-doubt over his usefulness in the face of old age, Raul was never able to find peace with himself.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Eventually, he left the Mojave and assumed a new name, as he had done so many times before.

Speaker: Raul
EN: {Narrating}Invigorated by his travels with the Courier, Raul once more took up his guns in memory of his lost Rafaela.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Soon after, the Mojave was filled with tales of the ghost-vaquero who hunts down those who prey on the weak.

Speaker: Raul
EN: {Narrating}Convinced that his time as a gunslinger was past, Raul made peace with the idea of growing old.

Speaker: Raul
EN: After traveling with the Courier for a time, he retired and settled down in Outer Vegas, where he would spend his days fixing ancient machinery.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}At odds with leadership over the Brotherhood's future, Veronica looked to the Mojave Wasteland for an answer both she and they could live with.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}But the answer would never come, and the dangers of the world that had left the Brotherhood of Steel behind would eventually claim her life.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Hoping to lead the Mojave Brotherhood down a new path, Veronica sought to learn from the thriving cultures of the desert.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Absent a firm solution, Veronica's expression of frustration with Brotherhood leadership would lead to her banishment.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}She ended her days a wandering tinker.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Despite her departure from the group, the Brotherhood's peace treaty with NCR came as some relief to Veronica.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Though she remained friendly with surface patrols, she was never again permitted to enter the bunker she once called home.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Fearing for the safety of anyone she associated with, she continued her solitary life as a scavenger.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}But reports would emerge from Mojave scientists and social workers of old equipment miraculously repaired and research notes mysteriously completed.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Though she'd seen the writing on the wall, the destruction of the Mojave Brotherhood came far more suddenly than Veronica had expected.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}The news devastated her. Despite her best efforts to leave her past behind, she found herself compelled to make one final journey to Hidden Valley.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}There, she paid her last respects to the only family she had ever known.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}The Brotherhood's open aggression along the New Vegas highways troubled Veronica greatly.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Nevertheless, it removed all doubt from her mind that in leaving them she had made the right choice.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Eventually she would take to the road, less in hopes of finding a new home than of leaving memories of the old one behind her.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}The peace with NCR served to ease Veronica's worries about the Brotherhood's immediate future.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Still, a distance had arisen between her and her fellow members that would never be bridged.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}She began secluding herself in crumbling libraries of the Old World, learning of promising technologies she knew the Brotherhood would never adopt.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}The death of the Mojave Brotherhood came much too soon for Veronica, and in their absence, she felt truly lost.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Yet in its wake, she took small comfort in her decision to remain by their side through their few remaining days.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Narration}Veronica put her moral sensibilities aside and supported the Brotherhood's new campaign of aggression as best she could.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Yet deep down, she understood that it meant their end would surely be soon to follow.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Lily's long life finally came to a close in the Mojave Wasteland. As the life faded from her, her last thoughts were of her grandchildren.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Encouraged by the Courier to take her medication regularly, Lily's mind eventually attained a semblance of clarity.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Her memories dulled by the pills, she cast aside the recording of her grandchildren, no longer remembering its significance.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Lily continued to take her medicine at half-doses, and although she remembered her grandchildren, her mind remained muddled and confused.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Eventually, she parted ways with the Courier and traveled west, seeking the remnants of her past.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Encouraged by the Courier to stop taking her medication altogether, Lily's instabilities grew worse with each passing day.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Eventually she became little more than a ravening beast, the kindly old grandmother subsumed beneath the rage.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: {Narrating - ED-E Dies}After a long and fantastic journey, ED-E finally met its end with the dangers of the Mojave.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: It lay destroyed and gathering dust, waiting for scavengers to pick through its remains for salvage.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: {Narrating ED-E Unrepaired}ED-E remained forgotten in the shop of Johnson Nash, until it was repaired by another courier who let it continue on its journey to Navarro.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: ED-E was eventually discovered by the Followers of the Apocalypse who managed to recover vast databanks of scientific knowledge.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: {Narrating ED-E Found/unresolved}ED-E traveled with the Courier until one of its memory banks was triggered causing it to continue its travels on to Navarro.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: Upon reaching Navarro ED-E vanished and was not see in the wastes again.

Speaker: ED-E
ActorNotes: [Narrating ED-E Resolved With Followers - Not dismissed]
EN: {Narrating ED-E Resolved With Followers - Not dismissed}With its logs cleared and its systems upgraded ED-E  remained a vigilant and constant companion to the courier.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: The Followers of the Apocalypse used the information recovered from ED-E on Poseidon Energy, to develop new methods to harness the energy of the sun.

Speaker: ED-E

EN: {Narrating ED-E Resolved With Brotherhood- Not dismissed}With its logs cleared and its systems upgraded ED-E  remained a vigilant and constant companion to the courier.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: The Brotherhood used the information recovered from ED-E to create a small army of Duraframe Eyebots.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: {Narrating ED-E Resolved With Followers - dismissed}With its logs cleared and its systems upgraded ED-E is discovered by a traveling caravan, who take him on as a protector as they wander the wastes.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: The Followers of the Apocalypse used the information recovered from ED-E on Poseidon Energy, to develop new methods to harness the energy of the sun.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: {Narrating ED-E Resolved With Brotherhood - dismissed}With its logs cleared and its systems upgraded ED-E is discovered by a traveling caravan, who take him on as a protector as they wander the wastes.

Speaker: ED-E
EN: The Brotherhood used the information recovered from ED-E to create a small army of Duraframe Eyebots.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}He had survived police service in Colorado, the Great War, combat duty with the Legion, and being the companion of The King.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}But, in the end, Rex finally succumbed to the horrors of the wasteland.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}Having never received a replacement brain, Rex finally succumbed to old age, abruptly shutting down forever one quiet morning.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}After two centuries of life and decades of service to humanity, Rex collapses and dies.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}Revitalized by Violetta's brain, Rex eventually learned to balance the memories of his old life with Violetta's experiences among the brutal Fiends.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}His mind had difficulty adjusting, but Rex eventually found peace with his new, more vicious self.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}With the transplant of Lupa's brain, Rex gained all of the donor's experiences traveling with the Legion.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}These melded well with his own memories of the Legion, and his new mind quickly adjusted to the myriad memories.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}After Rey's brain was transplanted into Rex's cybernetic body, it took Rex some time to adjust to the old scrap yard dog's memories.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: {narrating}Eventually, Rex's mind settled peacefully, melding his own memories with that of long travels with Old Lady Gibson.

Speaker: Cass
ActorNotes: [Narrating Her Own Ending, slow and sad]
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending, slow and sad}Rose of Sharon Cassidy died as her caravan died - in an unmarked grave, another victim of the Mojave.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad}Despite the destruction of Cassidy Caravans, Cass lived for 30 more years.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating her own ending, sad}She made her way back West and passed away in a small shack outside of Vault City, the rose pendant still around her neck.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}The slaughter of the Van Graffs and the Crimson Caravan caused no end of trouble for NCR back West.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Already struggling, NCR's supply lines suffered further as the two caravans withdrew support until the "massacre in the East" was resolved.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}In the years following the destruction of Cassidy Caravans, NCR used evidence of the plot to blackmail the Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}NCR enacted strict trade laws with little resistance, strengthening their supply lines and their position in the Mojave.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass survived to see the NCR flag flying proud over Hoover Dam, and thought for a moment... {emph}this is what a hero must feel like.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass lived to see Hoover Dam in its Old World glory, humming with power the likes of which the Mojave had never seen.

Speaker: Cass
ActorNotes: [Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad, skipping is bad]
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad, skipping is bad}Vegas burned brighter than ever, Securitrons filled the streets, and Cass's heart skipped... just a little.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Her last words were to the Dam - and to herself. {Resume Cass Voice, sad}"We were going full speed ahead... but facing backwards the whole time."

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass lived to see the Courier bring down three armies and by her count, that was three more than she'd expected. {Beat, a little quieter}She'd kept quiet about that, though.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending}Cass lived to see the mark of the Legion on Hoover Dam. Uncertain of what lay next for the West, she remained silent.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Narrating Her Own Ending, Sad}As the Legion marched West, she found it difficult to see the Dam as anything more than a gravestone for the Mojave - and everyone in it.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}Though Arcade's intentions were pure and his goals were noble, he ultimately succumbed to the harsh brutality of the Mojave like so many before him.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}Tricked by the Courier and imprisoned by the Legion, Arcade remained Caesar's personal physician for several years.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Caesar grew fond of speaking with such an educated man on philosophical matters. Arcade became his unwilling intellectual sparring partner.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}After years of such servitude, during an unguarded moment, Arcade used a surgical scalpel and his bare hands to disembowel himself.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}Lacking any other skilled medical personnel, the Legion was unable to prevent his death. Caesar mourned his loss for months.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}Though the Legion was victorious at Hoover Dam, the Legate did not have the same medical needs as Caesar.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}{lah-NEE-oos}Lanius quickly tired of Arcade's acerbic wit and had the doctor crucified.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}During the retreat of Caesar's Legion from the Mojave Wasteland, Arcade was a sad casualty, one of many.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}His body was heaped with those of many others in a nameless ravine on the Legion's long march home.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Though Arcade had not hoped for an NCR victory, he was proud of his role in the defense of Hoover Dam against the forces of Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Unfortunately, when word spread that Arcade was once a member of the Enclave, he was forced out of the Followers of the Apocalypse.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}Pursued by bounty hunters, NCR rangers, and the Brotherhood of Steel, Arcade pushed deep into the eastern plains and was never heard from again.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Arcade had hoped that Freeside would be able to remain independent of NCR rule, but he was glad that Caesar's Legion had been stopped at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}He tended to the sick in Freeside for a while longer, then returned to NCR territory to become a teacher with the Followers there.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Though Arcade was crushed by the Legion's victory at Hoover Dam, he was not among NCR's casualties.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}During the NCR's retreat from the Mojave Wasteland, he helped defend NCR citizens and refugees on their way to Mojave Outpost.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Unfortunately, NCR rangers identified his father's armor as Enclave property. He was arrested, tried as a war criminal, and imprisoned indefinitely.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}When news reached Freeside that Legion forces were approaching New Vegas, Arcade did his best to help people escape with adequate supplies.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}A Legion explorer saw Arcade helping locals escape and pointed him out to a Centurion.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {Narration}Arcade's group was run down somewhere near Westside. There were no survivors.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Arcade was outraged by Mr. House's power play following the defeat of Caesar's Legion at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Though he remained in Freeside for a short time after the Securitrons established widespread control, he eventually traveled back into NCR territory.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Disillusioned with the Followers of the Apocalypse, he settled down in the outskirts of the Boneyard, where he worked happily as a family doctor.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Arcade was proud to have been one of the defenders who helped repel the Legion from Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}He was prouder still to see the area freed from the shackles of the NCR and Mr. House.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Though independence for New Vegas was not all he hoped it could be, Arcade used his Enclave knowledge and technology to keep order wherever he could.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Arcade was tending to the locals of Freeside when he learned that Caesar's Legion had been defeated and NCR was being pushed out of New Vegas.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Though he found that independence for New Vegas was not all he hoped it would be, Arcade did his best to help the locals govern themselves.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Though Arcade was proud to have been one of the defenders who turned back the Legion at Hoover Dam, he was crushed by Mr. House's ascent to power.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {narration}Saddened by the loss of life and liberty in the area, Arcade left the Mojave Wasteland for parts unknown. He was never heard from again.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Tired of waiting for the world to be done with him, Boone ventured into the wastes to make his own way out.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Unable to clear his mind of the past, he was at last granted the death he'd awaited, bringing final rest to a life that had ended long ago.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}As the Battle of Hoover Dam ended, Boone confirmed what he had always suspected - that revenge would never quiet his troubled mind.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Side arm in hand, he journeyed back to California in search of the NCR officer who had led the attack on Bitter Springs.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}There, with only two bullets loaded, Boone did the only thing he believed would put an end to his suffering.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Looking for a place where he could be of some use, Boone found himself re-enlisting with his old unit.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Though his regrets remained in his thoughts, they coalesced into a purpose, and Boone embraced it.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}He spent his leave time hunting down slavers in the desert, his First Recon beret the last thing they never saw.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Though NCR was withdrawing from the region, Boone remained in New Vegas, finding work as a security guard and caravan scout along the highways.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}While he might've preferred rejoining his old unit, Boone couldn't bring himself to abandon the city where he'd met his wife.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Boone refused to take the Legion's victory lying down.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Heading to the hills with his rifle, he began a deadly campaign against high-ranking Legion officers.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}And though the price on his head rose to levels unheard of, few pursued it, fearing it would be the last thing they'd never see.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}No longer held in check by his conscience, Boone found lucrative work as a mercenary and assassin.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}No job was too violent, no target too innocent. As long as the caps were good, Boone would take the job.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Driven mad by Caesar's victory at Hoover Dam, and unable to escape his memories, Boone staged a suicide mission against the Legate.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Fighting as he wished he would've fought on the day of his wife's death, he brought down scores of Legionaries before being caught.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Before his crucifixion, he was brought before the Legate, who expressed his admiration for Boone's reckless abandon.

Speaker: Boone
EN: {Narration}Boone spat tobacco in his eye, for all of Caesar's armies to see.
