EN: However, our unarmed techniques favor offense over defense. We can charge the enemy and flatten him with our first strike before he can react.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: Would Chet be willing to give us his supplies?
EN: {annoyed at Chet's selfishness}I don't think "give" is in Chet's vocabulary. Even with the town at stake, he'd still make you barter with him.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Well, if you can help, I'd appreciate it. Need to get these caravans moving.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: If there were any survivors, they're going to be in the Town Hall. If you can get inside, let me know if you find anyone.

Speaker: Boomer Teacher
Topic_Name: The children here don't seem interested in guns.
EN: Few children are, especially when they are born during a relatively safe time in our history.

Speaker: Boomer Teacher
Topic_Name: The children here don't seem interested in guns.
EN: Our children are protected from the outside world, but they are not ignorant of the dangers it holds.

Speaker: Boomer Teacher
Topic_Name: I think I could improve your curriculum.
EN: Really, Outsider? I'm open to ideas.

Speaker: Boomer Teacher
Topic_Name: Good to hear. The wasteland is no place for children.
EN: I agree. That is why we do everything we can to teach the children from birth to defend themselves and serve the tribe.

Speaker: Boomer Teacher
Topic_Name: What happens when they come of age?
EN: All of us are trained in combat and farming from a very early age. When we reach adulthood, we serve in whatever capacity we are best suited.

Speaker: Boomer Teacher
EN: Bye.

Speaker: Jack
EN: Thanks.

Speaker: Jack
EN: Thanks.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Actually. I can't spare anything right now.
EN: That's too bad. I was hoping to melt some more down for machining.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Okay, I'll let you know if I find a pressure cooker.
EN: Great, that's all I need to get the rebreather to work right. I don't think you'd want to start breathing water halfway down.

Speaker: Beatrix Russell
EN: What do you have in mind?

Speaker: Beatrix Russell
EN: Hey, who doesn't enjoy a little pinch and squeal every once in a while?

Speaker: Anderson
Topic_Name: You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something.
EN: Some of the other Followers mentioned you. All right - the truth, then.

Speaker: Anderson
Topic_Name: You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something.
EN: I killed Corporal White to protect Westside's self-reliance. It was rash, and I regret it now.

Speaker: Anderson
Topic_Name: You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something.
EN: We don't have the money to pay for the water, so I rigged the pump station to divert water to the local cisterns from time to time.

Speaker: Anderson
Topic_Name: It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?
EN: {PC Intelligence 6+}Fair enough. Since you seem to have pieced it together, I won't insult you by denying it any further.

Speaker: Anderson
Topic_Name: It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?
EN: I killed Corporal White to protect Westside's self-reliance. It was rash, and I regret it now.

Speaker: Anderson
Topic_Name: It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?
EN: We don't have the money to pay for the water, so I rigged the pump station to divert water to the local cisterns from time to time.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: I thought you said I didn't have to kill her.
EN: Yeah, if you brought her back here. Is she behind you or something? 'Cause I don't see her.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: I thought you said I didn't have to kill her.
EN: Now stop stalling, get out there, and do your fucking job already. Sheesh.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Can we discuss this another time?
EN: Sure, boss. Whenever's good for you - I've probably got three, maybe four months before I keel over.

Speaker: Raul
EN: That Loyal guy. He's getting up there in years, but he still finds a way to make himself useful to his people.

Speaker: Raul
EN: If you ask me, that's better than withering away all alone, or holding on to some faded piece of glory from your past.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Would it surprise you to know I used to be a gunslinging adventurer?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: We're not just talking about Ranger Andy, are we?
EN: Not really, boss, no.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Why do you care so much, anyways?
EN: He reminds me of me in some ways.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: It sounds like maybe you're talking about yourself there, Raul.
EN: It's a question I've asked myself often enough.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Why do I get the impression this is more personal to you?
EN: I guess it reminds me of my own life.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: It might seem harsh, but a soldier can't do his job properly with those limitations.
EN: You're preaching to the choir here, boss. Once a man's prime is behind him, he should let it go.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: With those injuries, he's nothing but a drain on resources. He should retire.
EN: That's what I love about you, boss; the pity you show for the less fortunate than you.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: The NCR put a lot of time and money into his training. He owes it to them to use it however he can.
EN: Even if he can't use them any more? Isn't that like asking you to come up with one of your brilliant schemes after suffering a crippling head wound?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: The NCR put a lot of time and money into his training. He owes it to them to use it however he can.
EN: Err, another one, I mean?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I think it's good that he's so devoted to his duty. More people should act that way.
EN: You think so, boss? Because I remember a time when a lot of people stuck to their duty no matter what.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I think it's good that he's so devoted to his duty. More people should act that way.
EN: It ended with nuclear bombs falling on my hometown.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I don't have time for your useless chatter.
EN: Sure, boss. I know you've got a lot on your mind, what with all that wandering the empty desert wastes.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Okay, boss. When you feel like availing yourself of my centuries of experience, you know where I'll be.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Meeting Corporal Sterling, well... it kind of got me thinking.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Here's a guy that's been beat all to hell, right? I mean, he could have retired from the service, but instead he signs back on and does what he can.

Speaker: Raul
EN: You think he did the right thing?

Speaker: Cass
EN: Go with you? {Thinking}And why the hell would I do that.

Speaker: Cass
EN: You got one too many by my count.

Speaker: Cass
EN: My father had heart problems, and it ran down the family tree to me.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not looking to have my heart skip its last beat, even if I considered putting that junk in my system, which I don't.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Well, keep it away from me, won't have anything to do with it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Gift from my Dad, along with my name. {Wistful}Rose of Sharon Cassidy.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Mom said he got the name out of some Old World book about dirt pilgrims. {Beat}Name sure sounds sweet, though.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Anyway, pendant's a little rose. Originally thought it was one of Mom's tribal necklaces, but no, came from Dad.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Any idea why he went East?
EN: Not a clue. When he left, I was too in my crib to understand why, and around the time Mom passed, I was too into my teens to listen.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Any idea why he went East?
EN: Got his name, got this pendant, and that's about it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not much to tell. He ended up walking East one day when I was young and never came back. Not a family deserter like some, though.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Mom died waiting for him, and she had me to raise. She was sick but she held off dying until I was old enough to be getting into trouble with boys.

Speaker: Cass
EN: As for Dad, I figure he just got himself lost or dead. {Shrugs}Happens... and I'm not all boo-hoo about it, so save your glass for someone who's crying.

Speaker: Cass
EN: You know, like one of the tribes from the East - we got 'em out West, too. NCR's herding 'em up, though, domesticating them.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Mom was from East of the Colorado, though, not sure what tribe. Was before the time Caesar rounded them up, made them Legion.

Speaker: Cass
EN: She walked a hell of a way until she crossed paths with my Dad and he convinced her to stop walking. And lucky for me, he was a horny old bastard.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Any other weapons you know how to use?
EN: What, you mean like spears? No, none of that. Mom was a tribal, but she didn't teach me anything like that.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Sounds good to me.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Dynamite's for when you don't have enough bullets, want to clear a pass, or scare off Geckos from a caravan.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Some of the twisters out of the Divide can block off a pass in no time, so you learn how to handle powder so you don't get trapped somewhere.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Any event, I prefer shooting if it comes down to an argument. Don't worry, I'll carry my weight if a disagreement arises.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Where did you learn to shoot?
EN: Short of caps is what taught me, mostly. Ammo's expensive... so I learned to make every shot count.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Where did you learn to shoot?
EN: And hear tell, my Dad was a crack shot, so I don't want to dirty the family name. Not out of pride - respect.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You any good in a fight?
EN: I'm fair with chucking dynamite {rising smugness}and not bad with a pistol, if I do say so myself. {Beat, a little lower}Carry a knife, too, but that's more for practical reasons.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You any good in a fight?
EN: Prefer settling things with my fists, though. Made more friends than corpses in bar fights - plan on keeping it that way.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You any good in a fight?
EN: {Frowns, a little defensive}Don't think I'm some kind of Vault City pacifist, though - if things get heated, I'll start shooting, trust me.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}After Hoover Dam, the leaderless Powder Gangers at the Correctional Facility vanished into the wastes, leaving the prison empty.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}The Correctional Facility became another abandoned ruin in the wasteland, its carcass occasionally picked over by enterprising prospectors.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}With the Dam firmly in their grasp, the NCR turned its attention towards wresting the Correctional Facility from Powder Ganger hands.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}The Powder Gangers are no match for the battle-hardened troops of the NCR, and summary execution awaited the Powder Gangers who managed to survive.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}Most Powder Gangers at the Correctional Facility fled into the wasteland rather than face the advancing forces of the Legion.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}Those brave or foolish to remain were killed or crucified by the merciless Legionaries.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}The NCR, battered by the loss of the Dam, were unable to devote any troops to retaking the Correctional Facility from the Powder Gangers.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: {narrating}As a result, Powder Ganger raids on caravans became an unfortunate fact of life in the Mojave for years to come.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: Ethel, darling!{Pause, as anger boils inside - wife just got killed} I'll... I'll join you soon again! Someone's gonna pay first, though.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Anyone stupid enough not to set a watch deserved what they got.
EN: {angry, but more tired}Maybe we made a mistake. It was early on, we didn't know just how serious it was out there.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Anyone stupid enough not to set a watch deserved what they got.
EN: But to say they deserved it? What kind of devil are you, {sarcastic emphasis}boss?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: You can't think it was your fault. No one could stand against a dozen armed men all alone.
EN: I know that, boss. That's not what I'm getting at. I'm just getting sentimental in my old age. Anyways, forget it. Just wanted that off my chest.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: And you blame yourself for this?
EN: Maybe. I don't know. All I know is that for all my skill with a pistol, I couldn't help them.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: And you blame yourself for this?
EN: Anyway, that was weighing on my mind. Thanks for letting me get it out in the open, boss.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Rafaela and I ran. We were pursued by some of the men who attacked our home, but I was always a good shot.

Speaker: Raul
EN: The ones who came after us, I killed. The rest, I left be. I had to take care of Rafaela, not throw my life away on revenge.

Speaker: Raul
EN: About two dozen men came back in the night, after we'd gone to sleep. They set fire to the ranch house and barred the doors from the outside.

Speaker: Raul
EN: My whole family was trapped inside. I smelled the smoke and got myself and my little sister, Rafaela, out though a window, but everyone else....

Speaker: Raul
EN: My parents, my grandmother, my two brothers and two of my sisters all died.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Just a few days after Mexico City was vaporized, refugees started pouring down the road to our ranch. We helped who we could, but there were so many.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Eventually, my father started turning people away before we ran out of food. Things got violent. My father and I got our guns, and we drove them off.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I don't really have time for this, Raul. Maybe later?
EN: Sure, boss. Whenever's good for you.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Are you talking about something from your own past?
EN: A memory from a long time ago.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I suppose if you're happy with that kind of life, it's not so bad.
EN: Maybe... but what if you miss the old days, sometimes?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Is that something you're afraid of?
EN: That fear has always been a part of my life.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: At least he knew when to step back and start to take it easy. A lot of people don't.
EN: Yeah, it beats dying alone in the Wasteland because you were too slow.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Old history, boss.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Loyal's using his years of knowledge to help his tribe. I think that's a noble goal.
EN: {A little uncertain}Yeah. That's what I thought, too.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Don't waste my time with your reminiscing, Raul.
EN: Whatever you say, boss. I'll just stay back here and be quiet in case you have a sudden flash of brilliance you need to share.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Already cleared the roads for Jackson.
EN: {Blinks}No shit? Drink's on me, then.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Already cleared the roads for Jackson.
EN: Still, not like I'm going anywhere. Caravan title's still keeping me here, even though it's dead and gone.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: That drinking's going to get you in trouble in a second.
EN: Trouble's already come and went, so anything {emph}you bring will make my next drink go down easier.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'd slow down on that whiskey, if I were you.
EN: Yeah, well, you {emph}aren't me, so good-for-fucking-you.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: So you're out of the caravan business?
EN: Sure am. Burned for the last time, and this time, it's for good. Worse, it's not done kicking me - I'm still {emph}trapped here.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: What are you going to do?
EN: Drink. Got a lot of memories to drown. If I die while doing it, so be it. Got nowhere else to go.

Speaker: Cass
EN: NCR officer, trooper, whatever - runs the place. He's over in the main building, the one {emph}without a bar.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Jackson won't let me head north, it's not safe... and even though my caravan's gone, my caravan {emph}papers are keeping me here.

Speaker: Cass
EN: So if you came here for work, {emph}my advice? Go find the Crimson Caravan branch, south of Vegas. {Bitter, emph}They can help you out.

Speaker: Cass
EN: My guess is Legion, they're trying to cut NCR's supply line... and the Mojave Outpost is proof. Got us locked up tighter than a New Vegas virgin.

Speaker: Cass
EN: No caravans in, out, and just {emph}try arguing with Jackson about it. "Roads aren't safe," he says.

Speaker: Cass
EN: No shit, you washed-out old fuckup, I didn't need a Brotherhood Scribe to tell me that.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Uh, how about you keep your hands by your sides.
EN: Don't worry, not looking to throw punches just yet. {Beat}And something tells me hitting you would be a mistake I wouldn't want to repeat.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, if you couldn't tell, I'm not from around here and I'm not NCR. I run a caravan... or did.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: What are you trying to forget?
EN: Lost my caravan heading north, the driver burned to ash - and they didn't even take the cargo, they just burned that, too.

Speaker: Cass
EN: All right? No, I'm not all right.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Drinking to forget, and it's only getting me mad instead. Whiskey always gets my temper up - now more than ever.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Drinking used to cause all sorts of trouble back West - before I punched enough people, that is, and they learned to lay low when the whiskey hit.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, on account of my name... and the blossoms on my cheeks when I drink too much.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Won most of those fights, too. Can take a hell of a punch and give it right back when I've got a bottle in me.

Speaker: Cass
EN: It's all in how you drink it, though - there's a trick to it. {Beat, nods}When we pass the bottle, I'll show you how it's done.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Is whiskey your drink of choice?
EN: Not sure if I chose it or it chose me. {Beat}Dad ran a bar a long time ago, and it was a labor of love, Mom said. Didn't sound like it made her happy.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Is whiskey your drink of choice?
EN: Still, I'm guessing I got some of Dad's love of whiskey in me, because the burn suits me fine.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Is whiskey your drink of choice?
EN: Used to call me "Whiskey Rose" back West, before I punched enough people, so now they say it, but quiet and when I'm not around.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: All right. Come on, let's go.
EN: {Relieved to be leaving}Thank god, the sooner the better.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Sarcastic}Aside from the TV-faced robots, the dust, and the old man smell in every room? Nothing, it's a paradise.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Uneasy}This place has the Old World Blues about it. Everything in here feels like it should have passed on a long time ago.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Hell, it's hard to believe Vegas is right outside. So, yeah, I'm looking to leave whenever you're ready.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Stay here, you know exactly what's going to happen, day in, day out.
EN: So fighting boredom is your argument, huh?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Do you really want to stay in this shithole?
EN: {Player's got a point}Hnh. The Outpost lost its charm about three bottles ago, and that was just this morning.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: If your world's a whiskey bottle, there's more out there.
EN: {Sarcastic}Oh, that's got just the right bite of judgment to it, stings a little, too. {Beat}Did you hear that from a Followers preacher?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: If your world's a whiskey bottle, there's more out there.
EN: I bet you could preach all day, who knows what other little bits of wisdom might spill out.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why not? I could use someone who knows the roads.
EN: So you're looking for someone to help, not just tag along? Hnh.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Maybe it's not where you go, it's the company.
EN: {Incredulous}"It's the company?" That has {emph}got to be the biggest load of Brahmin shit I've ever heard.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Maybe it's not where you go, it's the company.
EN: Still, if you got more like that...

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Irritated}Where? Like Vegas? Chewed and spit enough friends out. East? Get put in one of Caesar's little "camps?" No thanks.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Head back West? I already know the Big Circle and everyone in it - 'cept now I go back there, ruined.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Thinking}Never really realized how small the Mojave's getting nowadays, hard to find a place to go to that's worthwhile.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: That's... one way to put it.
EN: Didn't ask Mom to elaborate. Never heard her complain about his bedroom behavior, only complain he wasn't around to do it no more.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, he's been with NCR so long all he can see is the worst outcome of everything - so he doesn't do anything.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
EN: You're looking at it. It's a watering hole without much to brag about.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
EN: It's like a Brahmin drive gone wrong - supposed to be a gate north, but you come here, you get caught in the pen. Better to head back home.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
EN: If you don't have a gun and a will, don't matter much what you do when you reach here, except stare at that fucking monument outside.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Don't even tell me you missed it coming in. It's like NCR showing its dick to all the East.

Speaker: Cass
EN: If the Republic put as much effort into protecting the East as they put into those two asinine giants outside, then they'd be {emph}worth that monument.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Shakes head}Statues of two men shaking hands covered in blood don't seem to be nothing to brag about.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Slight exasperation}I'm speaking figurative, isn't any blood on their damn hands. {Beat, to herself, serious}Course, when Caesar comes walking through here, there'll be blood for real.

Speaker: Cass
EN: And after the blood dries in the sun, he'll melt that piece of Jet-induced sculpture down, and reshape it into a bull.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Which by my reckoning is making up for a deficiency of his. But no matter what the state of his pecker, he's sure giving the West a good fucking.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: What are those statues supposed to be?
EN: {Irritated, doesn't much care}One's a ranger, one's an NCR trooper, supposed to represent unification of West and East... or some such shit.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: What are those statues supposed to be?
EN: As far as those two iron lovebirds go, they've got more spine than you'll see in a year from the NCR government.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why are you here at the bar?
EN: Whiskey and me are old friends, keeps me going when times get rough. Like now.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why are you here at the bar?
EN: Got me into the caravan business, you know - had to start transporting water instead of liquor, though.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why are you here at the bar?
EN: If I hadn't switched over, I'd end my trip with nothing but glass bottles rattling on the back of the Brahmin.

Speaker: Cass
EN: If you're looking to sign on with a caravan, no - traders are bottled up tight here.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Caravan work's up north, check with the Crimson Caravan, maybe. Gun Runners might have work, wouldn't know for sure, though.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Still, if you got a gun, guts, and feeling like going on patrol, might be some of the soldiers around here have work for you.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: [NCR] I think they're both rangers, one desert, one NCR.
EN: Hnh. Maybe you're right. Brimmed hats always throw me off.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: [NCR] I think they're both rangers, one desert, one NCR.
EN: Well, fine, whatever, they can be shaking each other's dicks, wouldn't change the Mojave now.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Jackson might have something for you, if you haven't already spoken to that old buzzard.

Speaker: Cass
EN: He was looking to try and get troops to clear the north road. You can find him over in the other building - the one without a bar.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I don't know, seems to be a lot of attention on Nipton. Word is, one of the snipers in the nest on the roof spotted smoke from the East.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, her name's... Ghost or something... {mocking}fucking scary, ooooooh. {Sarcastic}Guess it's cause you'll never see her 'til your dead.

Speaker: Cass
EN: NCR and their goddamn nicknames, as if Caesar himself's gonna piss and run if he hears them.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Anyway, go on and head up top, ask her what's going on, if you haven't already. I don't much give a shit.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: I'll just wait here for Mistress Tabitha.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
Topic_Name: I hate to tell you, but Tabitha's dead.
EN: And I suppose you're taking credit for the deed, fiend! I will avenge her!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: Yes, Rhonda.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Mistress Tabitha, we should be heading off. Our journey has been much delayed, but we can catch up if we hurry.  Come along, now.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: It's just... such a shock to see Rhonda up and about again. I'm not sure what to do now.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: It is, Mistress Tabitha. How I've missed you so. This stranger here fixed me up right as rain. Is he a friend of yours?

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: It is, Mistress Tabitha. How I've missed you so. This stranger here fixed me up right as rain. Is she a friend of yours?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha}R-Rhonda? Is that you?

Speaker: Tabitha
Topic_Name: Does this mean you're not going to kill me?
EN: {Laughs}No, of course not. I... don't know what I'm going to do now with Rhonda back...

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38.
EN: Does it come with its own Deathclaw? Trust me, if you can't see it, something just as nasty's waiting.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38.
EN: Whole Lucky 38... the idea that there's this casino in the middle of a town of people, and only you're ever let inside?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38.
EN: {To herself}Feels like other places I've been. Something that isolated from everyday folks starts to take on a bad shine.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit.
EN: Bad suit, huh? Well, if assholes had taste, we'd all be feasting on shit.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit.
EN: Still... suit means money, and suits stand out, especially here in the Mojave. One of the larger towns, or Vegas, might be the place to go.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit.
EN: {Cold}Don't you worry, though, we'll sort this asshole out, rattle his cage a little.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Frowns}Can't say I've heard the name. Or heard about any man dressed like a seat cover.

Speaker: Cass
ActorNotes: [Slight incredulous that the player would be dismissive of being shot]
Topic_Name: I don't think it was personal.
EN: {Slight incredulous that the player would be dismissive of being shot}Well if it wasn't before, it is now.

Speaker: Cass

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Ringo

EN: It's a two-player game, and the winner takes the whole pot. You build a "caravan" using the cards in your deck.

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: What are the rules of Caravan?
EN: The goal is to create caravan bids that beat your opponent's bids, so there's more strategy than luck involved.

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: What are the rules of Caravan?

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: What are the rules of Caravan?

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: What are the rules of Caravan?
EN: So... you feel like playing a game?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Easy Pete

Speaker: Easy Pete

Speaker: Easy Pete

Speaker: Easy Pete

Speaker: Easy Pete

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Return when you've gathered all of their reports.

Speaker: Jack

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Come back when you've made some progress.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Well, about time we got a soldier... and not a recruit, you look like you've seen some action.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: No, I mentioned you might accidentally get supplied, and I meant it. Not allowed to contract mercenaries at the Outpost.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Get on now, I'll make sure this gets West and let the wheels of law start turning in the courts.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: It's a motive for what happened up North, someone went cruising through both compounds, killed them all.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: I know some things are hard to let go, but you and Miss Cassidy need to understand that, hear me?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: What is it? Let me see.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: All right. This is... this explains a lot of the lost caravans. I thought it was Legion work, but...

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Frustrated? No. I have my orders - signed, and approved all the way up the chain from Kimball. And I understand the reasons.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Sending more troops, yes, to reinforce the Outpost, no. Troops head through here on their way to McCarran or to the frontlines at Forlorn Hope.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Or they're on leave, on their way to New Vegas to piss away their pay. All of them, passing through.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: You sure seem like you have enough soldiers.

EN: Soldiers, no, recruits, yes. And the Mojave Outpost has been ordered to have a standing force at the NCR perimeter at all times.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: You sure seem like you have enough soldiers.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: So sending anyone out reduces the Outpost's numbers and would be in direct violation of my orders from back West.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Don't have to tell me twice, feel more alive than I ever have.

Speaker: Cass
EN: All right then, let's move out.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, something's wrong, I can feel it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: It's not any closer than the first, so if you'd rather let be, let me know.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Want to go check it out?
EN: Yeah, it's a ways, though, hell of a detour. You sure?

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not sure, let's look around.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why would they have done it during the day?
EN: No idea. Maybe catch the sun in their eyes? Maybe they wanted the caravan to come to them, walk into an ambush?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why would they have done it during the day?
EN: We should check the wagon, they may not have got everything.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why would they have done it during the day?
EN: Whatever we find, it's yours - least I can do for hoofing it all this way with me.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I may have already searched the area.
EN: Well, you have to know what to look for.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Thanks, I appreciate it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Some of the caravan might be ash, but we were expecting raiders and over-inquisitive NCR border guards. There might be something left.

Speaker: Cass
EN: If I'm there with you, shouldn't be hard to spot. And I'd prefer to see the bodies with my own eyes.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Already been there, nothing worth finding.
EN: Well, I still wouldn't mind going there and crossing my heart a few times, if only to make me feel a bit better.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Already been there, nothing worth finding.
EN: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Sighs}Only wishful thinking on my part, most likely. At the least, I'd like to pay my respects.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: How did you catch word of it?
EN: Got word back on what happened from Rangers, guess they found enough in the wreckage to identify it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Sighs}Up side of Vegas, hear tell. Trapped at the Mojave Outpost, so I wasn't able to run there when I heard.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Been weeks since it was hit, so the site's probably a Cazador nest by now.

Speaker: Cass
EN: All right, let's do it, listen to what he has to say.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Blinks}Well... Jackson in the Mojave Outpost could get it to folks in the West. I wouldn't trust anyone closer to the Colorado.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Thinking}And the Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs have their heart back West. {Beat}Not sure it'll do any good, though.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: No one enters into a deal like this unless they have dirt on their partner.
EN: {Blinks}No... No, I'd agree with that. And Alice and Gloria are two crows that'd keep something like that in their nest.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Because of what happened to your caravan.
EN: {Blinks}You're saying... they might need to do the same thing to each other some day. And evidence is easier than bullets.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I held off on filling them full of holes, so unless you give me a good reason to cool my heels soon, I'm not waiting much longer.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Impressed}No shit. There it is, the blood, the motive, as clear as day. They must have penned these with snake venom.

Speaker: Cass
EN: But... we got it, now what? Sure, this damns them, but only if someone listens.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.
EN: So there's just one more safe to crack? Hope you can get to it.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.

Speaker: Cass

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West.
EN: But if I see either one, go into their camp? I'm going to start shooting, no matter what you find.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
EN: NCR? Are you out of your fucking mind?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
EN: That'd take years... and with the war with the Legion, no way they're going to waste time running up the Crimson Caravan or the Van Graffs!

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
EN: And what makes you think any evidence can be found?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
EN: Don't care much for which one we kill first, whether settling accounts with McLafferty or making that bitch Gloria eat her hair.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
EN: The Van Graffs are going to be tougher, so we'll likely get killed there. If we go to the Crimson Caravan camp, we'll just need a lot of bullets.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
EN: Still, we give the Van Graffs the what-for, that means all those guns they used on my caravan - we can take and use on the Crimson Caravan.

Speaker: Cass
EN: No... no, I know. Just hard to say how I feel right now.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Feels... I don't know. I guess I feel relieved. I don't know what I feel.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Wait, that's not true. I think the NCR back West, when riled, is going to be the worst enemy the Van Graffs and the Crimson Caravan ever had.

Speaker: Cass
EN: They're all so mired in procedure and paper out there, the kind of evidence we gave is going to be worse than shooting them.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I think that settles accounts with me - and my men. {Beat}That was some tricky political maneuvering, but worth it, even if it takes a few years.

Speaker: Cass
EN: That's it. {Beat}Except for one thing... thanks.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not many people in my company would have done what you did for me without some hesitation or asking me to cool down.

Speaker: Cass
EN: But you backed me, even when the odds were against us. Words aren't enough, but - thanks.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Takes a breath}Yeah... yeah, I am. Never realized had all that anger in me. {Beat, cold}Makes me wonder how much more I can settle with bullets.

Speaker: Cass
EN: You know, when I first heard about them, I was so mad, but there was this little part of me that said, "you can't do to them what they did to you."

Speaker: Cass
EN: I say fuck that part. I feel purified, and I love the fact that there's no more loose ends.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Got it. Let's loot the place.
EN: {Grim, pleased}Music to my ears.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You sure you want to do this?
EN: Oh, I'm sure. Killing never felt so good, could almost hear the dead behind me guiding my hand.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You sure you want to do this?
EN: Now that that bitch is in hell, they'll have a shot at her, too. So what are we waiting for? We've got more work to do.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Some caravans deal with the Legion now because the security. If towns could get the same protection? A lot more tempting than you'd think.

Speaker: Cass
EN: A bunch of people would be willing to side with the Legion to not have to worry about Fiends and Boomers and Powder Ganger attacks.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Sad}It's not hard for some folks to sell freedom when the alternative is worse. Especially if being with NCR is going to get you on a Legion cross.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Look... and what I'm about to say, I don't mean as any offense to you, I know where your sympathies lie.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Look, don't get me wrong.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I wouldn't want the Brotherhood or the Followers or the Vegas families running the Mojave, all of them are a different kind of fuck-up.

Speaker: Cass
EN: NCR just has some shaping up to do. Maybe Caesar kicking them in the nuts is a nice wake-up call, is all I'm saying.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I just wish Caesar would kick the heads of NCR, not the feet. {Beat}I've fucked a soldier in my time - they don't need to get fucked by their orders.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Aside from the people in the towns, it's the soldiers that suffer for it most.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Ever seen NCR troops asked to go after gangs at three-to-one odds? That bear flag doesn't make them bulletproof.

Speaker: Cass
EN: And  when those gangs were caused by NCR in the first place, like the Powder Gangers? Caesar on a crutch, don't get me started there.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Yeah, I got that part, thanks.
EN: So NCR, tries to hold on to everything. They can't, because it's too big for them to get their arms around.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Yeah, I got that part, thanks.

Speaker: Cass
EN: They try to put their stake in everything they see.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Nobody's dick's that long, not even Long Dick Johnson, and he had a fucking long dick. Thus, the name.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You support it no matter what?
EN: I'm not some blind, flag-saluting do-as-they-will NCR lover. They're family, but let me tell you what family means.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You support it no matter what?
EN: You ever had a brother? Some dumbass younger brother, say, who knocked up the pastor's daughter, can't hold a job, and his home-away is a jail cell?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: You support it no matter what?
EN: That's NCR. Their compass is spinning, all the time.

EN: I guess hunting down ghouls like wild animals is okay. I mean, they're probably going to die anyways, right boss?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Ah, he's young, boss. He'll bounce back. Unlike some of us.

Speaker: Raul
EN: That wig is going to haunt my nightmares. Seriously.

Speaker: Raul
EN: {Hanlon has just committe suicide}See, that's why you should retire before your brain goes. Oh. Sorry, boss. Bad choice of words.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Just putting this out there, boss: if these Super mutants kidnap us and force us to fix toasters for them, it's on you.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Hey, I'm one of you! Don't eat me, eat the smoothskin! Oh, uh, sorry boss.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Lots of older people are still useful to their friends and communities.
EN: Yeah? Maybe you can introduce them to me if we find them, because I've never met one.

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: I don't have time for a game right now.
EN: All right.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: Don't worry - I'm not that good of a player.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Well, return when you have.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
EN: Good, let's take a look... Hmmm, if I'm reading this right, it appears that the NCR's grip on this region is nowhere near as firm as I thought.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
EN: I'll have to review these in detail, but these reports have given me much to think about. Thank you, outsider.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
EN: You've become someone I can count on, so I believe I can share something rather confidential with you.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: I'm not going anywhere with you.
EN: {Sighs}Your call.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: I appear to be lost. I'll just head back the way I came in.
EN: Not on my watch you won't. You either go with me to the Elder or I put you in the ground right here. Choose.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: So, you're the outsider that's been given leave to wander around freely. Desperate times call for desperate measures, I guess.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Name's Hardin. I'm the Head Paladin of this chapter, and I think we might be able to help each other out.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I don't know what the Elder talked to you about, but I can tell you this chapter is in trouble, and he's at the center of it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Are you willing to listen to what I have to say?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Please make all haste in your search. It is imperative that I know the results of his mission.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Relieved, sighs}Good news for a change. Your efforts have humbled me, outsider. You have done more than I could expect, even from my Brothers.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Moreover, I've been going over the scouts' reports and keep coming up with the same conclusion. The NCR is not the threat I've believed it to be.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We should not have had to rely on your help in this crisis. I believed my actions were guided by caution and prudence, but I now see the truth.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: People called me a hero after what happened at HELIOS, but I left that battle scarred by fear, and have allowed that weakness to govern my actions.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: That ends now. I will undo the wrong I have done my brethren, and lift the lockdown. With luck, we will once again flourish.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Please, take this. It is a small token of my thanks, and scarcely begins to repay the debt owed you, but is all I am allowed to give an outsider.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: This key will allow you to use our safehouse to the northeast. I hope it will prove useful in your travels.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: What was the job you mentioned before?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Interested now? {Beat, nods}All right.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: If that's all you wanted, I'm done.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Well, thanks for hoofing it there and back, even if it was bad news. Wish we could spare the troops to go hunting, but... {irritated}orders are to stay put.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: If that's all you wanted, I'm done.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Tired}Fucking Mojave's going to hell, and all I can do is sit here and watch.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Didn't mean to be the bearer of bad news.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Unless you burned the town, don't take blame that's not due. Things are going to get uglier before the year's out.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: In Nipton? Hell no. Town was a shithole, asking to be burned. Just not by Legion. Nobody deserves that.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Town's been attacked, not sure by who.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Skeptical}Well, if you didn't see anyone, they might be gone - be just like Powder Gangers to hit and run.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Town's been attacked, not sure by who.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: See what you can find in the Town Hall, there might be survivors.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: If I pass through there, I'll check it out.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Better than nothing. {Beat}But close to it.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Had to try. Smoke trail's getting thicker by the hour - {under her breath}wish Jackson could spare some men.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: All right. {Beat, smiling}Look at you, all fired up and ready to go. Wish the others around here had that kind of attitude.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Get serious}Listen - I don't want you getting killed for this, so if you head there and run into trouble, I'm asking for eyes and ears, {emph}not your life. All right?

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Hear any news from the West?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Dismissive}Kimball's Kimball, not sure which end is his ass or his head. Caravan families are causing trouble, Big Circle getting tense - the usual.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Hear any news from the West?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Look, you want gossip, go to the bar downstairs and listen to a whole lot of nothing. Me, I got to keep watch, {grumbles}then fill out the daily log.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Why don't you go check it out?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Got my post. Don't think I wouldn't go, too - if trouble's hit Nipton, town's got enough camping spots to rack up some easy kills.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Why don't you go check it out?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Not about to have Jackson bust my ass again, though, even if I came back with Caesar's head - rather be sitting here than in a cell.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Surprised, not good news}Legion this far West? You're fucking kidding me.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: That's not {emph}outside the border, they're moving in - and fast. {To herself}Nipton wasn't the most friendly town, but...

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Sigh}All right - thanks for checking on that, wish it set my mind at ease, now I'm more on edge than ever.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: [NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Studying player}Hnh. Maybe Jackson got some additional soldiers after all. {Positive eval, player's not jaded}Didn't take you for a trooper at first, you seem a little... livelier than most.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: [NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: All right, if you're here to assist, good, that's what I want to hear.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Not much to tell, one of the worst posts in the NCR if you're looking to be anything more than a babysitter.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Slight frustration in these lines}Full up here, but just enough so we {emph}can't send out patrols. Got to maintain a "standing force," Jackson's orders... {corrects self}NCR's orders.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Can't spare men for patrols or escorts, so caravans are backing up here like a Brahmin with a bottle in its ass. {Sighs}Typical NCR bullshit.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Never mind, I'll be going now.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Dismissive}Mind yourself on the plank going down.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Mocking, but not to the player}The pay? The pay is a good goddamn thanks from the heart of the Republic!

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Scoffs}Just shitting you with the NCR line, done wonders for morale around here. President Kimball keeps saying getting shot at is its own damn reward.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Do this job for me, though, I'll do what I can. People know I hate most everyone, so if {emph}I put in a word for you... that's gold.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: I think there's trouble in Nipton - no traffic from there on the roads, and while I can explain that away, the smoke from the town I can't.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: I'm sure it's been hit - what I need to know is if they survived it. Might be Powder Gangers with all that smoke in the air.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: If there's anybody left, they'd be in the Nipton Town Hall. Go there, check it out, let me know what you find.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not much, and I haven't had occasion to look for anything more than that.

Speaker: Cass

Speaker: Cass

Speaker: Cass

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: See anything at the second caravan site?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: See anything at the caravan site?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: See anything at the caravan site?

Speaker: Cass
EN: Don't matter much how we settle this, as long as it gets settled.

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I don't need anything in return for my help.
EN: It fills me with hope to see that people from the surface world are kind, and brave. Again, thank you.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Until soon, I hope, outlander.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Kindly! The leaders of this fine community have accepted us among them. They give us food and protection from the outside.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Some people here seem extremely unhappy. They keep talking about getting "shafted," "swindled," and "fucked."

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Apparently somebody did them ill, all the way inside the surface-city with lights - the Strip, and Freeside, they call it.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: We're lucky to be here, alive and well. The land's a mystery to us, but we'll find our place in it.

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
EN: {Almost incredulous}We thought nobody would ever manage to get past the radiation, and the ghouls!

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
EN: We owe you our freedom, outlander. Please, if there's anything we can do for you...

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
EN: Yes, I believe that, outlander. We owe you our freedom.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.

Speaker: Cass
ActorNotes: [Calming down, just avoided a surprise attack]

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Attacked out of the blue}What the hell is this shit?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?
EN: Don't know, not sure where to head to next.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Thinking}The only Van Graffs I know are the ones out West - well, except for Gloria Van Graff, and I don't know her all that well, nor do I want to.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Don't have any objections speaking with him, though if he's with the Van Graffs, he should know I'm not looking to buy weapons.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Jean-Baptiste in Freeside wanted to meet with you.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Jean-Baptiste in Freeside wanted to meet with you.
EN: {To herself, "Canadarian" is intentional fuckup}Either that or it's Canadarian or some such shit. {Frowns, to player}So who is this... "Baptiste" and what does he want?

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: What makes the surplus ammo inferior?
EN: It's all about quantity over quality. Trouble is, you'll be cleaning and fixing your gun a lot more than usual when you use those kind of bullets.

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo.
EN: Weapon mods are things like silencers, scopes, bigger magazines.

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo.
EN: Special ammo includes things like armor-piercing bullets which don't hurt the target as much but let you punch through armor easier.

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo.
EN: There's also hollowpoint bullets which have the opposite effect - you can kill unarmored targets easier, but they don't do shit against armor.

Speaker: Disguised Frumentarius
Topic_Name: For how long will I get this benefit?
EN: Stay an ally of the Legion and we will share our loot with you. If you start working against us - or become an enemy - our deal ends.

Speaker: Disguised Frumentarius
Topic_Name: How long will I get this benefit?
EN: As long as you don't become an outright enemy of the Legion, payment will continue.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I have some things to take care of before the battle.
EN: {tense}Then handle them with dispatch. The Legion's assault is imminent.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: We've accomplished a great deal, you and I. One last task, and our work is complete. I'll see you in the control room.

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: I'm not an enemy, if that's what you're asking.

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: I'm not an enemy, if that's what you're asking.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: Did you want something else?

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: What do you know about the other group?

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: What do you know about the other group?
EN: I hear rumors, that's about it. Supposedly they keep slaves and they got some real nasty ways of killing folks.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: What do you know about the other group?

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: What does the NCR keep you safe from?

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: What does the NCR keep you safe from?
EN: They're protecting their own. Just happens to help us.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: What does the NCR keep you safe from?
EN: They've been holding off this other group from the East, too.

Speaker: Alice McLafferty
Topic_Name: Cass isn't around anymore, so I won't be able to complete the negotiation for you.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: If you run the town, they'll have to work for you. Food, water, and money will be yours.
EN: {realizing player has a good idea}Shit, yeah. Mayor Cobb - I like the sound of that. Running my own town will give me more pull with the guys at the prison, too.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: If you run the town, they'll have to work for you. Food, water, and money will be yours.

Speaker: Joe Cobb

Speaker: Joe Cobb
EN: They've got troops all over the Mojave, but it's a big desert so it's pretty easy to avoid them if you want.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Legion?

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Legion?

Speaker: Joe Cobb

Speaker: Joe Cobb

Speaker: Joe Cobb
EN: {thoughtful}Having all the food we want ain't a bad idea, actually. Getting sick of eating prison rations.

Speaker: Joe Cobb

Speaker: Loyal
Topic_Name: Where should I look for spare parts?

Speaker: Loyal
Topic_Name: Funny you should mention that, I have array parts right here.

Speaker: Loyal
Topic_Name: I passed through a place called Helios One. Maybe I could find parts there.
EN: Are you talking about that damn bright light we've seen blast off to the south occasionally? I was wondering what the hell that was.

Speaker: Loyal
Topic_Name: I passed through a place called Helios One. Maybe I could find parts there.
EN: If they've got the parts, bring them on back. We need to get the array back up and charging.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
EN: Good. We'll still need a plan before we rush the town. I don't want to embarrass myself and get beat by a bunch of townies.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
EN: We ain't got much in the way of supplies, so if you could shake down the old doctor and the store owner for some stuff, we'd be in good shape.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
EN: Once you're done with that stuff - or none of it - say the word and we'll make our move.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: I've done all I can. Let's take over Goodsprings.
EN: It's about time. I saw some of the townies gathering at the saloon, so we've got a militia to take down. We get rid of them and we own this place.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right, that does sound bad. Here, take these - it should be enough. Good luck!

Speaker: Player / Courier

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'll need all the medical supplies you can spare for an injured man down by the highway.

EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right! I can give you some of my extra leather armor and spare ammo. {pleading}Just don't hurt anybody if you don't have to, all right?

Topic_Name: The ghouls are no longer at REPCONN.
EN: Really? Unbelievable, man! I knew that wasn't gonna be easy.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: The ghouls are no longer at REPCONN.
EN: But I had a good feeling about you. You look like you been through a lot.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Okay, I'll see what can be done about it.
EN: It'd mean a lot to me.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Well they gotta go, or this'll be a ghost town before long.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Doesn't matter to me what you do. As long as the ghouls are out of there, that's good enough for me.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Why don't you deal with it?
EN: I would. But I've gotta watch the road. Caesar's Legion has been taking territory just east of here. They took Nelson.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Why don't you deal with it?
EN: If we let our guard down, they might attack. All it takes for the Legion is for them to sense weakness.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: I can't. I'm in a hurry.
EN: Say no more. I hope things work out for you.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Sure. Maybe I can help ease your mind.
EN: See? I was right about you.{in a positive way}

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: That's all I needed to know.
EN: Glad I could help.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: That's all I needed to know.
EN: Hey, I know you got no reason to help me now, but you seem really nice. Could I at least tell you about the problem we've got here?

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: That's all I needed to know.
EN: Hope that helps. I owed you.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: It's straight up Route 93 from here. Just keep following the road north.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Any idea why they went that way?
EN: No clue. I know Benny hadn't paid up yet. Maybe that was where they were supposed to get square.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: You've had your needs neglected for far too long, haven't you? I can tell.
EN: Yeah, I... everybody depends on you, you know? But they don't ask you about how you feel. What you worry about.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
ActorNotes: Surprised at meeting an understanding soul.
Topic_Name: You've had your needs neglected for far too long, haven't you? I can tell.
EN: There's something I like about you. You just seem really understanding. I was gonna ask you for a favor, but I'll just tell you what you wanna know.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: {NO-vack}Novac, it's home for me now. I want that to be for good. I like it here, and I've left too many homes behind.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: But the only resource we got here is junk. Without that, people wouldn't have anything to trade. They'd all have to leave.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: We get most of it up the road from the old rocket test site. But a bunch of ghouls showed up one day and took it over. We can't get in there now.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Forget it. I'll find him on my own.
EN: {Shrugs}Hey, do what you want. I'm just trying to make it easier on you.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
ActorNotes: [skeptical but going with it because he doesn't care]
Topic_Name: <Lie> He's a good friend of mine. I'm trying to help him out.
EN: {skeptical but going with it because he doesn't care}Oh yeah? A good friend? If you say so, man.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: Whatever he's doing, I want in on it.
EN: A piece of the action, huh? I don't think he's the sharing type, but okay.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Hey, doesn't matter to me. I was just curious.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: Must be something pretty important to be chasing a guy like that.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
EN: You talking about that chip? Man, I don't think he's giving it up.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: I have a score to settle.
EN: Doesn't surprise me. Guy seemed like he'd do whatever it takes to get what he wants. Probably makes a lot of enemies.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: I have a score to settle.
EN: Well listen, I can definitely help you find him, but I've got problems of my own.

Speaker: Manny Vargas
Topic_Name: I have a score to settle.
EN: Maybe we can do a trade. You need my help. There's something I need, too.

Speaker: [Context: EDEStatic]
EN: <Static>

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Uh... Hello? Hi. Are you there? Oh, right. You can't respond.{Pause} Listen, I'm using your robot as a relay to get this message to you.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I've picked up some unusual chatter regarding your robot. It seems that it has some information that we could use. Oh wait, where are my manners?

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: This is Lorenzo, a Knight with the Brotherhood of Steel. We'd be very interested in examining your tech.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Whenever you get a chance, can you bring your robot back to Hidden Valley so I can take a look at it?

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Hi, sorry to break in, he sounded truly riveting. I don't want to keep you much longer, but I'd like to make a counter suggestion.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse. We are much more liberal about the sharing of technology than those Brotherhood...{pause} People.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Bring your robot to us, we'll see that whatever information it may have on it is used for the greater good.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: No idea. Sounds like you two had a history for him to act like that. And turn down the money, too.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: Hope he didn't see any trouble in that package of yours. Maybe he thought your name was bad luck. Not for me to say.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: Do you know who he was? Where he went?

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: {Confused, whole thing was strange, slow}Yeah, got this look when he saw you next down on the Courier list. His expression turned right around, asked me if your name was for real.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
ActorNotes: [Delivered as "right as rain"] Previous text below
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: {Delivered as "right as rain"}I said, sure as lack of rain, you were still kicking. {Beat, slightly incredulous}Then he turned down the job, just like that. I asked if he was sure, it was good money.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: {Slow, foreshadowing}No, let {emph}"Courier Six" carry the package, that's what he said - like the Mojave'd sort you out or something. Then he just up and walked out.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: He canceled?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I have better things to do.
EN: Then that is your choice. If you should change your mind, please return.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Then allow me to explain our situation. This bunker is currently locked down, allowing no entry or exit, with you being one of the few exceptions.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In exceptional cases, teams are sent out to investigate sites or retrieve materials deemed too important to ignore.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Three such teams have gone missing recently, and the news of their disappearance has not yet been widely spread to avoid undue concern.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In order to maintain the peace, and adhere to the strictures of the lockdown, I need to send someone else to discover what happened to them.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Keep looking for them. The information they have is vital.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I already found all three patrols. They were all dead.
EN: {Solemn}I suppose I am not surprised. We have few friends in the world above, and many enemies.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I already found a couple of your patrols. The paladins were all dead.
EN: T-That is unfortunate. As long as there is a chance to find the remaining patrol, however, I must still ask you to try.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I think I already found one of your patrols. Both Paladins were dead.
EN: While that is disheartening news, there remains hope that the other two patrols may still be found alive.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I want no part of this.
EN: I half expected you to say that. In which case, I'll continue to pursue the matter on my own.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I want no part of this.
EN: Should you continue dealing with the Elder and find yourself beginning to see my point of view, I'll be around.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: How do you propose to do that?
EN: I don't know. I've gone through our records dozens of times looking for a precedent regarding the dismissal of an Elder and come up with nothing.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: How do you propose to do that?
EN: The people who are most likely to know how it could be done are also some of McNamara's strongest supporters, so they refuse to help me.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: How do you propose to do that?
EN: Which is why we're having this conversation. An outsider such as yourself would arouse less suspicion asking questions about such matters.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: How do you propose to do that?
EN: The fact that the Elder has some tasks for you means his faithful won't suspect you, and you have a line open to the man himself.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: How do you propose to do that?
EN: In short, you're in a perfect position to help me. Will you at least think about it?

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: The Scribes are responsible for discovering how all the old tech we recover actually works and sometimes even work on inventing new things.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Without them, the Brotherhood could never fulfill its mission. Or at least, that's what my dad always used to say.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Knights are in charge of all of our equipment. Power armor, gatling lasers, you name it. All of it built and maintained by Knights.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Knights also get to go out on patrols, scouting assignments, and support the Paladins in offensive operations.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Being a Knight would mean getting to see more of the world, fight the Brotherhood's enemies, and possibly someday become a Paladin like my mother.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Okay.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: What do you mean decide for yourself?
EN: I'm currently an Apprentice in the Brotherhood, and recently became eligible for Journeyman status.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: What do you mean decide for yourself?
EN: But first, I have to decide which Order I want to join - the Knights or the Scribes.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day.
EN: That was so much fun! The wind whipping through our hair, not knowing what was going to jump out at us at any moment.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day.
EN: And when those scorpions came out! It was just like the sims! All I had to do was line then up and squeeze the trigger.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day.
EN: I doubt I'll be able to get Stanton to go with me again, though. I thought he'd enjoy it as much as I did, but he was just scared the whole time.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Initiate Stanton told me about your little adventure the other day.
EN: Don't tell him I told you this, but when those scorpions surrounded us, I'd bet a week's rations he pissed himself!

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: So who do you take after more? Your mother or your father?
EN: I don't know, I'm a little like both of them I guess. If I had to choose, I really don't know which I'd pick.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: So who do you take after more? Your mother or your father?
EN: That's a question I've been asked a lot lately, since it's something I have to decide for myself soon.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: They both died at HELIOS One. The others were always like a family to me before that, but afterward they became my family in truth.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Well, like just about everyone else here, I grew up in the Brotherhood. My father was a Scribe and my mother a Paladin.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: You said "anymore" before. Did the Brotherhood used to go out more?
EN: Yeah, a lot more. Back when we were at the HELIOS station. Er, crap.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: You said "anymore" before. Did the Brotherhood used to go out more?
EN: I'm pretty sure I'm not supposed to talk about that, especially with outsiders, so forget you just heard that, okay?

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Shouldn't you be in school or something?
EN: Head Scribe Taggart quickly realized my extraordinary talent when I took the mandatory VR combat testing.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Shouldn't you be in school or something?
EN: Soon after that, he requested that I get transferred to VR specialist training, serving as his assistant.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
Topic_Name: Shouldn't you be in school or something?
EN: I miss hanging out with the other students all the time, but at least I get to skip all those boring lectures.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: It's our virtual reality training hall. We don't really go out all that often anymore, so this is how we stay sharp.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
EN: I do that all the time myself. One moment I'll think I've solved the conundrum, and the next I'm back to square one. Don't let it bother you.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
EN: Was there something else you wanted?

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
EN: Yes, did you have an idea that might help us?

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: What kind of information is in the datastore?
EN: {Excited, this is his favorite subject}Oh, all kinds of things! There was already information regarding the layout and systems of this bunker, but we've since added our own data as well.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: What kind of information is in the datastore?
EN: Prior to the lockdown, we had extensively scouted the surrounding area, and compiled dossiers on nearby points of interest.

Speaker: Knight Torres
Topic_Name: Anything I can help you with?
EN: If you must know, my inventory check this week shows that our weapon count is one short. Somehow we're missing a laser pistol.

Speaker: Knight Torres
Topic_Name: Anything I can help you with?
EN: Hardin will have my head if I don't find that weapon soon. I can't delay my report to him any longer.

Speaker: Knight Torres
Topic_Name: I could look around for the pistol.
EN: If you happen to find it, bring it here right away. I might be able to throw a few supplies your way if you do.

Speaker: Knight Torres
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Our patrols are always bringing more stuff in. Take a look.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: Not right now. I want to ask you a few questions.
EN: I suppose I could take a small break, but I can only spare a little time. Ask away.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: {Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}
EN: {Testy, Frustrated}I don't have time to think about silly things like politics right now. My main concern right now is getting this blasted datastore up and running.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}
EN: What do you think of Hardin trying to get McNamara dismissed?

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: {Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}
EN: I can understand how the man might be frustrated by the current situation. He's a take-charge sort of fellow. Standing around's not his strong suit.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: {Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}
EN: I myself often wish we could end this interminable stasis and begin moving forward again.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Ask Ibsen about Hardin trying to become Elder}
EN: Now that the datastore is fixed, what do you think of Hardin trying to get McNamara dismissed?

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: Vote for Hardin when he calls a tribunal.
EN: Fine, but you're making a big mistake. Hardin isn't half the leader that McNamara is.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: Don't worry, I'll keep your little secret.
EN: {Relieved}Thank you. There's no telling what would happen if everyone were to suddenly find out, but I trust it wouldn't be good.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: The rest of the chapter should be told!
EN: {Panicked}No! Please don't! Everyone would blame me! Look, I'll do whatever you want, just name it!

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: So you and the McNamara both know about this?
EN: {Resigned}...Yes. When I first discovered how much the systems had deteriorated, I reported it to the Elder right away.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: So you and the McNamara both know about this?
EN: He told me he'd take action right away, and sent out several patrols to search for parts.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: Your terminal had some very interesting things to say about the state of the air filtration system.
EN: {Initially outraged}What were you doing looking at my terminal? {Distracted, calmer}No, never mind that. You can't tell anyone about what you found!

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: Your terminal had some very interesting things to say about the state of the air filtration system.
EN: There'd be widespread panic. The Elder has the situation under control.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: Who {emph}was Elijah, more like. He was our Elder before McNamara. Bright guy, but just between you and me he was a little off.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: Our mission is to recover and preserve the technology of the past, but Elijah wanted more. He sought ways to improve upon technology, make it better.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: When we found HELIOS One, he was like a kid in a candy store. He kept talking about the potential, and a "grand design, never realized."

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: He even insisted we set up our base there, against the objection of nearly every paladin. What followed is a whole other story.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: I'm sure someone's told you all this before. Several years back, we were running our chapter out the HELIOS One solar power station.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: Our Elder at the time, Elijah, had some kind of obsession with the place. Which is the only reason we stayed as long as we did.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: That place was hardly defensible, and we knew the NCR was moving in on us, but the Elder refused to budge, insisting that he just needed "more time".

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: We never found out what he needed the time for. Wave upon wave of NCR troopers hit us from all directions.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: We held out for a time, but we were grossly outnumbered, and they had more men than we had ammo. Eventually our positions collapsed.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: Elder Elijah was nowhere to be found, so McNamara took charge and led what remained of us on a counter-offensive west.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: We lost a lot of men and women, but we broke through and made it here. Make no mistake, McNamara saved this chapter that day.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?
EN: So you've been talking to Hardin, eh? He's been looking for a way to usurp McNamara ever since the lockdown started.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?
