EN: Don't get me wrong, he's a good man, but Elder McNamara's done all right by us. If it weren't for him, none of us would have survived at HELIOS.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?
EN: I'll tell you what I told Hardin. There have only been a few cases of Elders being dismissed from their posts in the Brotherhood's history.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?
EN: And those involved crimes that someone like Elder McNamara is just not capable of. You can look it up for yourself, if you want.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What would an Elder have to do to get kicked out?
EN: I'll grant you access to that portion of the history section of our datastore. See Senior Scribe Ibsen about accessing it.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: Fine by me.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What exactly are the rules regarding entering and leaving?
EN: Under the lockdown, only essential personnel are permitted to enter or leave. That includes supply runners and high security patrols.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: What exactly are the rules regarding entering and leaving?
EN: All other personnel are forbidden to leave, and any personnel that were out there when the lockdown was enacted are forbidden from returning.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Did you know Watkins and Stanton snuck out of here a few weeks ago?
EN: {Laughs}Yeah, I knew about it. They're still young, and they weren't going to go very far.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Did you know Watkins and Stanton snuck out of here a few weeks ago?
EN: I had them on my monitors the whole time. I almost headed out there when they got surrounded by those scorpions, but Watkins is a hell of a shot.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: So why did I have to deal with that Ranger topside?
EN: Normally, that would have fallen under my jurisdiction, but the Elder thought it'd provide a good test for you, so I backed off.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: That's right. Nothing gets in or out of here without me knowing it.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
Topic_Name: You really don't like Taggart, do you?
EN: I don't appreciate how much harder I have to work to cover for his tendency to focus on his personal projects.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
Topic_Name: You really don't like Taggart, do you?
EN: I try not to think too much about his personal proclivities.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
Topic_Name: Was Initiate Watkins the "pet" you were referring to earlier?
EN: She's cute, isn't she? Like a puppy, almost. Unfortunately, our Head Scribe's intentions toward her aren't quite so innocent.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: Oh, I tried. The elder listened patiently to my carefully constructed argument regarding why that buffoon should lose his position.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: Then he just as patiently explained to me that Taggart's work was vital to our cause, and that he wasn't to be trifled with "lesser matters."

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: But vital to our cause? Hardly.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: If you wish.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
Topic_Name: You mentioned other duties you had?
EN: I'm this bunker's Head Scribe in everything but name. I supervise the research teams. I collate the reports. I attend the meetings.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
Topic_Name: You mentioned other duties you had?
EN: But for reasons beyond me, that buffoon Taggart still gets the title. And don't get me started on that little pet of his.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
Topic_Name: You mentioned other duties you had?
EN: Everyone around here knows what's going on there but her.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: We have equipment here to treat most physical injuries - lacerations, broken bones, that sort of thing. We also carry a full supply of antitoxins.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: You may have noticed the Bark Scorpions up above. Though tiny, their venom packs quite a punch. Treating scorpion stings is my most common procedure.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: I can also treat any form of radiation sickness you pick up out in the waste, no matter what stage, save the last.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: Yes, I handle all medical needs in the bunker. If you're ever wounded, I can treat you, for a fee.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: Normally I'd just be the base's medical officer, but my other duties say otherwise.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Nolan, we'll resume this discussion later. I can see you have company.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Have you tried bringing this up with the Elder yourself?
EN: Of course I have. Many times, in fact. The Elder has an open door policy, and will listen to advice on any subject, save this one.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Have you tried bringing this up with the Elder yourself?
EN: He refuses to see that our isolation is slowly weakening us. Aside from being our duty, going out on missions is what kept us strong.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Have you tried bringing this up with the Elder yourself?
EN: And because he fails to see that, he must be replaced.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What about Veronica? She seems to come and go as she pleases.
EN: Veronica's a special case. She handles the procurement of supplies. If we didn't let her and those like her back in, we'd all starve.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What about Veronica? She seems to come and go as she pleases.
EN: If the Elder could manage it, he'd shut them out as well, and all in the name of security. Which is why we need to replace him.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Why should you trust the Elder? I'd recommend listening to both of us, and choosing whom to trust for yourself.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: So are you willing to listen?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: No, I won't listen to you.
EN: If you change your mind, though, come find me, and we'll talk more.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: As you may have already heard, this entire base is under a state of lockdown. No one goes out except small patrols at night.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Most of the chapter has been sealed in here for years, and those few who were outside when the lockdown was initiated are forbidden from returning.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Morale has plummeted as time has gone by, and many of our current paladins haven't even seen combat outside of training simulations.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: And all because of the Elder's explicit order that no one be allowed in or out. The only way things will change is if a new Elder is installed.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: You've got trouble. The NCR are planning a raid on this place soon.
EN: {explosion heard}Sounds like they're already here. There's no way I'm letting them take me alive.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: You've got trouble. The NCR are planning a raid on this place soon.
EN: There's no reason for you to stick around and help us, but feel free to kill a few of the bastards on your way out.

Speaker: Trudy
Topic_Name: Why do you think the NCR and the Legion both want the Dam?
EN: I'm pretty sure the NCR wants to hold onto the Dam because it's one of the few places around that can make electricity.

Speaker: Trudy
Topic_Name: Why do you think the NCR and the Legion both want the Dam?
EN: The Legion are a bunch of savages, though. No idea why they'd want the Dam. Probably plan on destroying it or something.

Speaker: Trudy
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Legion?
EN: {disgust mixed with fear}Slavers, killers, and all other kinds of trouble. They dress up like Roman soldiers, so there's no mistaking it when you see them.

Speaker: Trudy
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Legion?
EN: The rumor is that the Legion is far larger than the NCR lets on, and that it's been due to luck that the Legion hasn't overrun the territory.

Speaker: Trudy
EN: The New California Republic's got the most power in Nevada. Money, troops, you name it.

Speaker: Trudy
EN: They do what they can to keep things safe in the region, but if you ask me, they're trying to do too much. They're spread too thin.

Speaker: Trudy
Topic_Name: Anything interesting going on in the rest of the wasteland?
EN: There's always something interesting going on, but the biggest news has to be the coming dustup between the NCR and the Legion over the Dam.

Speaker: NCR Ranger
EN: Three days.

Speaker: NCR Ranger
EN: {Dumbfounded}Crap, you don't even want to live a few more days? Go. Get laid one more time or something - we're walking away. Three days.

Speaker: NCR Ranger
EN: You're asking for leniency from us? Are you crazy?! We show up when the talking's over, get it?

Speaker: NCR Ranger
Topic_Name: What can I do about that?
EN: You've got three days to improve your reputation with the NCR or we come for you... without all of this pleasant conversation.

Speaker: NCR Ranger
Topic_Name: What can I do about that?
EN: Have a nice day now, you hear?

Speaker: NCR Ranger
Topic_Name: What did I do to the NCR?
EN: You got yourself a bad reputation with us - that's what.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Can you make me some of your Moonshine?
EN: Don't have all the ingredients you need - come back when you have 'em, and I'd be happy to get something cooking.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the items for making some Moonshine.
EN: {Warning}Look, no guarantee on the quality, only the results. And don't drink too much of this stuff or you might go blind.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the items for making some Moonshine.
EN: All right, I'll start brewing.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the items for making some Moonshine.
EN: Here you go. Go easy on it until you train yourself to choke back the urge to gag. After a few bottles and the vomiting, it ain't so bad.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, what else you going to do with an empty bottle? Wait for it to refill itself?

Speaker: Cass
EN: Get me some ingredients out of the Mojave, an empty bottle, a little time, and I'll keep us stocked.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Where do you usually go to drink?
EN: There's usually a bar in every stop along the road. Helps me sleep. Well, not really, but I tell myself that.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Where do you usually go to drink?
EN: Sometimes I have to brew it myself if I'm too far from a bar. Not quality, but I'm for anything that takes the edge off the day.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Hi there! Come with me!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Just to the top of the ridge up here...

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: See that? Vegas, right? Same as always - but not tonight!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Pretty nice, huh? But that's not all!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Now that the Lucky 38's reactor is fired up, Vegas doesn't need the dam to have power! Vegas is energy-independent! Whoo-hoo!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: If we keep the dam running, we can sell {emph}all its electricity to the NCR for a nice profit. Vegas doesn't need it!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Hope to see you soon!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: So I get to kill you over and over again. <Attack Yes Man.>
EN: Hahaha! I knew there was a positive in it somewhere!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: I feel really bad telling you this, but I kind of... can't die. I mean, {brightening}go ahead and destroy this Securitron, get it out of your system!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: The problem is that a distributed image of my neuro-computational matrix is backed-up to the network several times a day, or when I'm {pause, upbeat}threatened!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: I can't help it! There's a little bit of me in every Securitron out on the Strip, so if this instance gets destroyed, I just download to a new one.

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: If I could stop it from happening, I would! I mean, {sympathy}your vengeance is going to feel so incomplete!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {brittler laugh this time}Hahaha! That's not funny, you getting shot in the head.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: I really shouldn't have taken so much pride in how I set that up, huh? I feel really bad right now.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Hahaha! {joking along with the player}I know that's not true, because you still have a head!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: {sunny}I knew he was carrying the Platinum Chip! And I knew right where Benny should wait for him!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: {sunny}I knew she was carrying the Platinum Chip! And I knew right where Benny should wait for her!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: {sunny}That's why Benny put me here! To monitor Mr. House's data transmissions. They're all encrypted, of course - {swelling with pride}but I'm quite a decrypter!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: Did you know that Mr. House spent 812,545 caps hiring salvage teams to find the Platinum Chip- just in the last year alone? {delighted}Of course you didn't!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: Or that there were seven couriers, but six of them were carrying junk? How about their exact routes, and the mercenary teams that screened them?

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: I knew all that. Pretty smart, huh?

Speaker: Victor
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right, but put everything back the way you found it!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: There may be data corruption in one of your memory chips. Let me take a look.

Speaker: Victor
EN: [FAILED] No offense, pardner, but I'd rather not have you rooting around in there. It's technical-like.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Maybe something's broken in one of your computer parts. Let me take a look.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Hi there, my name is April Martimer. I've heard through various channels that you have some... curious robot with you.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, we'd love to have the opportunity to examine the technology on that machine.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: We'll make sure whatever information we find is used for the greater good - and who knows, I may be able to give it some kind of upgrade for you.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Hi there, my name is April Martimer. I monitored a communication earlier between you and someone with the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse. We are much more liberal about the sharing of technology than those Brotherhood...{pause} People.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Bring your robot to us, we'll see that whatever information it may have on it is used for the greater good.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Uh... Hello? Hi. Are you there? Oh, right. You can't respond.{Pause} Listen, I'm using your robot as a relay to get this message to you.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I've picked up some unusual chatter regarding your robot. It seems that it has some information that we could use. Oh wait, where are my manners?

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: This is Lorenzo, a Knight with the Brotherhood of Steel. We'd be very interested in examining your tech.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Could you bring your robot to one of our patrols so they can examine it? I'll have the robot mark the location on your map.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about Hoover Dam?
EN: Never been there since the NCR's got troops all over it. Must be pretty important.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I could use another gun at my side.
EN: That's a mighty fine offer, but I'm gonna need to conserve my strength if I’m to make it all the way to New Vegas.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I could use another gun at my side.
EN: I'm sure you'll do just fine without old Vic slowing you down.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I could use a bed and some supplies
EN: Well, this ain't New Vegas, but I reckon you can find what you need here. Try the office out front.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: This is too big to be a coincidence, robot - what's your angle?
EN: Now don't go getting paranoid, pardner - that bullet to your brain-pan probably just bucked your Brahmin a little. We're all friends here.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Quite a coincidence us meeting like this.
EN: Seeing how this is the only road around, I'd be a sight more surprised if we didn't run into each other from time to time.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: So what's the story with this place?
EN: Novac? Nice enough place I suppose... but between you and me - when I rolled into town my skin started to itch. Watch yourself.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Be seeing you.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Just stay out of my way, robot.
EN: I'll let that slide seeing how you gotta mind full of vengeance for that no-good polecat and all.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: You said the men that jumped me were heading this way, right?
EN: No, don't believe I did, but you might ask around - the Novac folk usually see anyone traveling this way.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: It's nice to see a friendly face out here.
EN: Likewise, friend - likewise. Is there anything old Vic can do you for?

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: What are you doing in Novac?
EN: Don't rightly know - I just got the notion to make my way to New Vegas. Reckon I'll find out when I get there.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Disoriented, pal just left him to scrub alone]
EN: {Disoriented, pal just left him to scrub alone}Hey... Hey! Where the hell are you going?{Small pause, looks at pal leave}Well, fuck you, then!

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: {Snaps back at his pal}You know what? It's all yours, then. Fuck this shit! I'm done.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints]
EN: {Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints}Hey, talk to Pappas if you've got complaints. I'm just want to be done with this shit.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints]
EN: {Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints}Shut up, and get to it. You rather be elsewhere? I can arrange a trip to the sewers - you'll love the smell.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Upset, staring at a grafitti painted wall]
EN: {Upset, staring at a grafitti painted wall}I can deal with them dancing in the fountain, I can deal with them running a Brahmin down The Strip.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Hell, I can even deal with the puke in the latrines. But I can't stand the smell of turpentine, fuck that!

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Upset, staring at a graffiti painted wall]
EN: {Upset, staring at a graffiti painted wall}This shit is not going to come off, I'm telling you.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: [Attack] You've just screwed up, big time.
EN: Think you can get away with this? Guys, time to rough this one up!

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: That's not going to cut it anymore. You've become a pain in the ass around here. Double that or we're going to box your ears.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: That's not going to cut it anymore. You've become a pain in the ass around here. Double that or we're going to box your ears.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: You cheap bastard, like all Mojave people.{Glances around, and tries to excuse his chickening out. Securitrons patrol the Strip} I'd beat you senseless right now, if we didn't have more important things to do.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: But this is not over, get it? We'll see each other again, when you least expect it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: I don't have 200 caps.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Let's just say that people around here talk about you. They say things, not nice things. We only like to hear nice things, get it?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Thank you, I'm ready for it too.
EN: Okay! You know where to go. See you soon!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Thank you, I'm ready for it too.
EN: Go all the way down to the Vault's main game room, take the hallway to your left and then the first room on the left-hand side. Enjoy your stay!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What do I get out of helping you?
EN: If I become Elder, the lockdown will be lifted, and we'll once again be able to send patrols out into the wastes. We'll become powerful again.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What do I get out of helping you?
EN: And when that happens, it will be good to have the Brotherhood as an ally. Good enough?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: That'll have to do. I'd recommend going to see Ramos first. As head of security, he's more familiar with our protocols than anyone else here.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: You could also try to find something relevant in our datastore, though last I heard, Scribe Ibsen has having a bit of a problem accessing it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: And if McNamara should give you any tasks, I'd ask that you kept me abreast of them.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: Report anything you find to me, and we'll move from there.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
EN: {Proud, but not vain}I would. I'm the senior-most paladin in the Chapter, and have more combat experience than any two others here put together.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
EN: I'd gladly support another candidate, but no one has the courage to step forward and make the attempt, so it falls to me.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
EN: I would put this chapter back on the right path, if I could just assume leadership.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
EN: Do that. And take care to avoid the valley to the east, if you know what's good for you.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
EN: I've no reason to disclose the purpose of my actions to a stranger. Please leave.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Then I am sworn to report. I've been dividing my time between the camps to the north and south of here.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: One belongs to the NCR, the other to a band of slavers known as Caesar's Legion. I was sure the NCR would quickly win, but that has not happened.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides have reached a stalemate, and only occasionally send skirmishers against one another.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: If I didn't know better, I'd say neither side is confident enough to push for a full victory. Which seems strange given the NCR's technological edge.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: In any event, I've recorded my findings in this report. Please deliver it to the Elder. I am sure he will find the contents most interesting.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and only after an extended duration did the NCR finally destroy its opponent.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: When they did, it appeared they did so with the help of fresh reinforcements. I do not believe they could have managed the feat without them.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That savages such as these could last so long against the NCR is troubling. Please, take my findings to the Elder. He'll know what to make of this.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and after an extended time the slavers rose up and slaughtered the NCR to the man.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That barbarians with such crude weapons could crush a foe that defeated us is food for much thought.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Here, take my report to the Elder. He must be made aware of what happened here.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and after some time fighting broke out and both sides were mysteriously wiped out.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Things were rather chaotic, so I wasn't able to see exactly what happened, or who did the deed, but seeing the NCR suffer such a loss was a shock.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: The Elder must know of what happened here. Take this report to him. It contains my notes on these events. Maybe he'll make some sense of it all.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Don't mind me. Just passing through.
EN: If so, you may wish to go around that town to the south. It's been taken by slavers, and they seem to be waiting for something, or someone.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: What are you doing way up here?
EN: That's none of your business. I suggest you head back the way you came.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Strange that the Elder should send an outsider, but I suppose he has his reasons.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: My observations have mostly focused on the small town to the south of here. It was cruelly attacked, its inhabitants slain nearly to the last.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That such an act could occur so far west is nearly unthinkable. The NCR has forces in all directions, and an outpost scant miles west from here.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That they have not responded to this violence shows either an unwillingness or inability to properly defend their borders, which is telling.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: I've collected such musings in this report. Please take it to the Elder.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Sorry, didn't mean to disturb you. I'll just be going.
EN: See that you do. I'd advise you to avoid the prison over there. It's overrun by barbarians and the whole place may become a battlefield at any time.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm just wondering what you're doing here.
EN: My purpose here is none of your concern. Now leave me be or I'll be forced to defend myself.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: You speak truly, for it is unlikely that an outsider would know both the Elder's name and that passphrase.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Very well. I've been observing the penal facility there in the distance for some time now, after having followed some rather disturbing rumors.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: {Attack hasn't happened}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and now use the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: What puzzles me is why these men have been allowed to run wild for so long unchecked. Why has the NCR not retaken this place?

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: {NCR won}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and used the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Eventually, the NCR got around to putting the prisoners down, but not until they had wreaked havoc on nearby trade routes.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: {NCR lost}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and used the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Eventually, the NCR tried to put the prisoners down, but they were overwhelmed by them, and haven't sent troops to the area since.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I was hoping to speak to you about other matters.
EN: I can spare a little time. What did you want to talk about?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me.
EN: The less who are aware of this situation, the better. My brothers and sisters were deeply traumatized by the losses we incurred several years ago.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me.
EN: It would be imprudent to worry them unduly without first discovering the facts of the situation.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Ha-ha! Stupid human!

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: They are very good Wind-Brahmin - all caps.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: All.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: You not buy?! Then you die!

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Good doing business - enjoy Wind-Brahmin.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Yes - the herd.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Crazy with low prices on Wind-Brahmin. You buy one.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: There in the corral.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Doggies!

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Tumble-whats?

Speaker: Nightkin
Topic_Name: Ahh! Where did you come from!
EN: Right here... where did you come from?

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I don't like being followed, robot.
EN: Now-now, it ain't my fault that Dorothy and the Tin Man happened to be on the same yellow-striped road, is it?

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: You see what happened in there?
EN: Yup. Guess it's just down to you and fancy-pants. I wouldn't worry about him - he looked all hat and no cattle if you ask me.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Look me up when you get to New Vegas - I'll buy the first round.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Did you see Benny come this way?
EN: 'Benny'? Fancy-pant's name is Benny? {short laugh}No, but I reckon that 'Bunny' hopped his way back to New Vegas.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Did you see Benny come this way?
EN: Fancy-pants? No, I ain't seen hide-nor-hair of him since the tussle in Goodsprings. I'm sure he ran back to the soft-living of New Vegas, 'though.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: It's good to see you again, Victor.
EN: Yup, but this is getting a might embarrassing - people are going to start to talk. <laughs>

Speaker: Victor
EN: Just rolling along on my spurs. Looks like I just might make it to New Vegas after all.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Ohh... that was a bad one, wasn't it, Leo?

Speaker: Lily
EN: {Heavy breathing}{Gramma}Grandma's feeling calmer now, dearie.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Oh my stars, did I do all of this?

Speaker: Lily
EN: Gracious me, I lost control a bit there!

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Why is it hard to remember them?
EN: It's my medicine, dearie. It keeps me calm, but it makes my memory go all fuzzy. That's why I only take my dosage every other time.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Why is it hard to remember them?
EN: That way at least I remember their faces.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: What was that recording you were listening to?
EN: Oh, that old thing? That's a holotape from the last time I visited my grandkids. Such sweet little children, you know. Little angels.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: What was that recording you were listening to?
EN: Sometimes it's hard to remember them, so I take that old tape out from time to time and listen.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: I'll risk you having more psychotic breaks if it means you're more dangerous in combat.
EN: All right, dear. If you're really sure.

Speaker: Lily
EN: All right, pumpkin.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Yes, dearie?

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong.
EN: Well, all right, then, dearie. {Sad}I suppose I'll have my holotapes to remind me of Becky and Jimmy....

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Never mind, we'll talk about it later.
EN: Whenever you're ready, dear.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: That medicine isn't doing you any good. I want you to stop taking it altogether.
EN: Oh my stars! Are you sure? If I don't take any medicine at all, Leo gets especially cranky. I can't stop him when he's like that.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: You should keep taking your meds every other time. It's worth the risk to remember your family.
EN: That's sweet of you, dearie. I'll try to be better about controlling myself if I see you try to sneak away.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: It's too dangerous for you to miss doses. From now on I want you to take your medicine every time.
EN: Are you sure, dearie? Taking my medicine all the time makes me feel woozy, but it does make it easier for me to ignore Leo.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Why don't you take your medicine?
EN: Sometimes it makes {gramma}grandma forget things she doesn't want to forget, pumpkin.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Well he might've been wearing a fancy outfit, but he wasn't any kind of a gentleman to me.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Had his nose stuck so high in the air, you couldn't see it above the clouds. City folk, they always think they deserve better than what they got.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Those hoodlums he was with seemed to know Manny for some reason. He's our daytime sniper, up in the dinosaur's mouth.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Can't say as I have, but we usually keep to ourselves down here. You might have more luck up by the motel.

Speaker: Dusty McBride
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Maybe ask Jeannie May. Nothing happens in this town that she don't know about. She'll be up in the lobby, most days.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Sure have. Camouflage, that coat was, trying to hide from extra terrestrials what can only see in black and white checkers.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: But they're not fooled 'cause he forgot to put the checkers on his face. I told him so and he seemed to take it to heart.

Speaker: No-bark Noonan
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: They stayed here a night, and was up by the dinosaur talking to the sniper fella with the moustache a couple of times.

Speaker: Cliff Briscoe
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Sure, but he didn't buy any souvenirs, if that's what you're wondering. Sounded like he didn't have his money with him.

Speaker: Cliff Briscoe
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: His friends seemed disappointed about it. Heck, I would be, too, if I found such a fine store and left my money elsewhere.

Speaker: Cliff Briscoe
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: Manny might know more about them. Thought he might've been friends with one or two of 'em. He's up in the dino mouth during the day.

Speaker: Ranger Andy
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: No, but I've been laid up for a while now. Haven't been able to keep an eye on things like usual.

Speaker: Ranger Andy
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a man in a checkered coat. Have you seen anyone like that?
EN: It's a small town, though. I'm sure someone would've noticed somebody like that if they came this way.

Speaker: Loyal
Topic_Name: Can I get a code to use the VR pods in the mess hall?
EN: No. Those aren't for outsiders to use. Leave them alone.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: Anything else you need? I've got work to do.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well, if you genuinely care so much, they're flight simulators. If you don't know our history yet, you should see Pete and get the tour.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: We dream to one day rule the skies.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm genuinely interested in your people's history. What are the pods for?

Speaker: Loyal
EN: [FAILED] Talk to Pete if you're so curious.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm genuinely interested in your people's history. What are the pods for?

Speaker: Jack
EN: You think I'm handsome? Wow, I wonder if she does, too!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: A "personal matter," eh? Handsome guy like you, I bet there's a girl involved.

Speaker: Loyal
Topic_Name: How exactly do you plan to get the plane back here?
EN: I just told you, the robots are going to handle it. They'll break the plane down into pieces and move it up from Callville Bay in one shot.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: Hey, I better get rolling. Jack and I have a lot of work ahead of us!

Speaker: Loyal
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Exactly. We'll be shelling an unoccupied location in Outer Vegas to get their attention elsewhere.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: By the time they realize they aren't under attack, the plane and the bots will be long gone.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: The kids wish we were shelling a real target, but Pearl thinks it wise to not start up a war just as the lady has risen.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Are you planning to use diversionary tactics to draw their attention?

Speaker: Loyal
EN: [FAILED] We've got that covered. They won't be a problem.

Speaker: Loyal
EN: Let's just say they'll be a little distracted for a while.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: But won't that attract the attention of the NCR?

Speaker: Raquel
EN: All right.

Speaker: Boomer Chef
Topic_Name: I'd like to buy some food.
EN: Here is what we have available.

Speaker: Boomer Chef
Topic_Name: I'd like to buy some food.
EN: I bet you would, but Pearl didn't give me permission to sell to outsiders.

Speaker: Boomer Chef
EN: Bye.

Speaker: Boomer Munitions Manager
Topic_Name: Could I buy some spare munitions?
EN: Sure. Pearl gave the green light. Take a look at the manifest.

Speaker: Boomer Munitions Manager
Topic_Name: Could I buy some spare munitions?
EN: Not without Pearl's permission, and she hasn't given permission.

Speaker: Boomer Munitions Manager
EN: Later.

Speaker: White Glove
EN: You're still welcome to dine with us, of course. We've just had quite enough of paying you to play our games.

Speaker: White Glove
EN: For a while, you were the toast of the Ultra-Luxe, but you're simply not en vogue any longer. Your act has gotten stale.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: Where did you take my weapons?
EN: They'll be handled with the utmost security in our bank.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: [Attack] Looks like I'll have to kill you, then.
EN: Well, I never.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: Could I trouble you to blow it out your ass?
EN: {Offended}How frightfully uncouth. I'm afraid I must insist you relinquish your weapons.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: Why do you need my guns?
EN: I'm afraid those are the rules. If you don't like it you can take your business elsewhere.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: <Keep holdout weapons> Sure, here you go.
EN: My deepest apologies for the slightest inconvenience. You have my assurance that everything will be returned upon your departure.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: <Keep holdout weapons> Sure, here you go.
EN: But we simply can't have anyone waving their weapons around in the hotel.  It's not the atmosphere we wish to cultivate.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
Topic_Name: <Keep holdout weapons> Sure, here you go.
EN: Please, enjoy your stay.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
EN: My deepest apologies for the slightest inconvenience. You have my assurance that everything will be returned upon your departure.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
EN: But we simply can't have anyone waving their weapons around in the hotel.  It's not the atmosphere we wish to cultivate.

Speaker: White Glove Greeter
EN: Please, enjoy your stay.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: Why don't you want the Brotherhood to have it?
EN: The Brotherhood{Spoke with distain} is all about keeping technology to themselves, and using what they find to protect themselves.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: Why don't you want the Brotherhood to have it?
EN: They are isolationist and belligerent. I have no doubt that they plan to use the data for weapons research.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: Ok, you can take it for a little while.
EN: Thank you. I'll get it back to you as soon as I can with the upgraded weapons systems.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: What are you going to do with it?
EN: First I'm going to pull off whatever log data I can. Then, I'll use some of the tech around here to upgrade its weapons systems.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: What are you going to do with it?
EN: Shouldn't be more than a few days work.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: What would you like it for?
EN: I've heard through our channels that it has some research that may be related to Enclave and Poseidon Energy technology.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: What would you like it for?
EN: I'd like to get what I can from it and use that data for the good of humanity... ALL of humanity, unlike the Brotherhood.

Speaker: April Martimer
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the followers?
EN: There are plenty of people here to talk to you about us and our mission. Let's get to brass tacks and talk about that robot.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: I'll have to think on this more.
EN: {Sad}Okay, but I'd really like to take a look at him. Remember, I'll be able to give his armor some extra plating while I've got him here.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Step closer to the demonstration area, please!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Okay, so you're familiar with Securitrons by now, obviously! I mean, some of your best friends are Securitrons, right?{chuckle}

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Our titanium alloy housing does a good job of protecting our delicate electronic insides from small arms fire and shrapnel!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Our left arm contains an X-25 gatling laser, quite deadly against soft targets at medium range. That looks like fun!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: And for close-range suppression and crowd control, we have this handy-dandy 9mm submachinegun! Nice!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: All of this is old hat, right?

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Here's where it gets interesting! Turns out those are our {emph}secondary weapons!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: All this time we've been running the {emph}Mark I operating system, which doesn't have drivers for our primary weapons! Imagine!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Now watch this - I'm downloading the Mark II OS to all the Securitrons on the network. Makes quite a difference!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: With the M-235 Missile Launcher, we can engage ground and air targets at long range!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: And a rapid-fire G-28 grenade launching system makes us deadly in close-range engagements! Whoo, look at that!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: The OS upgrade also includes drivers for our onboard auto-repair systems! Just try to hurt us now!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: All together, this {emph}software upgrade confers a 235% increase in combat effectiveness - per unit!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: New Vegas finally has soldiers worthy of protecting it!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: I hope you enjoyed this demonstration! You can come back up and see me or be on your way - I know you're a busy person!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: All you have to do is destroy the power generators! Without the generators, Hoover Dam's just a big bunch of concrete!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Take this override module - it's just like the one you used at the El Dorado Substation.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Install the override module on the terminal in the power control room! I'll disable the generator failsafes, and you can do the rest.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Good luck! See you at the dam!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You want me to destroy Hoover Dam?
EN: Not the whole thing, thank goodness! That'd be really hard!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: The dam is too valuable to destroy!
EN: That's exactly why this will work! Just hear me out...

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: You remember how the Securitron army at the Fort got destroyed? For very, very good reasons, of course...

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Well, the problem is that's left us with enough Securitrons to drive off a weakened NCR force -  but not enough to keep them from coming back!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: So what we do is take away the whole reason why they'd want to come back! Smart, huh?

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: Just tell me what to do.
EN: I wish I could, but I'm neuro-computationally incapable of making decisions like this one! It's up to you!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: You could rout the dam's power output to the facility under Fortification Hill. That'll restart its reactor, just like you did with the Lucky 38!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: That'll wake up the Securitron army you left on standby and give us enough force to push the Legion {emph}and the NCR straight out of the Mojave!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: The other option is destroy the dam's generators. Without those, it's just a big bunch of concrete! The NCR won't have any reason to stick around!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: You don't have to decide yet! For now, all you have to do is take this override module and install it on the terminal in the power control room!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {DUPLICATE?}Good luck! See you at the dam!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
EN: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
EN: It turns out there are two ways we can win this thing! Hear that? We have options!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
EN: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
EN: It turns out there's only one way for us to win this battle and make it stick! We have to render Hoover Dam inoperable!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: All right, I'll go talk to the Followers.
EN: Wonderful! I'll keep tabs on the situation at the dam! See you in a bit!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: I have a few things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam.
EN: Sure, no problem! So long as the Legion doesn't attack before you can get there! Which I'm sure they won't!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What is the final phase of the plan?
EN: {upbeat}Well, the Legion is going to attack Hoover Dam one of these days! And the NCR is going to defend it!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What is the final phase of the plan?
EN: {upbeat}One side will lose, and the other will win! But the side that wins will be weak, because a lot of its soldiers will be dead!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What is the final phase of the plan?
EN: {upbeat}That's when all our Securitrons will show up! We'll declare an Independent Vegas, and tell the side that won the dam - to scram!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What is the final phase of the plan?
EN: {upbeat}Or the Securitrons will kill all of them, too!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Here, take a look at this print-out. It covers all the details!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: This print-out describes the situation in more detail!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Take this print-out. It'll tell you what to do!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Here's another one of my print-outs! Read up!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: This print-out covers everything you need to know!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Take a look at this print-out. I may have said things wrong a moment ago.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Here's a print-out with some additional information.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Who am I to argue with a solution like that?

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: If you say so, that's good enough for me!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: All right, I'll cross them off the list!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}So this is what the rest of the world looks like!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}Everything looks bigger than I imagined!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}Isn't this exciting? I know I'm excited!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I have a good feeling about this! It's going to be great!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!

Speaker: Lily
EN: Nice puppies - do doggies want treats?

Speaker: Lily
EN: {Panicking}Ahh! Loud! Onetwothreefourfivesixseveneightninetenonetwothreefourfivesixseveneightnineten!

Speaker: Lily
EN: My, my, this reminds me of when I was a girl. Right over there would have been where your {grampa}grandpa and I had our first kiss!

Speaker: Lily
EN: Ooh, look, pumpkin! A dinosaur! Do you want to ride the dinosaur?

Speaker: Lily
EN: My, aren't all these lights fancy?

Speaker: Lily
EN: I wonder if Marcus knows about this place....

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: Oh. Well, all right.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: Your room will be the one upstairs, closest to the lobby side.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: Here's your key. Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better for you.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I can't afford 100 caps right now.
EN: Well that's nothing to be ashamed of. We all have money troubles from time to time.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I can't afford 100 caps right now.
EN: You just come on back when you can afford it, and that room's all yours.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: I'm glad you can stay with us.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I'd like to rent a room.
EN: I can't see as how I'd charge you after the generous things you've done for the town. The room's on me.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
Topic_Name: I'd like to rent a room.
EN: Well, I think that's a fine idea. I'll give you a good flat rate, and you can stay as long as you like. Least till the busy season comes. Sound good?

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: I'm sure I can get help with supply shortages.
EN: Even if that were the case, we still need more incentive to help Vegas.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave.
EN: I think I see now what you intend to set in motion.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave.
EN: If this plan will bring us one step closer to revitalizing the region, you can count on our support.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave.
EN: So long as you can keep us supplied, we will stay in the Mojave to provide care and education for those in need.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Be careful out there! It won't be long before the Legion makes its move!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What will the override module let you do?
EN: I'll use the Substation to send a {emph}huge jolt of electricity to the Lucky 38! Turns out this casino has its own reactor! All it needs is a jumpstart!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What will the override module let you do?
EN: With the reactor running at full-tilt, I can boost the transmission strength of the Lucky 38's command and control network!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Great! When this is taken care of, we'll be all set for the Legion to make its move.

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: I don't care what happens to Kimball.
EN: Fine by me! We've got more important things to take care of!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: {Terrible NCR rep}The NCR hates me. They won't let me within 1000 feet of Kimball.
EN: You are so misunderstood! Well, it's their loss!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: {Terrible NCR rep}The NCR hates me. They won't let me within 1000 feet of Kimball.
EN: Forget about the President! We've got something more important to take care of!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: {mixed/unknown NCR rep}I might be able to convince the NCR to let me help out.
EN: All right. A Ranger named Grant is in charge of security for the visit. He's the one you'll have to convince.

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: {mixed/unknown NCR rep}I might be able to convince the NCR to let me help out.
EN: After you've resolved the situation with the President, there's one more thing for you to take care of!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: {good NCR rep}I'm on good terms with the NCR. They'll let me help protect him.
EN: Great! A Ranger named Grant has been placed in charge of security for the President's visit. You'll want to talk to him.

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: {good NCR rep}I'm on good terms with the NCR. They'll let me help protect him.
EN: Once the President is safe, there's one more thing for you to take care of!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?
EN: Mr. House ran projections on how the NCR public will react to a defeat at Hoover Dam! Overwhelmingly, they'll blame Kimball!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?
EN: But if Kimball dies at Hoover Dam, there's no obvious scapegoat for them to blame! So they'll blame New Vegas instead!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?
EN: So that means reduced tourism for up to five years! The equations are pretty complicated! Mr. House sure liked numbers!

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm not going to let Benny get away.
EN: I can't say I understand your obsession, but for that I suppose I'd have to spend a night in your grave.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm not going to let Benny get away.
EN: Fine. I'll stick with you. Just remember this. If you want something from Caesar, sooner or later you'll have to give him his due.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
ActorNotes: ["And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-mee-kay?]
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: {"And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-mee-kay?}Et tu, mi amice?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
ActorNotes: ["And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-MEE-kah?]
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: {"And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-MEE-kah?}Et tu, mi amica?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: I have to commend you on your sense of historical propriety, but have you given more than a passing thought to how we would escape?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: No disrespect intended, but you aren't the first person to dream up the idea.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: Just give me a sign when you're about to pull out the dagger so I know when to make a run for the cliffs.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out.
EN: Short of canceling our imminent travel plans, that's the best thing you could have said.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out.
EN: Just be careful. If we travel at Caesar's pleasure, he may not let us out as easily as he lets us in.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I just want to hear Caesar out.
EN: Very optimistic of you. You'll make a good Follower someday assuming Caesar doesn't have us both crucified.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Did I say something? Sorry. Don't pay any attention to me. Just babbling. {becoming more quiet}Nonsense, really. {drifting off}Babbling nonsense.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Oh, uh... {trying to cover}of hearing stories. About energy weapons. {drifting off}They're... pretty crazy. {quietly}Yeah.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
ActorNotes: [off-hand, not realizing he's revealing something bad]
Topic_Name: Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?
EN: {off-hand, not realizing he's revealing something bad}Energy weapons? Of course not.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?
EN: {catching himself, trying to cover}I mean... but, we study all sorts of science and technology so, you know, we... you just kind of get familiar with them. Yeah.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why don't you come with me?
EN: I can't leave now. Caesar has gained too much ground. I need to be here in case the NCR fails to hold Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why don't you come with me?
EN: No offense intended, but why should I go anywhere with you?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you know much about Caesar?
EN: {sighs}I don't know anything that the others couldn't tell you. Caesar was one of the Followers. Before my time, of course.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you know much about Caesar?
EN: He wanted to rebuild the new world in the image of the old. A sad story of good intentions gone bad. In that regard, he's hardly unique.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you know much about Caesar?
EN: If you set aside his leadership capabilities, extensive knowledge, and ruthless cunning, he's just another jerk who steps on people to get his way.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Not from the Legion, if that's what you're getting at. Books. Sheet music. Gladiator movie holotapes. Bits and pieces here and there.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: The Followers have extensive libraries, but we all draw water from the same old well. Even Caesar.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Oh. {sincere}Sorry. "There is nothing new under the sun."

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If agave and mesquite were that miraculous, the locals would have figured it out a few thousand years ago.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?
EN: {“Yeah, well...”}{SEE-zar}Caesar can cite {KAY-toe}Cato to suit his purpose. Many people have spoken Latin. Some of them were quite pleasant.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?
EN: It's unfortunate that the language is now associated with the gentlemen across the river.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What kinds of illnesses and injuries?
EN: Cuts, lacerations, broken bones. Infections resulting from all of the above. Common cold, influenza. Take your pick.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What kinds of illnesses and injuries?
EN: There are plenty of ways to die out here, and most of them, surprisingly, don't have anything to do with war. Just common human fragility.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: For the past hundred years or so, the Followers have managed to get by using salvaged medical supplies from the Old World.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: But the side effect of medical success is that more people live longer. Funny how that works.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Eventually, we'll run out of hospitals to loot. We need new ways to produce those supplies. Or maybe old ways, if this research goes anywhere.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You don't sound too enthusiastic about it.
EN: I'm enthusiastic about helping people, but {nih-hill noh-wee soob soh-lay}nihil novi sub sole.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Not all Followers are "people persons." Besides, someone needs to do research. I have no problem with Julie sticking me back here.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Out of sight, out of mind. There are worse things one can be, though I do admit, it is a bit boring.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Though it has a noble goal, I don't think this research will yield much fruit. No pun intended.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Like I said before, not all Followers are good with people.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: I'm fine doing research back here, even if it is a bit boring... and pointless... and a complete waste of time.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Don't mind me. I'm just voicing my thoughts so they don't burrow out of my skull in a fit of abject despondency.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Oh, you know. Finding alternative treatments for common illnesses and injuries. Stimpaks out of barrel cacti and other fantastic improbabilities.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: As far as fruitless wastes of time go, it's quite noble in its aims.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>
EN: Huh? Hey, I think you dropped your gun there. Here. Here you go. Just don't point it at me, okay?

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>
EN: I'm paranoid now, and even though you clearly don't know how to hold that thing, it'd be one less thing for me to worry about. Thanks.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Did you know there's a nerve on your neck that helps you sleep? It's... uh... I know it's here...
EN: You're weird. Please stop that.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Maybe beating your head on a rock will fix it.
EN: Who are you, again?

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Maybe my weak and flimsy hands can massage that out for you.<Apply Sleeper Hold>
EN: What the-? Don't touch me. I could get a better massage from a baby.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Er... join the White Glove Society. They're cannibals, but that's probably a step up for you.
EN: What? Are you crazy?

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will you serve human flesh at the Gourmand?
EN: Oh, I very much doubt that. What fun would it be if everyone could have it?

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will you serve human flesh at the Gourmand?
EN: Then again, I wouldn't be surprised if our chef used it here and there as a secret ingredient to make his dishes really come alive.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: What's next, now that the White Glove Society has tasted human flesh again?
EN: Now that it's been accepted, it will become a regular course for us.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: What's next, now that the White Glove Society has tasted human flesh again?
EN: It's a new and exciting frontier for our chef. I've never seen him so cheerful.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: How is your new cuisine faring?
EN: Why it's splendid. Simply to die for.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: How is your new cuisine faring?
EN: {affably}Mortimer told me about you, you know. What a pair of mischief makers you two are!

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: How is your new cuisine faring?
EN: But the new entrees are fresh and bold and I have the two of you to thank for it.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: We know they supply the Fiends with illegal chems, but they never stick around in NCR territory for long. They know the land, and move quick.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: There's talk from time to time about taking out their base at Red Rock Canyon, but nothing ever comes of it. The Great Khans are tough fighters.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: If we ever did go up against them on their home turf, we'd win, but casualties would be high.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
ActorNotes: [painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents]
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: {painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents}Yeah, I was there. I was Captain Dhatri, then. That whole situation was a mess and could easily have been avoided with good intel.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: The major in charge at the time made a bad call - he thought Bitter Springs was full of Great Khan raiders, so we surrounded the place.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: By the time any of us realized there were civilians down there - women and children - the shooting had already started.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: The major froze up at the news, and we couldn't get another word out of him. I took over and salvaged the situation as best I could.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: For my effort, I was promoted to major. Not quite the way I'd have wanted it.

Speaker: Powder Ganger
Topic_Name: What happens if I hang around one of your camps?
EN: Then'll we have to make you leave by force. Your own fault, you understand.

Speaker: Powder Ganger
EN: See ya.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: {Edited Line}{Speaking in Audio Log/Journal}This is most unusual! The Powder Gangers have visitors today. I guess there's a first for everything!

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: Now those tough-looking fellows must be Great Khans. I recognize those funny helmets and leather vests from stories I've heard...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: So what are they doing with that dapper gentleman who wears a checked suit? I wouldn't mind a suit like that.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: They're talking about heading south toward Nipton, then west to Novac where they'll meet up with someone...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: I guess I could track them if I needed to, but {beat, cowardly justification}the town of Primm needs me here, to serve and protect.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: Oh my. I think I've been spotted...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well, you look to be the trustworthy sort. Okay, I'll tell you what I know.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You can tell me or you can rot in here.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: [FAILED] I'm sure you mean well, but I'm afraid you'll have to wait until I'm in a calmer emotional state before my memory is going to function.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'll free you... right after you tell me...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}Indeed I do good sir, and I would be thrilled to share that information with you as soon as I am released from captivity.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: I hear you may have information on some Khans that came through here with a guy in a checkered suit.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}My good lady, I believe I may have some information that would prove useful.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: If you would just untie my hands I'd be more than happy to share what information I have with you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: I hear you may have information on some Khans that came through here with a guy in a checkered suit.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}I'm in quite a state here. If you help me with my bonds I'll be more than happy to tell you anything, and everything about those Khans.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}Ahh yes, my memory is much clearer now that I am free from my bondage.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: I was sku{skulking, rethinking}... er, performing recon, gathering information on some of the Powder Gangers, when some great Khans arrived with your friend in the suit.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: They were talking about some delivery they took from a courier, I assume that was you.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: They said they'd be heading through Nipton to Novac to meet a contact there.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: Can you tell me about the man in the checkered suit who came through here?

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}I overheard them saying that they are on their way to Novac. If you want to follow them I strongly suggest that you follow the road through Nipton.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: There are a lot of dangerous things out in the desert, and you won't have me with you to protect you, as I need to stay here and keep Primm safe.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: Can you tell me where the man in the checkered suit went again?

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?
EN: Tabitha was {gramma's}grandma's squad leader when we both worked for the Master. She wasn't very nice at all, but she was good at the chopping.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?
EN: Almost as good as Leo....

Speaker: Lily
EN: Tabitha! You naughty, naughty girl! Leo remembers what you did!

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
EN: What'd you have in mind?

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: Is that when you settled out here with your wife?
EN: Eventually we made our way out here. But uh...

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: Is that when you settled out here with your wife?
EN: Well, when folks spend their lives in isolation, sometimes that ain't the best of things for learning to fight off germs.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: Is that when you settled out here with your wife?
EN: We was going to California, but Goodsprings was as far as we got. After she passed, wasn't no reason to keep going.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: Is that when you settled out here with your wife?
EN: I stayed so I could keep close to her.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?
EN: {Bitter, attempting to hide it}Yep. He sure did. Wanted himself a hotel, and to make sure once he made the change there'd never be any going back.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?
EN: We didn't get a say. Don't know how you'd argue with a fella like that anyways, everywhere and nowhere all at once.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?
EN: So just like that, we was all homeless. Went our separate ways, and that was all she wrote.

Speaker: Doc Mitchell
Topic_Name: You said before you had something taken from you.
EN: Well, ain't we all, right? That was a long time ago. {Lying}I don't pay it much mind anymore.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Forget it, I'll bring her here.
EN: Good, getting tired of questions from you when I should be getting answers. Bring her here.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: I'm not doing this for you.
EN: {Frowns}Guess Gloria was wrong about you, then. Get out of here, you're no use to me.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: "Nowhere's" a strange place to get an idea like that.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: You know what, you're new. Gloria's not going to miss you. And I'm not going to risk you saying the same thing to that bitch I'm hunting for.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Found out from investigating the wreckage.
EN: And after all the trouble I went through to kill all those witnesses. Guess now I have one more than I thought.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: So, looks like we have us a thief. All right, guess I'm talking to you instead of the girl.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: What did you want to talk to her about?
EN: {Irritated}If your answer isn't "yes, I'll bring her here" or "no, I won't, cause Gloria had me pegged wrong," then we're done here.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
ActorNotes: [Cold, angry that player is challenging him]
Topic_Name: Anything you can say to her, you can say to me.
EN: {Cold, angry that player is challenging him}You don't want {emph}us chatting, trust me. {Smooths out}As for the girl - I just want to talk to her.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Anything you can say to her, you can say to me.
EN: And if you can't bring her here, you're no use to me - or Gloria. So if you want to cause trouble in here over nothing, then go on - try.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: I got business here, need to watch the shop, make sure things are running - smoothly.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: {Slight mockery}Besides, if I came for the girl, I'm not all friendly and charming like you are. She might get the wrong idea.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Is it because the Van Graffs attacked her caravan?
EN: {Frowns}I had nothing to do with that, and neither did anyone here. Now where would you have gotten an idea like that?

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Do you know where she is?
EN: Fuck, no. If I knew where this bitch was, do you think I'd be asking you?

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Do you know where she is?
EN: Still, there's someone who might - old Alice McLafferty, Crimson Caravan, might know something.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Do you know where she is?
EN: She keeps tabs on caravan traffic in the Mojave, wouldn't put it past her to keep track of Cassidy Caravans and its owner.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say.
EN: {Slight mockery}What? You two on the outs? Ain't that a shame.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say.
EN: Guess you misheard me - I wasn't asking you a question. Find a way to get her here.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say.
EN: If you can't bring her here, then make sure she never leaves the Outpost, and that's {draws it out}fine with me.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Cass? She's in the Mojave Outpost.
EN: {Chews it over}Really. NCR all around her.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: Cass? She's in the Mojave Outpost.
EN: Well, tell you what. You find a {emph}way to bring her here. She'll want to hear what I have to say.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: Dead? {Beat}What... by you? {Beat, admiring}Yeah, I can tell, you had something to do with it.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: {Nods, impressed}Gloria was right about you. You take care of business before it's a problem.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: [Terrifying Presence] Raise that gun, and I'll kill everyone in here.
EN: {Pauses, a little uneasy}You know what, I think you mean that. All right... maybe...

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: {Scoffs}Really. We'll see about that.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
EN: {Eager}Waited too long to finish this, last loose end, all wrapped up.

Speaker: Brotherhood of Steel Paladin
EN: Don't think everyone around here is going to tolerate your actions, outsider. A few of us have a mind to put you down like the animal you are.

Speaker: Brotherhood of Steel Paladin
EN: If I or one of the others hears that you're topside, we might just come out and have a little chat.

Speaker: Brotherhood of Steel Knight
EN: You may have questionable methods, outsider, but some of us realize you get the job done.

Speaker: Brotherhood of Steel Knight
EN: We've talked Torres into giving you access to gear for a little cheaper, to help out with your travels. Hope it helps!

Speaker: Brotherhood of Steel Scribe
EN: There you are! A few of us wanted to thank you for being such a good friend to the Brotherhood, so we've set aside some of our recycled energy cells.

Speaker: Brotherhood of Steel Scribe
