EN: We'll leave a few of them in that footlocker in the corner every so often. The Paladins scoff at using recycled ammo, so no one should mind.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Good Karma, NCR Victory, Female}The Courier, fair and even-handed in her dealings throughout the Wasteland, was honored by the NCR for her support of the military at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}She was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, NCR Victory, Female}Though the Courier's agenda was a mystery to many, she was honored by NCR for her support of the military at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}She was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Evil Karma, NCR Victory, Female}With brutal methods that few in NCR would approve of, it was the Courier who secured NCR's victory at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Despite her extreme actions, she was awarded with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Good Karma, Legion Victory, Female}Though the Courier herself was just and forthright in her dealings throughout the Wasteland, she helped the Legion achieve victory.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Caesar honored her with a golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Legion Victory, Female}The Courier, a mercenary at heart, helped the Legion achieve victory at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Caesar honored her with a golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Evil Karma, Legion Victory, Female}The Legion marched over the Hoover Dam with the help of one who was as brutal and merciless as the worst of them: The Courier.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Caesar honored her with a  golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Good Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, fair and kind-hearted to those in the Wasteland, ensured that Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable and secure for future generations.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narrating}Mr. House afforded her every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, both out of gratitude and a quiet pride in his choice of lieutenants.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, who had a mixed history in the Wasteland, kept the status quo at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Mr. House kept New Vegas stable, if not free, for generations, and afforded the Courier every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Evil Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, cruel and merciless, had ensured that Mr. House would maintain complete control over New Vegas and everyone in it.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}Mr. House afforded her every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, mostly as a reward, but partly out of fear.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Good Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Supporting the ideals of independence, the Courier was recognized as the woman responsible for a truly free New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}She ensured that Mr. House's tyranny was broken and that neither Caesar's Legion nor NCR would ever gain control over New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Preferring neither the best of the NCR nor the worst of the Legion, the Courier was the woman responsible for a truly independent New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}She had removed Mr. House from power over the Strip and broken the influence of the NCR and Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration, Evil Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Supporting all of the chaos that comes with independence, the Courier was the woman responsible for a truly free New Vegas.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {Narration}She ensured the fall of Mr. House and the end of the Legion's and NCR's influence over New Vegas.

Speaker: Chairman Greeter
EN: Smooth and easy, just the way I like it. Don't worry, they'll be as safe as kittens till you're ready to leave.

Speaker: Chairman Greeter
EN: Oh, and a friendly word of advice: if you happen to "stumble across" any weapons during your stay here, well... just don't wear them openly. You dig?

Speaker: Chairman Greeter
EN: Now that we got that little business out of the way, what can I do to make your Tops experience the tops?

Speaker: Squatter Bill
EN: Pleasure doing business with you.

Speaker: Freeside Thug
EN: Get him!

Speaker: Freeside Thug
EN: Get her!

Speaker: Freeside Thug
Topic_Name: Ooh, look. A body. I really should be going.
EN: What's your rush? The boys and I here want to get to know you better.

Speaker: Freeside Thug
EN: Nah, just some idiot that wandered down the wrong alley. Sound familiar?

Speaker: Freeside Thug
EN: The last person stupid enough to follow me down this alley. Get this fool, boys!

Speaker: Kings Gang Member
EN: Hey, you're the one who's been going around helping people around here, right? The King says to keep up the good work, and said to give you this.

Speaker: Local
EN: You're starting to get quite the reputation around here, aren't you? Don't get me wrong, I'm not passing judgement or anything.

Speaker: Local
EN: The fine proprietors of Mick & Ralph's appreciate that kind of attitude, and would like to offer you a discount on their fine wares.

Speaker: Local
EN: Just as long as you keep making waves, that is. Be seeing you.

Speaker: Freeside Thug
EN: {Starts off blustering, ends up blubbering}Give me all of your {caps}ca- whoa, I'm sorry. I-I didn't know it was you. Please don't hurt me. I've got a wife! And kids! And pets and stuff!

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: Great Khans! Drive Caesar's dog out of our camp! If he's too slow to flee, kill him!

Speaker: Lucius
Topic_Name: You need me more than I need you - don't forget that.
EN: {cooly responding to the player's threat}We'll see about that. In any case, we can't let {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death get in the way of the Legion's goals.

Speaker: Lucius
Topic_Name: You need me more than I need you - don't forget that.
EN: Our scouts have reported that the NCR's President Kimball will be visiting the Dam. This is an excellent opportunity to assassinate him.

Speaker: Lucius
Topic_Name: You need me more than I need you - don't forget that.
EN: You are to meet with Cato Hostilius - he'll have more information on ways to eliminate Kimball.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: Yes, we can't let {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death get in the way of the Legion's goals.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: Our scouts have reported that the NCR's President Kimball will be visiting the Dam. This is an excellent opportunity to assassinate him.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: You are to meet with Cato Hostilius - he'll have more information on ways to eliminate Kimball.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death is regrettable, but we can't let it stand in the way of the Legion's goals.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: Our scouts have reported that the NCR's President Kimball will be visiting the Dam. This is an excellent opportunity to assassinate him.

Speaker: Lucius
EN: You are to meet with Cato Hostilius - he'll have more information on ways to eliminate Kimball.

Speaker: Big Sal
Topic_Name: Can I buy out the rest of his contract for 300 caps?
EN: {Pensive}Yeah, that sounds alright to me. I bet we can find someone to do his work for that much. Tell him to get going.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: What about Primm Slim? Could he be sheriff?
EN: Well I reckon he could be a sheriff if you have the skills to reprogram him.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What about Primm Slim? Could he be sheriff?
EN: Do you think Primm Slim could be sheriff?

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Topic_Name: What about Primm Slim? Could he be sheriff?
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: Well I guess I never thought of that. I guess he could be sheriff, if you think he could be reprogrammed for it.

Speaker: Jessup
EN: Yeah, {as in, "go on, get out"}go on.

Speaker: Benny
ActorNotes: [Player has tried to use elevator to leave]
EN: {Player has tried to use elevator to leave}That elevator is nowhere, baby. Step over to the mic.

Speaker: Vikki And Vance Floor Manager
EN: {Small Fry}Wow, this is our first hot streak since we opened this place back up! Here's a little something, on the house.

Speaker: Vikki And Vance Floor Manager
EN: {Big Winner}You're doing great! Keep on spending money, hopefully we'll get some extra action in here.

Speaker: Vikki And Vance Floor Manager
EN: {Whale}You're the luckiest player I've ever seen. Keep up the good work in here.

Speaker: Layla
EN: {Banned}I'm sorry, you've done so much good stuff for us here in Primm, but we just can't afford to lose any more money to you.

Speaker: Layla
EN: I can't let you play here anymore.

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
EN: {Breaking - his son died}Confound it. I knew I shoulda stayed with him. Ted, I'm so sorry, boy.

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
EN: I demand to know who did this!

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
Topic_Name: Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel.
EN: He's here? Bless you, I thought he was a goner for sure.

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
Topic_Name: Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel.
EN: Listen, you do what you gotta do to find him. I'd send my men with you but I'm worried they'd kill Ted if we got close.

Speaker: Heck Gunderson
Topic_Name: Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel.
EN: Reckon you might need one of these. Take it. Just don't wave it around here where they might take it from you.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: {neutral}Whatever suits you.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: I don't know what they're up to and I don't want to know. I just hope no harm comes to Novac.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: Not much to live off of around here, except salvage from that factory. If they made off with anything expensive, we'd be hurting something fierce.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: But I will say this. If all of 'em turned up dead tomorrow, I couldn't see as to how they'd be missed.

Speaker: Jeannie May Crawford
EN: That might even be a desirable thing, knowing the town was safe from the likes of them. There'd be a reward in it if some brave soul made it happen.

Speaker: Radio
EN: Attention. ARCHIMEDES I Laser is now armed. Move all personnel to minimum safe distance before initiating test fire.

Speaker: Radio
EN: Warning. Retargeting sequence initiated for HELIOS One reflector banks.

Speaker: Radio
EN: The ARCHIMEDES laser systems will automatically initiate test fire upon completion.

Speaker: Radio
EN: This concludes our firing test of the ARCHIMEDES I and II laser systems. Thank you for observing Poseidon Energy safety protocol. Have a nice day.

Speaker: Radio
EN: ARCHIMEDES II orbital laser bombardment will commence in T-minus 5... 4... 3... 2... 1.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
Topic_Name: Why is the NCR interested in this desert?
EN: It is no secret. Our interest here is two fold.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
Topic_Name: Why is the NCR interested in this desert?
EN: First, we want to remain in control of Hoover Dam. It supplies the Republic with power, and is a source of fresh water.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
Topic_Name: Why is the NCR interested in this desert?
EN: Second, we want to prevent the Legion from advancing across the Colorado River and endangering the home states.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: Caesar's Legion.{Lots of spite}

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: A bunch of degenerate slavers, led by a madman who calls himself Caesar. Every one of them is a barbarian to the last.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: I've even heard one of their leaders, the Legate or something, goes around with a human skull on his head. Savages to the last.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
Topic_Name: Can you tell me more about the NCR?
EN: Sure can. The NCR was founded from the survivors of one of the great Vaults. We started as a small settlement called Shady Sands.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
Topic_Name: Can you tell me more about the NCR?
EN: We now consist of 5 states, that make up the greatest nation since the Great War.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: Where do you come from that you haven't heard of the NCR? Nevermind, it doesn't matter much.

Speaker: Lieutenant Hayes
EN: If you haven't heard of us, you must not be from the Legion. Put simply, the NCR is the greatest nation currently functioning.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Another one of Poseidon Energy's many secret weapons projects. Before the Great War. It didn't go anywhere.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: That's how REPCONN got their shot. So to speak.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: REPCONN went through some rough times. When their rocket business was shaky, Mr. House purchased the company.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: It didn't take long for him to repurpose their plasma technology for a government weapon contract.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Plasma rifles. They were intended to replace the P94 plasma caster.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: There was some corporate espionage going on between Poseidon Energy's Project SEMELE and whatever was going on here.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland.
EN: Overt flirtation will get you everywhere, you know.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland.
EN: On a slightly more serious note, if you're interested in helping out with the troubles plaguing Freeside, I can come with you.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland.
EN: Just don't do anything obnoxious, like trying to help Caesar's Legion, and we should be fine. Understood?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Oh, well... in that case, never mind.
EN: I'm not sure why you thought a Follower would want to help Caesar after all of the misery he's visited on us and the people we try to help.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Oh, well... in that case, never mind.
EN: Well, good luck to you in your future endeavors, assuming they don't involve Caesar.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: All right. Let's not waste any time. {a bit of enthusiasm}There are people out there to help, things to learn. Maybe not in that order, but let's get to it.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Uh... it beats sitting around here all day, doesn't it?
EN: {slight mockery}Uh... probably not. Until things settle down around here, alleviating my boredom isn't a good motive to leave. Sorry.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Ugh. Well if you're going to be like that then never mind.
EN: Yes. The Followers do not like Caesar or Caesar's Legion. You should also not like them. If you do, you like hurting people and that is bad. Goodbye.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: This place is really complicated and stuff. You're smart. Can you help me do... things?
EN: Hmm. Wow. You sound like you really do need some help. Look, I can help you out, but you can't do anything stu-

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: This place is really complicated and stuff. You're smart. Can you help me do... things?
EN: I mean, you can't... help bad people, who want to hurt the locals in Freeside. If you do, I'll leave. Does that make sense?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me.
EN: Hmm. That seems appropriately resolute and yet vague. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt and go with you, but let me be clear about something.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me.
EN: If you plan to help Caesar's Legion, this is going to be a brief relationship.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me.
EN: I may not have all the answers for how to fix Freeside's problems, but Caesar taking control isn't part of the solution. Fair?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The NCR oppression around here would disappear if the Legion took control. I could use your help.
EN: Only because everyone would be conscripted or enslaved. And the people who are unfit for military service or slavery would be put down. Swell plan.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The NCR oppression around here would disappear if the Legion took control. I could use your help.
EN: Yes, a veritable {pahx roh-MAH-nah}Pax Romana for post-nuclear America. My political beliefs are a bit more progressive than outright fascism, so I'll pass. Thanks.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help.
EN: If that's really what you're trying to do, I'll go with you.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help.
EN: Things are hectic around here, but it won't mean anything if NCR or the Legion take control. I'm sure the Followers can manage without me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help.
EN: Just don't try to help the Legion, and we shouldn't have any problems. Sound good?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm trying to help Mr. House keep New Vegas independent.
EN: That's funny. Mr. House doesn't want to keep New Vegas independent. He just wants to keep the NCR and Caesar's Legion from pushing him around.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm trying to help Mr. House keep New Vegas independent.
EN: He must be pretty convincing if he's roped you into helping him, but you can count me out.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The NCR needs help against the Legion before Caesar moves on the dam. We could use your skills.
EN: The NCR had a chance to use the Followers' skills before, but being imperialists mattered more to them. No thanks.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm going after a man named Benny for revenge and I need someone to keep me patched up.
EN: Pulling bullets out of a vengeance-crazed drifter is truly a noble step up from tending to the downtrodden of Freeside, but I think I'll pass.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What do you know about them?
EN: Uh, what does anyone know about them? Big... flying machines, right? Crazy helicopters. {quietly}So weird.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Huh. {trying to think of a plausible lie}Good question. Must have been in a book.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did.
EN: Fantastic. Now the only influential person who gave a damn about Westside is gone. Great job.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did.
EN: In case I'm not laying down enough sarcasm, you just screwed up the lives of a bunch of struggling people.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {irritated}I guess that means you don't have to apologize to all of the people in Westside you just screwed over.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: In case you weren't paying attention, you killed the only person who ever gave a damn about them.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would end like this.
EN: {sighing, pause}Neither did Anderson.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Of course.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you say so. I'm not arguing.
EN: I do say so. The Followers aren't a military organization. If anyone knew what he was up to, they weren't talking.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you say so. I'm not arguing.
EN: And if they knew he was stealing water, so what? Westside has more of a right to that water than the NCR.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Right. "The Followers don't endorse his actions," and all that.
EN: Well {emph}I don't. I'm sure there were a few people turning a blind eye, but can you blame them?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Right. "The Followers don't endorse his actions," and all that.
EN: NCR's sharecropper farms had all of the water. The nearest fresh source is the lake, and that's a bit of a hike.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: See you around.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Me, specifically? No. I'm sure Julie Farkas does, though. Lab coat, pointy hair. Answers to the name "Julie Farkas," strangely enough.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I'm sure she can find something for you to do. It might be kind of... depressing and terrible, though. {cah-WEE-aht sah-mahr-ee-TAH-noos, "Samaritan, beware."}Caveat Samaritanus.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Personally, no. But thanks to you, Julie says we're a lot better off these days. I'll take her word for it. So, thanks.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: Then that means I can cast McNamara down for giving those secret orders to my Paladins! Well done! That's exactly what I was looking for!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: That is the standard procedure, yes. For example, McNamara gives orders to Head Scribe Taggart, who then relays further orders to the scribes.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: I wasn't aware that failing to do so was punishable, however. Interesting...

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: If we can just find an instance where McNamara went around someone and gave orders to their subordinates, we'll have him.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Did you know there's a second part to it?
EN: Second part? What are you talking about?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: One of the few times an Elder was dismissed was due to it.
EN: I could be wrong, but I think that's a dead end. McNamara's always followed orders, and we've been incommunicado since fleeing HELIOS.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about the Chain That Binds?
EN: I could hardly call myself Head Paladin if I didn't. It's one of the first things every initiate learns when they start training. What about it?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: {Increasingly angry}Just as I thought, McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me. The nerve of that man!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: This little stunt is probably what got them killed in the first place. Our normal patrol routes are known to be relatively safe.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: This is exactly what I've been looking for! McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me, thereby breaking the Chain That Binds!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: With this, I can finally have him removed as Elder, and end this ridiculous lockdown.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: This is exactly the kind of thing I'm trying to avoid by ousting McNamara.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I wanted to ask you some other questions.
EN: If you must.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: The filtration system? He wouldn't have you looking if we didn't need those parts badly, which means that system's in real trouble.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: If the air filters go, it will become impossible to breathe down here. We'd be forced to evacuate the bunker!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: I can't believe he's kept something like this to himself! We should have every able-bodied person in the chapter working on this.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: All the more reason for you to find a way to get McNamara out of that chair, before he dooms us all.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
EN: That's a sensible notion. Your familiarity with the nearby terrain makes you perfect as a liason.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
EN: I've been trying to get the Elder to send out scouts for years, and he's always been resistant to the idea. Said they'd be a vulnerability.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
EN: I wonder what changed his mind.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: Yes, I know the loss of the patrols has weighed heavily on his mind for some time. He took it very personally when they first went missing.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: That was when I first began to seriously question his ability to lead us. A commander has to be able to deal with the potential loss of his men.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: It's strange that he would ask you to find mission discs on them, however. The missing paladins were all on standard patrols, which don't need them.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: Only Brothers sent on special assignments are given mission discs. If you should find any on the lost patrols, let me know.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: I wanted to ask you some questions.
EN: Sure, what about?

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: No, I haven't found any of them yet.
EN: I don't want to rush you or anything, but time is of the essence. Please try to find those components as soon as you can.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: It's amazing that you've found any of them and not gotten gruesomely mangled. Keep up the good work!

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
ActorNotes: [Had serious doubts the player could do it]
EN: {Had serious doubts the player could do it}Really? I mean, that's great! I knew you could do it all along. I'll get right to work installing these.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Why don't you go tell the Elder the good news. I'm sure it'll be a huge load off of his shoulders.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: The items I'll need to keep the system running are a differential pressure controller, a reverse pulse cleaner, and several {HEP-uh} HEPA cartridge filters.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: At present, my best guess for finding the items would be to search any of the old vaults in the area.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Those vaults were usually built much like these military bunkers, even using the same contractors in their constructions at times.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I'll mark the vaults' locations on your map. Best of luck to you.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: No, I heard you quite clearly. You're being sent off to be killed like the others.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: {scornful, with a little hysteria}You think you're the first person the Elder's trusted with this? He sent three of our patrols out looking for those components, and they're all dead.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I was the one who supplied the Elder with the location of possible sites where we could find the components, so their deaths are my fault.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: {speaking somewhat quickly, nervous}And now it's your turn. Well, don't say you weren't warned. I won't take the blame when you die horribly. But I can tell you're getting impatient.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: The Elder wants me to retrieve components to help fix the air filtration system.
EN: {Beat}...So now I'm going to have your death on my conscience, too. Great.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: The device that creates the sandstorms above, that masks our comings and goings, was only intended to be used in case of emergencies.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It was never meant to be used with any regularity, and the other systems here were not designed to accommodate such usage.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In particular, the air filtration system simply cannot handle the quantity of sand and grit that it's been forced to cope with these last few years.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As a result, the system is failing, albeit slowly. I'm told we have scant few months before it shuts down completely.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Should that happen, it will quickly become impossible to breathe here in the bunker. Already the air quality begins to slightly worsen.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Just tell me what you want me to do.
EN: I would like you to find the components we need to fix this bunker's air filtration system. I cannot overstate the importance of this task.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Just tell me what you want me to do.
EN: See Senior Knight Lorenzo for the details. He's the one who brought the matter to my attention, and the only other person who is aware of it.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
EN: That's an old, old principle that's been around since the Brotherhood was founded. It basically means that you have to obey a superior officer.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
EN: It's pretty much common sense, but it gets invoked a lot when people get pissy about following orders.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
EN: If you're curious, I'll give you access to the datastore entry on it. You'd probably be the first to read it in years, if not decades.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?
EN: Well, you'd have to get a senior-level member of the chapter to unlock a topic for you. I've given you access to what I can, but that's not much.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?
EN: The majority of topics fall under Ramos's aegis, since they'd constitute a security risk. Good luck getting anything out of him.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?
EN: You might have better luck with another member of the senior staff. Try talking to them about it.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: He was going to leave if he couldn't get his radio working. So I destroyed it.
EN: I see. And he's not particularly likely to come back, since he's learned that the bunkers here aren't secure enough to serve as safehouses.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: He was going to leave if he couldn't get his radio working. So I destroyed it.
EN: It's not a foolproof solution, but indirect methods rarely are. What matters is that you drove him off without alerting him to our presence.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I convinced him that staying here was more dangerous than moving on.
EN: Yes, you exploited his fear of Powder Gangers very effectively. The collar includes a microphone, you see. Part of the test.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I convinced him that staying here was more dangerous than moving on.
EN: He'll keep his distance, setting ambushes, never suspecting that these bunkers house something far more dangerous to him than criminals. Well-played.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: What? Let me see that.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: What? That's great. I'll have to check it out when I head back tonight.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: The desert can play tricks on a man's mind. Don't let it bother you overmuch.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
EN: You're a strange one, aren'tcha? Fine, what did you want to talk about?

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: I'll be. Let me take a look at that.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: All this is, is a slave collar. Seen plenty of these infernal contraptions in my day, and I know just how to spring 'em. Hold still.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: There, it's off. Now thing is, a slave collar seems a little too basic for the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: That's not to say I don't believe you, {but}bu- did you just hear something?

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: I'll be. Let me take a look at that.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: All this is, is a slave collar. Seen plenty of these infernal contraptions in my day, and I know just how to spring 'em. Hold still.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: There, it's off. Now thing is, a slave collar seems a little too basic for the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: How about this explosive collar around my neck?
EN: That's not to say I don't believe you, just that maybe you got your facts mixed up a little. Let's head back to my camp and go over what you saw.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood of Steel has a base inside one of the bunkers here. They sent me after you.
EN: {Disbelief, thinks player's crazy}A Brotherhood base? Here? Are you shitting me? No one's seen them for years.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood of Steel has a base inside one of the bunkers here. They sent me after you.
EN: I don't suppose you've got a scrap of evidence to support this wild-eyed claim of yours?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Dobson's my name. I'm an NCR Ranger, operating out of Camp McCarran north of here. Redding man by birth, though.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Well, I was thinking I might set this bunker up as a safehouse. Between the remote location and the dust storms, I figured it was ideal.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: 'Course, seems a lot less remote since you showed up. Plus I haven't been able to get my radio working, and a safehouse's no good without one.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: I reckon I'll stick around awhile, patrol for troublemakers, see if I can get that radio working.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Well, I thought I might set up a safehouse in one of the bunkers here. Between the remote location and the dust storms, I figured it was ideal.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: 'Course, seems a lot less remote since you showed up. Plus I haven't been able to get my radio working, and a safehouse's no good without one.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: I reckon I'll stick around awhile, patrol for troublemakers, see if I can get that radio working.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: You have to get out of here.
EN: Now why would I do that? You see some powder gangers on the approach or something?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: I see. Well, I'll take that under advisement.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You've seen that with your own two eyes?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Goddamn, I knew Cooke's gang passed through these parts 'bout that frequently, but I didn't know they holed up here.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Be a rude awakening, to find fifteen of those merciless bastards looking down at me snoozing on my bedroll!

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Yep, I'd be better off setting up an ambush along one of their routes to catch stragglers. Thanks for the information. You may've saved my life.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> Powder gangers use these bunkers as hideouts once or twice a month.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: [FAILED] See now, thing is, I fancy myself a bit of a tracker. And I don't see much in the way of tracks 'round here.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Could say that's on account of the dust storms. But if there were criminals using these bunkers as hideouts, I'd know.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Well, criminals come through here. And the storms, they're bad. Right?

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: This seems like a bad location for a safehouse.
EN: Oh? And in your expert opinion, why would that be?

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: Actually, I rigged your radio with a bomb.
EN: Well, at least you're man enough to admit it. Now get the hell out of here. If I see you again, it'll be through my rifle's sight.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Okay, but if I find you messing with it again, there'll be hell to pay, you hear me?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Didn't look like nothing to me. Draw!

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Just kidding. You weren't doing any harm that I could see. So what do you think? Can it be fixed?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Didn't look like nothing to me. Draw!

Speaker: Dobson
EN: I've been trying to get that damn thing working for days, and you decided to just start tinkering with it? Let me see that.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I was just trying to fix it.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I've been trying to get that damn thing working for days, and you think you fixed it in a few minutes? Let me see that.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: [Lie] I just fixed it.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: [FAILED] The hell you did. I know enough about electronics to know that what you were doing wasn't fixing it.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: So I'll give you one more chance to tell me what you were doing.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: [Lie] I just fixed it.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Hey, what are you doing to my radio?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: You just had to go messing with my radio again, didn't you?

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Criminal scum that've infested this region, attacking caravans and regular folk just passing through.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: The dangerous ones are roamers, though there's another group that mostly stays put, over at the prison southwest of here.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: The NCR mounted an attack not long ago but they just used regular troops - no rangers - so that didn't amount to anything.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Criminal scum that've infested this region, attacking caravans and regular folk just passing through.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: The dangerous ones are roamers, though there's another group that mostly stays put, over at the prison southwest of here.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: So far the brass haven't mustered up enough men to take the prison back. Long overdue if you ask me. But I'm just one man.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Criminal scum that've infested this region, attacking caravans and regular folk just passing through.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: The dangerous ones are roamers, though there's another group that mostly stays put, over at the prison southwest of here.

Speaker: Dobson
EN: Or so they did, 'til NCR brass finally mustered up enough troops to take out the trash. Wish I could've been there.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: So no one knows you're here?
EN: Standard practice. Rangers operate on our own most of the time. And that's how we like it.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: So no one knows you're here?
EN: Usually we call in our positions to McCarran to be relayed to other rangers, but I can handle myself.

Speaker: Dobson
Topic_Name: So no one knows you're here?
EN: I'm sure as hell not going to lose any sleep on account of a goddamn broken down radio. But it will shorten my stay if I can't fix it.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: It was a complete accident, I swear.
EN: Accident or no, we both now find ourselves in an uncomfortable situation.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: No, what I told your man before was the truth. I don't like repeating myself.
EN: I applaud your commitment to your own word, though it saddens me to hear of the fate of our comrades.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Actually, I'd rather just be going. If I could just have my belongings back...
EN: I'm afraid that's not a possibility at the moment. Let's just say that your eventual safe departure from here relies on how forthcoming you are.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Actually, I'd rather just be going. If I could just have my belongings back...
EN: That said, I'd like you to tell me why you're here.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I found one of your patrols out in the waste. Your men are dead.
EN: That is sad news, indeed, and I thank you for making your way here to convey it to us, but now the issue remains that an outsider knows our location.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
EN: What did you have in mind?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Look, the Followers have had enough of a role in the misery that this area has had to endure.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If you want to go off half-cocked and leave a trail of corpses in your wake, that's your business. We'll do our best to clean up your mess.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Just don't try to drag us into it personally, okay?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you like to come with me? I could use someone skilled in medicine.
EN: Hmm... I'm starting to remember hearing some rumors about you and this crazy guy called "Caesar." Bad. Not a friend of the Followers.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you like to come with me? I could use someone skilled in medicine.
EN: Maybe they're not all true. That's enough for me to stand here and talk to you, but I'm not about to leave Freeside as your comrade-in-arms.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you like to come with me? I could use someone skilled in medicine.
EN: You've helped the Followers, so you can't be entirely bad. To be honest, I haven't heard anyone say a negative word about you.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you like to come with me? I could use someone skilled in medicine.
EN: As long as you keep working to help people around here get a fair shake, sure, I'll lend a hand.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you like to come with me? I could use someone skilled in medicine.
EN: You helped the Followers, but your reputation isn't exactly spotless. How do I know you're not going to lose it out there?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you like to come with me? I could use someone skilled in medicine.
EN: Here's my proposition. If you want to work together to help the people around here, I'll lend a hand. {on the other hand}If you start acting like a crazy waster...

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Would you reconsider my offer to travel with me? I could really use your help.
EN: The last time we discussed this, you didn't exactly wow me with your pitch. What have you got for me this time?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Certainly.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Where did you get your medical training?
EN: The Followers taught me everything I know about medicine. Despite our humble abode here in New Vegas, we have great facilities back in the NCR.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Where did you get your medical training?
EN: We may have over extended ourselves by setting up camp in Freeside, but the people here need help from someone. If not us, who?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: How did you join the Followers?
EN: Honestly, it isn't too difficult if you have half a brain and aren't a complete jerk. I wanted to help people and I enjoyed learning, so I signed up.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: How did you join the Followers?
EN: New Vegas is in trouble, so I came out here. If someone doesn't step up and try to help the people here, it's going to end very badly.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you always deflect personal questions?
EN: Only to obfuscate my past association with a fascist paramilitary organization.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you always deflect personal questions?
EN: I'm joking, of course. I will deflect personal questions at any opportunity.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'll keep an eye on it.
EN: Safety first. That's all I'm saying.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That sounds a little paranoid, Arcade.
EN: Does it? {beat, quietly}Does it?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: It's... {sigh}a thing. A science thing. It hurts robots. Don't worry about it. Silly Arcade's just telling magnetic field jokes for his own amusement.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {clears throat}Ahem. Shall we?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Fine, ignore me. Just don't ask me to re-attach your arm when your pet murder machine goes into "search and destroy" mode.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: It just seems a little twitchy. Some of these robots, you look at them the wrong way, don't screw in a vacuum tube right...

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: The next thing you know you're a pile of ash on the floor and someone's stepping out of a vertibird to sweep your remains into a Nuka-Cola bottle.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: You have quite the menagerie at your disposal. If you can get the posse down to "small gang" size, I'll happily go with you.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: As the old saying goes, two's company, but three's a small army. Okay, I'm paraphrasing a bit, but you get the idea.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: A courier, a doctor, and cybernetic dog. After we deal with this whole "imminent conquest of New Vegas" problem we should open an act at the Tops.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: There's something about that robot that doesn't seem... all right to me. I'm not saying we shouldn't take it with us.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: I'm just saying that if it were to fall into Lake Mead and be irreparably damaged... and if you threw an EMP grenade in after it...

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: Well, there are worse things happening in the world, right?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: After spending thirty years of my life hiding my association with the Enclave, I'd {emph}love to stroll the wasteland with a twitchy Eyebot.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: Thanks for asking. I appreciate it. I do.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: Back in your good graces again? I knew you'd see the light.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {joking}I thought my charm could win you over, but I guess it wasn't meant to be. Are you sure you want me to go?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: All right, I'll head back to the Old Mormon Fort. If you need me, just swing by.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Ugh. I guess that means I have to go back to that creepy mausoleum Mr. House calls the Lucky 38.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I've been around a few unsettling places in my life, but that place takes the cake.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Anyway, if you need me, you know where to find me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {sighing}Back to the tomb, I suppose.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {drifting off}If you need me, et cetera.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: You're helping the Legion, a slaving army that will almost certainly kill and enslave the majority of people in New Vegas.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: What? Did you expect me to applaud your efforts to support a deranged warlord?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: Caesar is bad. You are bad for helping him. Please stop.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: I have to say I don't understand where you're going with Mr. House. The man's been manipulating the locals for as long as anyone can remember.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: If you help him kick the NCR and Legion out, he's going to keep right on doing it. The people in Freeside will be just as bad off as they ever were.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: If you can find a way to push Mr. House out of the picture as well, I think everyone will be better off.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: Helping the NCR is better than helping Mr. House, but I don't think it's the best solution for the people in New Vegas.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: If the NCR can take full control of Freeside and the Strip, it's going to get worse before it gets better.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: Besides, even if New Vegas eventually gets representation in the NCR senate, it's not like the NCR runs efficiently.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: I think you're on the right track.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: The only way to ensure relative safety and independence for the people of New Vegas is to prevent others from taking control of the region.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: That means no NCR, no Mr. House, and no Legion.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: It could be better. If we can find a way to work toward the independence of New Vegas, that would be ideal.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: But really, as long as you don't help out the Legion, anything's better than that.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I'm really very boring. You'd get better stories out of a Freeside junkie.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {surprised}Oh. {beat}After spilling my guts to you, I wasn't expecting that kind of a response but... I understand.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If you change your mind, let me know. It would mean a lot to me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: Great! {excited}I'd like you to talk to the old-timers, the Remnants. I don't think I can convince them by myself. To them, I'm still a kid.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: But you're a big part of what's happening out here. When you talk to them, they'll understand how important this all is.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: I've kept in contact with them over the years, so I know where you can find them, but I doubt they'll open up to you unless I come along.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: I know I'm not always the most serious guy around, but this means a lot to me. Thanks.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you want them to help NCR?
EN: That's a hard question to answer. I know I don't want the Legion to take Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you want them to help NCR?
EN: So militarily, yes, I want them to help NCR. If possible, I'd like to figure out a way to help the NCR win Hoover Dam without holding New Vegas.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Where are you going with all this?
EN: The Enclave did a lot of bad things, but there were good people at Navarro. Good people with a lot of experience.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Where are you going with all this?
EN: Not many of them are alive anymore, but I think they could make a difference in the fight against Caesar.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: After the Enclave's command structure fell apart, it was only a matter of time before Navarro was overrun by NCR forces.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: My mother and I left with some of the troopers from my father's old unit, the same people I've kept in contact with over the years.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Anyone who didn't get out was killed by the NCR. Even some of the ones who escaped were eventually hunted down by the Brotherhood of Steel.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: A lot of different places. I only know what I was told. Some of them were cut down by the NCR and the Brotherhood. Some of them went east.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: My mother never told me what happened to my father, but she and I went south with some others and integrated into the NCR.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: When the NCR learned that Enclave personnel had integrated, we kept moving to the fringes. It's one of the reasons why I wound up out here.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Okay, I hear you. Forget I said anything. Consider it dropped.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Are you sure? I didn't even get to the ostensibly "good" part.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If you're sure, I won't bring it up again. We can just go on our merry way, fighting injustice in our typical fashion.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I wasn't always with the Followers, or with the NCR.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: My late father was an officer in a group called the Enclave, a remnant of America's Pre-War government.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Memories being short around here, not a whole lot of people remember them. But they did bad things. Terrorized communities, kidnapped people.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Eventually, someone stopped them. I was born a few years later at a military base on the coast, a place called Navarro.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {drawing the word out}Actually, I'm going to keep talking anyway. Sorry, but I really need to get this out.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Any day now, Caesar's going to try to march across Hoover Dam and kick NCR out of the Mojave.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: We're getting caught up in something important out here. Hell, after how you handled Benny, you're practically right in the middle of all this.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I know I'm just along for the ride, but it's made me think about the past, how I might be able to help out.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you don't like it, leave.
EN: Don't mind if I do. Enjoy your reign as King Scumbag the First, Overlord of Westside.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you don't like it, leave.
EN: Don't mind if I do. Enjoy your reign as Queen Scumbag the First, Overlord of Westside.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: They profit from crime, now I profit, too.
EN: {sickened}That's one way to look at it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It's just like other armor, but heavy, right?
EN: Not even close. Power armor isn't something you wear so much as {lightly stressed}use. It's a weapon in its own right, and takes skill to wield.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It's just like other armor, but heavy, right?
EN: If you don't know what you're doing, you won't even be able to walk with it on. So how about a bit of quick instruction?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Here, I'll show you. It's easy, once you get used to it. First, we'll start with putting it on...

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Actually, I already know how to use power armor.
EN: Do you now? If I didn't already owe you a great deal I'd be highly suspicious right now. You'll have to tell me about it sometime.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: ...There, I think you've got the hang of it now. You should be able to use any type of power armor you come across using what you just learned.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Very well, then. In addition to the armor, I've given the order that all of our arms and equipment be made available for your purchase.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Finally, while you are now a member of the Brotherhood, I cannot ask any more of you. I'm sure you have goals of your own outside these walls.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: You are free to come and go as you please, though I hope you'll return to us someday in a more permanent capacity.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I wish you the best, {outsider}outsid- {beat, catches himself}Brother.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: Well done. This is a small step in the right direction, but it's damn good to move forward again. Now, I believe congratulations are in order.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: It is my honor to bestow up on you the title of Paladin of the Brotherhood, for your meritorious service in its name.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: Normally, there'd be a ceremony and such, but everyone is too busy at the moment for such frivolity.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: I can give you this, however. Your very own suit of power armor. We can't spare our best, but I had the knights assemble this one for your use.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: Which reminds me, you don't even know how to use these, do you?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
EN: Hmph, I thought you were made of sterner stuff than that. The Brotherhood could use someone with your skills.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
EN: In any case, was there something else you wanted?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
EN: Now you're just wasting my time. When you make up your mind, let me know.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me what the task is before I agree to anything.
EN: Is that a waver of resolve I sense? The Brotherhood is not in the habit of taking on the timid.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Back when we were stationed at HELIOS, our scouts reported that a group was establishing itself in the area as a distributor of Pre-War weapons.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Our Elder at the time, Elijah, was too concerned with getting HELIOS running and fending off the NCR, so he ordered us to leave them alone.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It's time that we correct that oversight, and show this region that the Brotherhood is still a force to be reckoned with.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I want you to visit these weapons dealers, this Van Graff family, and make an example of them. Leave no one alive.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: When the job is done, report back and I'll arrange for a team to clean up the site and retrieve the weapons.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Yes, I thought you might, given how much time you've spent here.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: That's not usually a request we agree to. Typically, we take in the young, so that they might be trained through adolescence.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: In special cases, we allow exceptional individuals to conditionally join. Luckily for you, you happen to be exceptional.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: The condition is that you must complete a task. This task must prove beyond a shadow of a doubt that you have what it takes to join the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I happen to have something perfectly suitable in mind, though I warn you - it won't be easy. Still interested?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I want to join the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Had second thoughts, did you? We've made some progress since the lockdown was lifted, but the task I had in mind is still available if you want it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I wanted to ask about joining the Brotherhood again.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: While I can't dispute that you've earned our gratitude, I'm afraid you're going to have to be patient. Such a change takes time.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Stop back in a few days, and we can speak of this again. Now, I must be off. There is much to do!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Is there anything else for me to do?
EN: No, your role in this is done. The rest is up to us. There is much for me to do to make the transition as smooth as possible.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Is there anything else for me to do?
EN: Come back in a few days, and I should be firmly installed as Elder.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: There are a number of people I'll need to talk to. The process won't be instantaneous, but with this evidence, my path is clear.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It shouldn't take more than a few days, and then we can begin moving forward again.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you.
EN: Predecessor's records indicate matching item purchased by nervous man wearing metal collar.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
Topic_Name: I'm looking for an antique rangefinder somebody might've sold you.
EN: Records indicate man requested free lodging and was directed to concrete building in Freeside. Transmitting coordinates.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: How do you know so much about this, again?
EN: Stop thinking so much. Thanks.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: ...There, I think you've got the knack of it now. You should now be able to wear any kind of power armor you come across.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: I've also given the order that all of our equipment be made available to you, not just the more mundane arms.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: You're a member of the Brotherhood now, and your gear should reflect that.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Lastly, you will be allowed to come and go as you please. You've done so much for us that to do otherwise would be a crime.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: I just ask that you keep the Brotherhood's interests at heart in all your dealings. Remember that you will always have a home here.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Don't I just put it on?
EN: If only it were that simple. Think of power armor as a machine to be operated rather than clothing you'd wear.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Don't I just put it on?
EN: With a little instruction, using it becomes as natural as simple movement, but to the ignorant, it's just so much heavy junk.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Don't I just put it on?
EN: So let's bring you up to speed, shall we?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: First, let's go over how to put it on...

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I already know how to use power armor.
EN: Would you like to tell me where you learned such a thing?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I already know how to use power armor.
EN: No, don't bother. A person as well-traveled as yourself is bound to pick up all kinds of skills, I suppose. Luckily, that's not all I have for you.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: Yes, we've already started receiving telemetry from it. This will be a great help in our future efforts, and I thank you.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: Now then, it is my great honor to bestow upon you the title of Paladin of the Brotherhood, for meritorious service above and beyond the call of duty.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: I'm afraid a formal ceremony was out of the question given our current state, but I hope this will make up for it.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: I had the knights refurbish a suit of our power armor for your use. It's one of the earlier models, but it should serve you well.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: Now, I suppose I'm going to have to show you how to use it, aren't I?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm not really interested in joining the Brotherhood at the moment.
EN: Regrettable, but understandable. Should you change your mind, return here. I will hold off on assigning the task to my brethren, for now.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Do not hesitate, my friend. Learn from my mistake and go boldly, one way or the other.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As one of our patrols discovered, the mutants just to the northeast have become strangely violent in the years we were secluded.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: However, this turn of events could also be an opportunity. We mostly left the equipment of the communications array there alone, out of respect.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As the inhabitants have now proven themselves hostile, no more respect will accorded them. Making their equipment fair game.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: I want you to head up to the summit of Black Mountain and install this remote signal transmitter in one of their consoles.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It will allow us to tap into the radar and other detection systems running there, assuming they're still operational.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: If we're going to operate on the surface again, it would be nice to do so with as much information at our fingertips as possible. Good luck.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: You've certainly earned the right, but I'm afraid there's a slight matter of protocol that must be dealt with first.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Exceptional individuals, like yourself, {slightly stressed}are sometimes allowed to join the Brotherhood if they perform a valuable service for it.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: While your actions up to this point have been commendable, I'm afraid they don't quite qualify as such a service.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: However, I do have another task that fits the bill rather nicely. Would you consider undertaking it?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I want to join the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: The task I had in mind is still available, if you're up for it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Can I still join the Brotherhood?

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion
EN: Female, Evil Karma.

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion
EN: Female, Neutral Karma.

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion
EN: Female, Good Karma.

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion
EN: Male, Evil Karma.

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion
EN: Male, Neutral Karma.

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion
EN: Male, Good Karma.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: Watch yourself.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: Nothing I know of, {studies the player}but if you've come from the North, means you can travel freer than most around here.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: Might check the Barracks, someone might need you to hoof it somewhere. Just be careful if you go up on the roof - got a sniper watching the road.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: If you're gear's in need of repair, HQ's also worth checking out - talk to Major Knight, he can help. {Beat, to himself}Provided you got a pen and plenty of ink.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: Those two? Represents unification. {Beat, a little defeated}Mostly good for shade. Won't do much else when the Legion reaches us.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: Outpost, Mojave Outpost. Watching a lot of nothing, feels like a big Brahmin pen for caravans.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: They've been stopped for a while, waiting for the roads North to clear - or their clearance papers to go through.

Speaker: Sgt. Kilborn
EN: Look like you've walked a ways, so if you need to shake the dust off, head to the Barracks, the bar's there. {Beat, shrugs}Not much, but better than nothing.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about the battle at HELIOS.
EN: HELIOS was the worst goddamned action I've seen in a long, long career of fighting.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: Elijah was a strange one. His even becoming Elder was highly questionable, seeing as how he was a Scribe. Typically, only Paladins are eligible.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: But an exception was made in his case, on account of him being a genius. Unfortunately, whatever scientific acumen he had didn't extend to tactics.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: Trying to defend HELIOS was a blunder of the worst kind, and many brothers lost their lives because of it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: Many of the senior paladins, myself included, advised him to fight a retreating action, but he refused to budge. Said he almost "had it working".

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: We never did find out exactly what he was talking about. When the perimeter was finally overrun, the Elder had simply vanished.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What would you do if you became Elder?
EN: After lifting the lockdown, the first thing I'd do is send scouts out to recon the area. We need to know what's going on out there.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What would you do if you became Elder?
EN: Next, I'd resume patrols in the near vicinity, and begin sending search teams out to the spots the scouts reported were relatively safe.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What would you do if you became Elder?
EN: It's standard procedure when a chapter relocates to an area, but standard procedure wasn't our last Elder's style, either.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Why do you dislike McNamara so much?
EN: It's not that I dislike the Elder, but I strongly disapprove of his current style of leadership. We're safe, yes, but at what cost?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What do you think of the lockdown?
EN: It's a travesty, is what it is. Every second we sit on our hands down here is another second that we're not fulfilling our sworn duty.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: Yes, I've always known they were. Luckily, they don't know exactly where we are. And even if they did, our position here is fortified.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: And assuming they managed to breach the bunker, I would be forced to activate our failsafe system.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: Better we all die than allow the technology we have here to fall into such unworthy hands.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: The NCR is currently looking to destroy you.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: I suppose it was only a matter of time. I wonder if, given the NCR's current situation, they would consider a truce of sorts?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: We've given up our claim to HELIOS, and we don't have any interest in claiming Hoover Dam, so our ambitions are not at crossed purposes.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: Perhaps it's time for a new strategy. Go to the NCR commander and tell her the Brotherhood is willing to put aside our enmity for the time being.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: Further, tell her that we are willing to send troops to aid in their coming defense of the Dam. My guess is they're in no position to refuse.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: The NCR is currently looking to destroy you.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Did you know Hardin is trying to find a way to become Elder?
EN: Oh yes, he's been trying for quite some time. Hardin has been strongly opposed to the lockdown from the first. It goes against his nature, you see.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Did you know Hardin is trying to find a way to become Elder?
EN: Hardin's the type to fight to the last, and die rather than surrender. It's a good trait to have in a soldier, and a bad one to have in a leader.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Did you know Hardin is trying to find a way to become Elder?
EN: Don't let his actions bother you. He's only doing what he thinks is best for the chapter.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: We were overrun, plain and simple. My Brothers fought with great courage, but in the end the enemy was just too many.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: When the tide of the battle turned for the worse, our Elder was nowhere to be found, and everything was chaos.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: Fully half of our forces had already fallen. I gathered up those I could find and we fought our way here.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: This place had been briefly discussed as a fallback point, though at the time none really believed that could possibly become necessary.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: That's it, really. There was nothing glorious about the battle, just a nightmare of screams, blood, and death.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?
EN: That is this base's defensive system. It serves as camouflage and masks all entry and exit from the bunker.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?
EN: We use it to hide our patrols and supply runners, though we still send such out at night to be extra safe.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: All right. What did you wish to speak about?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We have some personnel that are allowed to travel on the surface. They trade for what we need, and occasionally drop off what they acquire.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We make sure that they only enter or leave the bunker while the sandstorm is active, to avoid detection.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It's a protective measure that was enacted after our defeat at HELIOS. The NCR was hot on our heels, and we wouldn't have survived another encounter.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It was decided that we would stay quiet for a time, heal the wounded, and try to come up with a new strategy.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: However, after we had fully recuperated, our first scouting measures showed that the NCR's presence in this region had only increased in our absence.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: There are now more than five times the number of NCR troops in the area as when we fought them, and we have half the number we did at HELIOS.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: And so the lockdown has been extended. To go outside would be the death of us all.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I must prepare myself before I go.
EN: Then be quick about it.

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [satisfied grunt - responding to the player's readiness]
Topic_Name: It will be an honor to fight for the Legion.
EN: {satisfied grunt - responding to the player's readiness}Good. {LATIN}{In the sign of the bull you will conquer}{En hock SIG-no Tor-OOS VINH-chase}"In hoc signo taurus vinces."

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: It will be an honor to fight for the Legion.
EN: Report to {Leh-GAH-tus LAH-nee-oos}Legatus Lanius immediately - he'll brief you on the plan of battle. Come back victorious, or don't come back.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: That was the plan. Bye.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Because you're helping Caesar's Legion. They are bad. You are bad. I am going. Bye.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Why are you crazy? That's a question for someone much wiser and more patient than myself.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: All I know is that you are a bad person and I don't want to be around you anymore. So if that was your goal, congratulations.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If not, I'm sorry to inform you that you are, as the locals say, "nuttier than a Bighorner dropping."

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you have a problem with me, why don't you just leave right now?
EN: If you insist. Have a nice life.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: That wasn't exactly the response I was hoping for, but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Seriously, though, watch it.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Sorry. I just lose my head sometimes.
EN: If by "sometimes" you mean "a lot of times," I agree. Please, just... settle down, okay?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them.
EN: They sure don't, but I hope you get everything that's coming to you.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: They hide behind NCR's protection and they deserve everything coming to them.
EN: Have a nice life.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That's a good way to put it.
EN: Sure, if you're a sociopath.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That's a good way to put it.
EN: {sickened}Enjoy the fruits of your labor.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice.
EN: How noble of you.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: More than collateral damage. A necessary sacrifice.
EN: Sorry, but I won't be sticking around to see if you have the courtesy to lay flowers on the mass grave that the Legion's going to dig for them.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub.
EN: Great! You're either unimaginably cruel or profoundly insane!

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Actually, yes, I would like to see New Vegas turned into a slavery hub.
EN: Either way, I'm not going to wait around for you to help the Legion roll across Hoover Dam. Bye.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The Legion is better than the alternative.
EN: What?! Caesar is going to enslave or kill everyone in the Mojave.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The Legion is better than the alternative.
EN: And when that's done, he'll try to destroy the NCR senate and install himself as its new military dictator.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The Legion is better than the alternative.
EN: I can't comprehend how Caesar could so extensively scramble your sense of morality to make you think the Legion is a better alternative to {emph}anything.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The Legion is better than the alternative.
EN: And you know what? I'm not going to stick around to try to figure it out. At least legionaries have the excuse of being born into it.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The Legion is better than the alternative.
EN: Have a nice life.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: NCR is broken beyond repair. Its time has come.
EN: If the NCR is broken, it will fail on its own.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
