Topic_Name: NCR is broken beyond repair. Its time has come.
EN: The people who live here don't deserve to be victims of your misguided attempts at political engineering.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: NCR is broken beyond repair. Its time has come.
EN: Or are they just collateral damage?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Yes, that's exactly what I'm suggesting.
EN: Okay. I just wanted you to confirm that I'm traveling in the company of an insane fascist. Thanks.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm just trying to be open-minded.
EN: It's a good thing to be, but you may want to close the floodgates once you see how Caesar runs things.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: With how messed up New Vegas is, do you really think Caesar has nothing to offer?
EN: At least the mess is ours to clean up.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: With how messed up New Vegas is, do you really think Caesar has nothing to offer?
EN: Wait a minute... am I going crazy or are you actually suggesting it might not be bad if the Legion takes over?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: In the words of Socrates, "Go fornicate yourself."

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
ActorNotes: ["The conquering cause pleased the gods, but the conquered cause pleased Cato" - week-treex cow-sah deh-ees plah-coo-eet sehd week-tah cah-toh-nee]
Topic_Name: The world needs Caesar more than it needs you.
EN: {"The conquering cause pleased the gods, but the conquered cause pleased Cato" - week-treex cow-sah deh-ees plah-coo-eet sehd week-tah cah-toh-nee}Victrix causa deis placuit sed victa Catoni.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: The world needs Caesar more than it needs you.
EN: {sadly}Goodbye, courier.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I thought you were interested in preserving life.
EN: I know I shouldn't place one life below another, but in Caesar's case, I'll make an exception.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I thought you were interested in preserving life.
EN: The whole "slavery and cultural annihilation" stance he's adopted is bit repugnant to me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I thought you were interested in preserving life.
EN: Though I guess what I think never really mattered much to you, did it?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: But in the end, doesn't it all just come down to numbers anyway?
EN: If you lose your humanity, then I suppose that is all that's left.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: It isn't enough to mean well if you don't do good. I'm sure Caesar meant well, too.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Good thing there are still people like you around.
EN: Kind of you to say, but there are better people than me around here. I just hope the Followers can make a difference in the long run.

Speaker: Mick and Ralph's Crier
EN: Come to Mick and Ralph's for all your shopping needs!

Speaker: Mick and Ralph's Crier
EN: If it can be bought, it can be found at Mick and Ralph's!

Speaker: Mick and Ralph's Crier
EN: We've got stuff we're not even allowed to sell, people. Only at Mick and Ralph's!

Speaker: Atomic Wrangler Crier
EN: Hungry? Thirsty? Horny? The Atomic Wrangler has you covered!

Speaker: Atomic Wrangler Crier
EN: Wanna get lucky? Head on down to the Atomic Wrangler!

Speaker: Atomic Wrangler Crier
EN: Make a brief stop at the Atomic Wrangler, where the booze is cheaper, the tables more friendly, and the women are just like the booze!

Speaker: Silver Rush Crier
EN: Come to the Silver Rush for all your energy weapon needs!

Speaker: Silver Rush Crier
EN: Lasers, plasma, pistols, grenades - we've got it all at the Silver Rush!

Speaker: Silver Rush Crier
EN: You want someone dead? {stressed}Really dead? Stop by the Silver Rush and we'll give you the means!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Veronica.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I hope you've been practicing your drills, Veronica. It's dangerous outside.

Speaker: Head Scribe Taggart
EN: Well, I {slightly stressed}have been working with some UV lights in the pods.

Speaker: Head Scribe Taggart
EN: Very funny, Veronica.

Speaker: Head Scribe Taggart
EN: Y-Yes. Well, it's, ah, nice to see you, too, Veronica.{it's not}

Speaker: Head Scribe Taggart
EN: Hmph.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
EN: Hmm? Oh, it's you, Veronica.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
EN: Yes, yes.

Speaker: Senior Scribe Schuler
EN: Quite well. Thank you for asking, Veronica.

Speaker: Knight Torres
EN: Can't complain. Not like there's anywhere else to go, right?

Speaker: Knight Torres
EN: With everyone getting to go to the surface, I'm a little jealous, but I'll be fine.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: Behave yourself this time, Veronica.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: Hey yourself, kiddo.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: {Dislikes her intensely}Veronica.

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: Still hiding that hair of yours, Veronica?

Speaker: Apprentice Watkins
EN: I'm surprised you're not wearing that hood to hide your hair like you usually do, Veronica.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpToResponses]
EN: Yeah, sounds cool.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpToResponses]
EN: Nah, I'm gonna be busy.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpToResponses]
EN: Maybe, depends on how my girl's feeling.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpTo]
EN: Nothing, man.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpTo]
EN: Just hanging out. Same as usual.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpTo]
EN: I was thinking of taking a walk a little later.

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpTo]
EN: I might be going scum-hunting later. You game?

Speaker: [Context: KingsUpTo]
EN: Nothing. Want to head to the Wrangler later?

Speaker: [Faction: vMojaveCivilianDialogueFaction]
EN: Stay safe.

Speaker: [Faction: vMojaveCivilianDialogueFaction]
Topic_Name: I'd like to see your wares.
EN: Sure. Here's what I've got.

Speaker: [Faction: VES08MojaveDuadz]
ActorNotes: [Screaming at soldiers that shoot them from a distance]
Quest_Name: Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity
EN: {Screaming at soldiers that shoot them from a distance}Fuck you, NCR thugs! This is our land, and you won't last here forever!

Speaker: [Faction: VES08MojaveDuadz]
Quest_Name: Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity
EN: {Alarmed}Oh shit! They saw us. Get out of here, quick!

Speaker: [Faction: VES08MojaveDuadz]
ActorNotes: [Whispering, trying not to be heard while sneaking]
Quest_Name: Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity
EN: {Whispering, trying not to be heard while sneaking}Hurry! We've got to get some before they notice us!

Speaker: [Faction: VES08NCRDuadz]
Quest_Name: Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity
EN: Screw it. Just shoot! They'll get the hint!

Speaker: [Faction: VES08NCRDuadz]
Quest_Name: Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity

Speaker: [Faction: VES08NCRDuadz]
Quest_Name: Encounters in Camp Golf and Vicinity
EN: Hey, look over there! It's those Mojave rats again, coming to take our water!

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: I could use some help with my gear.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Slight conspiratorial smile}Let me sign off on the work order for you, then.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: So is that a "no," you don't want to be friends, or...
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: I... would, perhaps some other time. When my orders take me to Vegas, perhaps. Wish things were different, but might take some time.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: Forget it, then, you're a waste of time.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Wait... wait a minute. Look. Some things in the NCR are... aren't ideal. But I want to help.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: Forget it, then, you're a waste of time.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Slight conspiratorial}If you need something repaired... let me know, I can sign the work order. As long as caps change hands, I can put them back in yours.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: Didn't realize NCR was so spineless.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Now wait a minute - Republic's a sight better than... other alternatives. Women are serving here, after all. The rest... well, might take some time.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: Didn't realize NCR was so spineless.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: And they're more accepting back West, like I said. In the meantime...

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Quieter, doesn't want to be overheard}This isn't the Republic. Oddly enough, Legion's a little more forgiving about... friendships. Out here, it's not as accepted.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Slightly apologetic}Not that I mind being friends, it's just being open about it in the Outpost... well, I have to work here.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: [Confirmed Bachelor] You didn't tell me your name.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Oh - Knight. {Frowns, a little uncomfortable}You must not be from around here. If so... it doesn't do to get too friendly.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Curious}Reinforcements? {Beat, to himself}About time we got some more hands around here.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Just need something for the log book, keeping tabs on traffic through the Outpost... {to himself}although mostly just in, not out these days.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: If you're looking for the commanding officer, he's in the back. Although... he's got a lot on his plate, so if you speak with him... keep it short.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Also, you need any gear checked, we can get you up and running again... once you fill out the work orders, and sign for the parts, of course.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: Never mind, I'll be going now.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Dismissive goodbye}Fine, then.

Speaker: Lacey
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Dismissive}Work around here? Might check with Jackson in the main building. Or Ghost up on the roof above, but watch out, she's... well, she's kind of a bitch.

Speaker: Lacey
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Backpedals}Don't tell her I said that, though. {Beat, to herself}Might take a bullet some night when I'm going to the latrine.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Shrugs}Not too much, lot of caravans going nowhere. {Beat}Lot of troopers going nowhere, too.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Few prospectors here and there, but... {shrug}they don't do more than stink up the place.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Everybody's backed up here. {Scoffs}You think it'd be good for business, but most of the traders are tight with the caps, even the larger caravan outfits.

Speaker: Lacey
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: All right, go on - let's put our cards down.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: I was hoping to pass the time with a game or two.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: What, Caravan? All right, I'll give it a go. {Shrugs}Haven't exactly got much of a line of folks to serve.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: What do you have for trade?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Take a look.

Speaker: Lacey
Topic_Name: What do you have for trade?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Skeptical, player's bad news}For you? I'm not sure I want to be seen dealing with you... {changes tune}but if you're willing to pay a little extra...

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Hold on a second. I need to talk to you about something else.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I've been wondering about Daisy and the others for so long, I still haven't figured out what I should do.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I mean, I'm not like them. I was born at Navarro and my father served with them, but I wasn't really part of the Enclave.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: It seems presumptuous of me to think that I could join the fight, even if this is a cause worth fighting for.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Because I know when fighting breaks out at the dam, all hell is going to break loose in Freeside. They're going to need every doctor they can get.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That's their story Arcade, not yours.
EN: Oh, I know. I was only a boy when they went through hell together. I'm glad you're helping me reunite them.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That's their story Arcade, not yours.
EN: Even if I'm still just a spectator in all of this, I know they can still do some good.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Sometimes I wonder how much of my father they see in me. They went through a lot together, but my family went through it, too.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I'm glad they've watched out for me all these years. Maybe someday I can return the favor.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: It seems pointless to do all of that without a goal.
EN: I'm sure Henry has goals. He was just more concerned with the "how" than the "why" of things. Being in the Enclave didn't really mean much to him.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: It seems pointless to do all of that without a goal.
EN: I guess I'm lucky that I'm part of the Followers. Helping people as a doctor is important, but with the Followers, it feels different.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: It seems pointless to do all of that without a goal.
EN: It feels like we're working toward something more important. That's more than the sum of good deeds that we do.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: His work was what mattered to him.
EN: Not everyone dreams of being a revolutionary, I suppose. Maybe we can't all change the world.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: His work was what mattered to him.
EN: Maybe it's enough just to do good for the short time that we're here. No one's going to sing Doc Henry's praises when he's gone.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: His work was what mattered to him.
EN: But he's probably saved more lives than I ever will.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why worry about it? You don't have to be your father.
EN: I grew up without him. I'll always feel like something is missing from my life. But you're right.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why worry about it? You don't have to be your father.
EN: It's not like I'm the only kid in the wasteland who's grown up without a dad. Johnson always said my father was a good man.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why worry about it? You don't have to be your father.
EN: If that's the only thing about me that's like him, that's enough for me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm sure your father would be proud of you.
EN: I wonder if he would. It's pointless, I know, but sometimes I wonder what he wanted me to be.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm sure your father would be proud of you.
EN: Maybe being a doctor in the middle of Nevada wasn't exactly what he had in mind for his little boy.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Some people can't stop reliving their glory days.
EN: Not much glory in the Enclave. Most of her old comrades are long gone.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Some people can't stop reliving their glory days.
EN: I know life as a salvager can't compare to being a vertibird pilot but... at least it's life. That has to count for something.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: It was an important part of her life. Why shouldn't she enjoy it?
EN: As screwed up as it sounds, at least she was part of something. Granted, it was something... admittedly, pretty bad, but it was something.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: It was an important part of her life. Why shouldn't she enjoy it?
EN: If you spent the first half of your life flying Enclave troopers in a vertibird, I suppose picking over Pre-War rocket parts doesn't quite compare.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: A man should know when to let go.
EN: It's been decades, you know. By now, he's been out of the Enclave longer than he was in.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: A man should know when to let go.
EN: Most people know when to hang it up and start over. But not Moreno.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Don't be too hard on him. It's part of who he is.
EN: I suppose you're right. When you're part of something for that long, maybe it's impossible to let go without losing part of yourself.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Don't be too hard on him. It's part of who he is.
EN: Moreno may be a stubborn son of a bitch, but at least he's loyal.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {having some difficulty speaking}Never this... bad before.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Is this the first time you've experienced sudden onset headaches?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: [FAILED] {fighting through the pain}What's it look like, you asshole?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Does your head hurt?

Speaker: Caesar

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What happens in Freeside won't make any difference if the Legion takes the dam. Fight with them.
EN: There's something I need to go do, but I'll catch up with you later. Thanks again for your help with the others. It means a lot to me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What happens in Freeside won't make any difference if the Legion takes the dam. Fight with them.
EN: I'm surprised to hear you say that. I thought you had a problem with people who hold on to the past.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What happens in Freeside won't make any difference if the Legion takes the dam. Fight with them.
EN: Suiting up to fight against Caesar with the Navarro veterans seems like... I don't know, like a kid playing dress up in his father's clothes.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you're so sure it's going to be a bloodbath, maybe you should stay in Freeside.
EN: I figured you'd say that. Sometimes staying put is the best thing you can do.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you're so sure it's going to be a bloodbath, maybe you should stay in Freeside.
EN: I'll leave the fighting to the old warhorses. It's what they were made for.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you're so sure it's going to be a bloodbath, maybe you should stay in Freeside.
EN: I need to go take care of something before I set up at Freeside. I'll see you soon. And again, thanks for your help with the others.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you're so sure it's going to be a bloodbath, maybe you should stay in Freeside.
EN: I honestly didn't expect you to say that. When I talked to you about Daisy and the others, you seemed to put a lot of value in loyalty to the past.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you're so sure it's going to be a bloodbath, maybe you should stay in Freeside.
EN: What's changed since then?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Time for the NCR to roast.
EN: Oh, to hell with this!

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'm thinking I'm going to get a sweet Pre-War laser. What are you thinking?
EN: I'm thinking that I'm leaving because you are a sociopath. Good riddance.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Oh, uh... whoops, I thought that was to turn it off.
EN: Argh, you moron! You're going to kill all of the troopers down there!

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Oh, uh... whoops, I thought that was to turn it off.
EN: That's it. I'm out. Good luck getting out of this place without being shot to pieces by NCR soldiers, assuming they aren't going to fry to death.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Yeah, exactly. They don't.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You can always use more power, right?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Redundancy. If Caesar takes the dam and cuts off power, it will be chaos all over New Vegas.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {nervous}O... kay.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why not to the whole area equally?
EN: NCR troops control Hoover Dam. Why do they need {emph}more power?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Great. Glad we're on the same page.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I mean, I didn't expect that you'd want to... activate the super weapon or anything.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {nervous}Heh.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: All right.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {sounds reasonable}All right.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Okay, okay, you don't have to agree with me {emph}that much.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why don't you like talking about yourself?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why don't you like talking about yourself?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Arcade, I'm asking you because I'm interested. Don't put yourself down.
EN: Oh, all right. I'm thirty-ish. {admitting}Well, late thirties. I was born... {guarded}west of here. I was an only child and spent most of my time with my mother.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Arcade, I'm asking you because I'm interested. Don't put yourself down.
EN: My father died when I was young and I never got over it. Oh... and I like medicine and reading books about failed Pre-War socioeconomic policies.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Arcade, I'm asking you because I'm interested. Don't put yourself down.
EN: {a bit of sarcasm}Right now, I'm sure you're asking yourself, "Why hasn't some lucky man scooped this bachelor off his feet?" {serious}Like I said, I'm boring.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You can do better than that.
EN: No, really. Have you ever snorted a ground up Cazador venom sac? Neither have I, but I can guarantee you that a Freeside junkie {emph.}has.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What will you do if Caesar wins?
EN: {melancholy}What the Followers always do. Whatever we can.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What do you think the others will do at Hoover Dam?
EN: I don't think you need to worry about the specifics. Basically, expect a lot of firepower and dead bodies.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What do you think the others will do at Hoover Dam?
EN: Enclave technology is even more advanced than Brotherhood equipment, and in the hands of soldiers as experienced as Moreno and the others...

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What do you think the others will do at Hoover Dam?
EN: Let's just say it's truly a sight to behold.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I don't think either of us can fully understand what he and the tribes have gone through.
EN: A fair point, but from the perspective of someone on the east side of Arizona, the man is clearly out of his mind.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I don't think either of us can fully understand what he and the tribes have gone through.
EN: Maybe he didn't intend for things to wind up this way, but that doesn't mean he needs to perpetuate this bizarre anachronistic myth.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I don't think either of us can fully understand what he and the tribes have gone through.
EN: And it doesn't mean that we should sit by and nod our heads at every absurd faux-Roman {kah-soos beh-lee, "case of war"}casus belli he can dream up.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I don't think either of us can fully understand what he and the tribes have gone through.
EN: He's a tyrant. The bad kind. And there's no way we're letting him take Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: He's a madman. What did you expect?
EN: Well, yeah! Right. What {emph}did I expect? The man's a megalomaniac. He acts like this is some pre-ordained cycle we're returning to.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: He's a madman. What did you expect?
EN: Of all the people who could learn from our past mistakes, he goes and throws all of our knowledge off of a cliff.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: He's a madman. What did you expect?
EN: Instead of trying to learn from the past, he re-creates it, runs back over the same old barren ground.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: He seemed pretty smart to me.
EN: Being "smart" doesn't matter if you're insane. Everything makes sense to Caesar because he's twisted everything to his world view.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: He seemed pretty smart to me.
EN: He's Caesar reincarnated, the NCR is the corrupt Roman senate. I wouldn't be surprised if he thought the Colorado River were the new Rubicon.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: He seemed pretty smart to me.
EN: He abdicates responsibility to a myth of historical inevitability. But he's {emph}not Caesar. This isn't Rome. {defiantly}And he isn't going to get away with this.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Of course, Caesar! You can hardly even hold his men responsible, given how they're practically raised to worship him as a living deity.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: What's the point of surviving the war? Why did the founders of the Followers crawl their way out of vaults to bring knowledge back to the wasteland?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: So we could act like the last two thousand years didn't happen? Play dress up so we can fight ancient wars all over again?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {defiantly}No way is he getting away with this. I'm not letting it happen. You're not letting it happen.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That was just talk. It's not the same for you.
EN: No, I think it {emph.}is the same for me. Maybe for a different reason, but... you can't hold on to a past you've never had.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That was just talk. It's not the same for you.
EN: For better or worse, I am not my father. I never had a life with the Enclave, and it would be silly for me to try to start one now.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That was just talk. It's not the same for you.
EN: I'll stay with you until the Legion moves on the dam, but once the attack starts, I'm going to have to go to back to Freeside. It's where I belong.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: That was just talk. It's not the same for you.
EN: I need to take care of something, but I'll see you soon enough. Thanks for all of the help. It means a lot to me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be.
EN: True enough. Maybe I can't fill my father's shoes. I wouldn't even know how.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be.
EN: But if following in his footsteps for a while means I can do some good out here, I will do my best.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be.
EN: I need to go do something. I won't be gone long, but I'll catch up with you later. Thanks for your help with the others. It means a lot to me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I am, but they're still my family. I think you were right the first time. If there's something I can do to help hold the dam, I'll do it.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Look, there's something I have to do, but I promise I'll be back in a while. Trust me. And thanks again for your help. It means a lot to me.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You were born at Navarro, but you are your own man. They have their fight, and you have yours.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You were born at Navarro, but you are your own man. They have their fight, and you have yours.
EN: Back to Freeside it is. I need to make a stop before I settle in. I'll be back in a while. Thanks again for your help. It means a lot to me.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 1}War. War never changes.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 2}When atomic fire consumed the earth, those who survived did so in great underground vaults.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 2}When they opened, their inhabitants set out across the ruins of the Old World to build new societies, establishing villages, forming tribes.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 3}As decades passed, what {slight emphasis}had been the American southwest united

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 3}beneath the flag of the New California Republic, dedicated to Old World values of democracy and the rule of law.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 4}As the Republic grew, so did its needs. Scouts spread east, seeking territory and wealth in the dry and merciless expanse of the Mojave desert.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 4}They returned with tales of a city untouched by the warheads that had scorched the rest of the world - and a great wall spanning the Colorado River.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 5}The NCR mobilized its army and sent it east, to occupy Hoover Dam and restore it to working condition.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 5}But across the Colorado, another society had arisen, under a different flag.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 5}A vast army of slaves forged from the conquest of 86 tribes - Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 6}Four years have passed since the Republic held the dam - just barely - against the Legion's onslaught. The Legion did not retreat.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 6}Across the river, it gathers strength. Camp fires burn, training drums beat.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 7}Through it all, the New Vegas Strip has stayed open for business, under the control of its mysterious overseer, Mr. House,

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 7}and his army of rehabilitated tribals and police robots.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 8}You are a Courier, hired by the Mojave Express to deliver a package to the New Vegas Strip.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 8}What seemed like a simple delivery job has taken a turn for the worse.
